It provides call center operations, clinical alerting and notifications, one-way and advanced two-way wireless messaging services, mobile communications and public safety solutions. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Spok Holdings, Inc. 從事提供通訊解決方案。它提供呼叫中心運營、臨床警報和通知、單向和高級雙向無線訊息服務、行動通訊和公共安全解決方案。該公司成立於 1965 年，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. engages in the provision of robotic-assisted surgical solutions and invasive care through a comprehensive ecosystem of products and services. Its products include Da Vinci Surgical and Ion Endoluminal systems. The company was founded by Frederic H. Moll, John Gordon Freund, and Robert G. Younge in November 1995 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. 透過全面的產品和服務生態系統提供機器人輔助手術解決方案和侵入性護理。其產品包括達文西手術系統和離子腔內系統。該公司由 Frederic H. Moll、John Gordon Freund 和 Robert G. Younge 於 1995 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Biotechnology seeks daily investment results that correspond to two times (2x) the daily performance of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index. The fund invests in financial instruments that ProShare Advisors believes, in combination, should produce daily returns consistent with the fund's investment objective. The index is a modified capitalization weighted index that includes securities of Nasdaq listed companies that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Ultra Nasdaq Biotechnology 寻求相当于纳斯达克生物技术指数每日表现两倍 (2x) 的每日投资结果。該基金投資於 ProShare Advisors 認為綜合起來應產生與基金投資目標一致的每日回報的金融工具。该指数是修改后的资本加权指数，包括纳斯达克上市公司的证券，这些公司被分类为生物技术或制药。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: American Battery Technology Co. is a technology company, which engages in the development and marketing of lithium-ion batteries. Its projects include recycling plant, United States Advanced Battery Consortium (USABC), and Tonopah flats. The company was founded on October 6, 2011 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: 美國電池科技有限公司是一家從事鋰離子電池研發和行銷的科技公司。其項目包括回收廠、美國先進電池聯盟 (USABC) 和托諾帕公寓。該公司成立於2011年10月6日，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc. is a commercial-stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the provision of development and commercialization of therapies for the treatment of neurological disorders. Its product, WAKIX, is a molecule with a novel mechanism of action designed to increase histamine signaling in the brain by binding to H3 receptors. The company was founded by Jeffrey S. Aronin on July 25, 2017 and is headquartered in Plymouth Meeting, PA.
info.description_zh: Harmony Biosciences Holdings, Inc.是一家商業階段的製藥公司，從事神經系統疾病治療方法的開發和商業化。其產品 WAKIX 是一種具有新穎作用機制的分子，旨在透過與 H3 受體結合來增強大腦中的組織胺訊號傳導。該公司由 Jeffrey S. Aronin 於 2017 年 7 月 25 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州普利茅斯米廷。

info.description: ARS Core Equity Portfolio ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities or ETFs that provide exposure to equity securities. For purposes of the fund's 80% policy, the managers define equity securities as common stock or securities with similar characteristics, including American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 核心股票投資組合 ETF 旨在實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於股本證券或提供股本證券敞口的ETF。就基金的 80% 政策而言，管理人將股本證券定義為普通股或具有類似特徵的證券，包括美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: CXApp, Inc. engages in the provision of workplace experience solutions. Its solutions are used in workplace experience, employee engagement, desk and meeting room reservations, workplace analytics, occupancy management, content delivery, corporate communications and notifications, event management, live indoor mapping, and wayfinding and navigation. The company was founded on September 19, 2022 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: CXApp, Inc. 致力於提供工作場所體驗解決方案。其解決方案用於工作場所體驗、員工敬業度、辦公桌和會議室預訂、工作場所分析、佔用管理、內容交付、企業通訊和通知、活動管理、即時室內測繪以及尋路和導航。該公司成立於 2022 年 9 月 19 日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Rezolve AI Plc operates in the mobile commerce industry with its cutting-edge engagement platform powered by artificial intelligence and machine learning. It develops AI-based mobile commerce and engagement solutions, simplifying the purchasing process by providing relevant information and facilitating seamless transactions with a single tap. The firm enables retailers, brands, and manufacturers to create dynamic connections with consumers across mobile and desktop devices. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Rezolve AI Plc 憑藉其由人工智慧和機器學習提供支援的尖端參與平台，在行動商務產業開展業務。它開發基於人工智慧的行動商務和參與解決方案，透過提供相關資訊並透過點擊促進無縫交易來簡化購買流程。該公司使零售商、品牌和製造商能夠透過行動和桌面設備與消費者建立動態聯繫。該公司成立於2016年，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: StepStone Group, Inc. is a private markets investment firm. It focuses on providing customized investment solutions and advisory and data services to clients. The firm serves public and private defined benefit and defined contribution pension funds, sovereign wealth funds and insurance companies, prominent endowments, foundations, family offices and private wealth clients, which include high-net-worth and mass affluent individuals. The company was founded by Monte M. Brem, Jose A. Fernandez, Steve R. Mitchell, Thomas Porter Keck, and Robert A. Waldo in January 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 行健資本集團 (StepStone Group, Inc.) 是一家私募市場投資公司。它專注於為客戶提供客製化的投資解決方案以及諮詢和數據服務。該公司為公共和私人固定福利和固定繳款退休基金、主權財富基金和保險公司、知名捐贈基金、基金會、家族辦公室和私人財富客戶（其中包括高淨值和大眾富裕人士）提供服務。該公司由 Monte M. Brem、Jose A. Fernandez、Steve R. Mitchell、Thomas Porter Keck 和 Robert A. Waldo 於 2007 年 1 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Qorvo, Inc. provides semiconductor solutions for RF and power. The firm combines product and technology leadership, systems-level expertise, and global manufacturing scale to quickly solve its customers' most complex technical challenges. Qorvo serves diverse high-growth segments of large global markets, including consumer electronics, smart home/IoT, automotive, EVs, battery-powered appliances, network infrastructure, healthcare, and aerospace/defense. It operates through the following segments: High Performance Analog (HPA), Connectivity and Sensors Group (CSG), and Advanced Cellular Group (ACG). The HPA segment supplies RF and power management solutions for infrastructure, defense and aerospace, automotive power, and other markets. The CSG segment supplies connectivity and sensor components and systems featuring multiple technologies such as UWB, Matter, Bluetooth Low Energy, Zigbee, Thread, Wi-Fi, cellular IoT and MEMS-/BAW-based sensors. The ACG segment supplies cellular RF solutions for smartphones, wearables, laptops, tablets, and various other devices. The company was formed following the merger of RF Micro Devices, founded in 2015, and TriQuint Semiconductor, incorporated in 1981. It is headquartered in Greensboro, NC.
info.description_zh: Qorvo, Inc. 提供射頻和電源半導體解決方案。該公司將產品和技術領先地位、系統級專業知識和全球製造規模相結合，能夠快速解決客戶最複雜的技術挑戰。 Qorvo 為全球大型市場的不同高成長細分市場提供服務，包括消費性電子產品、智慧家庭/物聯網、汽車、電動車、電池供電設備、網路基礎設施、醫療保健和航空航天/國防。該公司透過以下部門營運：高性能類比部門 (HPA)、連接和感測器部門 (CSG) 以及高級蜂窩部門 (ACG)。 HPA 部門為基礎設施、國防和航空航太、汽車電源和其他市場提供射頻和電源管理解決方案。 CSG 部門提供採用多種技術的連接和感測器組件和系統，例如 UWB、Matter、低功耗藍牙、Zigbee、Thread、Wi-Fi、蜂窩物聯網和基於 MEMS/BAW 的感測器。 ACG 部門為智慧型手機、穿戴式裝置、筆記型電腦、平板電腦和各種其他裝置提供蜂巢式射頻解決方案。該公司由成立於 2015 年的 RF Micro Devices 和成立於 1981 年的 TriQuint Semiconductor 合併而成。總部位於北卡羅來納州格林斯伯勒。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility XLE ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility XLE Index (the "Index"). The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the net asset value of a portfolio of securities of companies in the energy sector of the large-cap U.S. equity market. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility XLE ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility XLE 指數（「指數」）表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤美國大型股票市場能源產業公司證券投資組合的資產淨值。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long UBER Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Uber Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: UBER). The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the underlying stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long UBER Daily ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 Uber Technologies, Inc.（NYSE：UBER）普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍（200%）。基金將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Coherent Corp. engages in the development, refinement, manufacturing, and marketing of engineered materials, opto-electronic components and devices, and lasers for use in the industrial, communications, electronics, and instrumentation markets. It operates through the following segments: Networking, Materials, and Lasers. The Networking segment leverages compound semiconductor technology platforms and deep knowledge of end-user applications. The Materials segment markets engineered materials and optoelectronic devices. The Lasers segment serves industrial customers in semiconductor capital equipment, display capital equipment, precision manufacturing, and aerospace and defense, as well as instrumentation customers in life sciences and scientific research. The company was founded by Carl J. Johnson in 1971 and is headquartered in Saxonburg, PA.
info.description_zh: Coherent Corp. 從事工業、通訊、電子和儀器儀表市場使用的工程材料、光電元件和設備以及雷射的開發、精煉、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：網路、材料和雷射。網路部門利用複合半導體技術平台和對最終用戶應用的深入了解。材料部門銷售工程材料和光電設備。雷射部門為半導體資本設備、顯示資本設備、精密製造、航空航太和國防領域的工業客戶以及生命科學和科學研究領域的儀器客戶提供服務。該公司由 Carl J. Johnson 於 1971 年創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州薩克森堡。

info.description: Malibu Boats, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of recreational powerboats. The firm offers performance sport boats, sterndrive, and outboard boats under the Malibu, Axis, Pursuit, Maverick, Cobia, Pathfinder, Hewes, and Cobalt brands. It operates through the following segments: Malibu, Saltwater Fishing, and Cobalt. The Malibu segment is involved in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of Malibu and Axis performance sports boats. The Saltwater Fishing segment includes manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of Pursuit boats and the Maverick Boat Group boats. The Cobalt segment participates in the manufacturing, distribution, marketing, and sale of Cobalt boats. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Loudon, TN.
info.description_zh: Malibu Boats, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事休閒動力艇的設計、製造和行銷。該公司提供 Malibu、Axis、Pursuit、Maverick、Cobia、Pathfinder、Hewes 和 Cobalt 品牌的高性能運動船、尾機驅動船和舷外船。該公司透過以下部門運作：Malibu、鹹水捕魚和Cobalt。 Malibu 部門從事 Malibu 和 Axis 高性能運動艇的製造、分銷、行銷和銷售。鹹水釣魚部門包括 Pursuit 船和 Maverick Boat Group 船的製造、分銷、行銷和銷售。鈷部門參與鈷船的製造、分銷、行銷和銷售。該公司成立於 1982 年，總部位於田納西州勞登。

info.description: Arcturus Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. operates as a late-stage clinical mRNA medicines and vaccine company, which engages in the development of infectious disease vaccines and significant opportunities within liver and respiratory rare diseases. Its products include LUNAR-COV19, LUNAR-FLU, LUNAR-OTC, and LUNAR-CF. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Arcturus Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. 是一家後期臨床 mRNA 藥物和疫苗公司，致力於傳染病疫苗的開發以及肝臟和呼吸道罕見疾病領域的重大機會。其產品包括LUNAR-COV19、LUNAR-FLU、LUNAR-OTC和LUNAR-CF。該公司成立於 2013 年，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: VanEck Biotech ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the MVIS US Listed Biotech 25 Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The Biotech Index includes common stocks and depositary receipts of U.S. exchange-listed companies in the biotechnology industry. Such companies may include medium-capitalization companies and foreign companies that are listed on a U.S. exchange. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: VanEck Biotech ETF 尋求盡可能接近複製未計費用和支出之前的 MVIS 美國上市生物科技 25 指數的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。生技指數包括美國交易所上市公司生技產業的普通股和存託憑證。此類公司可能包括中等資本公司和在美國交易所上市的外國公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Mesoblast Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the research, development, and market of mesenchymal lineage adult stem cell technology platform. Its medicines target cardiovascular diseases, spine orthopedic disorders, oncology and hematology, immune-mediated, and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Silviu Itescu on June 8, 2004 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.description_zh: Mesoblast Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，從事間質成體幹細胞技術平台的研發和銷售。其藥物針對心血管疾病、脊椎骨科疾病、腫瘤學和血液學、免疫介導疾病和發炎性疾病。該公司由Silviu Itescu於2004年6月8日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: iShares Transition-Enabling Metals ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Clean Energy Transition Metals Index. The index measures the performance of a basket of exchange-traded metals futures contracts representing the underlying metals that are extensively used in a wide range of clean energy technologies, as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets, plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the same or similar metals futures contracts as the underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Transition-Eabling Metals ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 清潔能源過渡金屬指數的投資結果。該指數衡量一籃子交易所交易的金屬期貨合約的表現，這些合約代表了由 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的廣泛用於各種清潔能源技術的基礎金屬。該基金將至少 80% 的資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於與標的指數相同或相似的金屬期貨合約。

info.description: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield, before fees and expenses, of an equity index called the Indxx Metaverse Index (the "Index"). Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is comprised of companies that provide services and products that support the infrastructure and applications of the Metaverse. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust Indxx Metaverse ETF 尋求的結果通常與名為 Indxx Metaverse 指數（「指數」）的股票指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率相對應。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數由提供支援元宇宙基礎設施和應用程式的服務和產品的公司組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cabana Target Drawdown 10 ETF seeks to provide long-term growth within a targeted risk parameter. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective with limited volatility and reduced correlation to the overall performance of the equity markets by allocating its assets among the following five major asset classes - equities, fixed income securities, real estate, currencies, and commodities. The Sub-Adviser's target drawdown for the fund is 10%; however, there can be no assurance, and the fund, the Adviser, and the Sub-Adviser do not represent or guarantee, that this target will be maintained.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target Drawdown 10 ETF 尋求在目標風險參數範圍內提供長期成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過將資產配置在以下五個主要資產類別（股票、固定收益證券、房地產、貨幣和大宗商品）中，以有限的波動性並降低與股票市場整體表現的相關性來實現其投資目標。副顧問對該基金的目標提款是 10%；然而，不能保證，並且基金、顧問和副顧問也不聲明或保證這一目標將會得到維持。

info.description: Tempus AI, Inc. is a healthcare technology company, which engages in bringing artificial intelligence and machine learning to healthcare. It focuses on building platforms for oncology, neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease, and radiology. The company was founded by Eric Paul Lefkofsky in August 2015 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Tempus AI, Inc.是一家醫療保健技術公司，致力於將人工智慧和機器學習引入醫療保健領域。它專注於建立腫瘤學、神經精神病學、心臟病學、傳染病學和放射學的平台。該公司由 Eric Paul Lefkofsky 於 2015 年 8 月創立，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Thrivent International Small Cap ETF provides exposure to a well-diversified portfolio of small-capitalization equity securities issued by companies in non-U.S. developed markets across growth, value, and core investment styles. The Fund utilizes an active strategy combining quantitative analysis and fundamental research to seek long-term capital appreciation from international developed small-cap equities relative to its benchmark, the MSCI EAFE Small Cap Index.
info.description_zh: Thrivent International Small Cap ETF 提供非美國已開發市場公司發行的多元化小型股證券投資組合，涵蓋成長型、價值型和核心投資風格。該基金採用定量分析和基本面研究相結合的積極策略，從國際發達小型股中尋求相對於其基準 MSCI EAFE 小型股指數的長期資本增值。

info.description: Xos, Inc. is a provider of energy storage and fleet electrification solutions. It develops battery-electric commercial vehicles and mobile power systems designed for rapid deployment charging and lower total cost of ownership compared to internal combustion engine vehicles. The company was founded by Dakota Semler and Giordano Sordoni on July 29, 2020 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Xos, Inc. 是一家能源儲存和車隊電氣化解決方案提供商。該公司開發電池電動商用車和行動電源系統，旨在實現快速部署充電並比內燃機車降低總擁有成本。該公司由 Dakota Semler 和 Giordano Sordoni 於 2020 年 7 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Vertex Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a global biotechnology company, which engages in the business of discovering, developing, manufacturing, and commercializing small molecule drugs for patients with serious diseases. The firm focuses on development and commercializing therapies for the treatment of cystic fibrosis, infectious diseases including viral infections such as influenza and bacterial infections, autoimmune diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis, cancer, inflammatory bowel disease and neurological disorders including pain and multiple sclerosis. The company was founded by Joshua S. Boger in 1989 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Vertex Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家全球生技公司，從事為嚴重疾病患者發現、開發、製造和商業化小分子藥物的業務。該公司專注於開發和商業化用於治療囊性纖維化、傳染病（包括流感和細菌感染等病毒感染）、自體免疫疾病（如類風濕性關節炎、癌症、發炎性腸道疾病和神經系統疾病（包括疼痛和多發性硬化症））的療法。該公司由 Joshua S. Boger 於 1989 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Unity Bancorp, Inc. is a bank holding company, which engages in the ownership and supervision of Unity Bank. The firm accepts personal and business checking accounts, time deposits, money market accounts, regular savings accounts, and demand and savings deposits. Its loan portfolio comprises credit cards, mortgage, home equity, and personal loans. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Clinton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Unity Bancorp, Inc.是一家銀行控股公司，擁有Unity Bank並對其進行監管。該公司接受個人和企業支票帳戶、定期存款、貨幣市場帳戶、定期儲蓄帳戶以及活期存款和儲蓄存款。其貸款組合包括信用卡、抵押貸款、房屋淨值和個人貸款。該公司成立於 1991 年，總部位於新澤西州克林頓。

info.description: Global X Telemedicine & Digital Health ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Telemedicine & Digital Health Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from further advances in the field of telemedicine and digital health, as well as applications thereof (collectively, "Telemedicine & Digital Health Companies"), as defined by Solactive AG, the provider of the index. The Adviser uses a "passive" or indexing approach to try to achieve the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 遠距醫療和數位健康 ETF 尋求提供與 Solactive 遠距醫療和數位健康指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司將受益於遠距醫療和數位健康及其應用領域的進一步發展（統稱為「遠距醫療和數位健康公司」），正如指數提供者 Solactive AG 所定義的那樣。顧問使用「被動」或指數化方法來嘗試實現基金的投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long LULU Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of LULU. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of LULU, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 LULU 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 LULU 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 LULU 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Intelligent Livermore ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund uses Intelligent Alpha, LLC's proprietary artificial intelligence-powered stock selection strategy to create an intelligent equal weight portfolio of global large cap stocks with over $1 billion in market capitalization. The securities selected will be based on the major trading trends inspired by the greatest traders in the world. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 智能利弗莫爾 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金採用Intelligent Alpha, LLC專有的人工智慧選股策略，創造出市值超過10億美元的全球大盤股的智慧等權重投資組合。所選的證券將基於受世界上最偉大的交易者啟發的主要交易趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Robotics & Artificial Intelligence ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global Robotics & Artificial Intelligence Thematic Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies in developed markets that are involved in the development of robotics and/or artificial intelligence as defined by Indxx, the provider of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 機器人和人工智慧 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 全球機器人和人工智慧主題指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該基礎指數旨在為已開發市場的交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司參與基礎指數供應商 Indxx 定義的機器人和/或人工智慧開發。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (TSM) ADR. By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the performance of the underlying leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST TSM ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤台積電 (TSM) ADR 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌期權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎槓桿 ETF 表現的曝險，但須遵守潛在投資收益的上限。

info.description: ARS Focused Opportunities Strategy ETF seeks to achieve long-term growth of capital and generate current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"), sub-advised by ARS Investment Partners, LLC (the "Sub-Adviser"). The fund invests either directly in the equity securities of companies the Sub-Adviser deems to be high-quality, defined by strong balance sheets, reasonable earnings growth, and above-average dividend yields with the prospect for dividend growth, or indirectly through one or more underlying ETFs, that have exposure to the same companies. The fund manager intends to invest across a variety of sectors. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ARS 聚焦機會策略 ETF 尋求實現資本的長期成長並產生當前收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 ARS Investment Partners, LLC（「副顧問」）提供次級顧問服務。該基金直接投資於副顧問認為高品質的公司的股本證券，這些公司的資產負債表強勁、盈利增長合理、股息收益率高於平均水平且有股息增長的前景，或者通過一隻或多只投資於同一公司的基礎 ETF 間接投資。基金經理人打算投資多個產業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Mobilicom Ltd. is an end-to-end provider of cyber security and smart solutions for drones, robotics and autonomous platforms. It designs, develops and delivers solutions targeting global drone, robotics and autonomous system manufacturers. The firm holds patented technology and know-how for Mobile Mesh networking. Its customers include corporates, governments and military departments. The company was founded by Oren Elkayam and Yossi Segal in 2006 and is headquartered in Shoham, Israel.
info.description_zh: Mobilicom Ltd. 是一家為無人機、機器人和自主平台提供網路安全和智慧解決方案的端到端供應商。它為全球無人機、機器人和自主系統製造商設計、開發和提供解決方案。該公司擁有行動網狀網路的專利技術和專有技術。其客戶包括企業、政府和軍事部門。該公司由 Oren Elkayam 和 Yossi Segal 於 2006 年創立，總部位於以色列 Shoham。

info.description: iShares Biotechnology ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Biotechnology Index composed of U.S.-listed equities in the biotechnology sector. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Biotechnology ETF 旨在追蹤由美國上市生技產業股票組成的 ICE 生技指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Nasdaq Biotechnology ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index . The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq compiles the underlying index, which is a modified market capitalization weighted index that is designed to measure the performance of securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market that are classified as either biotechnology or pharmaceutical companies. The index may include securities of large-, mid- and small-capitalization companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順納斯達克生物技術 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克生物技術指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。納斯達克嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制基礎指數，這是一種修改後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量在納斯達克股票市場上市的生物技術或製藥公司證券的業績。該指數可能包括大、中、小型公司的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Amana Growth ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital growth by investing at least 80% of its total net assets in growth-oriented common stocks of domestic and foreign companies selected in accordance with Islamic principles. The fund targets financially sustainable companies characterized by low debt, strong balance sheets, and robust management strength, applying past earnings and revenue growth rates alongside future expansion expectations to construct a non-diversified, large-cap focused portfolio.
info.description_zh: Amana Growth ETF是一檔主動式管理基金，透過將至少80%的總淨資產投資於根據伊斯蘭原則挑選的國內外公司的成長型普通股來尋求長期資本成長。該基金針對以低債務、穩健的資產負債表和強大的管理實力為特徵的財務可持續公司，利用過去的盈利和收入增長率以及未來的擴張預期來構建非多元化、以大盤股為重點的投資組合。

info.description: Allogene Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical stage immuno-oncology company pioneering the development and commercialization of genetically engineered allogeneic T cell therapies for the treatment of cancer. The firm develops a pipeline of off-the-shelf T cell product candidates that are designed to target and kill cancer cells. Its engineered T cells are allogeneic, which are derived from healthy donors for intended use in any patient. The company was founded by Arie S. Belldegrun, David D. Chang, David M. Tanen, and Joshua A. Kazam in November 2017 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Allogene Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家临床阶段免疫肿瘤学公司，率先开发和商业化用于治疗癌症的基因工程同种异体 T 细胞疗法。該公司開發了一系列現成的 T 細胞候選產品，旨在靶向和殺死癌細胞。其工程化 T 細胞是同種異體的，源自於健康捐贈者，可用於任何患者。该公司由 Arie S. Belldegrun、David D. Chang、David M. Tanen 和 Joshua A. Kazam 于 2017 年 11 月创立，总部位于加利福尼亚州南旧金山。

info.description: iShares MSCI EAFE Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI EAFE Small Cap Index composed of small-capitalization developed market equities, excluding the U.S. and Canada. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index represents the small-capitalization segment of the MSCI EAFE IMI Index.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI EAFE 小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤由小型開發市場股票（不包括美國和加拿大）組成的 MSCI EAFE 小型股指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數代表 MSCI EAFE IMI 指數的小型股部分。

info.description: AGM Group Holdings, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the provision of financial solutions. It focuses on the research and development of blockchain-oriented ASIC chip, production of encryption mining machines, and financial technology software services. Its products and services include technology hardware research and development, and assembling and sales of technology hardware. The company was founded by Zhen Tao Jiang and Wen Jie Tang on April 27, 2015 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: AGM Group Holdings, Inc.是一家提供金融解決方案的科技公司。專注於面向區塊鏈的ASIC晶片研發、加密礦機生產、金融科技軟體服務。其產品和服務包括技術硬體研發、技術硬體組裝和銷售。該公司由姜振濤和唐文傑於2015年4月27日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions U.S. Equity ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in U.S.-listed equity securities of companies that, in the Sub-Adviser's opinion, are primarily focused on building solutions to address climate change. It may invest in international companies, including those in emerging markets, through U.S. exchange-tradedADRs, however, they will not be considered U.S. equity securities for purposes of the fund's 80% policy.
info.description_zh: Carbon Collective Climate Solutions 美國股票 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過主要投資於美國上市公司的股本證券來實現其投資目標，副顧問認為這些公司主要致力於建立應對氣候變遷的解決方案。它可以透過美國交易所交易的美國存託憑證投資於國際公司，包括新興市場的公司，但是，就該基金的 80% 政策而言，它們不會被視為美國股票證券。

info.description: FST Corp. engages in the manufactures and sells golf club shafts, along with other golf-related items, to golf equipment brands, OEMs, distributors, and consumers via the KBS Golf Experience retail outlets. The firm equipment, marketed under the KBS brand, is utilized by golfers at all levels, including many professional players participating in the PGA and other major golf associations. Its product portfolio, retail presence, and golf-related services are part of a vertically integrated business model that has established the KBS brand on a global scale and created significant competitive advantages over peer brands. The growth strategies currently position it for expansion into under-tapped golf shaft markets. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Chiayi, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: FST Corp. 致力於製造高爾夫球桿桿身以及其他高爾夫相關產品，並透過 KBS Golf Experience 零售店向高爾夫裝備品牌、原始設備製造商、分銷商和消費者銷售。該公司的設備以 KBS 品牌銷售，供各個級別的高爾夫球手使用，其中包括許多參加 PGA 和其他主要高爾夫協會的職業球員。其產品組合、零售業務和高爾夫相關服務是垂直整合業務模式的一部分，該模式在全球範圍內建立了 KBS 品牌，並與同行品牌相比具有顯著的競爭優勢。目前的成長策略使其能夠擴展到尚未開發的高爾夫球桿市場。公司成立於1989年，總部位於台灣嘉義。

info.description: TE Connectivity Plc is a company that engages in the provision of connectivity and sensor solutions for the purpose of distribution of power, signal, and data. It operates under the following segments: Transportation Solutions, Industrial Solutions, and Communications Solutions. The Transportation Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, sensors, relays, antennas, and application tooling. The Industrial Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, interventional medical components, relays, heat shrink tubing, and wire and cable. The Communications Solutions segment include terminals and connector systems and components, antennas, and heat shrink tubing. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Galway, Ireland.
info.description_zh: TE Con​​nectivity Plc 是一家致力於提供用於電力、訊號和資料分配的連接和感測器解決方案的公司。它的業務分為以下幾個部門：運輸解決方案、工業解決方案和通訊解決方案。運輸解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、感測器、繼電器、天線和應用工具。工業解決方案部門包括端子和連接器系統及組件、介入醫療組件、繼電器、熱縮管以及電線和電纜。通訊解決方案部門包括終端和連接器系統及組件、天線和熱縮管。該公司成立於2007年，總部位於愛爾蘭戈爾韋。

info.description: Rigel Pharmaceuticals, Inc. operates as a clinical stage biotechnology company. It discovers and develops novel, targeted drugs in the therapeutic areas of immunology, oncology and immune oncology. The firm focuses on intracellular signalling pathways and related targets that are critical to disease mechanisms. The company's products include Tavalisse, Fostamatinib and R835. Rigel Pharmaceuticals was founded by Donald G. Payan, James M. Gower, Thomas A. Raffin, Garry P. Nolan and Ronald B. Garren on June 14, 1996 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Rigel Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物技術公司。它在免疫學、腫瘤學和免疫腫瘤學治療領域發現和開發新型標靶藥物。該公司專注於對疾病機制至關重要的細胞內訊號通路和相關標靶。該公司的產品包括Tavalisse、Fostamatinib和R835。 Rigel Pharmaceuticals 由 Donald G. Payan、James M. Gower、Thomas A. Raffin、Garry P. Nolan 和 Ronald B. Garren 於 1996 年 6 月 14 日創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Global X Internet of Things ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global Internet of Things Thematic Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies in developed markets that facilitate the Internet of Things industry, including companies involved in wearable technology, home automation, connected automotive technology, sensors, networking infrastructure/software, smart metering and energy control devices. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 物聯網 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 全球物聯網主題指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該指數旨在為已開發市場的交易所上市公司提供投資機會，促進物聯網產業的發展，包括涉及穿戴式技術、家庭自動化、連網汽車技術、感測器、網路基礎設施/軟體、智慧計量和能源控制設備的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Simplify Tax Aware Alternatives ETF seeks to achieve long-term capital appreciation by employing an unconstrained alternatives investment approach targeting asset classes with low correlation to traditional domestic equities and fixed income. The fund utilizes a flexible, opportunistic tactical allocation strategy to deploy its portfolio across global commodities, currencies, real estate related securities, specialized alternative ETFs, and privately offered debt, primarily executing these exposures via total return swaps and derivative instruments backed by U.S. Government short-term collateral.
info.description_zh: Simplify Tax Aware Alternatives ETF 尋求透過採用不受約束的另類投資方法來實現長期資本增值，目標是與傳統國內股票和固定收益相關性較低的資產類別。該基金採用靈活、機會主義的戰術配置策略，將其投資組合部署在全球大宗商品、貨幣、房地產相關證券、專門另類 ETF 和私募債務中，主要透過總回報掉期和由美國政府短期抵押品支持的衍生工具來執行這些風險敞口。

info.description: Rigetti Computing, Inc. provides full-stack quantum computing services. It serves global enterprise, government, and research clients through its Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services platform. The company was founded by Chad Rigetti in 2013 and is headquartered in Berkeley, CA.
info.description_zh: RigettiComputing,Inc.提供全端量子運算服務。它透過 Rigetti Quantum 雲端服務平台為全球企業、政府和研究客戶提供服務。該公司由 Chad Rigetti 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州柏克萊。

info.description: Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a diversified portfolio of convertible securities and high yield corporate bonds rated Ba or lower by Moody's or BB or lower by Standard & Poor's. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis with a focus on such factors as financial soundness, ability to make interest and dividend payments, earnings and cash-flow forecast, and quality of management to create its portfolio. Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund was formed on April 17, 2002 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封闭式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。它主要投資於穆迪Ba級或以下評級或標準普爾評級BB級或以下的可轉換證券和高收益公司債券的多元化投資組合。該基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，重點關注財務穩健性、支付利息和股息的能力、收益和現金流量預測以及創建投資組合的管理品質等因素。 Calamos Convertible Opportunities and Income Fund 成立于 2002 年 4 月 17 日，注册地为美国。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is the equal-weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes 100 of the largest U.S. and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ-100 等加權指數基金尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ-100 等加權 TM 指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克上市的 100 家最大的美國和國際非金融公司。

info.description: FormFactor, Inc. engages in the provision of test and measurement solutions. It operates through the Probe Cards and Systems segments. The Probe Cards segment consists of technologies and product architectures, including micro-electromechanical systems technologies. The Systems segment consists of analytical probe solutions for on-wafer probing, board tests, and package tests. The company was founded by Igor Khandros on April 15, 1993 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: FormFactor, Inc. 致力於提供測試和測量解決方案。它透過探針卡和系統部門運作。探針卡部分由技術和產品架構組成，包括微機電系統技術。系統部門包括用於晶圓探測、電路板測試和封裝測試的分析探針解決方案。該公司由 Igor Khandros 於 1993 年 4 月 15 日創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: iShares MSCI World Small-Cap ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI World Small Cap Index. The index is composed of small-capitalization developed market equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 世界小型股 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 世界小型股指數的投資結果。該指數由小盤發達市場股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。

info.description: Energous Corp. engages in the development of wireless charging technology. It focuses on the product, WattUp, a wireless power technology consisting of proprietary semiconductor chipsets, software controls, hardware designs, and antennas, that enables radio frequency based charging for electronic devices. The company was founded by Michael Aaron Leabman in 2012 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Energous Corp.從事無線充電技術的開發。它專注於產品 WattUp，這是一種無線充電技術，由專有的半導體晶片組、軟體控制、硬體設計和天線組成，可為電子設備提供基於射頻的充電。該公司由 Michael Aaron Leabman 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Technology ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive technology companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性技術 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性科技公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ Technology Dividend Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ Technology Dividend IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is owned and was developed by Nasdaq, Inc. (the "index provider"). The index includes up to 100 technology and telecommunications companies that pay a regular or common dividend. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ Technology Dividend Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與稱為 NASDAQ Technology Dividend IndexTM 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數由納斯達克公司（「指數提供者」）擁有並開發。該指數包括多達 100 家支付定期或普通股息的科技和電信公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Korro Bio, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of a new class of genetic medicines based on editing RNA. The company was founded by Nessan Bermingham, Jean-Francois B. Formela, Joshua Rosenthal, and Andrew Fraley in 2018 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Korro Bio, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於基於 RNA 編輯的新型基因藥物的發現、開發和商業化。該公司由 Nessan Bermingham、Jean-Francois B. Formela、Joshua Rosenthal 和 Andrew Fraley 於 2018 年創立，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Solana 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Solana 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Solana Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Solana so that the total value of the Solana to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和 Solana 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P Solana 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權報酬表現，其中 S&P 500 指數權重為 75%，S&P Solana 指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約 75% 的資產投資於構成 S&P 500 指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於 Solana，以便該基金所涉經濟風險的 Solana 總價值約為該基金資產的 25%。

info.description: Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. engages in the manufacture and development of security screening products. It also provides artificial intelligence-based security screening solutions for industries including casinos, industrial workplaces, schools, and ticketed venues. The company was founded by Anil R. Chitkara and Michael Philip Ellenbogen in July 2013 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Evolv Technologies Holdings, Inc. 從事安全檢查產品的製造和開發。它還為賭場、工業工作場所、學校和售票場所等行業提供基於人工智慧的安全檢查解決方案。該公司由 Anil R. Chitkara 和 Michael Philip Ellenbogen 於 2013 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Intuitive Machines, Inc. is a space exploration, infrastructure, and services company, which engages in contributing to the establishment of cislunar infrastructure and helping to develop cislunar and deep space commerce. It offers space products and services. The company was founded by Stephen J. Altemus, Kam Ghaffarian, and Timothy P. Crain in 2013 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Intuitive Machines, Inc.是一家太空探索、基礎設施和服務公司，致力於促進地月基礎設施的建設並幫助發展地月和深空商業。它提供太空產品和服務。該公司由 Stephen J. Altemus、Kam Ghaffarian 和 Timothy P. Crain 於 2013 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBoost PLTR ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Palantir Technologies Inc.'s common stock (NASDAQ: PLTR) by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBoost PLTR ETF 尋求透過出售槓桿交易所交易基金的選擇權來實現 2 倍 (200%) 的收入，該收入是透過出售 Palantir Technologies Inc. 普通股（NASDAQ:PLTR）選擇權產生的，該基金旨在實現基礎股票每日表現的 2 倍（200%），並獲得基礎槓桿的表現上限。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於以標的槓桿ETF作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 24, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aldabra 4 Liquidity Opportunity Vehicle, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月24日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a diversified portfolio of convertible securities and high yield corporate bonds rated Ba or lower by Moody's or BB or lower by Standard & Poor's. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund was formed on March 12, 2003 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。其主要投資於穆迪評級為Ba或更低、標準普爾評級為BB或更低的可轉換證券和高收益公司債券的多元化投資組合。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Calamos Convertible and High Income Fund 成立於 2003 年 3 月 12 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: AXS Change Finance ESG ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Change Finance Diversified Impact U.S. Large Cap Fossil Fuel Free Index. The index measures the performance of an equal-weighted portfolio of approximately 100 large-, mid-capitalization equity securities of U.S.-listed companies. The fund adviser attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The adviser expects that, over time, the correlation between the fund's performance and that of the index will be 95% or better.
info.description_zh: AXS Change Finance ESG ETF 旨在追蹤 Change Finance 多元化影響美國大盤無化石燃料指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數衡量約 100 隻美國上市公司大中型股票證券的等權重投資組合的表現。基金顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該顧問預計，隨著時間的推移，基金績效與指數績效之間的相關性將達到 95% 或更高。

info.description: Pono Capital Four, Inc. is a blank check company formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, and reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 2, 2026 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, KY.
info.description_zh: Pono Capital Four, Inc. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買和重組。該公司成立於2026年1月2日，總部位於肯塔基州大開曼島。

info.description: Direxion NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index Shares seeks investment results before fees and expenses that track the NASDAQ-100 Equal Weighted Index. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its assets in the securities that comprise the index or investments with economic characteristics similar to the securities included in the index. The index is the equal weighted version of the NASDAQ-100 Index which includes approximately 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the NASDAQ Stock Market based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion NASDAQ-100 等權重指數股票尋求追蹤 NASDAQ-100 等權重指數的未計費用和開支的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的資產投資於指數所包含的證券或與指數所包含的證券具有相似經濟特徵的投資。該指數是 NASDAQ-100 指數的等權重版本，其中包括按市值計算在納斯達克股票市場上市的約 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares MSCI ACWI ex U.S. ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA Index composed of large- and mid-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI ACWI（美國除外）ETF 旨在追蹤由大中型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI（美國除外）指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 500 Large Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Large Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Large Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 500 大盤指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Victoryshares Westend U.S. Sector ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its total assets in U.S. equity securities of companies that are classified in one or more of the following sectors published by The GICS: (1) Communication Services; (2) Consumer Discretionary; (3) Consumer Staples; (4) Energy; (5) Financials; (6) Health Care; (7) Industrials; (8) Information Technology; (9) Materials; (10) Real Estate; and (11) Utilities.
info.description_zh: Victoryshares Westend 美國板塊 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於 GICS 公佈的屬於以下一個或多個行業的公司的美國股本證券： (1) 通訊服務； (2) 非必需消費品； (3) 必需消費品；（4） 能源； (5) 財務； (6) 醫療保健； (3) 必需消費品；(4) 能源； (5) 財務； (6) 醫療保健資訊； (7) 工業材料（10）；

info.description: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. Its business objective is purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 01, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: K2 Capital Acquisition Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。其業務目標是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組。該公司成立於2025年8月1日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: Primis Financial Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services through its subsidiary Sonabank. The firm focuses on making loans secured primarily by commercial real estate and other types of secured and unsecured commercial loans to small and medium-sized businesses in a number of industries, as well as loans to individuals for a variety of purposes. It also invests in real estate related securities, including collateralized mortgage obligations and agency mortgage backed securities. The company was founded by Georgia S. Derrico and R. Roderick Porter in July 28, 2004 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: Primis Financial Corp. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 Sonabank 提供金融服務。該公司專注於向多個行業的中小型企業提供主要以商業房地產和其他類型的有擔保和無擔保商業貸款為擔保的貸款，以及為各種目的的個人提供貸款。它還投資於房地產相關證券，包括抵押貸款抵押債券和機構抵押貸款支持證券。該公司由 Georgia S. Derrico 和 R. Roderick Porter 於 2004 年 7 月 28 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: T.Rowe Price Short Municipal Income ETF seeks high current income exempt from federal income taxes. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal securities whose income is exempt from federal income taxes. Any derivatives that provide exposure to the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, or to one or more market risk factors associated with the investment focus suggested by the fund's name, are counted (as applicable) toward compliance with the fund's 80% investment policy.
info.description_zh: T.Rowe Price 短期市政收入 ETF 尋求免除聯邦所得稅的高額當前收入。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於市政證券，其收入免徵聯邦所得稅。任何提供基金名稱所建議的投資重點或與基金名稱所建議的投資重點相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的衍生品，均被計入（如適用）以符合基金的 80% 投資政策。

info.description: iShares MSCI ACWI ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI composed of large- and mid-capitalization developed and emerging market equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI ACWI ETF 旨在追蹤由大中型已開發市場和新興市場股票組成的 MSCI ACWI 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家的綜合股市表現。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2029 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2029, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2029 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2029 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 2000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Growth Index that measures the investment return of small-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The fund advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 2000 Growth Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of small-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 2000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤Russell 2000 Growth Index的表現，該指數衡量美國小型成長股的投資回報。該基金顧問採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤 Russell 2000 成長指數的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國小型成長股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Communications ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive communications companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性通訊 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性通訊公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2029 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2029 (collectively, "2029 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2029 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2029 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）的投資組合（統稱為「2029 年債券」）的表現。

info.description: Roundhill Glp-1 & Weight Loss ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation. The fund's manager will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the equity securities of GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies or any derivative instruments (such as swap agreements or forward contracts) that utilize one or more GLP-1 & Weight Loss Companies as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Roundhill Glp-1 和減肥 ETF 旨在提供資本增值。基金管理人將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 GLP-1 和減肥公司的股本證券或利用一家或多家 GLP-1 和減肥公司作為參考資產的任何衍生工具（例如掉期協議或遠期合約）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco KBW High Dividend Yield Financial ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the KBW Nasdaq Financial Sector Dividend Yield IndexTM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is a modified-dividend yield-weighted index of companies principally engaged in the business of providing financial services and products, as determined by the index provider. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of financial companies with competitive dividend yields that are publicly-traded in the U.S.
info.description_zh: Invesco KBW 高股息殖利率金融 ETF 旨在追蹤 KBW 納斯達克金融部門股息殖利率指數™（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數是由指數提供者決定的主要從事提供金融服務和產品業務的公司的修正股息殖利率加權指數。該指數旨在追蹤在美國公開交易、股息殖利率具有競爭力的金融公司的表現。

info.description: iShares Fallen Angels USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg US High Yield Fallen Angel 3% Capped Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar denominated, high yield corporate bonds that were previously rated investment grade.
info.description_zh: iShares Fallen Angels 美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國高收益 Fallen Angel 3% 上限指數的投資結果，該指數由先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債券組成。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映先前被評為投資等級的以美元計價的高收益公司債的表現。

info.description: Eaton Vance Short Duration Income ETF seeks above-average total return over a market cycle of three to five years. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by primarily investing in a diversified portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated fixed income securities of varying maturities consistent with ordinarily seeking to maintain an average duration of approximately three years or less. The fund invests primarily in U.S. government securities, corporate bonds and mortgage- and asset-backed securities.
info.description_zh: 伊頓萬斯短期收益 ETF 尋求在三到五年的市場週期內高於平均的總回報。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過主要投資於不同期限的以美元計價的固定收益證券的多元化投資組合來實現其投資目標，並通常尋求保持約三年或更短的平均久期。該基金主要投資於美國政府證券、公司債以及抵押貸款和資產支持證券。

info.description: Global X Space Tech ETF invests in companies positioned to benefit from the commercialization of the global space economy, including developers of rocket launch systems, satellite-enabled telecommunications, and mission-critical space technology. The strategy utilizes a thematic approach to provide exposure to the space value chain, tracking an index of companies involved in space exploration, infrastructure, and next-generation space technologies.
info.description_zh: Global X Space Tech ETF 投資於能夠從全球太空經濟商業化中受益的公司，包括火箭發射系統、衛星電信和關鍵任務太空技術的開發人員。該策略採用主題方法來提供太空價值鏈的曝光，追蹤涉及太空探索、基礎設施和下一代太空技術的公司指數。

info.description: Nationwide Nasdaq-100 Risk-Managed Income ETF seeks current income with downside protection. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective principally by investing in a portfolio of the stocks included in the Nasdaq-100 Index and an options collar (i.e., a mix of written (sold) call options and long (bought) put options) on the Nasdaq-100. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in securities, or derivative instruments linked to securities, of companies that are included in the fund's reference index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 全國 Nasdaq-100 風險管理收益 ETF 尋求具有下行保護的當前收益。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過投資於納斯達克 100 指數中包含的股票組合和納斯達克 100 指數的選擇權項圈（即書面（賣出）買權和多頭（買入）看跌選擇權的組合）來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，至少80%的基金淨資產，加上用於投資目的的借款，將投資於基金參考指數中包含的公司的證券或與證券掛鉤的衍生性商品。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Insmed, Inc. is a global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for patients with rare diseases. Its focuses on Brensocatib, and Treprostinil Palmitil Inhalation Powder (TPIP) pipeline. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bridgewater, NJ.
info.description_zh: Insmed, Inc.是一家全球生物製藥公司，致力於罕見疾病患者療法的開發和商業化。其重點關注 Brensocatib 和曲前列素棕櫚油吸入粉劑 (TPIP) 管道。該公司成立於 1988 年，總部位於新澤西州布里奇沃特。

info.description: Sprott Lithium Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Lithium Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, or production of lithium. The index generally consists of from 40 to 50 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Lithium Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Lithium Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自鋰開採、勘探、開發或生產的公司的表現。該指數一般由 40 至 50 檔成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Medical segments. The Pharmaceutical segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products. The Medical segment manufactures, sources and distributes Cardinal Health branded medical, surgical, and laboratory products. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和醫療部門運作。製藥部門分銷品牌藥品和仿製藥、特殊藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。醫療部門生產、採購和分銷康德樂品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: McKesson Corp. engages in providing healthcare services. It operates through the following segments: North American Pharmaceutical, Oncology and Multispecialty, Prescription Technology Solutions (RxTS), and Medical-Surgical Solutions. The North American Pharmaceutical segment focuses on distribution of branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar and over-the-counter pharmaceutical drugs to customers in U.S. and Canada. The Oncology and Multispecialty segment includes provision of solutions that includes specialty drug distribution, group purchasing organizations, infusion services, direct to patient pharmacy capabilities, InspiroGene cell and gene therapy services, technology solutions, practice consulting services, and vaccine distribution. The RxTS segment focuses on solving medication access, affordability, and adherence challenges for patients by working across healthcare to connect patients, pharmacies, providers, pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, and biopharma companies. The Medical-Surgical Solutions segment provides medical-surgical supply distribution, logistics, and other services to healthcare providers. The company was founded by John McKesson and Charles Olcott in 1833 and is headquartered in Irving, TX.
info.description_zh: McKesson Corp. 從事提供醫療保健服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：北美製藥部門、腫瘤學和多專科部門、處方技術解決方案（RxTS）部門和醫療外科解決方案部門。北美製藥部門專注於向美國和加拿大的客戶分銷品牌藥品、仿製藥、特殊藥品、生物相似藥和非處方藥品。腫瘤學和多專科部門提供的解決方案包括特殊藥物分銷、團體採購組織、輸液服務、直接面向患者的藥房能力、InspiroGene 細胞和基因治療服務、技術解決方案、實踐諮詢服務和疫苗分銷。 RxTS 部門專注於透過跨醫療保健領域連接患者、藥房、提供者、藥品福利管理者、健康計劃和生物製藥公司，解決患者的藥物取得、負擔能力和依從性挑戰。醫療外科解決方案部門為醫療保健提供者提供醫療外科用品分銷、物流和其他服務。該公司由 John McKesson 和 Charles Olcott 於 1833 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州歐文。

info.description: Absci Corp. is the drug and target discovery company harnessing deep learning AI and synthetic biology to expand the therapeutic potential of proteins. It partners with pharma and biotech innovators to create the next generation of protein-based drugs. The company was founded by Sean McClain in 2011 and is headquartered in Vancouver, WA.
info.description_zh: Absci Corp. 是一家藥物和標靶發現公司，利用深度學習人工智慧和合成生物學來擴大蛋白質的治療潛力。它與製藥和生物技術創新者合作，創造下一代基於蛋白質的藥物。該公司由 Sean McClain 於 2011 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州溫哥華。

info.description: Addex Therapeutics Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of drugs for human health. It develops novel, orally available, and small molecule allosteric modulators for neurological disorders. Its pipeline includes Dipraglurant, ADX71149, GABAB PAM, mGlu7 NAM, mGlu2 NAM, mGlu4 PAM, and mGlu3 PAM. The company was founded by Vincent Mutel, Timothy Dyer, and Mark Epping-Jordan in 2002 and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
info.description_zh: Addex Therapeutics Ltd.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於人類健康藥物的開發。它開發用於神經系統疾病的新型口服小分子變構調節劑。其管道包括 Dipraglurant、ADX71149、GABAB PAM、mGlu7 NAM、mGlu2 NAM、mGlu4 PAM 和 mGlu3 PAM。該公司由 Vincent Mutel、Timothy Dyer 和 Mark Epping-Jordan 於 2002 年創立，總部位於瑞士日內瓦。

info.description: Alico, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the operations of agriculture, land management, and natural resources. It operates through the Alico Citrus, and Land Management and Other Operations segments. The Alico Citrus segment cultivates citrus trees to produce citrus for delivery to the processed and fresh citrus markets. The Land Management and Other Operations segment offers land leasing for recreational and grazing purposes, conservation, and mining activities. The company was founded on February 29, 1960 and is headquartered in Fort Myers, FL.
info.description_zh: Alico, Inc. 是一家控股公司，從事農業、土地管理和自然資源業務。它透過 Alico Citrus 以及土地管理和其他營運部門進行運作。 Alico Citrus 部門種植柑橘樹來生產柑橘，然後運送到加工和新鮮柑橘市場。土地管理和其他營運部門提供娛樂和放牧、保護和採礦活動的土地租賃。該公司成立於 1960 年 2 月 29 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁爾斯堡。

info.description: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF seeks to achieve long term capital appreciation. SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM"), the investment adviser to the fund, seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing the fund's assets based on a model portfolio provided by Bridgewater Associates, LP (the "Sub-Adviser" or "Bridgewater"), the investment sub-adviser to the fund.
info.description_zh: SPDR Bridgewater ALL Weather ETF 尋求實現長期資本增值。 SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（下稱「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）是該基金的投資顧問，旨在透過根據該基金的投資副顧問 Bridgewater Associates, LP（下稱「副顧問」或「Bridgewater」）提供的模型投資組合來投資基金資產，從而實現基金的投資目標。

info.description: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. operates as a blank check company. The company was founded on December 13, 2024 and is headquartered in Cornelius, NC.
info.description_zh: Alpha Modus Holdings, Inc. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。該公司成立於2024年12月13日，總部位於北卡羅來納州科尼利厄斯。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long BBAI Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of BBAI. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of BBAI, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 BBAI 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 BBAI 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 BBAI 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biotechnology company. It engages in the provision of structure-guided drug design with the goal of developing oral small-molecule and protein therapeutics to target difficult-to-treat rare diseases. The company was founded by William M. Spencer III, Charles E. Bugg, and John A. Montgomery in 1986 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: BioCryst Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家生技公司。它致力於提供結構指導的藥物設計，目標是開發口服小分子和蛋白質療法來治療難以治療的罕見疾病。該公司由 William M. Spencer III、Charles E. Bugg 和 John A. Montgomery 於 1986 年創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage oncology company developing MasterKey therapies that target families of oncogenic mutations in patients with cancer. The company's MasterKey therapies are designed to address a broad spectrum of genetically defined tumors, overcome resistance, minimize wild-type-mediated toxicities, and be brain-penetrant to treat central nervous system diseases. It is currently focused on advancing a Phase 2 NSCLC trial of BDTX-1535, a brain-penetrant, fourth-generation epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) MasterKey inhibitor targeting EGFR-mutant NSCLC and glioblastoma. The company was founded by David M. Epstein and Elizabeth Buck in 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Black Diamond Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤學公司，開發針對癌症患者致癌突變家族的 MasterKey 療法。該公司的 MasterKey 療法旨在解決廣泛的基因定義的腫瘤，克服抗藥性，最大限度地減少野生型介導的毒性，並具有腦滲透性以治療中樞神經系統疾病。該公司目前專注於推進 BDTX-1535 的 2 期 NSCLC 試驗，BDTX-1535 是一種針對 EGFR 突變 NSCLC 和膠質母細胞瘤的腦滲透性第四代表皮生長因子受體 (EGFR) MasterKey 抑制劑。該公司由 David M. Epstein 和 Elizabeth Buck 於 2014 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Bionano Genomics, Inc. is a life sciences instrumentation company, which focuses on the genome analysis space. The firm engages in the development and marketing of the Saphyr system, a platform for ultra-sensitive and ultra-specific structural variation detection that enables researchers and clinicians to accelerate the search for new diagnostics and therapeutic targets and to streamline cytogenetics. Its products include Saphyr, Bionano Chips, Bionano Prep Kits, and Bionano Data Solutions. The company was founded by Han Cao in January 2003 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Bionano Genomics, Inc. 是一家生命科學儀器公司，專注於基因組分析領域。該公司從事 Saphyr 系統的開發和行銷，該系統是一個超靈敏和超特異性結構變異檢測平台，使研究人員和臨床醫生能夠加速尋找新的診斷和治療標靶並簡化細胞遺傳學。其產品包括 Saphyr、Bionano 晶片、Bionano 製備套件和 Bionano 數據解決方案。該公司由曹韓於2003年1月創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2029 Treasury Bond ETF is a passively managed, non-diversified fixed-income strategy designed to track the performance of the ICE BulletShares US Treasury Bond 2029 Index by investing in U.S. dollar-denominated Treasury bonds maturing in the year 2029. The fund combines the structure of a defined-maturity investment with the liquidity of an exchange-traded vehicle, maintaining a systematic monthly rebalancing cycle and executing a mandatory cash liquidation and distribution on or about December 15, 2029
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2029 國債 ETF 是一種被動管理、非多元化的固定收益策略，旨在透過投資於 2029 年到期的美元計價國債來追蹤 ICE BulletShares 美國國債 2029 指數的表現。該基金將固定期限投資的結構與交易所交易工具的流動性相結合，維持系統性的每月再平衡週期並執行強制現金清算並於 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右分發

info.description: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. engages in the acquisition and development of oil and natural gas properties. It operates in the Rockies, Mid-Continent, South Texas, and West Texas. The company was founded on January 26, 1966 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Big Sky Industrial, Inc. 從事石油和天然氣資產的收購和開發。該公司在落基山脈、中大陸、德克薩斯州南部和德克薩斯州西部開展業務。該公司成立於1966年1月26日，總部位於德克薩斯州休斯頓。

info.description: BTQ Technologies Corp. engages in the business of post-quantum encryption. Its products include: QCIM, QSSN, OSS, QPoW, QRiNG. The company was founded by Nicolas Roussy Newton on Novemeber 23, 1983 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: BTQ Technologies Corp. 從事後量子加密業務。其產品包括：QCIM、QSSN、OSS、QPoW、QRiNG。該公司由 Nicolas Roussy Newton 於 1983 年 11 月 23 日創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: BitVentures Ltd. is a technology company that develops early-stage technology businesses. The company is actively developing technology ventures across verticals including e-commerce, digital assets, and other areas of consumer and enterprise technology. It also provides client referral services to external financial product partners and offers a range of insurance products, including life insurance products such as individual whole life, term life, health insurance, and universal life insurance; annuity insurance products; and critical illness insurance products, including personal accident insurance products. The company was founded by Hongwei Han in July 19, 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: BitVentures Ltd. 是一家開發早期技術業務的技術公司。該公司正在積極開發跨垂直行業的技術企業，包括電子商務、數位資產以及消費者和企業技術的其他領域。它還為外部金融產品合作夥伴提供客戶推薦服務，並提供一系列保險產品，包括個人終身壽險、定期壽險、健康險、萬能壽險等壽險產品；年金保險產品；重大疾病保險產品，包括人身意外傷害保險產品。該公司由韓宏偉於2019年7月19日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Calumet, Inc. engages in the manufacturing, formulation, and sale of specialty branded products and renewable fuel. It operates through the following segments: Specialty Products and Solutions, Montana/Renewables, Performance Brands, and Corporate. The Specialty Products & Solutions segment consists of customer-focused solutions and formulation businesses. The Montana/Renewables segment is composed of a Great Falls specialty asphalt facility and Montana Renewables facility. The Performance Brands segment includes Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, and TruFuel. The Corporate segment focuses on the general and administrative expenses not allocated to other segments. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Indianapolis, IN.
info.description_zh: Calumet, Inc. 從事專業品牌產品和再生燃料的製造、配​​製和銷售。該公司透過以下部門運作：特種產品和解決方案部門、蒙大拿州/再生能源部門、績效品牌部門和企業部門。特種產品和解決方案部門包括以客戶為中心的解決方案和配方業務。蒙大拿州/再生能源部門由大瀑布特種瀝青設施和蒙大拿州再生能源設施組成。性能品牌部門包括 Royal Purple、Bel-Ray 和 TruFuel。公司部門專注於未分配給其他部門的一般和管理費用。該公司成立於 1919 年，總部位於印第安納州印第安納波利斯。

info.description: CuriosityStream, Inc. is a media and entertainment company. It offers video and audio programming across the principal categories of factual entertainment, including science, history, society, nature, lifestyle, and technology. The company was founded by John S. Hendricks on June 06, 2008 and is headquartered in Silver Spring, MD.
info.description_zh: CuriosityStream, Inc. 是一家媒體和娛樂公司。它提供橫跨事實娛樂主要類別的視訊和音訊節目，包括科學、歷史、社會、自然、生活方式和技術。該公司由 John S. Hendricks 於 2008 年 6 月 6 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州銀泉。

info.description: DraftKings, Inc. is a digital sports entertainment and gaming company, which engages in the provision of online sports betting, online casino, daily fantasy sports product offerings, DraftKings Marketplace, retail sportsbook, media, and other consumer product offerings. The company was founded by Jason D. Robins, Matthew Kalish, and Paul Liberman on December 31, 2011 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: DraftKings, Inc.是一家數位運動娛樂和遊戲公司，從事提供線上體育博彩、線上賭場、每日夢幻體育產品、DraftKings Marketplace、零售體育博彩、媒體和其他消費性產品。該公司由 Jason D. Robins、Matthew Kalish 和 Paul Liberman 於 2011 年 12 月 31 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. is a clinical-stage oncology therapeutics company, which focuses on the research, development, and commercialization of diffusing alpha-emitters radiation therapy for the treatment of cancer. The firm is involved in the clinical trials at cancer centers with indications that include skin cancer, oral cavity cancer, breast cancer, and pancreatic cancer. The company was founded by Uzi Sofer, Yona Keisari, and Itzhak Kelson in November 2015 and is headquartered in Jerusalem, Israel.
info.description_zh: Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. 是一家臨床階段的腫瘤治療公司，專注於用於癌症治療的擴散 α 發射體放射療法的研究、開發和商業化。該公司參與癌症中心的臨床試驗，適應症包括皮膚癌、口腔癌、乳癌和胰臟癌。該公司由 Uzi Sofer、Yona Keisari 和 Itzhak Kelson 於 2015 年 11 月創立，總部位於以色列耶路撒冷。

info.description: Data Storage Corp. engages in the provision of business continuity services. These services include disaster recovery, infrastructure as a service, and cyber security. Its other services and solutions include data protection services, data center and security, voice and data solutions, and email archival solutions. The company was founded by Charles M. Piluso in June 2001 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Data Storage Corp. 從事提供業務連續性服務。這些服務包括災難復原、基礎設施即服務和網路安全。其其他服務和解決方案包括資料保護服務、資料中心和安全性、語音和資料解決方案以及電子郵件存檔解決方案。該公司由 Charles M. Piluso 於 2001 年 6 月創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: enCore Energy Corp. engages in the acquisition and exploration of resource properties. Its projects portfolio includes the Kingsville Dome, Rosita, Vasquez, Butler Ranch in Texas, Crownpoint & Hosta Butte, Nose Rock, Cebolleta, Juan Tafoya, West Largo, Ambrosia Lake-Treeline, Marquez, Checkerboard Mineral Rights in New Mexico, Moonshine Springs in Arizona, and White Canyon District in Utah. The company was founded on October 30, 2009 and is headquartered in Corpus Christi, TX.
info.description_zh: enCore Energy Corp. 從事資源資產的收購和勘探。其項目組合包括德克薩斯州的 Kingsville Dome、Rosita、Vasquez、Butler Ranch、Crownpoint & Hosta Butte、Nose Rock、Cebolleta、Juan Tafoya、West Largo、Ambrosia Lake-Treeline、Marquez、新墨西哥州的 Checkerboard Mineral Rights、亞利桑那州的 White Districtshine Springs 和猶他州的 White Canyon。該公司成立於2009年10月30日，總部位於德克薩斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂。

info.description: Invesco Electric Vehicle Metals Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that, under normal circumstances, seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the tradeable metals widely used in the production of an electric vehicle (which include, but are not limited to, iron ore, copper, aluminum, nickel, cobalt and lithium). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 景順電動車金屬商品策略No K-1 ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，尋求透過投資與電動車生產中廣泛使用的可交易金屬（包括但不限於鐵礦石、銅、鋁、鎳、鈷和鋰）經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: META) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying META ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF 尋求當前收入；暴露於一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Meta Platforms, Inc. A 類（納斯達克股票代碼：META）普通每日百分比的 2 倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益股票的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎 META ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity Systematic Municipal Bond Index ETF seeks to provide a high current yield exempt from federal income tax. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in municipal securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax (but may be subject to the federal alternative minimum tax).
