It normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities included in the Fidelity Systematic U.S. Municipal Bond IndexSM, which aims to increase exposure to municipal bonds with higher risk-adjusted performance and liquidity characteristics relative to traditional market-capitalization weighted U.S. investment grade municipal bond indices.
info.description_zh: 富達系統市政債券指數 ETF 尋求提供免徵聯邦所得稅的高當期收益率。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於市政證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅（但可能需繳納聯邦替代性最低稅）。它通常將至少80%的資產投資於富達系統美國市政債券指數SM中包含的證券，該指數旨在增加對相對於傳統市值加權美國投資級市政債券指數具有更高風險調整表現和流動性特徵的市政債券的投資。

info.description: First Trust Global Tactical Commodity Strategy Fund seeks to provide total return by providing investors with commodity exposure while seeking a relatively stable risk profile. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve attractive risk adjusted returns by investing in commodity futures contracts, exchange-traded commodity linked instruments, and commodity linked total return swaps (collectively, "Commodities Instruments") through a wholly-owned subsidiary of the fund organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (the "Subsidiary"). The advisor expects to gain exposure to these investments exclusively by investing in the Subsidiary.
info.description_zh: First Trust全球戰術商品策略基金旨在透過為投資者提供商品曝險來提供總回報，同時尋求相對穩定的風險狀況。該基金是一檔主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過根據開曼群島法律組成的基金全資子公司（「子公司」）投資於商品期貨合約、交易所交易商品掛鉤工具和商品掛鉤總收益互換（統稱「商品工具」），從而獲得有吸引力的風險調整回報。顧問希望僅透過投資子公司來獲得這些投資的機會。

info.description: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. is a redefining drug discovery company, which identifies and optimizes allosteric binding sites that never targeted before. Its See-Tx target identification platform uses the published 3D structure of enzymes and a proprietary computational technology to discover new allosteric binding sites and predict their druggability. The firm is also unlocking new treatment options to treat disorders characterized by protein misfolding. The company was founded by Khalid Islam in 2017 and is headquartered in Bethesda, MD.
info.description_zh: Gain Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家重新定義的藥物發現公司，該公司識別並優化以前從未靶向的變構結合位點。其 See-Tx 標靶識別平台使用已發布的酶 3D 結構和專有計算技術來發現新的變構結合位點並預測其成藥性。該公司還正在開發新的治療方案來治療以蛋白質錯誤折疊為特徵的疾病。該公司由 Khalid Islam 於 2017 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝塞斯達。

info.description: Geron Corp. operates as a biotechnology company. It develops a telomerase inhibitor, Imetelstat, in hematologic myeloid malignancies. The firm develops therapeutic products for oncology. The company was founded by Michael D. West on November 28, 1990 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: Geron Corp. 作为一家生物技术公司运营。它開發了一種用於治療血液骨髓惡性腫瘤的端粒酶抑制劑 Imetelstat。該公司開發腫瘤治療產品。該公司由 Michael D. West 於 1990 年 11 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州福斯特市。

info.description: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII is a blank check company. The firm was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cove, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII 是一家空白支票公司。該公司的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 7 月 15 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cove。

info.description: Himax Technologies, Inc. is a semiconductor solution provider dedicated to display imaging processing technologies. It operates through the Driver Integrated Circuit and Non-Driver Products segments. The company's products include display drivers, timing controllers, wafer level optics, video and display technology solutions, liquid crystal over silicon silicon, complementary metal-oxide semiconductor image sensor, and power integrated circuit. Its products used in TVs, laptops, monitors, mobile phones, tablets, digital cameras, car navigation, virtual reality (VR) devices and many other consumer electronics devices. Himax Technologies was founded by Biing Seng Wu and Jordan Wu on June 12, 2001 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: 奇景光電 (Himax Technologies, Inc.) 是一家致力於顯示影像處理技術的半導體解決方案供應商。它透過驅動器積體電路和非驅動器產品部門運作。該公司的產品包括顯示驅動器、時序控制器、晶圓級光學元件、視訊和顯示技術解決方案、矽基液晶、互補金屬氧化物半導體影像感測器和功率集成電路。其產品應用於電視、筆記型電腦、顯示器、手機、平板電腦、數位相機、汽車導航、虛擬實境（VR）設備和許多其他消費性電子設備。奇景科技由 Bing Seng Wu 和 Jordan Wu 於 2001 年 6 月 12 日創立，總部位於台灣台南。

info.description: Immix Biopharma, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company that engages in the development of therapies for cancer and inflammatory diseases. The company was founded by Ilya Rachman, Sean Senn, and Vladimir Torchilin in 2012 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Immix Biopharma, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於癌症和發炎性疾病療法的開發。該公司由 Ilya Rachman、Sean Senn 和 Vladimir Torchilin 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: Kopin Corp. engages in the development, manufacture and sale of wearable technologies which include components and systems. Its portfolio includes AMLCD, LCOS displays, OLED displays, ASIC, backlights, and optical lenses. The firm uses semiconductor material technology to design, manufacture and market its component products for use in military, enterprise and consumer electronic applications, training and simulation equipment and 3D metrology equipment. The company was founded by John C.C. Fan on April 23, 1984 and is headquartered in Westborough, MA.
info.description_zh: Kopin Corp. 從事穿戴式技術（包括組件和系統）的開發、製造和銷售。其產品組合包括 AMLCD、LCOS 顯示器、OLED 顯示器、ASIC、背光和光學鏡頭。該公司利用半導體材料技術設計、製造和銷售其組件產品，用於軍事、企業和消費性電子應用、培訓和模擬設備以及 3D 計量設備。該公司由 John C.C. 創立。 Fan 於 1984 年 4 月 23 日成立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州韋斯特伯勒。

info.description: Mesa Laboratories, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and market of instruments and disposable products utilized in healthcare, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, medical device, and petrochemical industries. It operates through the following segments: Sterilization and Disinfection Control, Clinical Genomics, Biopharmaceutical Development, and Calibration Solutions. The Sterilization and Disinfection Control segment manufactures and sells biological, cleaning, and chemical indicators. The Clinical Genomics segment division develops, manufactures and sells highly sensitive, low-cost, high-throughput genetic analysis tools and related consumables and services that enable clinical research labs and contract research organizations. The Biopharmaceutical Development segment caters and sells automated systems for protein analysis and peptide synthesis solutions. The Calibration Solutions segment focuses on the quality control products using principles of advanced metrology to enable customers to measure and calibrate critical parameters in applications such as renal care, environmental and process monitoring, gas flow, air quality and torque testing, primarily in medical device manufacturing, pharmaceutical manufacturing, laboratory and hospital environments. The company was founded by Luke R. Schmieder on March 26, 1982 and is headquartered in Lakewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Mesa Laboratories, Inc. 從事醫療保健、製藥、食品和飲料、醫療器材和石化行業所用儀器和一次性產品的設計、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：滅菌和消毒控制、臨床基因組學、生物製藥開發和校準解決方案。滅菌和消毒控制部門生產和銷售生物、清潔和化學指示器。臨床基因組學部門開發、製造和銷售高靈敏度、低成本、高通量的基因分析工具以及相關耗材和服務，為臨床研究實驗室和合約研究組織提供支援。生物製藥開發部門提供和銷售用於蛋白質分析和勝肽合成解決方案的自動化系統。校準解決方案部門專注於使用先進計量原理的品質控制產品，使客戶能夠測量和校準腎臟護理、環境和過程監測、氣流、空氣品質和扭矩測試等應用中的關鍵參數，主要在醫療器械製造、藥品製造、實驗室和醫院環境中。該公司由 Luke R. Schmieder 於 1982 年 3 月 26 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州萊克伍德。

info.description: SPDR MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the MSCI ACWI Climate Paris Aligned Index. The fund generally invests substantially all, but at least 80%, of its total assets in the securities comprising the index. The index is designed to exceed the minimum standards for a "Paris-Aligned Benchmark" under the EU BMR. A Paris-Aligned Benchmark is designed to align with a principal objective of the Paris Agreement to limit the increase in the global average temperature to well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.
info.description_zh: SPDR MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整 ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前的投資結果，該結果通常與 MSCI ACWI 氣候巴黎調整指數的總回報表現相對應。該基金通常將其總資產的大部分（但至少 80%）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在超過歐盟 BMR 下「巴黎一致基準」的最低標準。巴黎協調基準旨在與《巴黎協定》的主要目標保持一致，即將全球平均氣溫上升幅度限制在遠低於工業化前水準 2 攝氏度。

info.description: Purecycle Technologies, Inc. engages in recycling waste polypropylene into virgin polymer. Its process includes two steps: Feed Pre-Processing and the use of the Technology for purification. The company was founded by John Scott in September 2015 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Purecycle Technologies, Inc. 致力於將廢棄聚丙烯回收成原始聚合物。其製程包括兩個步驟：飼料預處理和利用此技術進行純化。該公司由 John Scott 於 2015 年 9 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Invesco Optimum Yield Diversified Commodity Strategy No K-1 ETF seeks long term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a combination of financial instruments that are economically linked to the world's most heavily traded commodities. Commodities are assets that have tangible properties, such as oil, agricultural produce or raw metals.
info.description_zh: 景順最佳收益多元化商品策略No K-1 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資與全球交易最頻繁的商品經濟相關的金融工具組合來實現其投資目標。商品是具有有形財產的資產，例如石油、農產品或原料金屬。

info.description: Pharming Group NV is a holding company, which engages in the development of pharmaceutical products for the treatment of rare diseases and unmet medical needs. The firm offers RUCONEST, which is a recombinant human C1-esterase inhibitor for the treatment of acute hereditary angioedema. It operates through the following segments: RUCONEST, Joenja, Europe, and Rest of the World. The company was founded on November 11, 1988, and is headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands.
info.description_zh: Pharming Group NV 是一家控股公司，從事治療罕見疾病和未滿足醫療需求的藥品開發。該公司提供 RUCONEST，這是一種重組人類 C1 酯酶抑制劑，用於治療急性遺傳性血管性水腫。它透過以下部門運作：RUCONEST、Joenja、歐洲和世界其他地區。該公司成立於1988年11月11日，總部位於荷蘭萊頓。

info.description: SMI 3Fourteen REAL Asset Allocation ETF seeks total return. The fund is actively managed and allocates its portfolio assets among three asset categories - stocks, bonds, and alternatives. Portfolio assets are chosen using the REAL Asset Allocation ("RAA") strategy developed by an affiliate of the Adviser, 3Fourteen Research, LLC. The RAA strategy is based on a proprietary model that dynamically allocates the portfolio into three broad categories of asset classes: Stocks, Bonds, and Alternatives. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SMI 3Fourteen REAL 資產配置 ETF 追求總報酬。該基金採用主動管理方式，將其投資組合資產分配到股票、債券和另類資產三個類別。投資組合資產是使用顧問附屬公司 3Fourteen Research, LLC 開發的真實資產分配（「RAA」）策略來選擇的。 RAA 策略基於專有模型，該模型將投資組合動態分配為三大類資產類別：股票、債券和另類投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. engages in the research and development of engineered cells as medicine. It focuses on identifying and developing potential product candidates, executing preclinical studies, and acquiring technology. The company was founded by Steven D. Harr, Noubar B. Afeyan, Robert Taylor Nelsen, and Hans Edgar Bishop on July 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Sana Biotechnology, Inc. 從事工程細胞藥物的研究和開發。它專注於識別和開發潛在的候選產品、執行臨床前研究以及獲取技術。該公司由 Steven D. Harr、Noubar B. Afeyan、Robert Taylor Nelsen 和 Hans Edgar Bishop 於 2018 年 7 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: Social Commerce Partners Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 11, 2025 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Social Commerce Partners Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年8月11日，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Sidus Space, Inc. is a space-as-a-service company. The firm focuses on commercial satellite design, manufacture, launch planning, mission operations and in-orbit support, and data collection with a vision to demonstrate space operations for new technologies, and deliver data and predictive analytics to both domestic and global customers. The company was founded by Carol M. Craig on July 17, 2012 and is headquartered in Merritt Island, FL.
info.description_zh: Sidus Space, Inc. 是一家空間即服務公司。該公司專注於商業衛星設計、製造、發射規劃、任務操作和在軌支援以及數據收集，旨在展示新技術的空間操作，並向國內和全球客戶提供數據和預測分析。該公司由 Carol M. Craig 於 2012 年 7 月 17 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州梅里特島。

info.description: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in the discovery and development of therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases. The company was founded on July 22, 1980 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發治療罕見疾病的療法。該公司成立於1980年7月22日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Touchstone Dynamic International ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of non-U.S. companies. Equity securities include common stocks, preferred stocks, depositary receipts such as American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs"), Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") and European Depositary Receipts ("EDRs"), Real Estate Investment Trusts ("REITs"), and interests in other investment companies, including other exchange-traded funds that invest in equity securities.
info.description_zh: Touchstone Dynamic International ETF 尋求資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於非美國公司的股本證券。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、美國存託憑證（「ADR」）、全球存託憑證（「GDR」）和歐洲存託憑證（「EDR」）等存託憑證、房地產投資信託基金（「REIT」）以及其他投資公司的權益，包括其他投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Texas ETF is an actively managed equity fund focused on long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in stocks of companies operating in the oil, gas & consumable fuels industry and the energy equipment & services sectors, across a diversified range of market capitalizations. The investment strategy combines fundamental, value-oriented research with selective growth opportunities to identify companies expected to benefit directly or indirectly from expanding economic opportunities within the State of Texas. The fund targets businesses positioned to capitalize on Texas-specific advantages, including energy sector strength, favorable regulatory conditions, and sustained demographic and economic growth.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Texas ETF 是一檔專注於長期資本增值的主動管理股票基金。該基金主要投資於石油、天然氣和消耗性燃料產業以及能源設備和服務業的公司股票，其市值範圍多元化。該投資策略將基礎性的、以價值為導向的研究與選擇性成長機會相結合，以確定預計將直接或間接受益於德州不斷擴大的經濟機會的公司。該基金的目標是那些能夠利用德州特有優勢的企業，包括能源產業的實力、有利的監管條件以及持續的人口和經濟成長。

info.description: Wah Fu Education Group Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of online exam preparation services and related technology solutions, and production of online training course materials. It operates through the Online Education Cloud Service (B2B2C) and Online Training Service (B2C). The B2B2C segment comprises online education platforms to institutions, such as universities, training institutions, and online course development service companies. The B2C segment provides online training and examination preparation services directly to students for a fee. The company was founded on July 23, 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 華富教育集團有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供線上考試準備服務和相關技術解決方案以及製作線上培訓課程材料。它透過線上教育雲端服務（B2B2C）和線上培訓服務（B2C）運作。 B2B2C 領域包括大學、培訓機構和線上課程開發服務公司等機構的線上教育平台。 B2C 部門直接向學生提供收費的線上培訓和考試準備服務。公司成立於2012年7月23日，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Wise Group Plc operates as a global payment solutions. It offers cross-border payment services to banks and customers. The company was founded on June 17, 2025 and is headquartered in St. Helier, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Wise Group Plc 是一家全球支付解決方案提供商。它為銀行和客戶提供跨境支付服務。該公司成立於2025年6月17日，總部位於英國聖赫利爾。

info.description: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 Term Treasury ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE 2029 Maturity U.S. Treasury Index composed of U.S. Treasury bonds maturing in 2029. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the underlying index. The underlying index consists of publicly-issued U.S. Treasury securities that are scheduled to mature between January 1, 2029 and December 15, 2029, inclusive.
info.description_zh: iShares iBonds Dec 2029 定期國債 ETF 旨在追蹤由 2029 年到期的美國國債組成的 ICE 2029 年期美國國債指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於 BFA 認為將有助於基金追蹤基礎指數的美國國債。標的指數由計劃於 2029 年 1 月 1 日至 2029 年 12 月 15 日（含）期間到期的公開發行的美國國債組成。

info.description: Insight Digital Partners II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 11, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Insight Digital Partners II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年7月11日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The underlying index is an optimized equity index designed to reflect the equity performance of U.S. companies that have favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") characteristics (as determined by the index provider), while exhibiting risk and return characteristics similar to those of the MSCI USA Index (the "parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Aware MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Extended ESG Focus Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。標的指數是優化的股票指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）特徵（由指數提供者確定）的美國公司的股票表現，同時表現出與 MSCI 美國指數（「母指數」）類似的風險和回報特徵。

info.description: iShares Core 1-5 Year USD Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg U.S. Universal 1-5 Year Index, which measures the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated taxable bonds that are rated either investment-grade or high yield with remaining effective maturities between one and five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index and TBA transactions that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the economic characteristics of the component securities of the index and it will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the index.
info.description_zh: iShares Core 1-5 年期美元債券 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國通用 1-5 年期指數的投資結果，該指數衡量以美元計價的應稅債券的表現，這些債券被評為投資級或高收益，剩餘有效期限為 1 至 5 年。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數的組成證券以及具有與該指數組成證券的經濟特徵基本相同的經濟特徵的 TBA 交易，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於該指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。

info.description: NEOS Enhanced Income Credit Select ETF seeks total return from income and capital appreciation while providing a tax efficient monthly income. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing 80% or more of its net assets in bonds or ETFs that invest 80% or more of their assets in bonds and selling and purchasing S&P 500 Index put options to generate income to the fund beyond what is received from the underlying investments.
info.description_zh: NEOS 增強型收入信用精選 ETF 尋求收入和資本增值的總回報，同時提供節稅的月收入。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，旨在透過將 80% 或以上的淨資產投資於債券或將 80% 或以上的資產投資於債券的 ETF，以及買賣標普 500 指數看跌期權，為基金帶來超出基礎投資收益的收入，從而實現其投資目標。

info.description: VanEck Space ETF is a thematic, passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the performance of publicly traded companies globally within the expanding space industry. The strategy uses a rules-based, modified float-adjusted market capitalization weighting framework to capture pure-play commercial space exposure by emphasizing firms involved in space exploration, rockets, propulsion systems, and satellite infrastructure while avoiding standard defense conglomerate dominance.
info.description_zh: VanEck Space ETF 是一款主題型、被動式管理的交易所交易基金，追蹤不斷擴張的航太產業中全球上市公司的表現。該戰略採用基於規則、經過修改的浮動調整市值加權框架，透過強調參與太空探索、火箭、推進系統和衛星基礎設施的公司，同時避免標準國防集團的主導地位，來捕捉純粹的商業太空風險。

info.description: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests in securities to provide dynamic exposure to developed and emerging markets countries. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of issuers economically tied to countries other than the United States and derivatives that provide investment exposure to such securities or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares International Country Rotation Active ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金投資於證券，為已開發和新興市場國家提供動態投資。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產，加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額，投資於與美國以外國家有經濟聯繫的發行人的證券以及提供此類證券或與此類證券相關的一項或多項市場風險因素投資的衍生品。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2032 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2032 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2032. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2032 高收益企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 美元高收益企業債券 2032 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2032 年到期的以美元計價的高收益公司債投資組合的表現，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in the public equity and fixed income markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in common and preferred stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, convertible securities, and high yield corporate bonds with an average credit rating of BB as rated by S&P. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis with a combination of bottom-up and top-down security picking approaches to create its portfolio. Calamos Strategic Total Return Fund was formed on December 31, 2003 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 策略總回報基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於美國的公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的普通股和優先股、可轉換證券以及標準普爾平均信用評級為BB的高收益公司債券。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，並結合自下而上和自上而下的證券選擇方法來創建投資組合。 Calamos 策略總回報基金成立於 2003 年 12 月 31 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. engages in the development of therapeutic products for the treatment of rare and orphan diseases. Its product pipeline includes QRX003, QRX004, QRX007, and QRX008. The company was founded by Michael Myers and Denise Carter on March 5, 2018 and is headquartered in Ashburn, VA.
info.description_zh: Quoin Pharmaceuticals Ltd. 從事治療罕見疾病和孤兒疾病的治療產品的開發。其產品線包括QRX003、QRX004、QRX007和QRX008。該公司由 Michael Myers 和 Denise Carter 於 2018 年 3 月 5 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿什本。

info.description: iShares 3-7 Year Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE U.S. Treasury 3-7 Year Bond Index (the "underlying index"). The index measures the performance of public obligations of the U.S. Treasury that have a remaining maturity of greater than or equal to three years and less than seven years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in U.S. Treasury securities that BFA believes will help the fund track the index.
info.description_zh: iShares 3-7 年期公債 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 美國 3-7 年期公債指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。該指數衡量美國財政部剩餘期限大於或等於三年且小於七年的公共債務的履行。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於該指數的組成證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於BFA認為將有助於該基金追蹤該指數的美國國債。

info.description: Shenandoah Telecommunications Co. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of regulated and unregulated telecommunication services to end-user customers and other telecommunications providers. The Tower segment leases space on 225 owned cell towers. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Edinburg, VA.
info.description_zh: Shenandoah Te communications Co. 是一家控股公司，致力於向最終用戶客戶和其他電信供應商提供受監管和不受監管的電信服務。塔楼部门租赁 225 个自有蜂窝塔的空间。该公司成立于 1902 年，总部位于弗吉尼亚州爱丁堡。

info.description: Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the FTSE Shariah USA Index. The index is composed of common stocks of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. companies the characteristics of which meet the requirements of Shariah and are consistent with Islamic principles as interpreted by subject-matter experts. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets will be invested in the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF 旨在追蹤 FTSE Shariah USA 指數（未計費用和支出）的總回報表現。該指數由大中型美國公司的普通股組成，其特徵符合伊斯蘭教法的要求，並符合主題專家解釋的伊斯蘭原則。一般情況下，其總資產的至少80%會投資於該指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2030. It does not purchase all of the securities in the index; instead, the fund utilizes a "sampling" methodology to seek to achieve its investment objective. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2030 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2030 年到期（或在某些情況下為「有效到期」）的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現。它不會購買指數中的所有證券；相反，該基金採用"抽樣"方法來尋求實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of products and services for the animal veterinary, livestock and poultry, dairy, and water testing industries. It operates through the following segments: Companion Animal Group (CAG), Water Quality Products (Water), Livestock, Poultry, and Dairy (LPD), and Other. The CAG segment provides diagnostic and information management-based products and services for the companion animal veterinary industry, including in-clinic diagnostic solutions, outside reference laboratory services, and veterinary software and services. The Water segment offers innovative testing solutions for easy, rapid, and accurate detection and quantification of various microbiological parameters in water. The LPD segment develops diagnostic tests, services, and related instrumentation that are used to manage the health status of livestock and poultry, to improve producer efficiency, and to ensure the quality and safety of milk and food. The Other segment is composed of products for the human point-of-care medical diagnostics market with its out-licensing arrangements. The company was founded by David Evans Shaw on December 19, 1983 and is headquartered in Westbrook, ME.
info.description_zh: IDEXX Laboratories, Inc. 從事動物獸醫、畜禽、乳製品和水質檢測行業產品和服務的開發、製造和分銷。該公司透過以下部門運作：伴侶動物部門（CAG）、水質產品部門（水）、畜牧業、家禽和乳製品部門（LPD）以及其他部門。 CAG部門為伴侶動物獸醫行業提供基於診斷和資訊管理的產品和服務，包括診所診斷解決方案、外部參考實驗室服務以及獸醫軟體和服務。水部門提供創新的測試解決方案，可輕鬆、快速、準確地檢測和量化水中的各種微生物參數。 LPD部門開發診斷測試、服務和相關儀器，用於管理牲畜和家禽的健康狀況，提高生產效率，並確保牛奶和食品的品質和安全。其他部門則由用於人體護理點醫療診斷市場的產品及其外包許可安排組成。該公司由 David Evans Shaw 於 1983 年 12 月 19 日創立，總部位於緬因州威斯布魯克。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Yield ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified strategy designed to deliver consistent monthly income and total return by combining a long equity portfolio of Nasdaq-listed stocks with a proprietary options overlay. The fund utilizes a data science-driven investment approach to construct its equity holdings while selling call option spreads to generate premiums, aiming to provide a significant portion of the Nasdaq 100 Index's returns with lower overall volatility.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收益 ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化策略，旨在透過將納斯達克上市股票的長期股票投資組合與專有選擇權疊加相結合，提供穩定的每月收入和總回報。該基金利用數據科學驅動的投資方法來建立其股票持有量，同時出售看漲期權價差以產生溢價，旨在以較低的整體波動性提供納斯達克100指數回報的很大一部分。

info.description: FlexShares Credit-Scored US Corporate Bond Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Northern Trust US Corporate Bond IndexSM. The underlying index is designed to reflect the performance of a diversified universe of intermediate maturity, U.S.-dollar denominated bonds of companies with investment grade credit quality, favorable valuations, and enhanced short-term and long-term solvency. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of its index.
info.description_zh: FlexShares 信用評分美國公司債指數基金尋求與 Northern Trust 美國公司債指數 SM 的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在反映具有投資等級信用品質、良好估值以及增強的短期和長期償付能力的公司的多元化中期債券的表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少80%投資於其指數的證券。

info.description: SGI Dynamic Tactical ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF and invests in securities of affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs and open-end mutual funds. The fund may allocate among major equity asset classes and sectors, within the underlying funds, of the U.S., foreign and emerging markets equity of any capitalization.
info.description_zh: SGI 動態戰術 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金是主動式管理 ETF，投資於附屬和非附屬 ETF 以及開放式共同基金的證券。該基金可以在基礎基金內的美國、外國和新興市場任何資本的股票的主要股票資產類別和部門之間進行配置。

info.description: The E.W. Scripps Co. engages in television and newspaper publishing. It operates through the following business segments: Local Media, Scripps Networks, and Other. The Local Media segment consists of local broadcast television stations and their related digital operations. The Scripps Networks segment consists of national television networks. The company was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Cincinnati, OH.
info.description_zh: E.W. Scripps Co. 從事電視和報紙出版。它透過以下業務部門運作：本地媒體、史克里普斯網路和其他。本地媒體部門由本地廣播電視台及其相關數位業務組成。史克里普斯網路部門由全國電視網組成。該公司成立於 1878 年，總部位於俄亥俄州辛辛那提。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2031 (collectively, "2031 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2031 Index（「基本指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）（統稱為「2031 年債券」）的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: 36Kr Holdings, Inc. operates as an online media publisher company. It offers business services, including online advertising services, enterprise value-added services and subscription services. The company was founded by Cheng Cheng Liu on December 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: 36氪控股有限公司是一家線上媒體出版公司。它提供商業服務，包括線上廣告服務、企業增值服務和訂閱服務。該公司由劉程程於2018年12月3日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2032 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2032. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2032.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2032 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2032 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2032 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Vanguard Total International Stock Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a benchmark index that measures the investment return of stocks issued by companies located in developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the FTSE Global All Cap ex US Index, a float-adjusted market-capitalization-weighted index designed to measure equity market performance of companies located in developed and emerging markets, excluding the United States. The fund invests all, or substantially all, of its assets in the common stocks included in its target index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total International Stock Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤基準指數的表現，該指數衡量已開發市場和新興市場（不包括美國）公司發行的股票的投資回報。該管理公司採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤富時全球全盤指數（美國除外）的表現，該指數是一種流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場（不包括美國）公司的股票市場表現。該基金將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於其目標指數中包含的普通股。

info.description: Synchrony Financial engages in the provision of consumer financial services. It focuses on digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoor, pet, and other industries. The company was founded on September 12, 2003 and is headquartered in Stamford, CT.
info.description_zh: Synchrony Financial 從事提供消費金融服務。專注於數位、健康與保健、零售、電信、家居、汽車、戶外、寵物等產業。該公司成立於2003年9月12日，總部位於康乃狄克州斯坦福。

info.description: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg Global Aggregate Float Adjusted Composite Index that measures the investment return of investment-grade U.S. bonds and investment-grade non-U.S. dollar-denominated bonds. The fund is a fund of funds and employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the index, which is a custom, USD-hedged index designed to track the market capitalized weights of the global investment-grade bond market and is comprised of the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Float Adjusted Index and the Bloomberg Global Aggregate ex-USD Float Adjusted RIC Capped Index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total World Bond ETF 旨在追蹤彭博全球綜合流通量調整後綜合指數的表現，該指數衡量投資等級美國債券和投資等級非美元計價債券的投資回報。該基金是基金中的基金，採用指數化投資方法，旨在追蹤指數的表現，該指數是定制的美元對沖指數，旨在追蹤全球投資等級債券市場的市值權重，由彭博美國綜合浮動調整指數和彭博全球綜合浮動調整後 RIC 上限指數組成。

info.description: Vanguard Total International Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of a benchmark index that measures the investment return of non-U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade bonds. The fund employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Bloomberg Global Aggregate ex-USD Float Adjusted RIC Capped Index (USD Hedged). This index provides a broad-based measure of the global, investment-grade, fixed-rate debt markets. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Total International Bond Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤衡量非美元計價投資等級債券投資回報的基準指數的表現。該基金採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤彭博全球綜合不計美元浮動調整 RIC 上限指數（美元對沖）的表現。該指數提供了對全球投資等級固定利率債務市場的廣泛衡量。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Viant Technology, Inc. is an advertising technology company, which develops and manages an enterprise software platform. The firm also offers Adelphic, an omnichannel demand-side platform which enables marketers to execute programmatic advertising campaigns. Its solutions include ViantAI, Demand Side Platform, Connected TV Advertising, Omnichannel marketing, and Data Platform. The company was founded by Timothy C. Vanderhook, Christopher John Vanderhook, and Russell T. Vanderhook in 1999 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Viant Technology, Inc. 是一家廣告科技公司，開發和管理企業軟體平台。該公司還提供 Adelphic，這是一個全通路需求方平台，使行銷人員能夠執行程式化廣告活動。其解決方案包括ViantAI、需求方平台、連網電視廣告、全通路行銷和數據平台。該公司由 Timothy C. Vanderhook、Christopher John Vanderhook 和 Russell T. Vanderhook 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Bloomberg USD Emerging Markets Government RIC Capped Index that measures the investment return of U.S. dollar-denominated bonds issued by governments and government-related issuers in emerging market countries. The manager employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of index. All of the fund's investments will be selected through the sampling process, and under normal circumstances at least 80% of the fund's assets will be invested in bonds included in the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Emerging Markets Government Bond Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤彭博美元新興市場政府 RIC 上限指數的表現，該指數衡量新興市場國家政府和政府相關發行人發行的美元計價債券的投資回報。管理人採用旨在追蹤指數表現的指數投資方法。基金的所有投資都會透過抽樣過程進行篩選，一般情況下基金資產的至少80%會投資於指數納入的債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Emerging Markets Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Emerging Markets Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Emerging Markets AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 新興市場指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克新興市場指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2033. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2033.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2033 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2033 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2033 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Gyre Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company. It is focused on the development and commercialization of Hydronidone (F351) for the treatment of Metabolic Dysfunction Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH-associated liver fibrosis). The firm operates through the BC and Gyre segments. The company was founded on March 7, 1997 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Gyre Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司。它專注於 Hydronidone (F351) 的開發和商業化，用於治療代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝炎（MASH 相關肝纖維化）。該公司透過 BC 和 Gyre 部門運營。該公司成立於1997年3月7日，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund is a closed ended balanced mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. The fund is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. It invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. The fund seeks to invest in securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in growth stocks of companies across all market capitalizations, as well as in higher yield corporate bonds, government bonds, convertibles, and alternative investments such as arbitrage and call writes. The fund employs both fundamental and quantitative analysis, focusing on such factors as source, sustainability, and risk of investment opportunities to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI World Index and Merrill Lynch Global Broad Markets Index. The fund was formerly known as Calamos Global Diversified Income & Opportunities Fund. Calamos Global Dynamic Income Fund was formed on April 10, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos 全球動態收入基金是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式平衡共同基金。該基金由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。它投資於全球公共股權和固定收益市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業運營的公司的證券。它主要投資於所有市值公司的成長型股票，以及較高收益的公司債、政府公債、可轉換債券以及套利和買權等另類投資。本基金採用基本面分析和定量分析，重點在於投資機會的來源、永續性和風險等因素來創建投資組合。它將其投資組合的表現與摩根士丹利資本國際世界指數和美林全球廣泛市場指數進行比較。該基金以前稱為卡拉莫斯全球多元化收入和機會基金。 Calamos 全球動態收入基金成立於 2007 年 4 月 10 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: iShares Preferred and Income Securities ETF seeks to track the investment results of the ICE Exchange-Listed Preferred & Hybrid Securities Index, which measures the performance of a select group of exchange-listed, U.S. dollar-denominated preferred securities, hybrid securities and convertible preferred securities listed on the NYSE or NASDAQ. The fund may invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares 優先和收入證券 ETF 旨在追蹤 ICE 交易所上市優先和混合證券指數的投資結果，該指數衡量一組精選的交易所上市、以美元計價的優先證券、混合證券以及在紐約證券交易所或納斯達克上市的可轉換優先證券的表現。該基金可以將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2033 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2033, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2033 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2033年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Broadcom Inc. is a global technology company, which designs, develops, and supplies semiconductors and infrastructure software solutions. It operates through the Semiconductor Solutions and Infrastructure Software segments. The Semiconductor Solutions segment refers to product lines and intellectual property licensing. The Infrastructure Software segment relates to mainframe, distributed and cyber security solutions, and fibre channel storage area networking business. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Broadcom Inc. 是一家全球科技公司，設計、開發和供應半導體和基礎設施軟體解決方案。它透過半導體解決方案和基礎設施軟體部門運作。半導體解決方案部門涉及產品線和智慧財產權授權。基礎設施軟體部門涉及大型主機、分散式和網路安全解決方案以及光纖通道儲存區域網路業務。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Navan, Inc. engages in offering a cloud-based technology platform for travelers. Its products include business travel and expense management. The company was founded by Ariel Cohen and Ilan Twig in February 2015 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Navan, Inc. 致力於為旅客提供基於雲端的技術平台。其產品包括商務旅行和費用管理。該公司由 Ariel Cohen 和 Ilan Twig 於 2015 年 2 月創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: iShares International Treasury Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the FTSE World Government Bond Index - Developed Markets Capped Select Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The underlying index measures the performance of fixed-rate, local currency, investment-grade, sovereign bonds from certain developed markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 國際公債 ETF 旨在追蹤富時世界政府公債指數 - 已開發市場上限精選指數的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於基礎指數的組成證券，並將至少 90% 的資產投資於基礎指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。相關指數衡量某些已開發市場的固定利率、本國貨幣、投資等級、主權債券的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: AB Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize total return through current income and long-term capital appreciation. The fund pursues its objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in investment grade fixed-income securities of corporate issuers. Corporate issuers may include corporate or other business entities in which a sovereign or governmental agency or entity may have, indirectly or directly, an interest, including a majority or greater ownership interest.
info.description_zh: AB Corporate Bond ETF 尋求透過當前收入和長期資本增值來最大化總回報。在正常情況下，該基金透過將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括用於投資目的的借款）投資於企業發行人的投資等級固定收益證券來實現其目標。公司發行人可能包括主權或政府機構或實體可能間接或直接擁有權益（包括多數或更多所有權權益）的公司或其他商業實體。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets Small Cap AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Emerging Markets Small Cap Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Emerging Markets Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 新興市場小型股 AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 新興市場小型股指數的股票指數的價格和收益率相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克新興市場指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: First Trust S-Network Future Vehicles & Technology ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the S-Network Electric & Future Vehicle Ecosystem Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. To be eligible for inclusion in the index, a company must be listed on a major recognized stock exchange and engaged in one of the following sectors: electric and autonomous vehicle manufacturing; enabling technologies or enabling materials. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust S-Network 未來車輛和技術 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 S-Network 電動和未來車輛生態系統指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。為了有資格納入該指數，公司必須在主要認可的證券交易所上市，並從事以下行業之一：電動和自動駕駛汽車製造；使能技術或使能材料。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: National Security Emerging Markets Index ETF seeks to track the results, before fees and expenses, of the Alerian National Security Emerging Markets Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index. The index consists of stocks listed on globally recognized stock exchanges that excludes companies benefiting end-users that, in the view of the sponsor of the fund, National Security Index, LLC (the "Sponsor") pose a threat to the national security interests of the United States.
info.description_zh: 國家安全新興市場指數 ETF 旨在追蹤 Alerian 國家安全新興市場指數（未計費用和開支）的結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於該指數的組成證券。該指數由在全球公認的證券交易所上市的股票組成，不包括使最終用戶受益的公司，該基金的發起人 National Security Index, LLC（「發起人」）認為這些公司對美國的國家安全利益構成威脅。

info.description: First Trust Emerging Markets Local Currency Bond ETF seeks maximum total return and current income. Under normal market conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in bonds, notes and bills issued or guaranteed by entities incorporated or domiciled in emerging market countries (collectively, "Bonds") that are denominated in the local currency of the issuer. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 新興市場本幣債券 ETF 尋求最大的總回報和當期收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金尋求透過將至少80%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於由在新興市場國家註冊或註冊的實體發行或擔保的以發行人當地貨幣計價的債券、票據和票據（統稱「債券」）來實現其投資目標。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. It develops precision therapies for genetically-defined cancer patients with mTOR pathway driver alterations such as alterations in TSC1 or TSC2 genes. The company was founded by Neil Desai in November 2007 and is headquartered in Morristown, NJ.
info.description_zh: Whitehawk Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。它為具有 mTOR 路徑驅動改變（例如 TSC1 或 TSC2 基因改變）的基因定義癌症患者開發精準療法。該公司由 Neil Desai 於 2007 年 11 月創立，總部位於新澤西州莫里斯敦。

info.description: The Estee Lauder Companies, Inc. engages in the manufacture of skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products. It sells products under Estee Lauder, Clinique, Origins, MAC, Bobbi Brown, La Mer, Jo Malone London, Aveda and Too Faced. The company was founded by Estee Lauder and Joseph Lauder in 1946 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 雅詩蘭黛公司從事護膚、化妝品、香水和護髮產品的製造。該公司銷售雅詩蘭黛、倩碧、Origins、MAC、Bobbi Brown、La Mer、Jo Malone London、Aveda 和 Too Faced 品牌的產品。該公司由雅詩蘭黛和約瑟夫蘭黛於 1946 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: SGI Enhanced Nasdaq-100 ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. Under normal market circumstances, seeks to achieve its objective by (1) investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity investments of companies that, at the time of investment, are included in the NASDAQ-100 Index and/or options, ETFs or options on ETFs that seek to replicate the returns of the Index, and (2) investing in options strategies that seek to generate current income. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SGI 增強型納斯達克 100 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場情況下，尋求透過以下方式實現其目標：(1) 將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於在投資時納入 NASDAQ-100 指數和/或尋求複製指數回報的期權、ETF 或 ETF 期權的公司的股權投資，以及 (2) 投資於尋求產生當前收入的期權策略。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600. The index, as designed, has two components: (i) a Nasdaq-100 component and (ii) a dividend component consisting of long positions in annual futures contracts that provide exposure to ordinary dividends paid on the common stocks of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Advisor attempts to invest all, or substantially all, of its assets in the component securities that make up the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Metarus Nasdaq 100 Dividend Multiplier 600 ETF 旨在追蹤 Metaurus Nasdaq Dividend Multiplier Total Return Index - Series 600 的總回報表現（未扣除費用和開支）。按照設計，該指數有兩個組成部分：(i) Nasdaq-100 成分和 (ii) 股息成分，由年度期貨合約的多頭頭寸組成，這些合約提供對包括以下公司的普通股支付的普通股股息的敞口被納入納斯達克 100 指數。顧問試圖將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TSPY Lift ETF tracks the daily performance of the TappAlpha SPY Growth & Daily Income ETF (TSPY) with a 1.3x leverage factor. The strategy is designed to provide amplified exposure to a core portfolio that combines long S&P 500 equity participation with a systematic, fintech-powered daily (0DTE) covered call overlay for income generation.
info.description_zh: TSPY Lift ETF 追蹤 TappAlpha SPY 成長和每日收入 ETF (TSPY) 的每日表現，槓桿係數為 1.3 倍。該策略旨在擴大對核心投資組合的曝險，該投資組合將長期標普 500 指數股票參與與系統性、金融科技驅動的每日 (0DTE) 覆蓋看漲期權疊加相結合，以產生收入。

info.description: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index ("Broad Markets Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-MO Broad Markets Momentum Index（「Broad Markets Index」或「Index」）的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in U.S. listed common stock. The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Burney U.S. Factor Rotation ETF seeks capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks long term growth of capital.在正常藉錢The fund will invest its assets in common stocks of large, mid, and small-capitalization companies.

info.description: McGrath RentCorp engages in the provision of business-to-business rental services. It operates through the following segments: Mobile Modular, Portable Storage, TRS-RenTelco, and Enviroplex. The Mobile Modular segment focuses on modular building and portable storage. The Portable Storage segment includes rental inventory consisting of steel containers used to provide a temporary storage solution that is delivered to the customer's location and addresses the need for secure, temporary storage with immediate access to the unit. The TRS-RenTelco segment includes operations for its electronic test equipment. The Enviroplex segment is involved in the classroom manufacturing business selling modular buildings used primarily as classrooms in California. The company was founded by Robert P. McGrath in 1979 and is headquartered in Livermore, CA.
info.description_zh: McGrath RentCorp 從事提供企業對企業租賃服務。它透過以下部門運作：行動模組化、便攜式儲存、TRS-RenTelco 和 Enviroplex。行動模組化部門專注於模組化建築和便攜式儲存。便攜式儲存部門包括由鋼製容器組成的租賃庫存，用於提供臨時儲存解決方案，將其交付到客戶所在地，並滿足安全、臨時儲存和立即存取設備的需求。 TRS-RenTelco 部門包括其電子測試設備業務。 Enviroplex 部門從事教室製造業務，銷售主要用作加州教室的模組化建築。該公司由 Robert P. McGrath 於 1979 年創立，總部位於加州利弗莫爾。

info.description: Russell Inv U.S. Small Cap Equity Active ETF seeks to provide long term capital growth. The fund has a non-fundamental policy to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes in small capitalization equity securities economically tied to the U.S. It invests principally in common stocks of small capitalization U.S. companies, some of which are also considered micro capitalization U.S. companies.
info.description_zh: Russell Inv 美國小型股主動型 ETF 致力於提供長期資本成長。該基金的非基本政策是，在正常情況下，將至少 80% 的淨資產加上用於投資目的的借款投資於與美國經濟相關的小市值股票證券。它主要投資於小市值美國公司的普通股，其中一些也被視為微型美國公司。

info.description: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Japan Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Japan Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Japan AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 日本指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克日本指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可能產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index. The index uses a rules-based methodology that seeks to provide exposure to large-capitalization U.S. companies with above average free cash flow margins. Under normal circumstances, the fund will seek to invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities of large-capitalization companies ("large cap") that are principally traded in the United States. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer US Large Cap Cash Cows Growth Leaders Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數採用基於規則的方法，旨在為自由現金流利潤率高於平均水平的大型美國公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將尋求將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於主要在美國交易的大型公司（「大盤股」）的證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: NVIDIA Corp. engages in the design and manufacture of computer graphics processors, chipsets, and related multimedia software. It operates through the following segments: Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) and Compute & Networking. The Graphics segment includes GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs, the GeForce NOW game streaming service and related infrastructure, Quadro and NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics, virtual GPU, or vGPU, software for cloud-based visual and virtual computing, automotive platforms for infotainment systems, and Omniverse Enterprise software for building and operating metaverse and 3D internet applications. The Compute & Networking segment consists of Data Center accelerated computing platforms and end-to-end networking platforms including Quantum for InfiniBand and Spectrum for Ethernet, NVIDIA DRIVE automated-driving platform and automotive development agreements, Jetson robotics and other embedded platforms, NVIDIA AI Enterprise and other software, and DGX Cloud software and services. The company was founded by Jen Hsun Huang, Chris A. Malachowsky, and Curtis R. Priem in April 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: NVIDIA Corp. 從事電腦圖形處理器、晶片組和相關多媒體軟體的設計和製造。它透過以下部分運作：圖形處理單元（GPU）和運算與網路。圖形部分包括用於遊戲和 PC 的 GeForce GPU、GeForce NOW 遊戲串流服務和相關基礎設施、用於企業工作站圖形的 Quadro 和 NVIDIA RTX GPU、虛擬 GPU 或 vGPU、用於基於雲端的視覺和虛擬計算的軟體、用於資訊娛樂系統的汽車平台以及用於構建和操作 Metaverse 和 3D 互聯網應用程式設計的公司。運算和網路部門包括資料中心加速運算平台和端對端網路平台，包括InfiniBand的Quantum和乙太網路的Spectrum、NVIDIA DRIVE自動駕駛平台和汽車開發協定、Jetson機器人和其他嵌入式平台、NVIDIA AI Enterprise和其他軟體以及DGX Cloud軟體和服務。該公司由 Jen Hsun Huang、Chris A. Malachowsky 和 ​​Curtis R. Priem 於 1993 年 4 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: OFS Credit Company (NASDAQ: OCCI) is a non-diversified, publicly traded, closed-end management company that is registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940. Its objective is to generate current income, with a secondary objective of generating capital appreciation primarily through investment in collateralized loan obligation (CLO) equity and debt securities
info.description_zh: OFS Credit Company（納斯達克股票代碼：OCCI）是一家非多元化、公開交易、封閉式管理公司，根據 1940 年《投資公司法》註冊。其目標是產生經常收入，次要目標是主要透過投資抵押貸款債券 (CLO) 股權和債務證券來產生資本增值

info.description: QuinStreet, Inc. engages in performance marketplaces and technologies for the financial and home services industries. Its approach to proprietary performance marketing technologies allows clients to engage high-intent digital media or traffic from a wide range of device types, in multiple formats or types of media, and in a wide range of cost-per-action. The company was founded by Douglas Valenti on April 16, 1999 and is headquartered in Foster City, CA.
info.description_zh: QuinStreet, Inc. 致力於金融和家庭服務業的績效市場和技術。其專有的績效行銷技術方法使客戶能夠以多種格式或類型的媒體以及各種每次操作成本來吸引來自各種設備類型的高意圖數位媒體或流量。該公司由 Douglas Valenti 於 1999 年 4 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州福斯特城。

info.description: Direxion Daily ORCL Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of ORCL. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of ORCL and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to ORCL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily ORCL Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ORCL 每日業績的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 ORCL 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些組合起來為 ORCL 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Algoma Steel Group, Inc. engages in the production of hot and cold rolled steel products. Its products include Sheet and Plate. The firm offers its products for automative, construction, infrastructure, energy, defense, transportation, and manufacturing industries. The company was founded in February 1901, and is headquartered in Sault Ste. Marie, Canada.
info.description_zh: Algoma Steel Group, Inc. 從事熱軋和冷軋鋼材產品的生產。其產品包括板材和板材。該公司為汽車、建築、基礎設施、能源、國防、運輸和製造業提供產品。該公司成立於 1901 年 2 月，總部位於蘇聖瑪麗。瑪麗，加拿大。

info.description: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. owns and operates retail outlets in the United States. It engages in the distribution and retailing of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies, equipment, and accessories in the U.S., serving both professional installers and do-it-yourself customers. It provides new and remanufactured automotive hard parts, including alternators, starters, fuel pumps, water pumps, brake system components, batteries, belts, hoses, temperature controls, chassis parts and engine parts, maintenance items consisting of oil, antifreeze products, fluids, filters, lighting products, engine additives, and appearance products, and accessories, such as floor mats, seat covers, and truck accessories. Its stores offer auto body paint and related materials, automotive tools, and professional service provider service equipment. The firm stores also offer enhanced services and programs consisting of used oil, oil filter and battery recycling, battery, wiper, and bulb replacement, battery diagnostic testing, electrical and module testing, check engine light code extraction, a loaner tool program, drum and rotor resurfacing, custom hydraulic hoses, professional paint shop mixing and related materials, and machine shops. O'Reilly Automotive stores provide do-it-yourself and professional service provider customers a selection of brand name, house brands, and private label products for domestic and imported automobiles, vans, and trucks. The company was founded by Charles F. O'Reilly and Charles H. O'Reilly in November 1957 and is headquartered in Springfield, MO.
info.description_zh: O'Reilly Automotive, Inc. 在美國擁有並經營零售店。該公司在美國從事汽車售後零件、工具、用品、設備和配件的分銷和零售，為專業安裝人員和自助客戶提供服務。它提供全新和再製造的汽車硬零件，包括交流發電機、起動機、燃油泵、水泵、煞車系統組件、電池、皮帶、軟管、溫控器、底盤零件和引擎零件，維護項目包括機油、防凍產品、液體、過濾器、照明產品、引擎添加劑和外觀產品，以及配件，例如腳踏墊、座椅套和卡車配件。其商店提供車身油漆及相關材料、汽車工具以及專業服務提供者的服務設備。公司商店還提供增強的服務和計劃，包括廢油、機油濾清器和電池回收、電池、雨刮器和燈泡更換、電池診斷測試、電氣和模組測試、檢查發動機燈代碼提取、借用工具計劃、鼓和轉子表面重修、定制液壓軟管、專業噴漆車間混合和相關材料以及機械車間。 O'Reilly Automotive 商店為自助和專業服務供應商客戶提供一系列國產和進口汽車、貨車和卡車的品牌、自有品牌和自有品牌產品。該公司由 Charles F. O'Reilly 和 Charles H. O'Reilly 於 1957 年 11 月創立，總部位於密蘇裡州斯普林菲爾德。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Tail Risk ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Protective Put 90 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies a protective put strategy (i.e. long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 尾部風險 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 季度保護性看跌期權 90 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票並對納斯達克 100 指數應用保護性看跌策略（即多頭（購買）看跌期權）的風險管理策略的績效。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ORCL ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Oracle Corporation (NYSE: ORCL). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long ORCL ETF 尋求甲骨文公司（NYSE：ORCL）每日股價變動百分比兩倍（200%）的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Global Water ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq OMX Global Water IndexSM (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index, as well as ADRs and GDRs that are based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of securities of global exchange-listed companies located in the United States, as well as developed and emerging markets throughout the world, that create products designed to conserve and purify water for homes, businesses and industries. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Global Water ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克 OMX 全球水指數 SM（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成基礎指數的證券，以及基於基礎指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。基礎指數由位於美國以及世界各地已開發和新興市場的全球交易所上市公司的證券組成，這些公司生產旨在為家庭、企業和工業節約和淨化水的產品。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. engages in the development, publishing, and marketing of interactive software games. Its products are designed for console systems, handheld gaming systems, and personal computers, including smart phones and tablets, and are delivered through physical retail, digital download, online platforms, and cloud streaming services. The company was founded by Ryan A. Brant in 1993 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. 從事互動軟體遊戲的開發、發行和行銷。其產品專為遊戲機系統、手持遊戲系統和個人電腦（包括智慧型手機和平板電腦）而設計，並透過實體零售、數位下載、線上平台和雲端串流服務提供。該公司由 Ryan A. Brant 於 1993 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Technology Opportunities ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (measured at the time of purchase) ("Net Assets") in equity investments in technology companies. It seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, in companies that are considered by the Investment Adviser to benefit from the proliferation of technology. The fund may invest up to 25% of its total assets measured at the time of purchase ("Total Assets") in foreign securities.
info.description_zh: 高盛科技機會ETF尋求資本的長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款（在購買時計量）（「淨資產」）投資於科技公司的股權投資。在正常情況下，它尋求透過投資投資顧問認為可從技術擴散中受益的公司來實現其投資目標。該基金最多可將其購買時總資產（「總資產」）的 25% 投資於外國證券。

info.description: Firefly Aerospace, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of space launch vehicles. The company was founded by Thomas E. Markusic, Mark Watt, and Max Polyakov in January 2017 and is headquartered in Leander, TX.
info.description_zh: Firefly Aerospace, Inc. 從事航太運載火箭的設計與製造。該公司由 Thomas E. Markusic、Mark Watt 和 Max Polyakov 於 2017 年 1 月創立，總部位於德克薩斯州利安德。

info.description: NerdWallet, Inc. engages in building online tools that provide information, insights, and consumer-driven advice about personal finance. It provides consumer-driven advice about personal finance through its platform by connecting individuals and small and mid-sized businesses with providers of financial products. The company was founded by Tim Chen and Jacob Gibson in 2009 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.
info.description_zh: NerdWallet, Inc. 致力於建立線上工具，提供有關個人理財的資訊、見解和消費者驅動的建議。它透過其平台將個人和中小型企業與金融產品提供者聯繫起來，提供有關個人理財的消費者驅動的建議。該公司由 Tim Chen 和 Jacob Gibson 於 2009 年創立，總部位於加州聖馬刁。

info.description: Albemarle Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and marketing of chemicals for consumer electronics, petroleum refining, utilities, packaging, construction, transportation, pharmaceuticals, crop production, food-safety, and custom chemistry services. It operates through the following segments: Energy Storage, Specialties, and Ketjen. The Energy Storage segment develops and manufactures a broad range of basic lithium compounds, including lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, and lithium chloride. The Specialties segment focuses on optimizing a portfolio of bromine and specialized lithium solutions. The Ketjen segment consists of clean fuels technologies, fluidized catalytic cracking catalysts and additives, and performance catalyst solutions, which is primarily composed of organometallics and curatives. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Charlotte, NC.
info.description_zh: Albemarle Corp. 從事消費性電子、石油精煉、公用事業、包裝、建築、運輸、製藥、農作物生產、食品安全和客製化化學服務的化學品的開發、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：能源儲存部門、專業部門和科琴部門。儲能部門開發和製造各種基本鋰化合物，包括碳酸鋰、氫氧化鋰和氯化鋰。特種產品部門專注於優化溴和特種鋰解決方案的產品組合。 Ketjen 部門包括清潔燃料技術、流化催化裂解催化劑和添加劑以及主要由有機金屬和固化劑組成的高性能催化劑解決方案。該公司成立於 1993 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州夏洛特。

info.description: Orchestra Biomed Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of biomedical technologies to patients through risk-reward-sharing partnerships with medical device companies. The company was founded by David P. Hochman on May 25, 2020 and is headquartered in New Hope, PA.
info.description_zh: Orchestra Biomed Holdings, Inc. 透過與醫療器材公司建立風險回報共享合作夥伴關係，為病患提供生物醫學技術。該公司由 David P. Hochman 於 2020 年 5 月 25 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州紐霍普。

info.description: Touchstone Sands Capital US Select Growth ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund invests primarily in common stocks of U.S. companies that have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth. The manager emphasizes investments in large and mid capitalization growth companies. The fund will invest, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its assets in common stocks of U.S. companies that Sands Capital believes have above-average potential for revenue or earnings growth.
info.description_zh: Touchstone Sands Capital US Select Growth ETF 寻求长期资本增值。该基金主要投资于收入或盈利增长潜力高于平均水平的美国公司的普通股。该经理强调对大中型资本成长型公司的投资。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的資產投資於金沙資本認為具有高於平均水平的收入或獲利成長潛力的美國公司的普通股。

info.description: iShares MSCI Qatar ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI All Qatar Capped Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the equity market in Qatar. The underlying index uses a capping methodology that limits the weight of any single "group entity" to a maximum of 25% of the underlying index weight. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 卡達 ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI 全卡達上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整市值加權指數，旨在衡量卡達股市。標的指數使用上限方法，將任何單一「集團實體」的權重限制為標的指數權重的最大 25%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: OSI Systems, Inc. engages in the design and manufacture of specialized electronic systems and components for critical applications. It operates through the following segments: Security, Optoelectronics and Manufacturing, Healthcare, and Corporate and Eliminations. The Security segment includes security and inspection systems, and turnkey security screening solutions. The Optoelectronics and Manufacturing segment refers to electronic components and electronic manufacturing services. The Healthcare segment focuses on the provision of patient monitoring, cardiology and remote monitoring, connected care systems, and associated accessories. The Corporate and Eliminations segment represents the executive compensation and certain other general and administrative expenses. The company was founded by Deepak Chopra in May 1987 and is headquartered in Hawthorne, CA.
info.description_zh: OSI Systems, Inc. 從事關鍵應用專用電子系統和組件的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：安全部門、光電子和製造部門、醫療保健部門以及企業和消除部門。安全部門包括安全和檢查系統以及統包安全檢查解決方案。光電子和製造部門是指電子元件和電子製造服務。醫療保健部門專注於提供病患監護、心臟病學和遠距監護、連網護理系統以及相關配件。公司和沖銷部分代表高階主管薪酬和某些其他一般和管理費用。該公司由 Deepak Chopra 於 1987 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州霍桑。

info.description: iShares S&P Small-Cap 600 Growth ETF seeks to track the investment results of the S&P SmallCap 600 Growth IndexTM composed of small-capitalization U.S. equities that exhibit growth characteristics. The index measures the performance of the small-capitalization growth sector of the U.S. equity market. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents.
info.description_zh: iShares S&P Small-Cap 600 Growth ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Growth IndexTM 的投資結果，該指數由具有成長特徵的小型美國股票組成。該指數衡量美國股市小型成長型板塊的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。

info.description: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The firm focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative treatments for severe, rare muscle disorders for which there is significant unmet medical need. Its platform utilizes custom-built throughput and translatable systems that measure integrated muscle function in whole organ extracts to identify small molecule precision medicines regulating key proteins in muscle tissue, initially focused on addressing rare neuromuscular and cardiac diseases. The company was founded by Badreddin Edris, Alan Russel and Peter A. Thompson in 2017 and is headquartered in Boulder, CO.
info.description_zh: Edgewise Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司。該公司專注於針對嚴重、罕見肌肉疾病的創新療法的發現、開發和商業化，這些疾病的醫療需求尚未得到滿足。其平台利用定制的通量和可翻譯系統來測量整個器官提取物中的綜合肌肉功能，以識別調節肌肉組織中關鍵蛋白質的小分子精準藥物，最初專注於解決罕見的神經肌肉和心臟病。該公司由 Badreddin Edris、Alan Russel 和 Peter A. Thompson 於 2017 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州博爾德。

info.description: Daktronics, Inc. engages in designing and manufacturing electronic scoreboards, programmable display systems and large screen video displays for sporting, commercial and transportation applications. It operates through the following segments: Commercial, Live Events, High School Park and Recreation, Transportation, and International. The Commercial segment sells video, display systems, digital billboards, Galaxy, and Fuelight product lines to resellers, out-of-home companies, national retailers, quick-serve restaurants, casinos, shopping centers, cruise ships, commercial building owners, and petroleum retailers. The Live Events segment provides scoring and video display systems to college and professional sports facilities and convention centers and the sale of mobile display technology to video rental organizations and other live events type venues. The High School Park and Recreation segment engages in the sale of scoring systems, Galaxy displays, and video display systems to primary and secondary education facilities. The Transportation segment consists of sales of Vanguard and Galaxy product lines to governmental transportation departments, airlines, and other transportation related customers. The International segment is composed of sales of all product lines outside the United States and Canada. The company was founded by Aelred J. Kurtenbach and Duane E. Sander in 1968 and is headquartered in Brookings, SD.
info.description_zh: Daktronics, Inc. 致力於設計和製造用於體育、商業和交通應用的電子記分牌、可編程顯示系統和大螢幕視訊顯示器。它透過以下部門運作：商業、現場活動、高中公園和娛樂、交通和國際。商業部門向經銷商、戶外公司、全國零售商、快餐店、賭場、購物中心、遊輪、商業建築業主和石油零售商銷售影片、顯示系統、數位廣告看板、Galaxy 和 Fuellight 產品線。現場活動部門為大學和專業體育設施和會議中心提供計分和視訊顯示系統，並向視訊租賃組織和其他現場活動類型場所銷售行動顯示技術。高中公園和娛樂部門向中小學教育設施銷售計分系統、Galaxy 顯示器和視訊顯示系統。運輸部門包括向政府運輸部門、航空公司和其他運輸相關客戶銷售 Vanguard 和 Galaxy 產品線。國際部門由美國和加拿大以外所有產品線的銷售組成。該公司由 Aelred J. Kurtenbach 和 Duane E. Sander 於 1968 年創立，總部位於南達科他州布魯金斯。

info.description: ADMA Biologics, Inc. operates as a biopharmaceutical company, which is engaged in manufacturing, marketing, and developing specialty plasma-derived biologics. The firm operates through the following business segments: ADMA BioManufacturing and Plasma Collection Center. The ADMA BioManufacturing segment consists of immune globulin manufacturing and development operations. The Plasma Collection Center consists of source plasma collection facilities. The company was founded by Adam S. Grossman and Jerrold B. Grossman on June 24, 2004 and is headquartered in Ramsey, NJ.
info.description_zh: ADMA Biologics, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，從事製造、行銷和開發特種血漿衍生生物製劑。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：ADMA 生物製造和血漿採集中心。 ADMA 生物製造部門包括免疫球蛋白製造和開發業務。血漿採集中心由源頭血漿採集設施組成。該公司由 Adam S. Grossman 和 Jerrold B. Grossman 於 2004 年 6 月 24 日創立，總部位於新澤西州拉姆齊。

info.description: Maplebear, Inc. engages in the design and development of an online application that offers grocery delivery and pick-up services. The firm offers Instacart which enables users to connect with personal shoppers in the area who pick up and deliver groceries from local stores. The company was founded by Apoorva Mehta, Brandon Leonardo, and Max Mullen in 2012 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Maplebear, Inc. 從事設計和開發提供雜貨配送和提貨服務的線上應用程式。該公司提供 Instacart，使用戶能夠與該地區從當地商店提貨和送貨的個人購物者聯繫。該公司由 Apoorva Mehta、Brandon Leonardo 和 Max Mullen 於 2012 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: NextCure, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovering and developing immunomedicines to treat cancer and other immune-related diseases. Its novel FIND-IO discovery technology identifies targets based on immunomodulatory function and on which the company is building a proprietary pipeline of immunomedicines. The company was founded by Michael S. Richman and Lie Ping Chen in September 2015 and is headquartered in Beltsville, MD.
info.description_zh: NextCure, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發治療癌症和其他免疫相關疾病的免疫藥物。其新穎的 FIND-IO 發現技術根據免疫調節功能來識別靶點，並在此基礎上該公司正在建立專有的免疫藥物管道。該公司由 Michael S. Richman 和 Lie Ping Chen 於 2015 年 9 月創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州貝爾茨維爾。

info.description: Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bluestar 5G Communications Index (the index). The fund uses a passive management approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a tiered, modified market capitalization-weighted portfolio of the U.S.-listed equity securities, including depositary receipts, of companies whose products or services are predominantly tied to the development of 5G networking and communication technologies.
info.description_zh: Defiance 5G Next Gen Connectivity ETF 旨在追蹤藍星 5G 通訊指數（簡稱「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金採用被動管理方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由在美國上市的股票證券（包括其產品或服務主要與 5G 網路和通訊技術的發展相關的公司的存託憑證）的分級、修改後的市值加權投資組合組成。

info.description: TSS, Inc. engages in the provision of comprehensive services for the planning, design, development and maintenance of mission-critical facilities and information infrastructure as well as integration services. It operates through the Facilities and Systems Integration Services business segments. The Facilities segment consists of the design, project management, and maintenance of data center and mission-critical business operations. The Systems Integration segment integrates information technology equipment for original equipment manufacturer vendors and customers to be used inside data center environments, including modular data centers. The company was founded by Gerard J. Gallagher on December 20, 2004 and is headquartered in Georgetown, TX.
info.description_zh: TSS, Inc. 致力於為關鍵任務設施和資訊基礎設施的規劃、設計、開發和維護以及整合服務提供綜合服務。它透過設施和系統整合服務業務部門運作。設施部門包括資料中心和關鍵任務業務運作的設計、專案管理和維護。系統整合部門為原始設備製造商供應商和客戶整合資訊科技設備，以便在資料中心環境（包括模組化資料中心）內使用。該公司由 Gerard J. Gallagher 於 2004 年 12 月 20 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州喬治敦。

info.description: Cisco Systems, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of Internet Protocol-based networking products and services related to the communications and information technology industry. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: the Americas, EMEA, and APJC. Its products include the following categories: Secure, Agile Networks, Internet for the Future, Collaboration, End-to-End Security, Optimized Application Experiences, and Other Products. The company was founded by Sandra Lerner and Leonard Bosack in 1984 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Cisco Systems, Inc. 從事與通訊和資訊科技產業相關的基於互聯網協定的網路產品和服務的設計、製造和銷售。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美洲、歐洲、中東和非洲和亞太及日本地區。其產品包括以下類別：安全性、敏捷網路、未來網路、協作、端到端安全、優化應用體驗和其他產品。該公司由 Sandra Lerner 和 Leonard Bosack 於 1984 年創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。
