info.description: Great Elm Capital Corp., a publicly traded business development company located in the United States, which operates through the broad range of sectors. The company was founded on April 01, 2016, and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: Great Elm Capital Corp. 是一家位於美國的上市業務開發公司，業務涉及廣泛的行業。該公司成立於2016年4月1日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: United Fire Group, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the business of writing property, casualty insurance, life insurance, and selling annuities through a network of independent agencies. The firm operates through the following segments: Property and Casualty Insurance and Life Insurance. The Property and Casualty Insurance segment includes commercial lines insurance, personal lines insurance, and assumed reinsurance. The Life Insurance segment includes deferred and immediate annuities, universal life products and traditional life insurance products. The company was founded in January 1946 and is headquartered in Cedar Rapids, IA.
info.industry_zh: 保險 - 財產與意外傷害
info.description_zh: United Fire Group, Inc. 是一家控股公司，透過獨立機構網路從事財產保險、傷亡保險、人壽保險和年金銷售業務。該公司透過以下部門運作：財產和意外保險以及人壽保險。財產和意外保險部門包括商業保險、個人保險和假定再保險。人壽保險部門包括遞延年金和即期年金、萬能壽險產品和傳統人壽保險產品。該公司成立於 1946 年 1 月，總部位於愛荷華州錫達拉皮茲。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.5x Long NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.5 times (150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of NVIDIA Corporation. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Underlying Stock. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 1.5 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 NVIDIA 公司普通股每日百分比變化的 1.5 倍 (150%)。基金將與主要金融機構簽訂一項或多項互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和金融機構將同意交換標的股票賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Turn Therapeutics, Inc. is a pharmaceutical and medical device development company. Its primary development programs focus on dermatological diseases. The company was founded by Bradley Burnam on January 6, 2015 and is headquartered in Westlake Village, CA.
info.description_zh: Turn Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家製藥和醫療設備開發公司。其主要開發計劃側重於皮膚病。該公司由 Bradley Burnam 於 2015 年 1 月 6 日創立，總部位於加州西湖村。

info.description: Braze, Inc. operates a customer relationship management platform for mobile applications. Its application combines messaging, audience segmentation, analytics and user support in a single integrated solution. The firm offers push notifications, email, in-app messages, and news feed services. The company was founded by Mark Ghermezian, William Magnuson, and Jonathan Hyman on March 28, 2011 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Braze, Inc. 經營行動應用程式的客戶關係管理平台。其應用程式將訊息傳遞、受眾細分、分析和用戶支援結合在一個整合解決方案中。該公司提供推播通知、電子郵件、應用程式內訊息和新聞源服務。該公司由 Mark Ghermezian、William Magnuson 和 Jonathan Hyman 於 2011 年 3 月 28 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: ViaSat, Inc. engages in providing communications technologies and services. It operates through the Communication Services and Defense and Advanced Technologies business segments. The Communication Services business segment provides a wide range of broadband and narrowband communications solutions across government and commercial mobility markets. The Defense and Advanced Technologies business segment develops and offers a diverse array of resilient, vertically integrated solutions to government and commercial customers, leveraging the company's technical competencies in encryption, cyber security, tactical gateways, modems, and waveforms. The company was founded by Mark D. Dankberg and Mark J. Miller on May 1, 1986 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: ViaSat, Inc. 從事提供通訊技術和服務。它透過通訊服務以及國防和先進技術業務部門運作。通訊服務業務部門為政府和商業行動市場提供廣泛的寬頻和窄頻通訊解決方案。國防和先進技術業務部門利用公司在加密、網路安全、戰術網關、數據機和波形方面的技術能力，為政府和商業客戶開發並提供各種彈性、垂直整合的解決方案。該公司由 Mark D. Dankberg 和 Mark J. Miller 於 1986 年 5 月 1 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: DuPont de Nemours, Inc. engages in the development and manufacture of specialty materials and technology-based products. It operates through the Healthcare & Water Technologies and Diversified Industrials segments. The Healthcare & Water Technologies segment includes packaging, parts, and components for medical device and biopharma markets and water filtration and purification technologies primarily for industrial wastewater and energy, municipal drinking water and desalination, and life sciences and specialty markets. The Diversified Industrials segment builds technologies, with a portfolio serving new-build, repair, and remodel applications across non-residential and residential construction markets, and industrial technologies, which include a portfolio of adhesive, wear and friction, and packaging solutions serving aerospace, automotive, printing, and packaging markets. The company was founded in 1802 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: 杜邦德內穆爾公司從事特殊材料和技術產品的開發和製造。它透過醫療保健和水技術以及多元化工業部門運作。醫療保健和水技術部門包括用於醫療器材和生物製藥市場的包裝、零件和組件，以及主要用於工業廢水和能源、市政飲用水和海水淡化以及生命科學和專業市場的水過濾和淨化技術。多元化工業部門建構技術，提供服務於非住宅和住宅建築市場的新建、維修和改造應用的產品組合，以及工業技術，其中包括服務於航空航太、汽車、印刷和包裝市場的黏合劑、磨損和摩擦以及包裝解決方案的產品組合。該公司成立於 1802 年，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd. provides intelligent robotics and supply chain solutions to enterprises. It offers smart automation systems for industrial processes, logistics and retail stores. The firm operates through the following segments: Intelligent Robotics, Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), and Supply Chain Solutions. The company was founded by Israel Gal in 1990 and is headquartered in Rishon LeZion, Israel.
info.description_zh: BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd. 為企業提供智慧機器人和供應鏈解決方案。它為工業流程、物流和零售商店提供智慧自動化系統。該公司透過以下部門運作：智慧機器人、無線射頻識別 (RFID) 和供應鏈解決方案。該公司由 Israel Gal 於 1990 年創立，總部位於以色列裡雄萊錫安。

info.description: Netflix, Inc. engages in providing entertainment services. It also offers activities for leisure time, entertainment video, video gaming, and other sources of entertainment. It operates through the United States and International geographic segments. The company was founded by Marc Randolph and Wilmot Reed Hastings on August 29, 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Netflix, Inc. 從事提供娛樂服務。它還提供休閒活動、娛樂影片、視頻遊戲和其他娛樂來源。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Marc Randolph 和 Wilmot Reed Hastings 於 1997 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on the discovery, acquisition, and development of small molecules and biologics to treat and prevent human disease and alleviate suffering. Its portfolio includes TNX-102 SL, TNX-601, TNX-801, and TNX-1800. The company was founded by Seth Lederman and Donald W. Landry on November 16, 2007 and is headquartered in Berkeley Heights, NJ.
info.description_zh: Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於發現、收購和開發小分子和生物製劑，以治療和預防人類疾病並減輕痛苦。其產品組合包括 TNX-102 SL、TNX-601、TNX-801 和 TNX-1800。該公司由 Seth Lederman 和 Donald W. Landry 於 2007 年 11 月 16 日創立，總部位於新澤西州 Berkeley Heights。

info.description: Guardant Health, Inc. is a precision oncology company, which engages in the provision of treatment of cancer through the use of proprietary blood-based tests, vast data sets, and advanced analytics. Its solutions include treatment selection, recurrence detection, and early detection. The company was founded by Helmy Eltoukhy, AmirAli H. Talasaz, and Michael Joseph Wiley in December 2011 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: Guardant Health, Inc. 是一家精準腫瘤學公司，透過使用專有的血液檢查、大量數據集和高級分析來提供癌症治療。其解決方案包括治療選擇、復發檢測和早期檢測。該公司由 Helmy Eltoukhy、AmirAli H. Talasaz 和 Michael Joseph Wiley 於 2011 年 12 月創立，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of NVDA and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that provide leveraged exposure to NVDA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares 尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 NVDA 每日表現的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NVDA 的證券以及為 NVDA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long NVDA Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of NVDA. The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics, that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to NVDA, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 NVDA 每日 ETF 尋求 NVDA 普通股價格每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金是主動式管理ETF。它將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來為 NVDA 提供 200% 的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Elmet Group Co. engages in the provision of precision-engineered components. The firm offers its products and solutions to aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, semiconductor, electronics, energy industry and also the government. It operates through the Critical Materials Components and Engineered Microwave Products business divisions. The company was founded on September 13, 2024 and is headquartered in Portland, ME.
info.description_zh: Elmet Group Co. 從事提供精密設計的零件。該公司為航空航太、國防、工業、醫療、半導體、電子、能源產業以及政府提供產品和解決方案。它透過關鍵材料組件和工程微波產品業務部門運作。該公司成立於2024年9月13日，總部位於緬因州波特蘭。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Utilities & Communication Services ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Utilities & Communication Services Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the utilities and communication services sectors, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap 公用事業和通訊服務 ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped 公用事業和通訊服務指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的公用事業和通信服務行業小型美國公司的證券表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Prospect Capital Corp., a traded business development company invests in middle market companies located in the United States. The fund targets companies operating across a broad range of sectors. It provides debt and equity financing for buyout, growth, development, and recapitalization. It acts as a co-investor and takes controlling interest. The company was founded on April 13, 2004 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Prospect Capital Corp. 是一家上市業務開發公司，投資於位於美國的中間市場公司。該基金的目標投資對象涉及多個行業的公司。它為收購、成長、發展和資本重組提供債務和股權融資。它作為共同投資者並擁有控股權。該公司成立於2004年4月13日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: iShares MSCI China Multisector Tech ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI China Technology Sub-Industries Select Capped Index composed of Chinese equities in technology and technology-related industries. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI 中國多板塊科技 ETF 旨在追蹤由中國科技及科技相關產業股票組成的 MSCI 中國科技次產業精選上限指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Winmark Corp. engages in operating a franchise retail store which includes children's and women's apparel, sporting goods, and musical instruments. The firm's franchise brands include Plato's Closet, Once Upon A Child, Play It Again Sports, Style Encore, and Music Go Round. It operates through the Franchising and Other segments. The Franchising segment is involved in value-oriented retail store concepts that buy, sell, trade, and consign merchandise, and provides strategic consulting services related to franchising. The Other segment includes the middle-market equipment leasing and small-ticket franchising businesses conducted through Winmark Capital Corp. and Wirth Business Credit, Inc. The company was founded on July 20, 1988 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: Winmark Corp. 從事特許經營零售店的經營，其中包括兒童和女性服裝、體育用品和樂器。該公司的特許經營品牌包括 Plato's Closet、Once Upon A Child、Play It Again Sports、Style Encore 和 Music Go Round。它透過特許經營和其他部門運作。特許經營部門涉及以價值為導向的零售商店概念，購買、銷售、交易和寄售商品，並提供與特許經營相關的策略諮詢服務。其他部門包括透過 Winmark Capital Corp. 和 Wirth Business Credit, Inc. 進行的中階市場設備租賃和小額特許經營業務。該公司成立於 1988 年 7 月 20 日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. engages in the provision of global logistics services. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Other North America, Latin America, North Asia, South Asia, Europe, and Middle East, Africa, and India. It offers air freight, ocean freight and ocean and customs brokerage and other services. It also provides customer solutions such as order management, time-definite transportation, warehousing and distribution, temperature-controlled transit, cargo insurance and customized logistics solutions. The company was founded by John M. Kaiser, Peter Rose, Wang Li Kou, Kevin Walsh, Hank Wong, George Ho, Robert Chiarito, and Glenn Alger in 1979 and is headquartered in Bellevue, WA.
info.description_zh: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. 從事提供全球物流服務。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、北美其他地區、拉丁美洲、北亞、南亞、歐洲、中東、非洲和印度。它提供空運、海運以及海運和報關等服務。它還為客戶提供訂單管理、限時運輸、倉儲配送、溫控運輸、貨物保險和客製化物流解決方案等解決方案。該公司由 John M. Kaiser、Peter Rose、Wang Li Kou、Kevin Walsh、Hank Wong、George Ho、Robert Chiarito 和 Glenn Alger 於 1979 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州貝爾維尤。

info.description: Amphenol Corp. engages in the design, manufacture, and marketing of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products, and specialty cable. It operates through the following segments: Harsh Environment Solutions, Communications Solutions, and Interconnect and Sensor Systems. The Harsh Environment Solutions segment manufactures and markets a broad range of ruggedized interconnect products, including connectors and interconnect systems, printed circuits and printed circuit assemblies, and other products. The Communications Solutions segment focuses on the design, manufacture, and marketing of connector and interconnect systems, including radio frequency, power, fiber optic, and other products, together with antennas. The Interconnect and Sensor Systems segment is involved in the design, manufacture, and marketing of sensors, sensor-based systems, connectors, and value-add interconnect systems. The company was founded by Schmitt J. Arthur in 1932 and is headquartered in Wallingford, CT.
info.description_zh: 安費諾公司從事電氣、電子和光纖連接器、互連繫統、天線、感測器和基於感測器的產品以及特殊電纜的設計、製造和行銷。它透過以下部門運作：惡劣環境解決方案、通訊解決方案以及互連和感測器系統。惡劣環境解決方案部門製造和銷售各種堅固耐用的互連產品，包括連接器和互連繫統、印刷電路和印刷電路組件以及其他產品。通訊解決方案部門專注於連接器和互連系統的設計、製造和行銷，包括射頻、電源、光纖和其他產品以及天線。互連和感測器系統部門涉及感測器、基於感測器的系統、連接器和增值互連系統的設計、製造和行銷。該公司由 Schmitt J. Arthur 於 1932 年創立，總部位於康乃狄克州沃靈福德。

info.description: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and commercialization of therapeutics for patients with rare diseases. The firm offers IMCIVREE (setmelanotide), a precision medicine designed to treat hyperphagia and severe obesity caused by rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) diseases. It is also involved in the clinical development program for setmelanotide in other rare MC4R pathway diseases, as well as a preclinical suite of investigational candidates for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism. The company was founded by Bart Henderson in November 2008 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，致力於罕見疾病患者治療藥物的開發和商業化。該公司提供 IMCIVREE（setmelanotide），這是一種精準藥物，旨在治療由罕見的黑皮質素 4 受體（MC4R）疾病引起的食慾過盛和嚴重肥胖。它還參與了 setmelanotide 在其他罕見 MC4R 通路疾病中的臨床開發計劃，以及用於治療先天性高胰島素血症的臨床前研究候選藥物套件。該公司由 Bart Henderson 於 2008 年 11 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: U.S. Gold Corp. engages in the exploration of gold properties. It has properties in CK Gold Project, Wyoming, Challis Gold Project, Idaho, and Keystone, Nevada. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Elko, NV.
info.description_zh: 美国黄金公司从事黄金矿产勘探。該公司在懷俄明州 CK Gold 項目、愛達荷州 Challis Gold 項目和內華達州 Keystone 擁有資產。該公司成立於 1967 年，總部位於內華達州埃爾科。

info.description: GE Aerospace is an American aircraft company, which engages in the provision of jet and turboprop engines, as well as integrated systems for commercial, military, business, and general aviation aircraft. The firm's portfolio of brands includes Avio Aero, Unison, GE Additive, and Dowty Propellers. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Engines and Services, Defense and Propulsion Technologies, and Corporate and Other. The Commercial Engines and Services segment is involved in the design, development, manufacturing, and servicing of jet engines for commercial airframes, as well as business aviation and aeroderivative applications. The Defense and Propulsion Technologies segment offers defense engines and critical aircraft systems. The Corporate and Other segment relates to corporate functions and operations costs. The company was founded by Thomas Alva Edison in 1878 and is headquartered in Evendale, OH.
info.description_zh: GE航空航太公司是一家美國飛機公司，主要為商用、軍用、公務和通用航空飛機提供噴射和渦輪螺旋槳發動機以及整合系統。該公司的品牌組合包括 Avio Aero、Unison、GE Additive 和 Dowty Propellers。它透過以下部門運作：商用引擎和服務部門、國防和推進技術部門以及企業和其他部門。商用發動機和服務部門涉及商用機身噴射發動機的設計、開發、製造和維修，以及公務航空和航改應用。國防和推進技術部門提供國防發動機和關鍵飛機系統。公司及其他部門涉及公司職能和營運成本。該公司由托馬斯·阿爾瓦·愛迪生於 1878 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州埃文代爾。

info.description: Direxion Daily AVGO Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of AVGO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of AVGO and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily AVGO Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 AVGO 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 AVGO 證券和掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 AVGO 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pro-Dex, Inc. engages in the design, development and manufacture of rotary drive surgical and dental instruments. The firm specializes in medical devices and services, industrial and scientific, dental and component, repairs and other. Its products include finished medical devices, micro air-motors, dental products, plastic injection molding and torque wrenches. The company was founded on January 26, 1994 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Pro-Dex, Inc. 從事旋轉驅動手術和牙科器械的設計、開發和製造。該公司專注於醫療設備和服務、工業和科學、牙科和零件、維修等。其產品包括成品醫療器材、微型氣動馬達、牙科產品、塑膠射出成型和扭力扳手。該公司成立於1994年1月26日，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Largo Inc. is a natural resource and battery energy storage system company. It is engaged in the exploration and production of vanadium at the Maracas Menchen Mine located in Brazil. The firm mines and sells vanadium pentoxide flakes, high purity vanadium pentoxide flakes, and high purity vanadium pentoxide powder. It also focuses on the advancement of renewable energy storage solutions through its vanadium redox flow battery technology. The company was founded on April 18, 1988 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Largo Inc.是一家自然資源和電池儲能係統公司。它在位於巴西的Maracas Menchen礦從事釩的勘探和生產。該公司開採並銷售片狀五氧化二釩、片狀五氧化二釩和粉狀五氧化二釩。它還專注於透過釩氧化還原液流電池技術推進再生能源儲存解決方案。該公司成立於1988年4月18日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: GraniteShares 2x Long AVGO Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Broadcom Inc. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund that attempts to replicate 2 times (200%) the daily percentage change the underlying stock by entering into financial instruments such as swaps and options on the underlying stock as well as directly purchasing the underlying stock. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares 2x Long AVGO Daily ETF 尋求未計費用和開支的每日投資結果為 Broadcom Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，試圖透過簽訂標的股票掉期和選擇權等金融工具以及直接購買標的股票來複製標的股票每日百分比變化的 2 倍 (200%)。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Willdan Group, Inc. engages in the provision of technical and consulting services. It operates through the Energy and Engineering & Consulting segments. The Energy segment offers energy and sustainability consulting services to utilities, public agencies, and private industries. The Engineering and Consulting segment manages civil engineering-related construction management, building and safety, city engineering office management, city planning, civil design, geotechnical, material testing and other engineering consulting services. The company was founded by Dan W. Heil and William Stookey in May 1964 and is headquartered in Anaheim, CA.
info.description_zh: Willdan Group, Inc. 從事提供技術和諮詢服務。它透過能源和工程與諮詢部門運作。能源部門為公用事業、公共機構和私營企業提供能源和永續發展諮詢服務。工程與顧問部門管理土木工程相關的施工管理、建築與安全、城市工程辦公室管理、城市規劃、土木設計、岩土、材料測試和其他工程諮詢服務。該公司由 Dan W. Heil 和 William Stookey 於 1964 年 5 月創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州阿納海姆。

info.description: Globe Life, Inc. is an insurance holding company, which engages in the provision of individual life and supplemental health insurance products and services. It operates through the following segments: Life Insurance, Health Insurance, and Investments Insurance. The Life Insurance segment offers products marketed by Globe Life include traditional whole life and term life insurance. The Health Insurance segment is involved in the renewable and includes Medicare Supplement, cancer, critical illness, accident, and other limited-benefit supplemental hospital and surgical products. The Investments Insurance segment refers to the management of capital resources, including investments, and the management of liquidity. The company was founded on November 19, 1979, and is headquartered in McKinney, TX.
info.description_zh: Globe Life, Inc.是一家保險控股公司，從事提供個人人壽和補充健康保險產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：人壽保險、健康保險和投資保險。人壽保險部門提供 Globe Life 行銷的產品，包括傳統的終身人壽保險和定期人壽保險。健康保險部門涉及再生保險，包括醫療保險補充、癌症、重大疾病、事故和其他有限福利補充醫院和手術產品。投資保險部門是指資本資源的管理，包括投資和流動性的管理。該公司成立於1979年11月19日，總部位於德克薩斯州麥金尼。

info.description: iShares MSCI UAE ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI All UAE Capped Index composed of UAE equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The index is designed to measure the equity market in the United Arab Emirates ("UAE"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares MSCI UAE ETF 旨在追蹤由阿聯酋股票組成的 MSCI All UAE Capped Index 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數旨在衡量阿拉伯聯合大公國（「UAE」）的股票市場。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Star Equity Holdings, Inc. is a diversified holding company, that seeks to build long-term shareholder value by acquiring, managing, and growing businesses with strong fundamentals and market opportunities. Its current structure consists of four divisions: Building Solutions, Business Services, Energy Services, and Investments. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Old Greenwich, CT.
info.description_zh: Star Equity Holdings, Inc.是一家多元化控股公司，致力於透過收購、管理和發展具有強勁基本面和市場機會的業務來建立長期股東價值。其目前的結構由四個部門組成：建築解決方案、商業服務、能源服務和投資。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於康乃狄克州老格林威治。

info.description: Astronics Corp. engages in the provision of electrical power generation and distribution systems. The firm includes motion systems, lighting and safety systems, avionics products, aircraft structures, systems certification, and automated test systems. It operates through the Aerospace and Test Systems segments. The Aerospace segment designs and manufactures products for the global aerospace industry. The Test Systems segment designs, develops, manufactures and maintains communications and weapons test systems and training and simulation devices for military applications. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in East Aurora, NY.
info.description_zh: Astronics Corp. 從事提供發電和配電系統。該公司包括運動系統、照明和安全系統、航空電子產品、飛機結構、系統認證和自動化測試系統。它透過航空航天和測試系統部門運作。航空航天部門為全球航空航天工業設計和製造產品。測試系統部門設計、開發、製造和維護通訊和武器測試系統以及軍事應用的訓練和模擬設備。該公司成立於 1968 年，總部位於紐約州東奧羅拉。

info.description: Carvana Co. is a holding company and an eCommerce platform, which engages in the buying and selling of used cars. The company was founded by Ernest Garcia, III, Benjamin Huston and Ryan Keeton in 2012 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: Carvana Co.是一家控股公司和電子商務平台，從事二手車買賣。該公司由 Ernest Garcia, III、Benjamin Huston 和 Ryan Keeton 於 2012 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long ALB Daily ETF seeks to provide two times (200%) the daily performance of the common stock of Albemarle Corporation (ALB), before fees and expenses. The fund is designed for sophisticated investors to gain amplified exposure to the price movements of a leading global lithium producer through the use of derivative instruments.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 ALB 每日 ETF 旨在提供雅寶公司 (ALB) 普通股每日表現的兩倍 (200%)（未扣除費用和開支）。該基金專為經驗豐富的投資者而設計，透過使用衍生性工具，擴大對全球領先鋰生產商價格變動的曝險。

info.description: SiTime Corp.is a micro-electromechanical system-based silicon timing solution. The company is transforming the timing industry with configurable solutions that replace legacy quartz devices and enable customers to differentiate their products with performance, smaller size, lower power, and reliability. The company was founded by Markus Lutz and Aaron Partridge on December 3, 2003 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: SiTime Corp.是一家基於微機電系統的矽計時解決方案。該公司正在透過可配置的解決方案來改變計時行業，這些解決方案取代了傳統的石英裝置，並使客戶能夠憑藉性能、更小的尺寸、更低的功耗和可靠性來區分他們的產品。該公司由 Markus Lutz 和 Aaron Partridge 於 2003 年 12 月 3 日創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Spear Alpha ETF seeks long-term capital growth. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that will invest primarily in equity securities, including common stock or American depositary receipts ("ADRs") of companies that Spear Advisors LLC (the "Adviser") believes are poised to benefit from breakthrough innovation in industrial technology. The Adviser defines "innovation in industrial technology" as those technological developments that are transforming or have the potential to transform the industrial sector. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Spear Alpha ETF 尋求長期資本成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要投資於股票證券，包括 Spear Advisors LLC（「顧問」）認為有望從工業技術突破性創新中受益的公司的普通股或美國存託憑證（「ADR」）。顧問將「工業技術創新」定義為那些正在改變或有潛力改變工業部門的技術發展。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Starling Oncology, Inc. provides cancer care treatment services. It operates through the following business segments: Dispensary, Patient Care, and Clinical Trials and Other. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Cerritos, CA.
info.description_zh: Starling Oncology, Inc. 提供癌症護理治療服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：藥房、病患照護、臨床試驗及其他。該公司成立於 2007 年，總部位於加州塞里托斯。

info.description: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. provides outpatient mental health services. It offers patients a suite of mental health services, including psychiatric evaluations and treatment, psychological, and neuropsychological testing, as well as individual, family, and group therapy. The firm operates outpatient mental health platform as well as offers patients care virtually through its online delivery platform or in-person at its centers in 32 states. The company was founded by Michael K. Lester, Gwen H. Booth and Danish J. Qureshi in 2017 and is headquartered in Scottsdale, AZ.
info.description_zh: Lifestance Health Group, Inc. 提供門診心理健康服務。它為患者提供一套心理健康服務，包括精神病學評估和治療、心理和神經心理學測試以及個人、家庭和團體治療。該公司經營門診心理健康平台，並透過其線上交付平台或在 32 個州的中心親自為患者提供虛擬護理。該公司由 Michael K. Lester、Gwen H. Booth 和Danish J. Qureshi 於 2017 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州斯科茨代爾。

info.description: Lumentum Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of optical and photonic products. It operates through the Cloud and Networking, and Industrial Tech segments. The Cloud and Networking segment refers to a portfolio of optical and photonic components, modules, and subsystems. The Industrial Tech segment includes solid-state lasers, kilowatt-class fiber lasers, ultrafast lasers, diode lasers, and gas lasers. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: Lumentum Holdings, Inc. 從事提供光學和光子產品。它透過雲端和網路以及工業技術部門運作。雲和網路部分是指光學和光子組件、模組和子系統的組合。工業技術領域包括固態雷射、千瓦級光纖雷射、超快雷射、二極體雷射和氣體雷射。該公司成立於 1979 年，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Direxion Daily CSCO Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of CSCO. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of CSCO and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to CSCO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily CSCO Bull 2X Shares 尋求每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 CSCO 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 CSCO 的證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 CSCO 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global Self Storage, Inc. is a real estate investment trust, which engages in the ownership, operation, management, acquisition, and re-development of self-storage properties. It offers personal, outdoor parking, climate controlled, wine, and business storage facilities. The company was founded on September 1, 1983 and is headquartered in Millbrook, NY.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 專業
info.description_zh: Global Self Storage, Inc.是一家房地產投資信託公司，從事自助倉儲物業的所有權、營運、管理、收購和再開發業務。飯店提供個人室外停車場、氣候控制、葡萄酒和商務儲存設施。該公司成立於1983年9月1日，總部位於紐約州米爾布魯克。

info.description: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. engages in designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing semiconductors and modules. The firm is involved in the provision of products for telecommunications (Telecom), industrial and defense (I&D), and data center industries. The company was founded on March 25, 2009 and is headquartered in Lowell, MA.
info.description_zh: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. 從事設計、開發、製造和行銷半導體和模組。該公司為電信 (Telecom)、工業和國防 (I&D) 以及資料中心產業提供產品。該公司成立於2009年3月25日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州洛威爾。

info.description: Global X Social Media ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Social Media Total Return Index. The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index and in American Depositary Receipts and Global Depositary Receipts based on the securities in the underlying index. The underlying index tracks the equity performance of the largest and most liquid companies involved in the social media industry, including companies that provide social networking, file sharing, and other web-based media applications. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 社群媒體 ETF 力求提供與 Solactive 社群媒體總回報指數未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少80%的總資產投資於標的指數的證券以及基於標的指數的證券的美國存託憑證和全球存託憑證。該指數追蹤社交媒體行業規模最大、流動性最強的公司的股票表現，包括提供社交網路、文件共享和其他基於網路的媒體應用程式的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Blink Charging Co. engages in the operation and provision of electric vehicles, charging equipment, and networked EV charging services. Its product line and services include the Blink EV charging network, charging equipment, also known as electric vehicle supply equipment, and EV charging services. The company was founded by Michael D. Farkas on October 3, 2006 and is headquartered in Bowie, MD.
info.description_zh: Blink Charging Co.從事電動車、充電設備和連網電動車充電服務的營運和提供。其產品線和服務包括Blink EV充電網路、充電設備（也稱為電動車供電設備）和EV充電服務。該公司由 Michael D. Farkas 於 2006 年 10 月 3 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州鮑伊。

info.description: Atea Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a clinical stage company, which focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing antiviral therapeutics. Its product pipelines include Coronaviridae, Flaviviridae, and Paramyxovirdae. The company was founded by Jean-Pierre Sommadossi and David Chu in July 2012 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Atea Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家臨床階段公司，專注於發現、開發和商業化抗病毒療法。其產品線包括冠狀病毒科、黃病毒科和副黏病毒科。該公司由 Jean-Pierre Sommadossi 和 David Chu 於 2012 年 7 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC compiles, maintains and calculates the index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the information technology sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Information Technology Index 的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。標普道瓊斯指數有限責任公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算該指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準所定義的信息技術領域美國小型公司的證券表現。

info.description: Aurora Innovation, Inc. engages in the design and development of automobile hardware, software, and provision of data services. It offers the Aurora Driver which allows a vehicle to drive itself. The company was founded by Christopher Urmson, Sterling Anderson and James Andrew Bagnell in 2017 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Aurora Innovation, Inc.從事汽車硬體、軟體的設計和開發以及提供數據服務。它提供了 Aurora Driver，允許車輛自動駕駛。該公司由 Christopher Urmson、Sterling Anderson 和 James Andrew Bagnell 於 2017 年創立，總部位於賓州匹茲堡。

info.description: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., doing business as SpaceX, operates as an aerospace manufacturer, launch service provider, and satellite communications company. It is building the integrated hardware and software infrastructure of the future across space, connectivity, and AI. The firm designs, manufactures, launches, and operates products and services built on cutting-edge technologies, including the rockets and spacecraft. The company was founded by Elon Reeve Musk in 2002 and is headquartered in Starbase, TX.
info.description_zh: Space Exploration Technologies Corp.（以 SpaceX 名義開展業務）是一家航空航太製造商、發射服務供應商和衛星通訊公司。它正在建立未來跨空間、連接和人工智慧的整合硬體和軟體基礎設施。該公司設計、製造、發射和營運基於尖端技術（包括火箭和太空船）的產品和服務。該公司由 Elon Reeve Musk 於 2002 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州 Starbase。

info.description: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. engages in the provision of power electronics conversion products. Its products include AC-DC power supply units, DC-DC conversion, high voltage amplifiers and power supplies, plasma power, controllers, sense, and measurement. The company was founded by Douglas S. Schatz in 1981 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. 從事提供電力電子轉換產品。其產品包括AC-DC電源裝置、DC-DC轉換、高壓放大器和電源、等離子電源、控制器、感測和測量。該公司由 Douglas S. Schatz 於 1981 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: Sprout Social, Inc. engages in the provision of online social media management tools for businesses. It offers communication tools, contact management, lead generation, and analytics services. The firm also offers solutions for enterprises, agencies, small businesses, customer service, social media marketing, and employee advocacy sectors. The company was founded by Justyn Howard, Aaron Rankin, Gilbert Lara, and Peter Soung on April 21, 2010 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Sprout Social, Inc. 致力於為企業提供線上社群媒體管理工具。它提供通訊工具、聯絡人管理、潛在客戶開發和分析服務。該公司也為企業、機構、小型企業、客戶服務、社群媒體行銷和員工倡導領域提供解決方案。該公司由 Justyn Howard、Aaron Rankin、Gilbert Lara 和 Peter Soung 於 2010 年 4 月 21 日創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: 8x8, Inc. engages in the provision of enterprise communication solutions. It offers solutions to the business services, education, financial services, government, healthcare, and manufacturing industries. The company was founded in February 1987 and is headquartered in Campbell, CA.
info.description_zh: 8x8, Inc. 從事提供企業通訊解決方案。它為商業服務、教育、金融服務、政府、醫療保健和製造業提供解決方案。該公司成立於 1987 年 2 月，總部位於加州坎貝爾。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long CRWV Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of CRWV. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of CRWV, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 CRWV 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 CRWV 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 CRWV 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: XPEL, Inc. engages in the manufacture and distribution of automotive products. It offers paint protection, automotive, flat glass window films, and plotters. The company was founded on October 14, 2003 and is headquartered in San Antonio, TX.
info.description_zh: XPEL, Inc. 從事汽車產品的製造和分銷。它提供油漆保護、汽車、平板玻璃窗膜和繪圖儀。該公司成立於2003年10月14日，總部位於德克薩斯州聖安東尼奧。

info.description: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of transportation services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Domestic, Atlantic, Pacific, and Latin America. The company was founded on December 30, 1968 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: United Airlines Holdings, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事提供運輸服務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：國內、大西洋、太平洋和拉丁美洲。該公司成立於1968年12月30日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Lightwave Logic, Inc. is a development stage company which engages in the commercialization of electro-optic photonic devices. The firm offers the P2ICTM technology platform which uses in-house proprietary organic polymers. Its products include electro-optical modulation devices and proprietary polymer photonic integrated circuits. The company was founded on June 24, 1997 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Lightwave Logic, Inc.是一家處於開發階段的公司，致力於電光光子元件的商業化。該公司提供 P2ICTM 技術平台，該平台使用內部專有的有機聚合物。其產品包括電光調製元件和專有的聚合物光子積體電路。該公司成立於1997年6月24日，總部位於科羅拉多州恩格爾伍德。

info.description: PRA Group, Inc. engages in the purchase, collection and management of portfolios of nonperforming loans. The firm purchase portfolios of nonperforming loans at a discount in two broad categories: Core and Insolvency. It also provides fee-based services on class action claims recoveries and by servicing consumer bankruptcy accounts in the United States. The company was founded by Steven D. Fredrickson and Kevin P. Stevenson on March 20, 1996 and is headquartered in Norfolk, VA.
info.description_zh: PRA Group, Inc. 從事不良貸款組合的購買、催收和管理業務。該公司以折扣價購買兩大類不良貸款組合：核心貸款和破產貸款。它還提供集體訴訟索賠追償的收費服務，並為美國的消費者破產帳戶提供服務。該公司由 Steven D. Fredrickson 和 Kevin P. Stevenson 於 1996 年 3 月 20 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州諾福克。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long AVGO Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of AVGO. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of AVGO, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AVGO 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（扣除費用和開支）為 AVGO 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 AVGO 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVGO ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of Broadcom Inc. (Nasdaq: AVGO) (the "Underlying Security" or "AVGO"). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by entering into swap agreements on the underlying security. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long AVGO ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Broadcom Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：AVGO）（「基礎證券」或「AVGO」）股價每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過簽訂基礎證券掉期協議來實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: OPAL Fuels, Inc. engages in the production and distribution of low-carbon intensity renewable natural gas. It operates as a vertical waste-to-energy model that combines the upstream production and downstream marketing and distribution of RNG. The company operates under the following segments: RNG Fuel, Fuel Station Services, Renewable Power, and Corporate. The RNG Fuel segment relates to all RNG supply and dispensing activities directly related to the generation and sale of brown gas. The Fuel Station Services provides construction and maintenance services to third-party owners of vehicle fueling stations. The Renewable Power segment generates renewable power which is then sold to public utilities. The Corporate segment consists of activities managed and maintained at the company corporate level. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in White Plains, NY.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 受監管的燃氣
info.description_zh: OPAL Fuels, Inc. 從事低碳強度可再生天然氣的生產和分銷。它以垂直垃圾發電模式運作，結合了RNG的上游生產和下游行銷和分銷。該公司經營以下業務部門：RNG 燃料部門、加油站服務部門、再生能源部門和企業部門。 RNG 燃料部門涉及與棕色氣體的產生和銷售直接相關的所有 RNG 供應和分配活動。加油站服務為車輛加油站的第三方所有者提供建造和維護服務。再生能源部門生產再生電力，然後出售給公用事業公司。公司部門由公司層級管理和維護的活動組成。該公司成立於 1998 年，總部位於紐約州懷特普萊恩斯。

info.description: Ouster, Inc. engages in the provision of high resolution digital lidar sensors that offer advanced 3D vision to machinery, vehicles, robots, and fixed infrastructure assets. The company was founded by Angus Pacala and Mark Frichtl on June 30, 2015 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Ouster, Inc. 致力於提供高解析度數位光達感測器，為機械、車輛、機器人和固定基礎設施資產提供先進的 3D 視覺。該公司由 Angus Pacala 和 Mark Frichtl 於 2015 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Zillow Group, Inc. engages in the provision of real estate and home-related information marketplaces on mobile and the web. The company was founded by Richard N. Barton and Lloyd D. Frink in December 2004 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.
info.description_zh: Zillow Group, Inc. 致力於在行動和網路上提供房地產和家居相關資訊市場。該公司由 Richard N. Barton 和 Lloyd D. Frink 於 2004 年 12 月創立，總部位於華盛頓州西雅圖。

info.description: VinFast Auto Ltd. engages in designing and manufacturing electric vehicles. It offers electric scooters (e-scooters) and electric buses (e-buses). It provides e-mobility ecosystem built around customers, community and connectivity alongside new vehicle roll-out. The company was founded by Pham Nhat Vuong in June 2017 and is headquartered in Hai Phong City, Vietnam.
info.description_zh: VinFast Auto Ltd. 從事電動車的設計和製造。它提供電動滑板車（e-scooters）和電動巴士（e-buses）。它提供圍繞客戶、社區和連接性以及新車推出而構建的電動車生態系統。該公司由Pham Nhat Vuong於2017年6月創立，總部位於越南海防市。

info.description: Sabre Corp. is a software and technology company, which engages in the provision of technological solutions to the global travel and tourism industry. It operates through the Travel Solutions and Hospitality Solutions segments. The Travel Solutions segment provides global travel for suppliers and buyers through a business-to-business travel marketplace. The Hospitality Solutions segment provides software and solutions, through SaaS and hosted delivery models, to hoteliers around the world. It provides data-driven business intelligence, mobile, distribution, and software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions. The company was founded in December 2006 and is headquartered in Southlake, TX.
info.description_zh: Sabre Corp.是一家軟體和科技公司，致力於為全球旅遊和旅遊業提供技術解決方案。它透過旅行解決方案和酒店解決方案部門運作。旅行解決方案部門透過企業對企業旅行市場為供應商和買家提供全球旅行服務。酒店解決方案部門透過 SaaS 和託管交付模式向世界各地的酒店經營者提供軟體和解決方案。它提供數據驅動的商業智慧、行動、分發和軟體即服務 (SaaS) 解決方案。該公司成立於2006年12月，總部位於德克薩斯州南湖。

info.description: Bloomin Brands, Inc. engages in the acquisition, operation, design, and development of restaurant concepts. It operates through the U.S. and International geographical segments. The U.S. segment operates in the USA and Puerto Rico. The International segment operates in Brazil, South Korea, Hong Kong, and China. Its brands include Outback Steakhouse, Carrabba's Italian Grill, Bonefish Grill, and Fleming's Prime Steakhouse and Wine Bar. The company was founded by Chris Thomas Sullivan, Robert Danker Basham and John Timothy Gannon in March 1988 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: Bloomin Brands, Inc. 從事餐廳概念的收購、營運、設計和開發。它透過美國和國際地理部門開展業務。美國部門在美國和波多黎各開展業務。國際部門在巴西、韓國、香港和中國開展業務。其品牌包括 Outback Steakhouse、Carrabba's Italian Grill、Bonefish Grill 和 Fleming's Prime Steakhouse and Wine Bar。該公司由 Chris Thomas Sullivan、Robert Danker Basham 和 John Timothy Gannon 於 1988 年 3 月創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: OFS Capital Corp. is a business development company, which invests in middle market companies located in the United States. It provides financing for recapitalizations and refinancing, MBOs, LBOs, acquisition financing, shareholder liquidity events, growth capital investments, and ESOPs with an investment of million. The company was founded on March 20, 2001 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: OFS Capital Corp. 是一家業務開發公司，投資位於美國的中間市場公司。它為資本重組和再融資、管理層收購、槓桿收購、收購融資、股東流動性事件、成長資本投資和員工持股計劃提供融資，投資額達數百萬美元。該公司成立於2001年3月20日，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 30, 2024 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。公司成立於2024年1月30日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. is a clinical stage pharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of novel therapies for cancer. It also offers cancer treatments with surgery, radiation therapy, chemotherapy, and immunotherapy. The company was founded by Anatoly Dritschilo, Mira Jung, and Milton Brown on December 18, 2012 and is headquartered in Gaithersburg, MD.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc.是一家臨床階段製藥公司，致力於開發癌症新療法。它還提供手術、放射治療、化療和免疫治療等癌症治療方法。該公司由 Anatoly Dritschilo、Mira Jung 和 Milton Brown 於 2012 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州蓋瑟斯堡。

info.description: Accuray, Inc. is a radiation therapy company, which engages in manufacturing medical equipment. It develops, manufactures, sells, and supports medical solutions. The company was founded by John R. Adler in 1990 and is headquartered in Madison, WI.
info.description_zh: Accuray, Inc.是一家放射治療公司，從事醫療設備製造。它開發、製造、銷售和支援醫療解決方案。該公司由 John R. Adler 於 1990 年創立，總部位於威斯康辛州麥迪遜。

info.description: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc. is an oncology company, which engages in research, development, and commercializing therapeutics for cancer and obesity. Its pipeline includes CRB-701, an antibody drug conjugate (ADC) that targets the expression of Nectin-4 on cancer cells to release a cytotoxic payload, CRB-601, an anti-integrin monoclonal antibody that blocks the activation of TGFß expressed on cancer cells, and CRB-913, a highly peripherally restricted cannabinoid type-1 (CB1) receptor inverse agonist for the treatment of obesity. The company was founded in April 2009 and is headquartered in Norwood, MA.
info.description_zh: Corbus Pharmaceuticals Holdings, Inc.是一家腫瘤學公司，從事癌症和肥胖療法的研究、開發和商業化。其產品線包括CRB-701，一種抗體藥物偶聯物（ADC），靶向癌細胞上Nectin-4的表達，釋放細胞毒性有效負載；CRB-601，一種抗整合素單克隆抗體，阻斷癌細胞上表達的TGFβ的激活；以及CRB-913，一種高度外周限制的大麻素反向激動劑（CB1）受體反向激動劑。該公司成立於 2009 年 4 月，總部位於馬薩諸塞州諾伍德。

info.description: Crocs, Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacture, worldwide marketing, sale, and distribution of lifestyle footwear and accessories. It operates through the Crocs Brand and HEYDUDE Brand segments. The Crocs Brand segment refers to the United States, South Korea, China, Japan, Singapore, Canada, Germany, Great Britain, France, Malaysia, Australia, Puerto Rico, the Netherlands, Australia, India, and Ireland. The HEYDUDE Brand segment focuses on the United States. The company was founded by Scott Seamans, George B. Boedecker, Jr., and Lyndon V. Hanson III in 2002 and is headquartered in Broomfield, CO.
info.description_zh: Crocs, Inc. 從事時尚鞋類和配件的設計、開發、製造、全球行銷、銷售和分銷。它透過 Crocs 品牌和 HEYDUDE 品牌部門運作。 Crocs 品牌細分市場涉及美國、韓國、中國、日本、新加坡、加拿大、德國、英國、法國、馬來西亞、澳洲、波多黎各、荷蘭、澳洲、印度和愛爾蘭。 HEYDUDE 品牌細分市場專注於美國。該公司由 Scott Seamans、George B. Boedecker, Jr. 和 Lyndon V. Hanson III 於 2002 年創立，總部位於科羅拉多州布魯姆菲爾德。

info.description: Frontdoor, Inc. engages in the provision of home service plans. Its home service plans cover the repair or replacement of major home's systems and appliances. The firm's service focuses on water heaters, garbage disposals, doorbells, smoke detectors, ceiling fans, central vacuums, refrigerators, dishwashers and trash compactors. Its brands include American Home Shield, HSA, OneGuard and Landmark. The company was founded on January 2, 2018, and is headquartered in Memphis, TN.
info.description_zh: Frontdoor, Inc. 從事提供居家服務計畫。其家庭服務計劃涵蓋主要家庭系統和電器的維修或更換。該公司的服務重點是熱水器、垃圾處理器、門鈴、煙霧偵測器、吊扇、中央吸塵器、冰箱、洗碗機和垃圾壓實機。其品牌包括American Home Shield、HSA、OneGuard和Landmark。該公司成立於2018年1月2日，總部位於田納西州孟菲斯。

info.description: Kimball Electronics, Inc. engages in the provision of contract manufacturing services including engineering and supply chain support for the production of electronic assemblies and other products including medical devices, medical disposables, precision molded plastics, and automation, test, and inspection equipment primarily in automotive, medical, and industrial applications. It operates through the following business units: the United States, China, Mexico, Poland, Romania, Thailand, and GES. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Jasper, IN.
info.description_zh: Kimball Electronics, Inc. 從事提供合約製造服務，包括為電子組件和其他產品（包括主要用於汽車、醫療和工業應用的醫療設備、醫療一次性用品、精密模製塑膠以及自動化、測試和檢查設備）的生產提供工程和供應鏈支援。它透過以下業務部門運作：美國、中國、墨西哥、波蘭、羅馬尼亞、泰國和 GES。該公司成立於 1961 年，總部位於印第安納州賈斯珀。

info.description: Cargurus, Inc. is an online automotive platform, which engages in buying and selling vehicles that is building upon its listings marketplace with digital retail solutions and the CarOffer digital wholesale platform. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Marketplace, Digital Wholesale, and Other. The U.S. Marketplace segment offers marketplace services from customers. The Digital Wholesale segment consists of dealer-to-dealer and IMCO services and products which are sold on the CarOffer platform. The company was founded by Langley Steinert on November 10, 2005 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: Cargurus, Inc. 是一個線上汽車平台，致力於購買和銷售車輛，該平台基於其列表市場，提供數位零售解決方案和 CarOffer 數位批發平台。它透過以下部門運作：美國市場、數位批發和其他部門。美國市場部門為客戶提供市場服務。數位批發部門包括經銷商對經銷商以及在 CarOffer 平台上銷售的 IMCO 服務和產品。該公司由 Langley Steinert 於 2005 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery and development of a class of RNA-targeting therapeutics for upregulating gene expression and restoration of healthy protein levels to treat a broad range of genetic diseases. Its lead product candidate is CMP-002. The company was founded by Richard A. Young and Leonard Zon in 2015 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: CAMP4 Therapeutics Corp. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發一類 RNA 標靶療法，用於上調基因表現和恢復健康蛋白質水平，以治療多種遺傳疾病。其主要候選產品為 CMP-002。該公司由 Richard A. Young 和 Leonard Zon 於 2015 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: D-Wave Quantum, Inc. engages in the development and delivery of quantum computing systems, software, and services. It provides customers with access to the company's quantum computing systems via the cloud in the form of quantum computing as a service. It offers professional services such as customer assistance in identifying and implementing quantum-computing applications. The company was founded on January 25, 2022 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
info.description_zh: D-Wave Quantum, Inc. 從事量子計算系統、軟體和服務的開發和交付。它以量子運算即服務的形式為客戶提供透過雲端存取公司量子運算系統的能力。它提供專業服務，例如幫助客戶識別和實施量子運算應用程式。該公司成立於2022年1月25日，總部位於加州帕洛阿爾托。

info.description: SoundHound AI, Inc. engages in the development, owning, and commercialization of voice, sound, and natural language artificial intelligence technologies and related activities. The company was founded by Keyvan Mohajer, Majid Seyed Emami and James M. Hom on September 2, 2005 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: SoundHound AI, Inc. 從事語音、聲音和自然語言人工智慧技術及相關活動的開發、擁有和商業化。該公司由 Keyvan Mohajer、Majid Seyed Emami 和 James M. Hom 於 2005 年 9 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: X4 Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development and discovery of novel therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases and those with limited treatment options. It is focused on mavorixafor which is being marketed in the U.S. under the trade name xolremdi. The company was founded by Henri A. Termeer, Keith T. Flaherty, Renato T. Skerlj, Richard Peters and Paula Ragan in 2010 and is headquartered in Boston, MA.
info.description_zh: X4 Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和發現治療罕見疾病和治療選擇有限的疾病的新型療法。它的重點是 mavorixafor，該藥物在美國以商品名 xolremdi 銷售。該公司由 Henri A. Termeer、Keith T. Flaherty、Renato T. Skerlj、Richard Peters 和 Paula Ragan 於 2010 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州波士頓。

info.description: Happen, Inc. is a U.S. digital marketplace bank focused on the Motivated Middle high FICO, high-income borrowers actively managing their financial lives. The firm's success is fueled by advanced credit underwriting, a proprietary technology platform, and a marketplace bank model that generates compelling revenue through loan sales, net interest income, and fee-based services. It operates through the LendingClub Bank and LendingClub Corporation (Parent Only) segments. The LendingClub Bank segment is involved in the provision of a full complement of financial products and solutions, loans, leases, and deposits. The LendingClub Corporation (Parent Only) segment includes the holding company legal entity. The company was founded by Renaud Laplanche and Soulaiman Htite on October 2, 2006 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Happen, Inc. 是一家美國數位市場銀行，專注於積極管理其財務生活的中高 FICO、高收入借款人。該公司的成功得益於先進的信貸承銷、專有技術平台和市場銀行模式，該模式透過貸款銷售、淨利息收入和收費服務產生可觀的收入。它透過 LendingClub Bank 和 LendingClub Corporation（僅限家長）部門運作。 LendingClub Bank 部門提供全套金融產品和解決方案、貸款、租賃和存款。 LendingClub Corporation（限家長）部門包含控股公司法人實體。該公司由 Renaud Laplanche 和 Soulaiman Htite 於 2006 年 10 月 2 日創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Superior Group of Cos., Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of uniforms, corporate identity apparel, career apparel, and accessories to the medical and health fields as well as for the industrial, commercial, leisure, and public safety industries. It operates through the following segments: Branded Products, Healthcare Apparel, and Contact Centers. The Branded Products segment produces and sells customized merchandising solutions, promotional products and branded uniform programs. The Healthcare Apparel segment manufactures and sells a wide range of healthcare apparel, such as scrubs, lab coats, protective apparel and patient gowns. The Contact Centers segment offers outsourced, nearshore business process outsourcing, contact and call-center support services. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in St. Petersburg, FL.
info.description_zh: Superior Group of Cos., Inc. 從事醫療和健康領域以及工業、商業、休閒和公共安全行業的製服、企業形象服裝、職業服裝和配件的製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：品牌產品部門、醫療保健服裝部門和聯絡中心部門。品牌產品部門生產和銷售客製化行銷解決方案、促銷產品和品牌制服項目。醫療保健服裝部門生產和銷售各種醫療保健服裝，例如手術服、實驗室外套、防護服和病人服。聯絡中心部門提供外包、近岸業務流程外包、聯絡和呼叫中心支援服務。該公司成立於 1920 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州聖彼得堡。

info.description: Remitly Global, Inc. engages in the provision of digital financial services for immigrants and their families. The company was founded by Matthew B. Oppenheimer and Joshua Hug on October 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, WA.

info.description: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. engages in the manufacture and provision of products and services for the renewable energy, residential, and infrastructure markets. It operates through the following segments: Residential, Infrastructure, and Agtech. The Residential segment includes roof and foundation ventilation products, rain dispersion products and roofing accessories, centralized mail systems, and electronic package solutions. The Infrastructure segment provides engineered solutions for bridges, highways, and airfields including structural bearings, expansion joints, pavement seals, elastomeric concrete, and bridge cable protection systems. The Agtech segment offers growing and processing solutions including designing, engineering, manufacturing, full scope construction, and maintenance and support of greenhouses, indoor growing operations, and botanical extraction systems. The company was founded on September 1, 1972 and is headquartered in Buffalo, NY.
info.description_zh: Gibraltar Industries, Inc. 從事為再生能源、住宅和基礎設施市場製造和提供產品和服務。它透過以下部門運作：住宅部門、基礎設施部門和農業科技部門。住宅部門包括屋頂和地基通風產品、雨水分散產品和屋頂配件、集中式郵件系統和電子成套解決方案。基礎設施部門為橋樑、高速公路和機場提供工程解決方案，包括結構軸承、伸縮縫、路面密封、彈性混凝土和橋樑電纜保護系統。農業科技部門提供種植和加工解決方案，包括溫室、室內種植作業和植物提取系統的設計、工程、製造、全方位建設以及維護和支援。該公司成立於1972年9月1日，總部位於紐約州布法羅。

info.description: Outdoor Holding Co. engages in the design and manufacture of products for law enforcement, military, sport shooting, and self-defense. It operates through the following segments: Ammunition, Martketplace, and Corporate and Other. The Ammunition segment consists of the manufacturing business. The Marketplace segment includes GunBroker.com. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Outdoor Holding Co. 從事執法、軍事、運動射擊和自衛產品的設計和製造。它透過以下部門運作：彈藥部門、市場部門、企業及其他部門。彈藥部門由製造業務組成。市場部分包括 GunBroker.com。該公司成立於 1990 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Cognition Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery and development of innovative, small molecule therapeutics targeting age-related degenerative diseases and disorders of the central nervous system, or CNS, and retina. It offers the CT1812 which aims to restore the damaged cellular processes that drive diseases such as Alzheimer's disease, dry age-related macular degeneration, geographic atrophy and other conditions. The company was founded by Franz F. Hefti, Gilbert M. Rishton, and Susan M. Catalano on August 21, 2007 and is headquartered in Purchase, NY.
info.description_zh: Cognition Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於發現和開發與年齡相關的退化性疾病以及中樞神經系統（CNS）和視網膜疾病的創新小分子療法。它提供的 CT1812 旨在恢復導致阿茲海默症、乾性老年黃斑部病變、地圖樣萎縮和其他疾病等疾病的受損細胞過程。該公司由 Franz F. Hefti、Gilbert M. Rishton 和 Susan M. Catalano 於 2007 年 8 月 21 日創立，總部位於紐約州普切斯。

info.description: Dorman Products, Inc. engages in the supply of automotive replacement and upgrade parts for the motor vehicle aftermarket industry. Its products include automotive body, steering and suspension, undercar, underhood, hardware and accessories, and heavy-duty components. The company was founded by Steven L. Berman and Richard N. Berman on October 16, 1978 and is headquartered in Colmar, PA.
info.description_zh: Dorman Products, Inc. 致力於為機動車輛售後市場產業供應汽車更換和升級零件。其產品包括汽車車身、轉向和懸吊、車底、引擎蓋、硬體和配件以及重型零件。該公司由 Steven L. Berman 和 Richard N. Berman 於 1978 年 10 月 16 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州科爾馬。

info.description: WW International, Inc. engages in the provision of weight management services. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, and Other. The company was founded by Jean Nidetch in 1963 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: WW International, Inc. 從事提供體重管理服務。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國和其他地區。該公司由 Jean Nidetch 於 1963 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Adeia, Inc. is a technology company, which engages in the invention, development, and licensing of innovations and technologies for entertainment, media, consumer electronics, and semiconductor industries. It operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Asia, Canada, Europe and Middle East, and Other. The company was founded on October 1, 2022 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.industry_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.
info.description_zh: Adeia, Inc. 是一家科技公司，致力於娛樂、媒體、消費性電子和半導體產業的創新和技術的發明、開發和授權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、亞洲、加拿大、歐洲和中東等。該公司成立於2022年10月1日，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Symbotic, Inc. is an automation technology company, which engages in a robotics and automation-based product movement technology platform. It focuses on developing, commercializing, and deploying innovative, end-to-end technology solutions for supply chain operations. It operates through the United States and Canada geographical segments. The company was founded by Richard B. Cohen on December 11, 2020 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Symbotic, Inc.是一家自動化技術公司，從事機器人和基於自動化的產品移動技術平台。它專注於為供應鏈營運開發、商業化和部署創新的端到端技術解決方案。它透過美國和加拿大的地理部門開展業務。該公司由 Richard B. Cohen 於 2020 年 12 月 11 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: First Advantage Corp. is a provider of employment background screening, identity, and verification solutions. It operates through the following segments: First Advantage Americas, First Advantage International, and Sterling. The First Advantage Americas segment performs a variety of background check and compliance services across all phases of the workforce lifecycle, from pre-onboarding to post-onboarding and ongoing monitoring, covering employees, contractors, contingent workers, tenants, and drivers. The First Advantage International segment involves regions such as Europe, India, and Asia Pacific. The Sterling segment refers to Sterling Check Corp., which provides services globally. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: First Advantage Corp. 是一家就業背景篩選、身分和驗證解決方案提供者。它透過以下部門運作：First Advantage Americas、First Advantage International 和 Sterling。 First Advantage Americas 部門在勞動力生命週期的各個階段提供各種背景調查和合規服務，從入職前到入職後以及持續監控，涵蓋員工、承包商、臨時工、租戶和司機。第一優諮詢國際部門涉及歐洲、印度和亞太地區等地區。 Sterling 部門是指在全球範圍內提供服務的 Sterling Check Corp.。該公司成立於 2003 年，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. engages in the development, franchising, licensing, and operation of quick-service restaurants under the name El Pollo Loco. It specializes in fire-grilling fresh citrus-marinated chicken with a variety of offerings including Chicken Avocado Burrito, Pollo Fit entrees, chicken tostada salads, and Pollo Bowls. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Costa Mesa, CA.
info.description_zh: El Pollo Loco Holdings, Inc. 從事 El Pollo Loco 名稱下快餐店的開發、特許經營、許可和營運業務。它專門提供火烤新鮮柑橘醃製雞肉，提供各種菜餚，包括雞肉酪梨捲餅、Pollo Fit 主菜、雞肉托斯塔達沙拉和 Pollo Bowls。該公司成立於 1980 年，總部位於加州科斯塔梅薩。

info.description: Microbot Medical, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the research, design, and development of robotic endoluminal surgery devices targeting the minimally invasive surgery space. It carries out its operations through the ViRob and TipCat platforms. The ViRob platform technology is an autonomous crawling micro-robot that can be controlled remotely or within the body. It makes use of the Self-Cleaning Shunt, a robotic system designed as the ventricular catheter portion of a Cerebrospinal Fluid shunt system and is mainly used for the treatment of hydrocephalus and Normal Pressure Hydrocephalus. The TipCat platform, a self-propelling, flexible, and semi-disposable endoscope, provides see-and-treat capabilities within tubular lumens in the human body such as the colon, blood vessels, and the urinary tract. The company was founded by Harel Gadot, Moshe Shoham, and Yosseph Bornstein on August 2, 1988 and is headquartered in Hingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Microbot Medical, Inc.是一家醫療器材公司，從事針對微創手術領域的機器人腔內手術設備的研究、設計和開發。它透過 ViRob 和 TipCat 平台開展業務。 ViRob平台技術是一種自主爬行微型機器人，可遠端控製或在體內控制。它利用自清潔分流器，這是一種機器人系統，設計為腦脊髓液分流系統的腦室導管部分，主要用於治療腦積水和正常壓力腦積水。 TipCat 平台是一種自推進式、靈活的半一次性內視鏡，可在人體管狀腔內（如結腸、血管和泌尿道）提供檢視和治療功能。該公司由 Harel Gadot、Moshe Shoham 和 Yosseph Bornstein 於 1988 年 8 月 2 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州欣厄姆。

info.description: People, Inc. engages in the media and Internet business. It operates through the following segments: Dotdash Meredith, Angi Inc, Search, and Emerging and Other. The Dotdash Meredith segment provides digital and print publishing services from mobile to magazines. The ANGI Homeservices segment offers repairing, remodeling, cleaning, and landscaping through category-transforming products under HomeAdvisor, Angie's List, Handy, and Fixd Repair brands. The Search segment consists of Ask Media Group, which provides general search services and information. The Emerging and Other segment includes platforms Care.com, Bluecrew, NurseFly Mosaic Group, Vivian Health, The Daily Beast, IAC Films, and Newco. The company was founded on August 24, 1995, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: People, Inc. 從事媒體和網路業務。該公司透過以下部門營運：Dotdash Meredith、Angi Inc、Search、Emerging and Other。 Dotdash Meredith 部門提供從手機到雜誌的數位和印刷出版服務。 ANGI Homeservices 部門透過 HomeAdvisor、Angie's List、Handy 和 Fixd Repair 品牌下的類別轉型產品提供維修、改造、清潔和景觀美化服務。搜尋部門由 Ask Media Group 組成，該集團提供一般搜尋服務和資訊。新興和其他部門包括 Care.com、Bluecrew、NurseFly Mosaic Group、Vivian Health、The Daily Beast、IAC Films 和 Newco 等平台。該公司成立於1995年8月24日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Jiayin Group, Inc. engages in the operation of an online individual finance marketplace in China, which connects individual investors and individual borrowers. The company was founded by Dinggui Yan in 2011 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 嘉銀集團在中國從事線上個人金融市場的運營，該市場連接個人投資者和個人借款人。該公司由嚴鼎貴於2011年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Nutex Health, Inc. engages in the management and operation of healthcare facilities. It operates through the following segments: Hospital Division, Population Health Management Division, and Real State Division. The Hospital Division is involved in developing and operating a network of micro-hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments (HOPDs). The Population Health Division establishes and operates provider networks such as independent physician associations (IPAs). The Real State Division owns land and hospital buildings which are leased to hospital entities. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Nutex Health, Inc. 從事醫療保健設施的管理和營運。它透過以下部門運作：醫院部門、人口健康管理部門和房地產部門。醫院部門參與開發和營運微型醫院、專科醫院和醫院門診部 (HOPD) 網路。人口健康部門建立並運作獨立醫師協會 (IPA) 等提供者網路。房地產部門擁有出租給醫院實體的土地和醫院建築。該公司成立於 2011 年，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Atlanticus Holdings Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of financial technology and related services. It operates through the Credit as a Service (CaaS) and Auto Finance segments. The CaaS segment includes private label credit and general purpose credit cards originated by lenders through multiple channels, including retail and healthcare, direct mail solicitation, digital marketing and partnerships with third parties. The Auto Finance segment services loans secured by independent automotive dealers and automotive finance companies in the buy-here, pay-here used car business. The company was founded by David G. Hanna in August 1996 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Atlanticus Holdings Corp.是一家金融控股公司，從事提供金融科技及相關服務。它透過信貸即服務（CaaS）和汽車金融部門運作。 CaaS 部分包括貸款人透過多種管道發起的自有品牌信用卡和通用信用卡，包括零售和醫療保健、直郵招攬、數位行銷以及與第三方的合作。汽車金融部門為獨立汽車經銷商和汽車金融公司在「在這裡購買、在這裡付款」的二手車業務中提供擔保的貸款服務。該公司由 David G. Hanna 於 1996 年 8 月創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Vivid Seats, Inc. operates as an online ticket marketplace, which engages in the provision of different selections of events and tickets in North America. It operates through the following segments: Marketplace and Resale. The Marketplace segment acts as an intermediary between event ticket buyers and ticket sellers. The Resale segment acquires tickets to resell on secondary ticket marketplaces, including its own. Its partners include Caesars Entertainment, RollingStone, Marriott Bonvoy, Capital One, American Airlines and others. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Vivid Seats, Inc. 是一家線上門票市場，致力於在北美提供不同的活動和門票選擇。它透過以下部門運作：市場和轉售。市場部分充當活動門票買家和門票賣家之間的中介。轉售部門購買門票並在二級門票市場（包括自己的市場）上轉售。其合作夥伴包括凱撒娛樂、滾石、萬豪旅享家、第一資本、美國航空等。該公司成立於 2001 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: i3 Verticals, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of enterprise software solutions to public sector solutions. It delivers end-to-end digital transformation, streamlining complex government operations, and citizen engagement. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Nashville, TN.
info.description_zh: i3 Verticals, Inc. 是一家控股公司，致力於為公共部門解決方案提供企業軟體解決方案。它提供端到端的數位轉型，簡化複雜的政府運作和公民參與。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於田納西州納許維爾。

info.description: AirSculpt Technologies, Inc. is a fat removal treatment under its brand, Elite Body Sculpture.. It provides custom body contouring using proprietary AirSculpt method that removes unwanted fat in a minimally invasive procedure, producing dramatic results. The company was founded by Aaron J. Rollins in 2012 and is headquartered in Miami Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: AirSculpt Technologies, Inc. 是其品牌 Elite Body Sculpture 下的脂肪去除療程。它使用專有的 AirSculpt 方法提供客製化身體輪廓，透過微創手術去除不需要的脂肪，產生顯著的效果。該公司由 Aaron J. Rollins 於 2012 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密海灘。

info.description: BioVie, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in discovery, development, and marketing drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative disorders, and liver disease. The company was founded on April 10, 2013 and is headquartered in Carson City, NV.
info.description_zh: BioVie, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於發現、開發和行銷神經系統和神經退化性疾病以及肝病的藥物療法。該公司成立於2013年4月10日，總部位於內華達州卡森市。

info.description: Tigo Energy, Inc. engages in the manufacturing and development of module level power electronics. Its solutions include TS4-X, EI Residential, Energy Intelligence, TS4-A, and EI Predict. The company was founded on February 13, 2019 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Tigo Energy, Inc.從事模組級電力電子產品的製造和開發。其解決方案包括 TS4-X、EI Residential、Energy Intelligence、TS4-A 和 EI Predict。該公司成立於2019年2月13日，總部位於加州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: CVRx, Inc. engages in developing, manufacturing, and commercializing neuromodulation solutions for patients with cardiovascular diseases. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Germany, and Other Countries. The company was founded by Robert S. Kieval and Tyler P. Lipschultz in August 2001 and is headquartered in Minneapolis, MN.
info.description_zh: CVRx, Inc. 致力於為心血管疾病患者開發、製造和商業化神經調節解決方案。它透過以下地理區域運作：美國、德國和其他國家。該公司由 Robert S. Kieval 和 Tyler P. Lipschultz 於 2001 年 8 月創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼阿波利斯。

info.description: All In FutureTech Alliance, Inc. operates as an experiential entertainment company, which engages in the creation of esports venues and live events for both video games and poker. It operates through following segments: E-Sports, Casual Mobile Gaming, and Live Concert Promotion and Events Organizing. The E-Sports segment includes video game events and tournaments through Allied Esports. The Casual Mobile Gaming segment is provided through Z-Tech. The Live Concert Promotion and Events Organizing segment is provided through Skyline. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: All In FutureTech Alliance, Inc. 是一家體驗式娛樂公司，致力於為電玩遊戲和撲克創建電競場地和現場活動。它透過以下部門運作：電子競技、休閒行動遊戲、現場音樂會推廣和活動組織。電競部分包括透過 Allied Esports 舉辦的電玩賽事和錦標賽。休閒行動遊戲部分由 Z-Tech 提供。現場音樂會推廣和活動組織部分透過 Skyline 提供。該公司成立於2017年，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of land-based aquaculture services. It includes farming of aquatic organisms such as fish, shellfish, crustaceans, and aquatic plants. The firm focuses on a salmon product, a bioengineered Atlantic salmon that can grow to market size faster than conventional farmed Atlantic salmon. The company was founded by Elliot Z. Entis and Garth L. Fletcher on December 17, 1991 and is headquartered in Harvard, MA.
info.description_zh: AquaBounty Technologies, Inc. 從事提供陸基水產養殖服務。它包括魚類、貝類、甲殼類和水生植物等水生生物的養殖。該公司專注於鮭魚產品，這是一種生物工程大西洋鮭魚，它可以比傳統養殖的大西洋鮭魚更快長到上市尺寸。該公司由 Elliot Z. Entis 和 Garth L. Fletcher 於 1991 年 12 月 17 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州哈佛大學。

info.description: American Resources Corp. engages in the extraction, processing, transportation, and distribution of metallurgical coal to the steel industry. It focuses on the operation of coal mining complexes located primarily within Pike, Knott, and Letcher Counties, Kentucky, and Wyoming County, West Virginia. The company was founded in 2006 and in headquartered in Fishers, IN.
info.description_zh: 美國資源公司從事冶金煤的開採、加工、運輸和分配給鋼鐵業。該公司專注於主要位於肯塔基州派克縣、諾特縣和萊徹縣以及西維吉尼亞州懷俄明縣的煤礦綜合體的運作。該公司成立於 2006 年，總部位於印第安納州費希爾斯。

info.description: TEN Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of event planning, production, and broadcasting services. The firm produces virtual, hybrid, and physical events such as live streaming and video recording. It also offers the Xyvid Pro Platform, which supports virtual and hybrid event planning, as well as production, broadcasting, and continuing education services. The company was founded on December 5, 2011 and is headquartered in Langhorne, PA.
info.description_zh: TEN Holdings, Inc. 從事提供活動規劃、製作和廣播服務。該公司製作虛擬、混合和實體活動，例如直播和錄影。它還提供 Xyvid Pro 平台，支援虛擬和混合活動策劃以及製作、廣播和繼續教育服務。該公司成立於2011年12月5日，總部位於賓州蘭霍恩。

info.description: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of light emitting diode lighting systems, wireless Internet of Things enabled control, commercial and industrial electric vehicle charging infrastructure solutions, and lighting and electrical maintenance services. It operates through the following segments: Lighting, Maintenance, Electric Vehicle Charging (EV), and Corporate and Other. The Lighting segment is involved in the development and sale of lighting products and provides construction and engineering services for commercial lighting and energy management systems. The Maintenance segment focuses on retailers, distributors, and other businesses with maintenance, repair, and replacement services for lighting and related electrical components. The EV segment offers electric vehicle charging expertise and provides EV turnkey installation solutions with ongoing support to all commercial verticals. The Corporate and Other segment includes operating expenses. The company was founded by Neal R. Verfuerth and Patrick J. Trotter in April 1996 and is headquartered in Manitowoc, WI.
info.description_zh: Orion Energy Systems, Inc. 從事提供發光二極管照明系統、無線物聯網控制、商業和工業電動車充電基礎設施解決方案以及照明和電氣維護服務。該公司透過以下部門運作：照明部門、維修部門、電動車充電部門（EV）以及企業及其他部門。照明部門從事照明產品的開發和銷售，並為商業照明和能源管理系統提供建築和工程服務。維修部門專注於為照明及相關電氣元件提供維護、維修和更換服務的零售商、經銷商和其他企業。電動車部門提供電動車充電專業知識，並提供電動車交鑰匙安裝解決方案，並為所有商業垂直領域提供持續支援。公司及其他部門包括營運費用。該公司由 Neal R. Verfuerth 和 Patrick J. Trotter 於 1996 年 4 月創立，總部位於威斯康辛州馬尼托瓦克。

info.description: Mako Mining Corp. engages in the development and exploration of gold. It also focuses on San Albino gold project located in Nueva Segovia, Nicaragua. The company was founded on April 1, 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: Mako Mining Corp. 從事黃金的開發和勘探。它還專注於位於尼加拉瓜新塞哥維亞的San Albino金礦計畫。該公司成立於2004年4月1日，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Elong Power Holding Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacturing, sales and service of high-power lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and construction machinery, as well as large-capacity, long-cycle lithium-ion batteries for energy storage systems. The company was founded on August 18, 2023 and is headquartered in Ganzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 藝龍動力控股有限公司從事電動車、工程機械用高功率鋰離子電池以及儲能係統用大容量、長循環鋰離子電池的研發、製造、銷售和服務。公司成立於2023年8月18日，總部位於中國贛州。

info.description: AsiaStrategy engages in the trading, distribution, and retail of luxury watches of international brands. It sources luxury products directly or indirectly from authorized dealers, distributors, and brand owners, located in Europe, Japan, Singapore, and other locations, and sell them to customers, comprising independent watch dealers, watch distributors, and retail buyers within the watch industry. The company offers internationally renowned watch brands, including Blancpain, Breguet, Cartier, Chopard, Hermes, IWC, Jaeger, Rolex, Omega, and Longines. Top Win International was founded on July 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: AsiaStrategy 從事國際品牌豪華手錶的貿易、經銷及零售。該公司直接或間接從位於歐洲、日本、新加坡和其他地區的授權經銷商、分銷商和品牌所有者採購奢侈品，並將其銷售給客戶，包括獨立手錶經銷商、手錶分銷商和手錶行業的零售買家。該公司提供國際知名手錶品牌，包括寶珀、寶璣、卡地亞、蕭邦、愛馬仕、萬國、積家、勞力士、歐米茄和浪琴。達運國際成立於2024年7月27日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Organigram Global, Inc. engages in the provision of high-quality, indoor-grown cannabis for patients and adult recreational consumers and developing international business partnerships to extend the company's global footprint. Its brands include Edison, Big Bag O' Buds, SHRED, Monjour, and Trailblazer. The company was founded on July 5, 2010 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Organigram Global, Inc. 致力於為患者和成人娛樂消費者提供高品質的室內種植大麻，並發展國際業務合作夥伴關係以擴大公司的全球足跡。其品牌包括 Edison、Big Bag O' Buds、SHRED、Monjour 和 Trailblazer。該公司成立於2010年7月5日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: Aura Minerals, Inc. engages in the development and operation of gold, copper, and base metal projects in the Americas. It operates through the following segments: Minosa Mine, Apoena Mine, the Aranzazu Mine, Almas Mine, and Borborema Project. The company was founded on July 12, 1946 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Aura Minerals, Inc. 在美洲從事金、銅和賤金屬專案的開發和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：Minosa 礦、Apoena 礦、Aranzazu 礦、Almas 礦和 Borborema 計畫。该公司成立于 1946 年 7 月 12 日，总部位于佛罗里达州迈阿密。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PLTR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PLTR. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PLTR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PLTR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支），為 PLTR 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PLTR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Veritone, Inc. engages in the provision of artificial intelligence (AI) computing solutions to media and entertainment, government, and legal and compliance industries. It operates through the following segments: Advertising, aiWARE SaaS Solutions, and aiWARE Content Licensing and Media Services. The Advertising segment places advertisements for clients, primarily with radio broadcasters, podcasters and digital media producers.
