The aiWARE SaaS Solutions segment offers solutions through a combination of its direct sales force and indirect channel partners, such as value-added resellers (VARs), distributors, system integrators, managed services providers, and referral partners. The aiWARE Content Licensing and Media Services segment sells and markets activities relating to its digital content licensing services business through its direct sales force. The company was founded by Chad Edward Steelberg and Ryan S. Steelberg on June 13, 2014 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Veritone, Inc. 致力於為媒體和娛樂、政府以及法律和合規產業提供人工智慧 (AI) 運算解決方案。該公司透過以下部門運作：廣告部門、aiWARE SaaS 解決方案部門以及 aiWARE 內容授權和媒體服務部門。廣告部門為客戶投放廣告，主要是廣播公司、播客和數位媒體製作商。 aiWARE SaaS 解決方案部門透過其直接銷售人員和間接通路合作夥伴（例如加值經銷商 (VAR)、經銷商、系統整合商、主機服務供應商和推薦合作夥伴）的結合提供解決方案。 aiWARE 內容授權和媒體服務部門透過其直銷團隊銷售和行銷與其數位內容授權服務業務相關的活動。該公司由 Chad Edward Steelberg 和 Ryan S. Steelberg 於 2014 年 6 月 13 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: electroCore, Inc. engages in the provision of non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation (nVNS) therapy. It develops a platform bioelectronic medical therapy that modulates neurotransmitters and immune function through its effects on both the peripheral and central nervous systems. The company was founded by Joseph P. Errico, Steven M. Mendez, Peter S. Staats and Thomas J. Errico in September 2005 and is headquartered in Rockaway, NJ.
info.description_zh: electroCore, Inc. 從事提供非侵入性迷走神經刺激 (nVNS) 治療。它開發了一個生物電子醫學療法平台，透過其對週邊和中樞神經系統的影響來調節神經傳導物質和免疫功能。該公司由 Joseph P. Errico、Steven M. Mendez、Peter S. Staats 和 Thomas J. Errico 於 2005 年 9 月創立，總部位於新澤西州洛克威。

info.description: Evolus, Inc. is a medical aesthetics company, which engages in the provision of medical aesthetic treatments and procedures. It offers products under the brand of Jeuveau. The company was founded by Scott Cannizzaro in November 2012 and is headquartered in Newport Beach, CA.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Evolus, Inc. 是一家醫學美容公司，提供醫學美容治療和手術。它提供 Jeuveau 品牌的產品。該公司由 Scott Cannizzaro 於 2012 年 11 月創立，總部位於加州紐波特海灘。

info.description: Texxon Holding Ltd. provides supply chain management services in East China. Its services include the sale of plastic, chemical raw materials, and other plastic raw materials. Its products are used in fabrics, coastings, resins, beverage packing, other downstream products, pipelines and pipes used in infrastructure, daily or food grade packing and agriculture membranes. The company was founded on January 20, 2022 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 德盛控股有限公司在華東地區提供供應鏈管理服務。其服務包括銷售塑膠、化學原料及其他塑膠原料。其產品用於織物、海岸線、樹脂、飲料包裝、其他下游產品、基礎設施、日用或食品級包裝和農業膜中使用的管道和管道。公司成立於2022年1月20日，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Fennec Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company. It focuses on the development and commercialization of PEDMARK to reduce the risk of platinum-induced ototoxicity in pediatric patients. The company was founded by Orest W. Blaschuk on September 3, 1996 and is headquartered in Durham, NC.
info.description_zh: Fennec Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家專業製藥公司。它專注於 PEDMARK 的開發和商業化，以降低兒科患者鉑類引起的耳毒性風險。該公司由 Orest W. Blaschuk 於 1996 年 9 月 3 日創立，總部位於北卡羅來納州達勒姆。

info.description: ZenaTech, Inc. is an enterprise software technology company, which specializes in mission-critical cloud-based applications integrated with smart hardware to deliver solutions across diverse industries. The firm also develops drone manufacturing, sales, and distribution business. The company was founded by Shaun A. Passley on August 31, 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
info.description_zh: ZenaTech, Inc. 是一家企業軟體技術公司，專注於與智慧硬體整合的關鍵任務雲端應用程序，為不同行業提供解決方案。該公司還發展無人機製造、銷售和分銷業務。該公司由Shaun A. Passley於2017年8月31日創立，總部位於加拿大溫哥華。

info.description: Ensysce Biosciences, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of solutions for severe pain relief while reducing the fear of and the potential for misuse and overdose. The firm's Trypsin Activated Abuse Protection and Multi-Pill Abuse Resistance platforms are in the process of developing a new class of powerful, tamper-proof opioids that prevent both drug abuse and overdoses. The company was founded in April 2003 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: Ensysce Biosciences, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於開發緩解嚴重疼痛的解決方案，同時減少誤用和過量的恐懼和可能性。該公司的胰蛋白酶活化濫用保護和多藥丸濫用抵抗平台正在開發一種新型強效、防篡改鴉片類藥物，可防止藥物濫用和過量服用。該公司成立於 2003 年 4 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: NextNav, Inc. engages in development of positioning, navigation, and timing solutions. Its products include NextNav Pinnacle, NextNav 3D, and NextNav TerraPoiNT. The company was founded by Ganesh Pattabiraman and Arun Raghupathy in May 2021 and is headquartered in Reston, VA.
info.description_zh: NextNav, Inc. 從事定位、導航和授時解決方案的開發。其產品包括 NextNav Pinnacle、NextNav 3D 和 NextNav TerraPoiNT。該公司由 Ganesh Pattabiraman 和 Arun Raghupathy 於 2021 年 5 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州雷斯頓。

info.description: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. engages in the development of ocean robots that are controlled through an AI-driven cloud software platform, which enables a sliding scale spectrum of autonomous operations. It offers an aquanaut, hydronaut, argonaut, ToolKITT, and olympic arms. The company was founded by Nicolaus Adam Radford and Reginald Bruce Berka on March 27, 2014 and is headquartered in Webster, TX.
info.description_zh: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. 從事海洋機器人的開發，這些機器人透過人工智慧驅動的雲端軟體平台進行控制，從而實現了自主操作的滑動範圍。它提供了 Aquanaut、Hydronaut、Argonaut、ToolKITT 和 Olympic Arms。該公司由 Nicolaus Adam Radford 和 Reginald Bruce Berka 於 2014 年 3 月 27 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州韋伯斯特。

info.description: Themes Gold Miners ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Global Pure Gold Miners Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that are active in the gold mining industry and is denominated in U.S. dollars. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Gold Miners ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Global Pure Gold Miners Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為活躍於黃金開採行業的公司提供風險敞口，並以美元計價。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Royalty Management Holding Corp.is a blank check company which engages in merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or other similar business combination with one or more target businesses. The company was founded on June 21, 2021 and is headquartered in Fishers, IN.
info.description_zh: Royal Management Holding Corp.是一家空白支票公司，與一個或多個目標企業從事合併、股份交換、資產收購、股票購買、資本重組、重組或其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年6月21日，總部位於印第安納州費希爾斯。

info.description: Globus Maritime Ltd. is an integrated dry bulk shipping company that provides marine transportation services. It owns, operates, and manages dry bulk vessels that transport iron ore, coal, grain, steel products, cement, alumina and other dry bulk cargoes internationally. The company was founded by Athanasios Georgios Feidakis and Georgios Karageorgiou on July 26, 2006 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
info.description_zh: Globus Maritime Ltd. 是一家提供海上運輸服務的綜合乾散貨航運公司。它擁有、經營和管理乾散貨船舶，在國際上運輸鐵礦石、煤炭、糧食、鋼鐵產品、水泥、氧化鋁和其他乾散貨。該公司由 Athanasios Georgios Feidakis 和 Georgios Karageorgiou 於 2006 年 7 月 26 日創立，總部位於希臘雅典。

info.description: Innospec, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, blend, marketing, and supply of fuel additives, oilfield chemicals, personal care, and other specialty chemicals. It operates through the following segments: Fuel Specialties, Performance Chemicals, and Oilfield Services. The Fuel Specialties segment develops, manufactures, blends, markets, and supplies a range of specialty chemical products used as additives to a range of fuels. The Performance Chemicals segment provides technology-based solutions for customers processes or products focused on the personal care, home care, agrochemical, and mining industries. The Oilfield Services segment refers to the development and marketing of chemical solutions for fracturing, drilling, stimulation, completion operations, products for oil and gas production, and transport. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Englewood, CO.
info.description_zh: Innospec, Inc. 從事燃料添加劑、油田化學品、個人護理品和其他特殊化學品的開發、製造、混合、行銷和供應。它透過以下部門運作：特種燃料部門、高性能化學品部門和油田服務部門。特種燃料部門開發、製造、混合、行銷和供應一系列特殊化學產品，用作一系列燃料的添加劑。高性能化學品部門為專注於個人護理、家庭護理、農業化學品和採礦行業的客戶流程或產品提供基於技術的解決方案。油田服務部門是指用於壓裂、鑽井、增產、完井作業、石油和天然氣生產和運輸產品的化學解決方案的開發和行銷。該公司成立於 1938 年，總部位於科羅拉多州恩格爾伍德。

info.description: X-Energy, Inc. operates as an energy company The firm focuses on modular nuclear reactors and fuel technology for clean energy generation. The company was founded by Kam Ghaffarian and Eben Mulder on 2009 and is headquartered in Rockville, MD.
info.description_zh: X-Energy, Inc. 作為一家能源公司運營，該公司專注於用於清潔能源發電的模組化核反應器和燃料技術。該公司由 Kam Ghaffarian 和 Eben Mulder 於 2009 年創立，總部位於馬裡蘭州羅克維爾。

info.description: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. engages in the vehicle rental business through Hertz, Dollar, and Thrifty brands. It operates through the following business segments: Americas Rental Car (RAC) and International Rental Car (RAC). The Americas RAC segment focuses on operations in the United States, Canada, Latin America, and the Caribbean. The International RAC segment includes the provision of rental and sales of vehicles and value-added services in other locations. The company was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Estero, FL.
info.description_zh: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. 透過 Hertz、Dollar 和 Thrifty 品牌從事汽車租賃業務。它透過以下業務部門運作：美洲租車（RAC）和國際租車（RAC）。美洲 RAC 部門專注於美國、加拿大、拉丁美洲和加勒比地區的業務。國際RAC部門包括在其他地點提供車輛租賃和銷售以及增值服務。該公司成立於 1918 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州埃斯特羅。

info.description: Creative Medical Technology Holdings, Inc. is a commercial stage biotechnology company which focuses on regenerative therapies in the fields of immunotherapy, endocrinology, urology, neurology and orthopedics. Its products include CaverStem, FemCelz, StemSpine and ImmCelz. The company was founded by Timothy Warbington on December 3, 1998 and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Creative Medical Technology Holdings, Inc.是一家商業階段的生物技術公司，專注於免疫療法、內分泌學、泌尿學、神經學和骨科領域的再生療法。其產品包括CaverStem、FemCelz、StemSpine 和ImmCelz。該公司由 Timothy Warbington 於 1998 年 12 月 3 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Evogene Ltd. engages in the development and commercialization of a computer-biological platform for improving the development processes of products in the field of life sciences. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture, Industrial Applications, and Human Health. The Agriculture segment develops seed traits, agrochemical products, and agro biological products to improve plant performance. The Industrial Applications focuses on the development and commercialization of improved castor bean seeds for industrial uses. The Human Health segment involves discovery and development of human microbiome-based therapeutics. The company was founded by Amir Barzilay and Hagai Karchi on October 10, 1999 and is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
info.description_zh: Evogene Ltd. 從事電腦生物平台的開發和商業化，以改善生命科學領域產品的開發流程。它透過以下部門運作：農業、工業應用和人類健康。農業部門開發種子性狀、農化產品和農業生物產品，以提高植物性能。工業應用重點在於工業用途改良蓖麻子種子的開發和商業化。人類健康部分涉及基於人類微生物組的療法的發現和開發。該公司由 Amir Barzilay 和 Hagai Karchi 於 1999 年 10 月 10 日創立，總部位於以色列雷霍沃特。

info.description: VSE Corp. is focused on significantly enhancing the productivity and longevity of its customers' high-value, business-critical assets. It operates through the Aviation segment. The Aviation segment is a provider of aftermarket parts distribution and MRO services for components and engine accessories supporting commercial, business and general aviation operators. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Miramar, FL.
info.description_zh: VSE Corp. 致力於大幅提升客戶高價值、業務關鍵型資產的生產力與壽命。它透過航空部門運作。航空部門是為商業、公務和通用航空業者提供零件和引擎配件的售後零件分銷和 MRO 服務提供者。該公司成立於 1959 年，總部位於佛羅裡達州米拉瑪。

info.description: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. engages in the purpose of acquiring and integrating various companies engaged in the aerospace and defense industry. It operates through the following segments: Avionics and Electronics, Electric Air Mobility, Drones, and Training. The Avionics and Electronics segment refers to its brand, Aspen Avionics, which designs, certifies, and manufactures critical navigation, communication, and display components and integrated systems. The Electric Air Mobility segment transforms urban transportation with its development of an electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft. The Drones perform crucial missions such as ISR and target tracking, mapping, surveying, inspection, and localization, enhancing military, and commercial operational efficiency worldwide. The Training segment relates to its brand, Coastal Defense, delivers specialized professional training services to the military and commercial aviation communities. The company was founded by Chirinjeev Kathuria on August, 30, 2021 and is headquartered in McLean, VA.
info.description_zh: AIRO Group Holdings, Inc. 致力於收購和整合從事航空航天和國防工業的多家公司。該公司透過以下部門運作：航空電子和電子部門、電動空中交通部門、無人機部門和培訓部門。航空電子設備和電子部門是指其品牌 Aspen Avionics，該公司設計、認證和製造關鍵的導航、通訊和顯示組件以及整合系統。電動空中交通部門透過開發電動垂直起降 (eVTOL) 飛機改變了城市交通。無人機執行ISR和目標追蹤、測繪、測量、檢查和定位等關鍵任務，提高全球軍事和商業營運效率。培訓部門與其品牌海岸防禦有關，為軍事和商業航空界提供專門的專業培訓服務。該公司由 Chirinjeev Kathuria 於 2021 年 8 月 30 日創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州麥克萊恩。

info.description: Tractor Supply Co. engages in the retail sale of farm and ranch products. It operates retail farm and ranch stores and focuses on supplying the lifestyle needs of recreational farmers and ranchers, as well as tradesmen and small businesses. The firm operates the retail stores under the names: Tractor Supply Company, Orscheln Farm & Home, and Petsense. Its product categories include equine, livestock, pet, and small animal, hardware, truck, towing, and tool, heating, lawn and garden items, power equipment, gifts, and toys, recreational clothing and footwear, and maintenance products for agricultural and rural use. The company was founded by Charles E. Schmidt, Sr. in 1938 and is headquartered in Brentwood, TN.
info.description_zh: Tractor Supply Co. 從事農場和牧場產品的零售。它經營零售農場和牧場商店，專注於滿足休閒農民和牧場主以及商人和小型企業的生活方式需求。該公司以以下名稱經營零售店：Tractor Supply Company、Orscheln Farm & Home 和 Petsense。其產品類別包括馬、牲畜、寵物和小動物、五金、卡車、拖車和工具、暖氣、草坪和花園用品、電力設備、禮品和玩具、休閒服裝和鞋類以及農業和農村使用的維護產品。該公司由 Charles E. Schmidt, Sr. 於 1938 年創立，總部位於田納西州布倫特伍德。

info.description: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. develops drone technology and safety systems. It is engaged in the business of designing, developing, and providing autonomous parachute safety systems for commercial drones, also known as Unmanned Aerial Systems or UAS. The company was founded by Amir Tsaliah and Ran Krauss on June 30, 2013 and is headquartered in Kiryat Ono, Israel.
info.description_zh: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. 開發無人機技術和安全系統。該公司從事設計、開發和提供商用無人機自主降落傘安全系統（也稱為無人機系統或 UAS）的業務。該公司由 Amir Tsaliah 和 Ran Krauss 於 2013 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於以色列 Kiryat Ono。

info.description: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc. is an exploration stage company, which engages in the provision of boron and lithium properties in Australia and the United States. It focuses on supplying boron specialty materials, complemented by lithium co-product production. The company was founded on September 23, 2021 and is headquartered in Hesperia, CA.
info.description_zh: 5E Advanced Materials, Inc.是一家處於勘探階段的公司，主要在澳洲和美國提供硼和鋰資源。它專注於供應硼特種材料，並輔以鋰副產品生產。該公司成立於2021年9月23日，總部位於加州希斯皮里亞。

info.description: Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. is a closed-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by Sprott Asset Management, LP. The fund is co-managed by Sprott Asset Management USA Inc. It invests in the public equity markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in value stocks of companies across all market capitalizations. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Russell 3000 Index. It was formerly known as Royce Focus Trust, Inc. Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. was formed on March 2, 1988 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. 是由 Sprott Asset Management, LP 發起和管理的封閉式股票共同基金。該基金由 Sprott Asset Management USA Inc. 共同管理，投資於美國公共股票市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業的公司股票。它主要投資於所有市值公司的價值股票。該基金將其投資組合的表現與羅素 3000 指數進行比較。它的前身為 Royce Focus Trust, Inc.。 Sprott Focus Trust, Inc. 成立於 1988 年 3 月 2 日，註冊地在美國。

info.description: Lixiang Education Holding Co., Ltd. operates as an investment holding company, which engages in the provision of education services. It offers kindergarten, private primary, and secondary levels. The company was founded by Fen Ye in August 2001 and is headquartered in Lishui, China.
info.description_zh: 理想教育控股有限公司是一家投資控股公司，主要提供教育服務。它提供幼兒園、私立小學和中學。該公司由葉芬於2001年8月創立，總部位於中國麗水。

info.description: AeroVironment, Inc. is a defense technology company delivering integrated capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. The company develops and deploys autonomous systems, loitering munitions, counter-UAS technologies, space-based platforms, directed energy systems, and cyber and electronic warfare capabilities-built to meet the mission needs of today's warfighter and tomorrow's conflicts. At the core of these technologies lies AV_Halo, a modular, mission-ready suite of AI-powered software tools that empowers warfighters and enables full-battlefield dominance: detect, decide, deliver. With a national manufacturing footprint and a deep innovation pipeline, AV delivers proven systems and future-defining capabilities at speed, scale, and operational relevance. The company was founded by Paul B. MacCready, Jr. in July 1971 and is headquartered in Arlington, VA.
info.description_zh: AeroVironment, Inc. 是一家國防技術公司，提供跨空中、陸地、海上、太空和網路的綜合能力。該公司開發和部署自主系統、巡飛彈藥、反無人機技術、天基平台、定向能係統以及網路和電子戰能力，旨在滿足當今作戰人員的任務需求和未來的衝突。這些技術的核心是 AV_Halo，這是一套模組化、任務就緒的人工智慧軟體工具套件，可為作戰人員提供支援並實現全戰場主導地位：偵測、決策、交付。 AV 憑藉全​​國製造足跡和深入的創新管道，以速度、規模和營運相關性提供經過驗證的系統和未來定義能力。該公司由 Paul B. MacCready, Jr. 於 1971 年 7 月創立，總部位於維吉尼亞州阿靈頓。

info.description: Exagen, Inc. is a commercial-stage diagnostics company, which engages in transforming the care continuum for patients suffering from debilitating and chronic autoimmune diseases by enabling timely differential diagnosis and optimizing therapeutic intervention. It operates under the Avise brand. The company was founded by Waneta C. Tuttle and Cole Harris in 2002 and is headquartered in Vista, CA.
info.description_zh: Exagen, Inc. 是一家商業階段的診斷公司，致力於透過及時鑑別診斷和優化治療介入來改變患有衰弱性和慢性自體免疫疾病的患者的護理連續性。它以 Avise 品牌運作。該公司由 Waneta C. Tuttle 和 Cole Harris 於 2002 年創立，總部位於加州維斯塔。

info.description: WisdomTree Cybersecurity Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance of the WisdomTree Team8 Cybersecurity Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to equity securities of exchange-listed companies globally, which are primarily involved in cybersecurity and security-oriented technology that generate a meaningful part of their revenue from cybersecurity activities and are experiencing revenue growth. To the extent the index concentrates in the securities of a particular industry or group of industries, the fund will concentrate its investments to approximately the same extent as the index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 網路安全基金旨在追蹤 WisdomTree Team8 網路安全指數的價格和收益率表現。該指數旨在提供全球交易所上市公司的股本證券敞口，這些公司主要涉及網路安全和安全導向技術，這些公司的收入中有很大一部分來自網路安全活動，並且正在經歷收入成長。如果指數集中於特定產業或產業組的證券，則基金的投資集中程度將與指數大致相同。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Pfizer Inc. is a research-based global biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, marketing, sales and distribution of biopharmaceutical products worldwide. The firm works across developed and emerging markets to advance wellness, prevention, treatments and cures that challenge the most feared diseases. The company was founded by Charles Pfizer Sr. and Charles Erhart in 1849 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 輝瑞公司是一家以研究為基礎的全球生物製藥公司，在全球範圍內從事生物製藥產品的發現、開發、製造、行銷、銷售和分銷。該公司在已開發和新興市場開展工作，推動健康、預防、治療和治療，以應對最可怕的疾病。該公司由 Charles Pfizer Sr. 和 Charles Erhart 於 1849 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Themes Cybersecurity ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of Solactive Cyber Security Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that have business operations in the cybersecurity industry. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs") based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Cyber​​security ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive Cyber​​ Security Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數旨在為在網路安全產業開展業務的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: BT Brands, Inc. engages in the ownership and operation of quick-service restaurants. It operates Burger Time restaurants and a Dairy Queen franchise. Its Burger Time restaurants sell chicken and pulled pork sandwiches, side dishes, and soft drinks. The company was founded in August 1987 and is headquartered in Minnetonka, MN.
info.description_zh: BT Brands, Inc. 從事快餐店的所有權和經營業務。該公司經營 Burger Time 餐廳和 Dairy Queen 特許經營店。其 Burger Time 餐廳販售雞肉和手撕豬肉三明治、配菜和軟性飲料。該公司成立於 1987 年 8 月，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼通卡。

info.description: REalloys, Inc. is engaged in the rebuilding of domestic supply chain resilience for rare earth elements and magnets. It is involved in recycling, mining, oxide production, metallization, alloying, and magnet manufacturing. The company was founded on October 4, 2011 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: REalloys, Inc. 致力於重建稀土元素和磁鐵的國內供應鏈彈性。它涉及回收、採礦、氧化物生產、金屬化、合金化和磁鐵製造。該公司成立於2011年10月4日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Brilliant Earth Group, Inc. operates as a holding company, which engages in retail sale of diamonds, gemstones, and jewelry. Its product portfolio consists of diamond engagement and wedding rings, gemstone rings, and fine jewelry. The company was founded by Beth Gerstein and Eric Grossberg in 2005 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Brilliant Earth Group, Inc. 作為一家控股公司經營，從事鑽石、寶石和珠寶的零售業務。其產品組合包括鑽石訂婚戒指和結婚戒指、寶石戒指和高級珠寶。該公司由 Beth Gerstein 和 Eric Grossberg 於 2005 年創立，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long UEC Daily ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, two times (200%) the daily performance of the common stock of Uranium Energy Corp. The fund is designed for active traders seeking to magnify short-term results through leveraged exposure to a single equity security, utilizing financial derivatives to achieve its daily investment objective.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 UEC 每日 ETF 旨在複製 Uranium Energy Corp 普通股每日表現的兩倍 (200%)（未扣除費用和開支）。該基金專為尋求透過單一股票證券槓桿曝險放大短期績效、利用金融衍生性商品實現其日常投資目標的活躍交易者而設計。

info.description: BCP Investment Corp. is a non-diversified closed-end investment company. It engages in the investment opportunities in middle market companies located in the United States. The firm provides secured term loans, bonds, notes and mezzanine debt financing for buyout transactions and also acts as a co-investor. The company was founded on August 8, 2006 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: BCP Investment Corp. 是一家非多元化封閉式投資公司。它從事位於美國的中間市場公司的投資機會。該公司為收購交易提供擔保定期貸款、債券、票據和夾層債務融資，並擔任聯合投資者。該公司成立於2006年8月8日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Vroom, Inc. engages in providing an ecommerce platform for the buying and selling of used vehicles. It operates through the following segments: UACC and CarStory. The UACC segment includes UACC's operations with its network of third-party dealership customers, including the purchases and servicing of vehicle retail installment sales contracts. The CarStory segment includes sales of AI-powered analytics and digital services to automotive dealers, automotive financial services companies and others in the automotive industry. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Fort Worth, TX.
info.description_zh: Vroom, Inc. 致力於提供二手車買賣的電子商務平台。它透過以下部門運作：UACC 和 CarStory。 UACC 部門包括 UACC 與其第三方經銷商客戶網路的業務，包括車輛零售分期銷售合約的購買和服務。 CarStory 部門包括向汽車經銷商、汽車金融服務公司和汽車行業的其他公司銷售人工智慧驅動的分析和數位服務。該公司成立於 2012 年，總部位於德克薩斯州沃思堡。

info.description: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd. engages in the gaming entertainment business. It operates through the Gaming and iGaming business divisions. The Gaming business division develops and publishes social casinos and casual games. The iGaming business division refers to development and operation of license-based online casinos. The company was founded in December 2007 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
info.description_zh: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd.從事遊戲娛樂業務。它透過遊戲和網路遊戲業務部門運作。遊戲業務部門開發和發布社交賭場和休閒遊戲。 iGaming業務部門是指基於許可的線上賭場的開發和營運。該公司成立於2007年12月，總部位於韓國首爾。

info.description: Safe Pro Group, Inc. engages in the provision and acquisition of security and protection products. Its products include Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) software technology and photogrammetry analysis tools, bullet and blast resistant personal protection equipment, and aerial managed services and mission-critical uncrewed solutions. The firm operates through the following segments: Safe-PRO USA, Airborne Response, and Safe Pro AI. The company was founded by Daniyel Erdberg on December 15, 2021 and is headquartered in Aventura, FL.
info.description_zh: Safe Pro Group, Inc. 從事安全和保護產品的提供和收購。其產品包括人工智慧（AI）和機器學習（ML）軟體技術和攝影測量分析工具、防彈和防爆個人防護設備以及空中管理服務和關鍵任務無人解決方案。該公司透過以下部門營運：Safe-PRO USA、Airborne Response 和 Safe Pro AI。該公司由 Daniyel Erdberg 於 2021 年 12 月 15 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州阿文圖拉。

info.description: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory International Growth Free Cash Flow Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. The index is designed to deliver exposure to equity securities of non-U.S. developed markets of growth companies.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares International Free Cash Flow Growth ETF 力求提供在扣除費用和開支之前與 Victory International Growth 自由現金流指數的表現密切相關的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。該指數旨在提供對非美國已開發市場成長型公司股票證券的投資。

info.description: iPower, Inc. engages in the online retail and supply of consumer home, garden, in-home farming, pet, and wellbeing products. It sells its brands such as Simple Deluxe, YSSOA, Zenhydro, Flourish, iPOWER, iFarm, FluffyDream, ScratchMe, and HealSmart through zenhydro.com, simpledeluxe.com, and various third-party online platforms. The company offers grow light systems, advanced heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) systems, water pumps, heaters, chillers and filters, nutrient and fertilizer delivery systems, and various growing media typically made from soil, rock wool or coconut fiber. It also provides home goods supplies including commercial fans, floor and wall fans, storage and shelving units, and chairs. The company was founded by Chenlong Tan and Allan Huang on April 11, 2018 and is headquartered in Rancho Cucamonga, CA.
info.description_zh: iPower, Inc. 從事消費者家居、園藝、家庭農業、寵物和保健產品的線上零售和供應。它透過zenHydro.com、simpledeluxe.com和各種第三方線上平台銷售Simple Deluxe、YSSOA、ZenHydro、Flourish、iPOWER、iFarm、FluffyDream、ScratchMe和HealSmart等品牌。該公司提供生長燈系統、先進的暖氣、通風和空調 (HVAC) 系統、水泵、加熱器、冷卻器和過濾器、養分和肥料輸送系統以及通常由土壤、岩棉或椰子纖維製成的各種生長介質。它還提供家居用品，包括商用風扇、落地扇和壁扇、儲物櫃和層架以及椅子。該公司由 Chenlong Tan 和 Allan Huang 於 2018 年 4 月 11 日創立，總部位於加州庫卡蒙加牧場。

info.description: Village Farms International, Inc. engages in the management and operation of agricultural greenhouse facilities in the United States and Canada. It operates through the following segments: Canadian Cannabis, U.S. Cannabis, Produce, Energy, and Leli. The Canadian Cannabis segment includes Pure Sunfarms and Rose LifeScience. The U.S. Cannabis segment operates Balanced Health. The Produce segment involves producing, marketing, and distribution of tomatoes. The Energy segment owns and operates power plants from landfill gas that generates electricity and provides thermal heat. The Leli segment produces and supplies cannabis products to designated coffee shops. The company was founded by Michael A. DeGiglio and Albert W. Vanzeyst in 1987 and is headquartered in Lake Mary, FL.
info.description_zh: Village Farms International, Inc.在美國和加拿大從事農業溫室設施的管理和營運。該公司透過以下部門運作：加拿大大麻部門、美國大麻部門、農產品部門、能源部門和 Leli 部門。加拿大大麻部門包括 Pure Sunfarms 和 Rose LifeScience。美國大麻部門經營平衡健康業務。農產品部門涉及番茄的生產、行銷和分銷。能源部門擁有並經營利用垃圾掩埋氣體發電並提供熱能的發電廠。 Leli 部門生產並向指定咖啡店供應大麻產品。該公司由 Michael A. DeGiglio 和 Albert W. Vanzeyst 於 1987 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州瑪麗湖。

info.description: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a commercial stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of therapeutics, starting with eye care. Its product candidate, TP-03, is a novel therapeutic in Phase 2b/3 that is being developed for the treatment of blepharitis caused by the infestation of Demodex mites, which is referred to as Demodex blepharitis. It is also developing TP-04 for the potential treatment of Ocular Rosacea and TP-05 as an oral tablet for the potential prevention of Lyme disease. The company was founded by Bobak Azamian and D. Michael Ackermann in 2017 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 是一家商業階段的生物製藥公司，專注於治療藥物的開發和商業化，從眼科護理開始。其候選產品TP-03是一種處於2b/3期的新型治療藥物，正在開發用於治療由蠕形蟎蟲感染引起的瞼緣炎（簡稱蠕形蟎瞼緣炎）。該公司還在開發 TP-04 用於潛在治療眼部紅斑痤瘡，以及 TP-05 作為口服片劑用於潛在預防萊姆病。該公司由 Bobak Azamian 和 D. Michael Ackermann 於 2017 年創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Smith Micro Software, Inc. engages in the provision of software solutions. It offers wireless internet solutions which enable access to information and entertainment. Its products include SafePath Family, SafePath IoT, SafePath Home, CommSuite VVM, CommSuite VTT, and ViewSpot. The company was founded by William W. Smith Jr. on November 30, 1982 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, PA.
info.description_zh: Smith Micro Software, Inc. 從事提供軟體解決方案。它提供無線互聯網解決方案，可以存取資訊和娛樂。其產品包括SafePath系列、SafePath IoT、SafePath Home、CommSuite VVM、CommSuite VTT和ViewSpot。該公司由 William W. Smith Jr. 於 1982 年 11 月 30 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡。

info.description: Sprott Junior Uranium Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Junior Uranium Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from (i) mining, exploration, development, and production of uranium; (ii) earning uranium royalties; and/or (iii) supplying uranium. The index generally consists of from 30 to 40 constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Junior Uranium Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和支出之前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Junior Uranium Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 收入和/或資產來自 (i) 鈾礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現； (ii) 賺取鈾礦使用費；和/或 (iii) 供應鈾。該指數一般由 30 至 40 檔成分股組成。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: ATN International, Inc. engages in the provision of digital infrastructure and communications services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Telecom and International Telecom. The U.S. Telecom segment offers fixed, carrier, and managed services to customers in Alaska and the western U.S. The International Telecom segment focuses on fixed, carrier, mobility and managed services to customers in Bermuda, Cayman Islands, Guyana, and US Virgin Islands. The company was founded by Cornelius B. Prior Jr. in June 1987 and is headquartered in Beverly, MA.
info.description_zh: ATN International, Inc. 從事提供數位基礎設施和通訊服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國電信部門和國際電信部門。美國電信部門為阿拉斯加和美國西部的客戶提供固定、營運商和管理服務。國際電信部門專注於為百慕達、開曼群島、圭亞那和美屬維京群島的客戶提供固定、營運商、行動和管理服務。該公司由 Cornelius B. Prior Jr. 於 1987 年 6 月創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州貝弗利。

info.description: Fluent, Inc. engages in the provision of digital marketing services. It operates through the following segments: Fluent, Call Solutions, and AdParlor. The Fluent segment includes delivering data and performance-based marketing executions. The company was founded by Ryan Schulke and Matthew Conlin in 2001 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Fluent, Inc. 從事提供數位行銷服務。它透過以下部門運作：Fluent、Call Solutions 和 AdParlor。 Fluent 部分包括提供數據和基於績效的行銷執行。該公司由 Ryan Schulke 和 Matthew Conlin 於 2001 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Odyssey Marine Exploration, Inc. is a deep-ocean exploration pioneer that provides access to critical mineral resources. The company uses innovative methods and cutting-edge technology to discover, validate and develop subsea mineral deposits in an environmentally and socially responsible manner. Its projects include US Critical Minerals Program, Lihir Gold projects and Cook Island Nodule Exploration. The company was founded by Gregory P. Stemm and John C. Morris in 1994 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.
info.description_zh: 奧德賽海洋勘探公司是深海勘探先驅，提供關鍵礦產資源的取得。該公司採用創新方法和尖端技術，以對環境和社會負責的方式發現、驗證和開發海底礦藏。其項目包括美國關鍵礦產計劃、利希爾金礦項目和庫克島結核勘探項目。該公司由 Gregory P. Stemm 和 John C. Morris 於 1994 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州坦帕。

info.description: WEBs Materials XLB Defined Volatility ETF is a passively managed fund that provides exposure to the U.S. large-cap materials sector while employing a systematic, rules-based strategy to target a specific annual volatility rate. The fund dynamically adjusts its market exposure between 0% and 200% based on recent realized volatility, increasing exposure through derivatives when market fluctuations are low and reducing exposure to cash when volatility exceeds the target.
info.description_zh: WEBs Materials XLB 定義波動率 ETF 是一款被動管理基金，提供對美國大盤材料行業的投資，同時採用系統化的、基於規則的策略來瞄準特定的年度波動率。該基金根據近期實現的波動率在0%至200%之間動態調整其市場敞口，當市場波動較低時透過衍生性商品增加敞口，當波動率超過目標時減少現金敞口。

info.description: Edwards Lifesciences Corp. engages in patient-focused medical innovations for heart disease and critical care monitoring. Its products are categorized into four main areas: Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement, Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies, Surgical Structural Heart, and Critical Care. It operates through the following geographical segments: United States, Europe, Japan, and Rest of World. The company was founded by Miles Lowell Edwards in 1958 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Edwards Lifesciences Corp. 致力於以患者為中心的心臟病和重症監護監測醫療創新。其產品分為四個主要領域：經導管主動脈瓣置換術、經導管二尖瓣和三尖瓣治療、外科結構性心臟和重症監護。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、歐洲、日本和世界其他地區。該公司由 Miles Lowell Edwards 於 1958 年創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. operates as a software development company. It operates through the following business units: the customer experience management platform and the digital transformation. The customer experience management platform includes marketing, sales, service, and a content management system. The digital transformation business provides customers with robotic process automation, process mining, and task mining. The company was founded on May 18, 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
info.description_zh: HeartCore Enterprises, Inc. 是一家軟體開發公司。它透過以下業務部門運作：客戶體驗管理平台和數位轉型。客戶體驗管理平台包括行銷、銷售、服務和內容管理系統。數位轉型業務為客戶提供機器人流程自動化、流程挖掘、任務挖掘。該公司成立於2021年5月18日，總部位於日本東京。

info.description: IDX Alternative FIAT ETF provides exposure to precious metals (gold, silver) and major digital assets (Bitcoin, Ethereum) via futures, crypto ETPs and metal ETPs with a stated risk-managed, inflation/currency-hedge objective and judicious use of leverage up to 1.25x.
info.description_zh: IDX 另類法定 ETF 透過期貨、加密貨幣 ETP 和金屬 ETP 提供貴金屬（黃金、白銀）和主要數位資產（比特幣、以太幣）的投資，並具有明確的風險管理、通膨/貨幣對沖目標，並明智地使用高達 1.25 倍的槓桿。

info.description: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company, which engages in identifying, acquiring, and commercializing novel products. It operates through the Rx and Consumer Health segments. The RX segment consists of various prescription pharmaceutical products sold through third parties. The Consumer Health segment includes various consumer health products sold directly to consumers. Its products include Adzenys ER, Adzenys XR-ODT, Cotempla XR-ODT, Karbinal ER, Poly-Vi-Flor, Tri-Vi-Flor, Generic Tussionex, Tuzistra XR, and ZolpiMist. The company was founded on August 9, 2002 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Aytu Biopharma, Inc. 是一家專業製藥公司，致力於識別、收購和商業化新產品。它透過處方藥和消費者健康部門運作。 RX 部門由透過第三方銷售的各種處方藥品組成。消費者健康部門包括直接銷售給消費者的各種消費者健康產品。其產品包括 Adzenys ER、Adzenys XR-ODT、Cotempla XR-ODT、Karbinal ER、Poly-Vi-Flor、Tri-Vi-Flor、Generic Tussionex、Tuzistra XR 和 ZolpiMist。該公司成立於2002年8月9日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Arhaus, Inc. engages in the retail of furniture, outdoor, lighting, textiles, and decor. The company was founded by John Reed in 1986 and is headquartered in Hudson, OH.
info.description_zh: Arhaus, Inc. 從事家具、戶外用品、照明、紡織品和裝飾品的零售。該公司由 John Reed 於 1986 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州哈德遜。

info.description: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the advancement of cell-based therapeutics to target the B-cell receptor on the surface of an individual patient's malignant tumor cells. Its product pipeline includes XCart Platform and Polyxen. The company was founded on August 9, 2011 and is headquartered in Framingham, MA.
info.description_zh: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發基於細胞的療法，以靶向個別患者惡性腫瘤細胞表面的 B 細胞受體。其產品線包括 XCart Platform 和 Polyxen。該公司成立於2011年8月9日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州弗雷明漢。

info.description: Credit Suisse X-Links Silver Shares Covered Call ETN seeks a return linked to the performance of the Credit Suisse NASDAQ Silver FLOWSTM 106 Index. The index measures the return of a "covered call" strategy on the shares of the iShares Silver Trust (the "SLV Shares") by reflecting changes in the price of the SLV Shares and the notional option premiums received from the notional sale of monthly call options on the SLV Shares less notional transaction costs incurred in connection with the covered call strategy.
info.description_zh: 瑞士信貸 X-Links 白銀股票備兌買權 ETN 尋求與瑞士信貸 NASDAQ Silver FLOWSTM 106 指數表現掛鉤的回報。該指數衡量 iShares Silver Trust 股票（「SLV 股票」）「備兌買權」策略的回報，反映了 SLV 股票價格的變化以及每月名義出售 SLV 股票看漲期權所獲得的名義期權費減去與備兌看漲期權策略相關的名義交易成本。

info.description: Tenon Medical, Inc. is a medical device company, which engages in the development of a minimally invasive approach to the sacroiliac joint (SI joint) using a single titanium implant for treatment of the most common types of SI Joint disorders. The company was founded by Richard Ferrari and Richard Ginn on June 19, 2012 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, CA.
info.description_zh: Tenon Medical, Inc. 是一家醫療器材公司，致力於開發骶髂關節（SI 關節）微創方法，使用單一鈦植入物來治療最常見的 SI 關節疾病。該公司由 Richard Ferrari 和 Richard Ginn 於 2012 年 6 月 19 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州洛斯加托斯。

info.description: Alzamend Neuro, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing products for the treatment of neurodegenerative and psychiatric disorders. The company's pipeline includes AL001, which is in Phase II clinical trial, and delivers a therapeutic combination of lithium, proline, and salicylate for the treatment of Alzheimer's, bipolar disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, major depressive disorder, other neurodegenerative diseases, and psychiatric disorders, and AL002, which completed preclinical stage, and uses a method using a mutant-peptide sensitized cell as a cell-based therapeutic vaccine to restore the ability of a patient's immunological system to combat Alzheimer's disease. The company was founded on February 26, 2016 by Milton C. Ault, III and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Alzamend Neuro, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發治療神經退化性疾病和精神疾病的產品。該公司的管道包括處於II期臨床試驗的AL001，提供鋰、脯氨酸和水楊酸鹽的治療組合，用於治療阿茲海默症、雙相情感障礙、創傷後壓力症候群、重度憂鬱症、其他神經退化性疾病和精神疾病；以及已完成臨床前階段的AL002，並採用使用突變肽致敏細胞作為基於細胞的治療性疫苗來恢復能力的免疫病患者。該公司由 Milton C. Ault, III 於 2016 年 2 月 26 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: VEON Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of connectivity and digital services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Pakistan, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and Bangladesh. Additionally, the company reports its operations under Other, which includes activities in Kyrgyzstan, and HQ and eliminations, which covers management-related transactions. The company was founded by Dmitriy Borisovich Zimin and Augie K. Fabela II in 1992 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
info.description_zh: VEON Ltd.是一家控股公司，從事提供連接和數位服務。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：巴基斯坦、烏克蘭、哈薩克、烏茲別克和孟加拉。此外，該公司在「其他」項下報告其業務，其中包括在吉爾吉斯斯坦的活動，以及總部和抵銷，其中包括與管理相關的交易。該公司由 Dmitriy Borisovich Zimin 和 Augie K. Fabela II 於 1992 年創立，總部位於阿拉伯聯合大公國杜拜。

info.description: Macquarie Focused International Core ETF seeks to provide capital growth and appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the ETF will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity companies. The fund will invest primarily in common stocks of non-U.S. companies located or operating in both developed markets and emerging markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 麥格理聚焦國際核心 ETF 致力於提供資本成長和增值。在正常情況下，ETF將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於股權公司。該基金將主要投資於位於已開發市場和新興市場或在新興市場運營的非美國公司的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptive Medicine ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in securities of disruptive medicine companies. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 富達顛覆性醫藥 ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於顛覆性醫藥公司的證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Symmetry Panoramic Sector Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal conditions, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its assets primarily among (i) shares of ETFs that each focus on common stocks of companies included in an individual sector of the U.S. large capitalization universe, as such sectors are determined by the Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) and/or (ii) common stocks of companies included in the Equity Sectors. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Symmetry Panoramic Sector Momentum ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過將其資產主要配置在 (i) ETF 份額中來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 份額均專注於美國大型資本領域中單個部門所包含的公司的普通股，因為這些部門由全球行業分類標準 (GICS) 確定，和/或 (ii) 股票部門所包含的公司的普通股。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cohen & Steers Future of Energy Active ETF is an actively managed fund targeting structural and transitional shifts within the global energy sector by investing primarily in equity securities of traditional, alternative, renewable, and clean energy companies, alongside associated utilities and natural resource firms. The strategy focuses on issuers leading or enabling the energy transition across any market capitalization, blending global infrastructure and utility exposures with the flexibility to allocate up to 50% in foreign markets and up to 20% in fixed-income instruments, including high-yield debt.
info.description_zh: Cohen & Steers Future of Energy Active ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，旨在透過主要投資於傳統、替代、再生和清潔能源公司以及相關公用事業和自然資源公司的股權證券，瞄準全球能源產業的結構性和轉型轉變。該策略重點在於引領或推動任何市值能源轉型的發行人，將全球基礎設施和公用事業風險敞口與可靈活配置高達 50% 的國外市場和高達 20% 的固定收益工具（包括高收益債務）的靈活性結合起來。

info.description: Man Active Trend Enhanced ETF seeks to provide capital growth. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in two complementary investment strategies: an active, trend-following strategy (the "Trend-Following Strategy") and an equity strategy (the "Equity Strategy"). AHL Partners LLP, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), employs a quantitative model to identify investment opportunities across a wide range of global markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Trend 增強型 ETF 旨在提供資本成長。該基金尋求透過投資兩種互補的投資策略來實現其投資目標：積極的趨勢追蹤策略（「趨勢追蹤策略」）和股票策略（「股票策略」）。該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）AHL Partners LLP 採用定量模型來識別全球廣泛市場的投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Autism Impact ETF is a passively managed thematic fund tracking an equal-weighted index of publicly traded global companies within developed markets that provide products, services, or research supporting the autism ecosystem and broader neurodivergent community. The fund targets the expanding healthcare, specialized education, assistive technology, and behavioral diagnostics sectors while incorporating a unique philanthropic commitment to donate net advisory profits to autism care and research organizations.
info.description_zh: Defiance Autism Impact ETF 是一支被動管理的主題基金，追蹤已開發市場內全球上市公司的等權重指數，這些公司提供支持自閉症生態系統和更廣泛的神經分歧社群的產品、服務或研究。該基金的目標是擴大醫療保健、專業教育、輔助技術和行為診斷領域，同時納入獨特的慈善承諾，將淨諮詢利潤捐贈給自閉症護理和研究組織。

info.description: E-Power, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sale of graphite anode material. It operates through the Graphite Anode Business and Peer-to-Peer Knowledge Sharing and Enterprise Business segments. The company was founded by Hai Ping Hu in December 2014 and is headquartered in Zibo, China.
info.description_zh: E-Power, Inc.是一家控股公司，從事石墨負極材料的製造和銷售。它透過石墨陽極業務以及點對點知識共享和企業業務部門進行運作。該公司由胡海平於2014年12月創立，總部位於中國淄博。

info.description: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. engages in uranium exploration and development with proprietary small modular reactor (SMR) technology to address structural supply challenges in the U.S. nuclear sector. It offers Uranium Resources and Proprietary Small Modular Reactor (SMR) Technology. The company was founded on September 19, 2025 and is headquartered in Reno, NV.
info.description_zh: Eagle Nuclear Energy Corp. 利用專有的小型模組化反應器 (SMR) 技術從事鈾勘探和開發，以解決美國核能產業的結構性供應挑戰。它提供鈾資源和專有的小型模組化反應器（SMR）技術。該公司成立於2025年9月19日，總部位於內華達州里諾。

info.description: Ames National Corp. is a bank holding company, which engages in the provision of banking services through its subsidiaries. Its activities include personal, business, agricultural and commercial lending, management of the investment securities portfolio, deposit account services, and wealth management services. The company was founded on January 21, 1975 and is headquartered in Ames, IA.
info.description_zh: Ames National Corp. 是一家銀行控股公司，透過其子公司提供銀行服務。其業務包括個人、企業、農業和商業貸款、投資證券組合管理、存款帳戶服務和財富管理服務。該公司成立於 1975 年 1 月 21 日，總部位於愛荷華州艾姆斯。

info.description: Veru, Inc. is a late clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel medicines and treatment of cardiometabolic and inflammatory diseases. Its drug development program consists of two late-stage new chemical entities, enobosarm and sabizabulin. The company was founded by William R. Gargiulo, Jr. and O. B. Parrish in 1971 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Veru, Inc. 是一家處於後期臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發新藥以及治療心臟代謝和發炎疾病。其藥物開發計劃包括兩種後期新化學實體：enobosarm 和 sabizabulin。該公司由 William R. Gargiulo, Jr. 和 O. B. Parrish 於 1971 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Alkami Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of digital banking software solutions to credit unions, banks, credit union service organizations, and service bureaus. It offers content management and an online and mobile banking suite that brings together a snapshot view of accounts with recent and upcoming activities. The company was founded by Louis A. Iannaccone, Scott Klososky, Steve Meston, Gary L. Nelson, Gruenewald Bobby, Jay Lackey, Stephen Bohanon, and Kim Stroh in 2007 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Alkami Technology, Inc. 致力於向信用社、銀行、信用社服務組織和服務局提供數位銀行軟體解決方案。它提供內容管理以及線上和行動銀行套件，將帳戶快照視圖與最近和即將進行的活動結合在一起。該公司由 Louis A. Iannaccone、Scott Klososky、Steve Meston、Gary L. Nelson、Gruenewald Bobby、Jay Lackey、Stephen Bohanon 和 Kim Stroh 於 2007 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 Index. The index measures the performance of approximately 70 securities of domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq based on market capitalization, as determined by Nasdaq, Inc. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ex Top 30 指數的投資結果。該指數根據納斯達克公司確定的市值衡量在納斯達克上市的約 70 種國內和國際非金融公司證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其基礎指數的組成證券。

info.description: TDH Holdings, Inc. is a real estate management company, that focuses on owning, operating and managing commercial real estate properties. It provides office services for small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was founded by Rong Feng Cui on April 22, 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: TDH Holdings, Inc. 是一家房地產管理公司，專注於擁有、經營和管理商業房地產。為中小企業提供辦公服務。該公司由崔榮峰於2002年4月22日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: Interface, Inc. is a flooring company, which offers carpet tile & resilient flooring, including luxury vinyl tile and rubber flooring products. The firm designs, manufactures and sells modular carpet, manufactured for the commercial and institutional markets under the interface brand, and for consumer markets as FLOR modular carpets. It also offers Intersept, a proprietary antimicrobial used in a number of interior finishes. The company was founded by Ray C. Anderson in 1973 and is headquartered in Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: Interface, Inc. 是一家地板公司，提供方塊地毯和彈性地板，包括豪華乙烯基瓷磚和橡膠地板產品。該公司設計、製造和銷售模組化地毯，以 Interface 品牌為商業和機構市場製造，並以 FLOR 模組化地毯為消費者市場製造。它還提供 Intersept，一種用於多種室內裝飾的專有抗菌劑。該公司由 Ray C. Anderson 於 1973 年創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: National Energy Services Reunited Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of oilfield services. It operates through the Production Services and Drilling and Evaluation Services. The Production Services segment includes coiled tubing, cementing, stimulation and pumping, nitrogen services, filtration services, completions, pipelines, laboratory services, and artificial lift services. The Drilling and Evaluation Services segment offers well testing services, drilling services and rental, fishing and remediation, drilling and workover rigs, wireline logging services, turbines drilling, directional drilling, slickline services, and drilling fluids. The company was founded on January 23, 2017 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣設備與服務
info.description_zh: National Energy Services Reunited Corp.是一家控股公司，從事提供油田服務。它透過生產服務以及鑽井和評估服務來運作。生產服務部門包括連續油管、固井、增產和泵送、氮氣服務、過濾服務、完井、管道、實驗室服務和人工舉升服務。鑽井和評估服務部門提供試井服務、鑽井服務和租賃、捕魚和修復、鑽井和修井機、電纜測井服務、渦輪機鑽井、定向鑽井、鋼絲服務和鑽井液。該公司成立於2017年1月23日，總部位於德州休士頓。

info.description: SSR Mining, Inc. is a metals mining company with assets located in four jurisdictions: the USA, Turkiye, Canada, and Argentina, which engages in the operation, acquisition, exploration and development of precious metal resource properties. The firm produces gold ore as well as copper, silver, lead and zinc concentrates. It operates through the following business segments: Copler, Marigold, Crippler Creek and Victor, Seabee and Puna. The company was founded on December 11, 1946 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: SSR Mining, Inc.是一家金屬礦業公司，資產分佈於美國、土耳其、加拿大和阿根廷四個司法管轄區，從事貴金屬資源資產的營運、收購、勘探和開發。該公司生產金礦石以及銅、銀、鉛和鋅精礦。該公司透過以下業務部門營運：Copler、Marigold、Crippler Creek 和 Victor、Seabee 和 Puna。該公司成立於 1946 年 12 月 11 日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Nordson Corp. engages in the engineering, manufacture and market of products and systems used for adhesives, coatings, sealants, biomaterials and other materials. It operates through the following segments: Industrial Precision Solutions, Medical and Fluid Solutions and Advanced Technology Solution. The Industrial Precision Solutions segment enhances the technology synergies between adhesive dispensing systems and industrial coating systems to deliver proprietary dispensing and processing technology to diverse end markets. The Medical and Fluid Solutions segment includes components and device solutions for medical, life science, high-tech industrial and other diverse end markets. The Advanced Technology Solution segment integrates proprietary product technologies found in progressive stages of a customer's production processes, such as surface treatment, precisely controlled dispensing of material and post-dispense test and inspection to ensure quality. The company was founded by Eric T. Nord, Evan W. Nord and Walter G. Nord in 1954 and is headquartered in Westlake, OH.
info.description_zh: Nordson Corp. 從事用於黏合劑、塗料、密封劑、生物材料和其他材料的產品和系統的工程、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：工業精密解決方案、醫療和流體解決方案以及先進技術解決方案。工業精密解決方案部門增強了黏合劑點膠系統和工業塗層系統之間的技術協同作用，為不同的終端市場提供專有的點膠和加工技術。醫療和流體解決方案部門包括用於醫療、生命科學、高科技工業和其他多元化終端市場的組件和設備解決方案。先進技術解決方案部門整合了客戶生產流程各個階段的專有產品技術，例如表面處理、精確控制的材料分配以及分配後測試和檢查，以確保品質。該公司由 Eric T. Nord、Evan W. Nord 和 Walter G. Nord 於 1954 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州韋斯特萊克。

info.description: Global X Thematic Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Thematic Growth Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to provide broad exposure to thematic growth strategies using a portfolio of exchange-traded funds (each, an "underlying ETF"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 主題成長 ETF 力求提供與 Solactive 主題成長指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。基礎指數旨在利用交易所交易基金（每隻「基礎 ETF」）投資組合提供對主題成長策略的廣泛投資。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Credit Suisse X-Links Gold Shares Covered Call ETN seeks to replicate, net of expenses, the Credit Suisse NASDAQ Gold FLOWSTM 103 Index. The index measures the return of a "covered call" strategy on the shares of the SPDR Gold Trust (the "GLD Shares") by reflecting changes in the price of the GLD Shares and the notional option premiums received from the sale of monthly call options on the GLD Shares less notional trading costs incurred in connection with the covered call strategy.
info.description_zh: 瑞士信貸 X-Links 黃金股備兌買權 ETN 旨在複製扣除費用後的瑞士信貸納斯達克黃金 FLOWSTM 103 指數。該指數透過反映 GLD 股票價格的變化以及出售 GLD 股票每月看漲期權收到的名義期權費減去與備兌看漲策略相關的名義交易成本，衡量 SPDR Gold Trust 股票（「GLD 股票」）的「備兌看漲」策略的回報。

info.description: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI composed of large-, mid- and small-capitalization non-U.S. equities. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization index designed to measure the combined equity market performance of developed and emerging markets countries, excluding the United States.
info.description_zh: iShares Core MSCI Total International Stock ETF 旨在追蹤由大、中、小型非美國股票組成的 MSCI ACWI ex USA IMI 的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該指數是自由流通量調整後的市值指數，旨在衡量已開發市場和新興市場國家（不包括美國）的綜合股市表現。

info.description: Cronos Group, Inc. engages in the production and distribution of cannabis. I It operates through the Canada and Israel segments. The company was founded on August 21, 2012 and is headquartered in Stayner, Canada.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Cronos Group, Inc. 從事大麻的生產和分銷。 I 它透過加拿大和以色列部門運作。該公司成立於2012年8月21日，總部位於加拿大斯塔納。

info.description: Cabana Target Drawdown 7 ETF seeks to provide long-term growth within a targeted risk parameter. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective with limited volatility and reduced correlation to the overall performance of the equity markets by allocating its assets among the following five major asset classes - equities, fixed income securities, real estate, currencies, and commodities. The Sub-Adviser's target drawdown for the fund is 7%; however, there can be no assurance, and the fund, the Adviser, and the Sub-Adviser do not represent or guarantee, that this target will be maintained.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target Drawdown 7 ETF 尋求在目標風險參數範圍內提供長期成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過將資產配置在以下五個主要資產類別（股票、固定收益證券、房地產、貨幣和大宗商品）之間，以有限的波動性並降低與股票市場整體表現的相關性來實現其投資目標。副顧問對該基金的目標提款是 7%；然而，不能保證，並且基金、顧問和副顧問也不聲明或保證這一目標將會得到維持。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Equal Weight ETF is a non-diversified, index-based strategy that provides exposure to the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market using an equal-weighted methodology. The fund offers a balanced path to the Nasdaq-100 universe by assigning an initial 1% weight to each constituent, effectively mitigating the single-stock and mega-cap concentration risk inherent in market-capitalization-weighted strategies
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ 等權重 ETF 是一種非多元化、基於指數的策略，採用等權重方法提供對納斯達克股票市場上市的 100 家最大非金融公司的投資。該基金為每個成分股分配初始 1% 的權重，為進入納斯達克 100 指數提供了一條平衡的路徑，有效降低了市值加權策略中固有的單股和大型股集中風險

info.description: OTG Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on June 12, 2025 and is headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
info.description_zh: OTG Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 12 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘花園。

info.description: Xsolla SPAC 1 is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded by Aleksandr Agapitov on September 16, 2025 and is headquartered in Sherman Oaks, CA.
info.description_zh: Xsolla SPAC 1 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業實現合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Aleksandr Agapitov 於 2025 年 9 月 16 日創立，總部位於加州謝爾曼奧克斯。

info.description: Fidelity Intermediate Municipal Income ETF is an actively managed fund that normally invests at least 80% of its assets in investment-grade municipal debt securities whose interest is exempt from federal income tax. The fund manages interest rate risk by maintaining a dollar-weighted average maturity between three and 10 years, allocating assets across different market sectors, and utilizing credit quality analysis to capture valuation opportunities.
info.description_zh: 富達中等市政收入 ETF 是一檔主動管理的基金，通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於投資等級市政債務證券，其利息免徵聯邦所得稅。該基金透過維持三年至十年之間的美元加權平均期限、在不同市場領域配置資產以及利用信用品質分析來捕捉估值機會來管理利率風險。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Ethereum 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P Ether Futures 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P Ether Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Ether futures contracts so that the total value of the Ether to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和以太坊 75/25 策略 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前複製 S&P 500 和 S&P 以太期貨 75/25 混合指數的總回報。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數權重為 75%，標普以太期貨指數權重為 25%。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於以太坊期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險敞口的以太幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: Northern Trust Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE All Maturity Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust免稅債券ETF尋求與ICE全到期市政債券指數（未計費用和開支）的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的結果。基礎指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V is a blank check company incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V 是一家空白支票公司，其註冊目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Relative Sentiment Tactical Allocation ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund's investment strategy is to seek to grow capital by tactically investing in other ETFs that invest in equities, bonds, commodities, currencies, and gold based on "relative sentiment" factors. The fund's portfolio will be tactically allocated among passively-managed U.S. and foreign, developed market, equity ETFs, bond ETFs, and, in some instances, gold exchange-traded products (ETPs), commodities ETPs, and currency ETPs. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 相對情緒戰術配置ETF尋求長期資本增值。該基金的投資策略是透過戰術性投資於其他基於「相對情緒」因素投資於股票、債券、大宗商品、貨幣和黃金的ETF來尋求資本成長。該基金的投資組合將在戰術上分配給被動管理的美國和外國已開發市場、股票ETF、債券ETF，以及在某些情況下的黃金交易所交易產品(ETP)、商品ETP和貨幣ETP。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: J.W. Mays, Inc. engages in the operation of commercial real estate properties. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Brooklyn, NY.
info.description_zh: J.W. Mays, Inc. 從事商業房地產的營運。該公司成立於 1924 年，總部位於紐約布魯克林。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SPY ETF seeks current income; the fund's secondary investment objective being exposure to the performance of the Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X Shares (NYSE ARCA: SPXL) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for an indirect exposure to the share price of the Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X Shares, subject to a limit on potential gains from increases in the price of the underlying ETF's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SPY ETF 尋求當前收入；該基金的次要投資目標是接觸 Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X 股票（NYSE ARCA：SPXL）的表現，但潛在投資收益受到限制。該基金是主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前收入，同時保持間接接觸 Direxion Daily S&P500 Bull 3X 股票價格的機會，但受到標的 ETF 股票價格上漲的潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. is a premier global media and entertainment company, which engages in the provision of a differentiated portfolio of content, brands, and franchises across television, film, streaming, and gaming. It operates through the following segments: Studios, Networks, Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), and Corporate. The Studios segment includes producing and releasing feature films for initial exhibition in theaters, producing and initial licensing television programs to networks services as well as third parties, distributing films and television programs to various third party, internal television, and streaming services, distribution through the home entertainment market related consumer products, and themed experience licensing and interactive gaming. The Networks segment focuses on domestic and international television networks. The DTC segment is involved in premium pay-television and streaming services. The company was founded on June 17, 1985 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 華納兄弟探索公司 (Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc.) 是一家全球領先的媒體和娛樂公司，致力於提供跨電視、電影、串流媒體和遊戲的差異化內容、品牌和特許經營權組合。它透過以下部門運作：工作室、網路、直接面向消費者 (DTC) 和企業。製片廠部門包括製作和發行用於在劇院首次放映的長片，向網路服務和第三方製作和初始授權電視節目，向各種第三方、內部電視和串流媒體服務分發電影和電視節目，透過家庭娛樂市場相關消費產品進行分發，以及主題體驗授權和互動遊戲。網路部門專注於國內和國際電視網絡。 DTC 部門涉及優質付費電視和串流媒體服務。該公司成立於1985年6月17日，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Activate Energy Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company, which engages for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on June 10, 2025 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Activate Energy Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司經營，其目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月10日，總部位於開曼群島喬治敦。

info.description: Aldel Financial II, Inc. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on July 15, 2024 and is headquartered in Itasca, IL.
info.description_zh: Aldel Financial II, Inc. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現合併、合併、股份交換、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 7 月 15 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州伊塔斯卡。

info.description: Alector, Inc. operates as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which engages in pioneering of immuno-neurology. It develops portfolio of innate immune system programs, designed to functionally repair genetic mutations and enable the rejuvenated immune cells to counteract emerging brain pathologies. Its treatment targets immune dysfunction as a root cause of multiple pathologies that are drivers of degenerative brain disorders. The company was founded by Asa Abeliovich, Errik B. Anderson, Tillman U. Gerngross, and Arnon Rosenthal in May 2013 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Alector, Inc. 是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，致力於免疫神經學領域的開拓。它開發了一系列先天免疫系統項目，旨在功能性修復基因突變，並使免疫細胞恢復活力，以對抗新出現的大腦病變。其治療目標是免疫功能障礙，這是多種病理學的根本原因，而這些病理學是退化性腦部疾病的驅動因素。該公司由 Asa Abeliovich、Errik B. Anderson、Tillman U. Gerngross 和 Arnon Rosenthal 於 2013 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Arqit Quantum, Inc. engages in the provision of cybersecurity services via satellite and terrestrial forms. Its product is QuantumCloud which secures devices with cloud-based quantum encryption. The company was founded by David John Williams and David James Bestwick on April 26, 2021 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
info.description_zh: Arqit Quantum, Inc. 致力於透過衛星和地面形式提供網路安全服務。其產品是 QuantumCloud，它透過基於雲端的量子加密來保護設備。該公司由 David John Williams 和 David James Bestwick 於 2021 年 4 月 26 日創立，總部位於英國倫敦。

info.description: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. engages in the provision of conversational artificial intelligence assistants with the purpose of transforming engagement and analytics for businesses through security-focused, multimodal communication and human-like artificial intelligence assistants. The firm is also involved in delivering highly personalized, multi-modal artificial intelligence engagement with a focus on industries where there is a massive workforce gap and an opportunity to transform how consumers engage with networks, providers, and brands. The company is founded by Tyler J. Luck, Michael Lucas, Patrick Nunally & Hanseok Ko on March 14, 2024 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
info.description_zh: Brand Engagement Network, Inc. 致力於提供對話式人工智慧助手，旨在透過以安全為中心的多模式通訊和類人人工智慧助理來改變企業的參與和分析。該公司也致力於提供高度個人化、多模式的人工智慧參與，重點關注勞動力缺口巨大的產業，並有機會改變消費者與網路、供應商和品牌的互動方式。該公司由 Tyler J. Luck、Michael Lucas、Patrick Nunally 和 Hanseok Ko 於 2024 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於特拉華州威爾明頓。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares Municipal Bond 2028 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade municipal bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities," in the year 2028 (collectively, "2028 Bonds").
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares (R) 2028 市政債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 市政債券 2028 指數的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量 2028 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級市政債券（在某些情況下為「有效到期日」）投資組合的表現（統稱為「2028 年債券」）。

info.description: Capstone Holding Corp. is a growing platform of building products companies, focused on serving residential and commercial construction markets across the United States. Its current portfolio includes Instone, a national wholesale distributor of thin veneer stone and related masonry products. With over 30 years of operating history, Instone has established itself as the largest player in its category, offering a comprehensive range of manufactured and natural stone solutions. The company was founded on July 30, 1987 and is headquartered in Alsip, IL.
info.description_zh: Capstone Holding Corp. 是一家不斷發展的建築產品公司平台，專注於為美國各地的住宅和商業建築市場提供服務。其目前的產品組合包括 Instone，一家薄飾面石材及相關磚石產品的全國批發經銷商。 Instone 擁有 30 多年的經營歷史，已成為該類別中最大的參與者，提供全面的人造石和天然石材解決方案。該公司成立於 1987 年 7 月 30 日，總部位於伊利諾伊州阿爾西普。

info.description: Collective Mining Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in South America. It holds interests in San Antonio and Guayabales projects. The company was founded on February 21, 2018 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Collective Mining Ltd. 從事南美洲礦產的收購、勘探和開發業務。它擁有聖安東尼奧和瓜亞巴萊斯項目的權益。該公司成立於2018年2月21日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd. engages in the development and operation of seawater desalination plants and water distribution systems. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Bulk, Services, Manufacturing, and Corporate. The Retail segment operates the water utility for the Seven Mile Beach and West Bay areas of Grand Cayman Islands. The Bulk segment supplies potable water to government utilities in Grand Cayman and the Bahamas. The Services segment designs, constructs, and sells water infrastructure, and provides management and operating services to third parties. The Manufacturing segment focuses on the manufacture and service of custom and specialized water-related products applicable to commercial, municipal and industrial water production, supply, and treatment. The Corporate segment consists of various expenses of general and administrative nature to the firm. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.
info.description_zh: Consolidated Water Co. Ltd.從事海水淡化廠和配水系統的開發和營運。它透過以下部門運作：零售部門、散貨部門、服務部門、製造部門和企業部門。零售部門經營大開曼群島七英里海灘和西灣地區的自來水公司。散裝部門向大開曼島和巴哈馬的政府公用事業供應飲用水。服務部門設計、建造和銷售水基礎設施，並向第三方提供管理和營運服務。製造部門專注於適用於商業、市政和工業水生產、供應和處理的客製化和專業水相關產品的製造和服務。公司部門包括公司的各種一般性和行政性費用。該公司成立於1973年，總部位於開曼群島喬治城。

info.description: Liberty Defense Holdings Ltd. engages in the commercialization of an active 3D imaging technology system, HEXWAVE, to detect concealed threats. The firm is also involved in providing multi-technology security solutions for concealed weapons detection in high volume foot traffic areas and locations requiring enhanced security such as airports, stadiums, and schools. It operates through the following business segments: Corporate, HEXWAVE and Contract. The company was founded on June 8, 2012 and is headquartered in Wilmington, MA.
info.description_zh: Liberty Defense Holdings Ltd. 致力於主動 3D 成像技術系統 HEXWAVE 的商業化，以偵測隱藏的威脅。該公司還提供多技術安全解決方案，用於高人流區域和需要增強安全性的地點（例如機場、體育場和學校）的隱藏武器檢測。它透過以下業務部門運作：企業部門、HEXWAVE 部門和合約部門。該公司成立於2012年6月8日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州威爾明頓。

info.description: Dominari Holdings, Inc. engages in wealth management, investment banking, sales and trading, and asset management through its subsidiaries. It operates through the Dominari Financial and Legacy AIkido business segments. The Dominari Financial segment represents the company's broker-dealer business, which is composed of mostly underwriting and transactional service activities. The Legacy AIkido segment includes Aikido Labs, which manages the investments holdings of the legacy entity. The company was founded by Gilbert V. Levin and M. Karen Levin in 1967 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Dominari Holdings, Inc.透過其子公司從事財富管理、投資銀行、銷售和交易以及資產管理業務。它透過 Dominari Financial 和 Legacy AIkido 業務部門運作。 Dominari Financial 部門代表該公司的經紀自營商業務，主要由承銷和交易服務活動組成。傳統合氣道部門包括合氣道實驗室，該實驗室管理傳統實體的投資控股。該公司由 Gilbert V. Levin 和 M. Karen Levin 於 1967 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Design Therapeutics, Inc. operates as a biotechnology company that develops therapies for serious degenerative disorders. It is created to design, develop and commercialize a novel class of small molecule therapeutic candidates (GeneTACs) designed to directly address the underlying basis of genetic disease. The company was founded by Pratik Shah and Aseem Z. Ansari on December 18, 2017 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, CA.
info.description_zh: Design Therapeutics, Inc. 是一家生技公司，開發嚴重退化性疾病的療法。它的創建是為了設計、開發和商業化一類新型小分子候選治療藥物 (GeneTAC)，旨在直接解決遺傳疾病的根本問題。該公司由 Pratik Shah 和 Asem Z. Ansari 於 2017 年 12 月 18 日創立，總部位於加州卡爾斯巴德。

info.description: GigaMedia Ltd. is engaged in the provision of digital entertainment services. Through its subsidiary, FunTown, it manages mobile and browse-based casual games. Its portfolio includes MahJong, online card games, and multi-player role-playing online games. The company was founded in October 1998 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: GigaMedia Ltd. 從事提供數位娛樂服務。它透過其子公司 FunTown 管理行動和基於瀏覽的休閒遊戲。其產品包括麻將、線上紙牌遊戲和多人角色扮演線上遊戲。公司成立於1998年10月，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of information and communication technology services. Its solutions include ICT solution services, technical services, and project management services. The company was founded by Yat Lung Lee on May 3, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Global Engine Group Holding Ltd. 從事提供資訊和通訊技術服務。其解決方案包括ICT解決方案服務、技術服務和專案管理服務。該公司由李逸龍於2018年5月3日創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd. is a holding company which provides payroll outsourcing services. It also offers employment, consultancy and market research services. The outsourcing services assist its end-users in calculating employees' salaries and the required employer's contributions to social security and housing provident funds as well as individual income tax and any other deductions. The employment services act as the employers of record to employ suitable candidates, who are sourced by their end-users. The consultancy and market research services provides consultation for local policy and delivery of country profile reports. The company was founded by Wai Hong Lao, Yiu Kong But, and Wai Cheung Yeung in April 2013 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Payroll Group Ltd.是一家提供薪資外包服務的控股公司。它還提供就業、諮詢和市場研究服務。外包服務協助最終用戶計算員工薪資、雇主所需繳納的社會安全和住房公積金以及個人所得稅和任何其他扣除項目。就業服務機構作為記錄雇主來僱用合適的候選人，這些候選人是由其最終用戶尋找的。諮詢和市場研究服務為當地政策提供諮詢並提供國家概況報告。該公司由Wai Hong Lao、Yiu Kong But和Wai Cheung Yeung於2013年4月創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: GRI Bio, Inc. engages in the development and commercialization of therapies for inflammatory, fibrotic, and autoimmune diseases. It focuses on its lead program, GRI-0621, an inhibitor of type 1 invariant Natural Killer T (iNKT) cell activity and is being developed as a novel oral therapeutic for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded in May 2009 and is headquartered in La Jolla, CA.
info.description_zh: GRI Bio, Inc. 從事發炎、纖維化和自體免疫疾病療法的開發和商業化。該公司專注於其主導項目 GRI-0621，這是一種 1 型不變自然殺手 T (iNKT) 細胞活性抑制劑，正在開發為治療特發性肺纖維化的新型口服療法。該公司成立於 2009 年 5 月，總部位於加州拉霍亞。

info.description: HF Foods Group, Inc. engages in the marketing and distribution of fresh produce, frozen and dry food, and non-food products to primarily independently operated Asian restaurants and other foodservice customers. The company leverages its network of distribution centers covering the United States, and partners with domestic and international suppliers to offer fresh, specialty restaurant food products to supply the demand for Asian American cuisine. HF Foods was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Las Vegas, NV.
info.description_zh: HF Foods Group, Inc. 致力於向主要獨立經營的亞洲餐廳和其他餐飲服務客戶行銷和分銷新鮮農產品、冷凍食品、乾燥食品以及非食品產品。該公司利用其覆蓋美國的配送中心網絡，並與國內和國際供應商合作，提供新鮮、特色的餐廳食品，以滿足對亞裔美式菜餚的需求。 HF Foods 成立於 1997 年，總部位於內華達州拉斯維加斯。

info.description: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. operates as a tanker pool company. It is engaged primarily in the commercial management and chartering of crude oil and refined petroleum product tankers. The company was founded on May 7, 2024 and is headquartered in Piraeus, Greece.
info.description_zh: Heidmar Maritime Holdings Corp. 是一家油輪聯營公司。它主要從事原油和成品油油輪的商業管理和租賃。該公司成立於2024年5月7日，總部位於希臘比雷埃夫斯。

info.description: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Matthew Kiernan and Andrew McLean on April 7, 2025 and is headquartered in Camas, WA.
info.description_zh: Invest Green Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Matthew Kiernan 和 Andrew McLean 於 2025 年 4 月 7 日創立，總部位於華盛頓州卡馬斯。

info.description: Katapult Holdings, Inc. is an e-commerce focused financial technology company. The firm is engaged in the provision of e-commerce point-of-sale lease-purchase options for nonprime U.S. consumers. It offers its customers a lease purchase transaction processing system with no long-term obligation and options for ownership. The company was founded in August 2019 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Katapult Holdings, Inc. 是一家專注於電子商務的金融科技公司。該公司致力於為美國非優質消費者提供電子商務銷售點租賃購買選擇。它為客戶提供租賃購買交易處理系統，沒有長期義務和所有權選擇。該公司成立於 2019 年 8 月，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 6, 2026 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Mountain Crest Acquisition 6 Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2026年1月6日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Medalist Diversified, Inc. engages in the acquisition, reposition, renovation, lease, and management of income-producing properties. It focuses on commercial properties, including flex-industrial and retail properties, multi-family residential properties, and limited-service hotel properties. It operates through the following segments: Retail Center Properties, Flex Center Property and STNL Properties. The Retail Center Properties segment consists of the Shops at Franklin Square, the Ashley Plaza Shopping Center, the Lancer Center, and the Salisbury Marketplace Shopping Center. The Flex Center Property segment consists of Brookfield Center, the Greenbrier Business Center, and the Parkway property. The STNL Properties segment consists of the Citibank property, an outparcel at its Salisbury Marketplace property, and the Hanover Square outparcel. The company was founded on September 28, 2015 and is headquartered in Richmond, VA.
info.description_zh: Medalist Diversified, Inc. 從事創收財產的收購、重新定位、翻新、租賃和管理。它專注於商業房地產，包括靈活工業和零售房地產、多戶住宅房地產和有限服務酒店房地產。該公司透過以下部門營運：Retail Center Properties、Flex Center Property 和 STNL Properties。零售中心地產部門包括富蘭克林廣場商店、阿什利廣場購物中心、蘭瑟中心和索爾茲伯里市場購物中心。 Flex Center 物業部分包括 Brookfield Center、Greenbrier Business Center 和 Parkway 物業。 STNL 地產部門包括花旗銀行地產、索爾茲伯里市場地產和漢諾威廣場地產。該公司成立於2015年9月28日，總部位於維吉尼亞州里士滿。
