info.description: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. is multi-platform media company, which engages in the operation of radio stations in the United States. The firm offers marketing solutions across event platforms. It operates through the following business segments: Audio, Digital, and Other. The company was founded by George G. Beasley in 1961 and is headquartered in Naples, FL.
info.description_zh: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc.是一家多媒體平台公司，在美國從事廣播電台的營運。該公司提供跨活動平台的營銷解決方案。它透過以下業務部門運作：音訊、數位和其他。該公司由 George G. Beasley 於 1961 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州那不勒斯。

info.description: TNL Mediagene engages in digital advertising, integrated marketing, marketing survey, artificial intelligence technology, data analysis, content service platform, and production of audio-visual programs. It operates media, technology, and digital studio businesses primarily in Japan and Taiwan. The company was founded on May 25, 2023 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: TNL Mediagene 從事數位廣告、整合行銷、行銷調查、人工智慧技術、數據分析、內容服務平台和視聽節目製作。該公司主要在日本和台灣經營媒體、科技和數位工作室業務。該公司成立於2023年5月25日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: YSX Tech. Co. Ltd. engages in providing comprehensive business solutions to enterprise customers, mainly insurance companies and brokerages in China. Its service includes electronic engineering, PCB fabrication, SMT and PCB assembly, components sourcing, prototyping, box build, turn-key solution and other value-added services for a broad range of companies with regard to telecommunication, consumptive electronics, industrial test and control, medical equipment, power supply, security, vehicle and more. It operates through the following segments: Auto Insurance Aftermarket Value-added Services, Other Scenario-based Customized Service, and Software Development and Information Technology Services. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 永興科技.有限公司致力於為企業客戶（主要是中國的保險公司和經紀公司）提供全面的業務解決方案。其服務包括電子工程、PCB製造、SMT和PCB組裝、元件採購、原型設計、整機組裝、交鑰匙解決方案和其他加值服務，為電信、消費性電子、工業測試和控制、醫療設備、電源、安全、車輛等領域的廣泛公司提供服務。其業務板塊包括：車險後市場加值服務、其他場景客製化服務、軟體開發與資訊科技服務。公司成立於2004年，總部位於中國廣州。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOUN ETF seeks daily leveraged investment results of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of SoundHound AI, Inc. The fund is an actively managed ETF that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the Underlying Security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund aims to achieve this daily percentage change for a single day, and not for any other period. A "single day" means the period "from the close of regular trading on one trading day to the close on the next trading day." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long SOUN ETF 尋求 SoundHound AI, Inc. 股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日槓桿投資結果。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，試圖透過利用衍生性商品，即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約，實現基礎證券股價每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的結果。該基金的目標是在一天內實現這一每日百分比變化，而不是在任何其他時期。 「單日」指「由交易日常規交易收盤至下一交易日收盤止」的期間。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long AAL Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of AAL. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of AAL, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 AAL 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 AAL 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 200% 的 AAL 價格每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: TryHard Holdings Ltd. is a lifestyle entertainment company that operates in Japan offering a diverse range of services across the entertainment and hospitality sectors. It operates through the following business segments: Consultancy and management, Event curation, Sub-leasing and Restaurants. The Consultancy and management segment provides expert services to clubs, including operations, event management, and strategic support to enhance performance and engagement. The Event curation segment organize and produce own events, also provides a full suite of services, including event planning, construction, entertainment booking, event operation, and ticket sales. The Sub-Leasing segment acts as an intermediary between landlords and clubs. The Restaurants segment operates several restaurants. The company was founded on October 16, 2013 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
info.description_zh: TryHard Holdings Ltd. 是一家在日本營運的生活風格娛樂公司，在娛樂和酒店業提供多種服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：諮詢和管理、活動策劃、分租和餐廳。諮詢和管理部門為俱樂部提供專家服務，包括營運、活動管理和策略支持，以提高績效和參與。活動策展部門組織和製作自己的活動，並提供全套服務，包括活動策劃、施工、娛樂預訂、活動運營和門票銷售。轉租部門充當房東和俱樂部之間的中介。餐廳部門經營多家餐廳。公司成立於2013年10月16日，總部位於日本大阪。

info.description: Kustom Entertainment, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of digital audio, video recording, and speed detection devices. It operates through the following segments: Video Solutions, Revenue Cycle Management, and Entertainment. The Video Solutions segment includes video recording products and services for law enforcement and commercial customers and the sale of Shield disinfectant and personal protective products. The Revenue Cycle Management Segment consists of medical billing subsidiaries. The Entertainment segment focuses on ticketing services provided through TicketSmarter and its online platform, TicketSmarter.com. The company was founded on December 13, 2000 and is headquartered in Overland Park, KS.
info.description_zh: Kustom Entertainment, Inc. 從事數位音訊、錄影和速度檢測設備的設計、製造和銷售。它透過以下部門運作：視訊解決方案部門、收入週期管理部門和娛樂部門。視訊解決方案部門包括為執法和商業客戶提供錄影產品和服務，以及銷售 Shield 消毒劑和個人防護產品。收入周期管理部門由醫療計費子公司組成。娛樂部門專注於透過 TicketSmarter 及其線上平台 TicketSmarter.com 提供的票務服務。該公司成立於2000年12月13日，總部位於堪薩斯州歐弗蘭帕克。

info.description: Huize Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of insurance brokerage services through its online platform. It distributes insurance products underwritten by insurer partners and helps them to reach a large number of insurance clients. The company was founded by Cun Jun Ma in August 2006 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: 匯澤控股有限公司透過其線上平台提供保險經紀服務。它分銷由保險公司合作夥伴承保的保險產品，並幫助他們接觸大量的保險客戶。該公司由馬存軍於2006年8月創立，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd. is a holding company. It engages in the business of processing, selling, and distributing cured meat products including cured pork sausages, cured pork meat, and other cured meat products such as cured chicken, cured duck, and cured fish; snack products including ready-to-eat sausages, jerky, duck necks, duck feet, and clay pot rice; and frozen meat products including frozen sausages, frozen beef patties, and frozen chicken breast fillets. The company was founded on April 24, 2015 and is headquartered in Zhongshan, China.
info.description_zh: 永業食品控股集團有限公司是一家控股公司。從事醃製肉製品的加工、銷售和分銷業務，包括醃製豬肉香腸、醃製豬肉以及醃製雞、醃鴨、醃魚等其他醃製肉製品；即食香腸、肉乾、鴨脖、鴨腳、煲仔飯等休閒食品；以及冷凍肉類製品，包括冷凍香腸、冷凍牛肉餅和冷凍雞胸肉片。公司成立於2015年4月24日，總部位於中國中山。

info.description: Quanome Technologies, Inc. engages in providing cross-border supply chain solutions. It operates through the Cross-border Freight Solutions and Pharmaceutical Distribution segments. The company was founded by Henry Liu and Shuai Li in February 2018 and is headquartered in Itasca, IL.
info.description_zh: Quanome Technologies, Inc. 致力於提供跨境供應鏈解決方案。它透過跨境貨運解決方案和藥品分銷部門運作。該公司由 Henry Liu 和 Shuai Li 於 2018 年 2 月創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州艾塔斯卡。

info.description: W.F Holding Ltd. engages in the manufacture of fiberglass reinforced plastic and FRP products. It sells a range of FRP products, including filament wound and molded tanks, thermoplastic tanks, lining products, ducting and fitting products, air pollution control equipment, and custom-made products. The firm also offer delivery, installation and repair, maintenance services, and on-site consultation services. The company was founded on March 7, 2023 and is headquartered in Shah Alam, Malaysia.
info.description_zh: W.F Holding Ltd. 從事玻璃纖維增強塑膠和玻璃鋼製品的製造。該公司銷售一系列玻璃鋼產品，包括纖維纏繞和模壓儲罐、熱塑性儲罐、襯裡產品、管道和配件產品、空氣污染控制設備和客製化產品。該公司還提供送貨、安裝和維修、維護服務以及現場諮詢服務。該公司成立於2023年3月7日，總部位於馬來西亞莎阿南。

info.description: MasterBeef Group is an investment holding company. It established multiple brands, namely Anping Grill, Chubby Bento, Chubby Noodles and Bao Pot, diversifying its operations into Taiwanese grill, Taiwanese bento and Taiwanese noodles. The company was founded by Oi Wai Chau, Oi Yee Chau, Tsz Kiu So, Ka Chun Lam and Shing Yan Lee in 2019 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: MasterBeef集團是一家投資控股公司。成立安平扒房、小胖便當、小胖麵、包鍋等多個品牌，業務多元化至台灣燒烤、台灣便當及台灣麵條。該公司由Oi Wai Chau、Oi Yee Chau、Tsz Kiu So、Ka Chun Lam和Shing Yan Lee於2019年創立，總部位於香港。

info.description: Jinxin Technology Holding Co. engages in the provision of digital content services. It focuses on providing digital and integrated educational content. The company was founded by Jin Xu in 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 金鑫科技控股有限公司從事提供數位內容服務。它專注於提供數位和整合的教育內容。該公司由金旭於2014年創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Yunji, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of social e-commerce platforms. It offers Yunji App, a combination of Yunji VIP App and Yunji Flagship App. It also provides solutions and services that allow suppliers to benefit from the firm's scale of operations and marketing capabilities. The company was founded by Shang Lue Xiao in May 2015 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 雲集有限公司是一家控股公司，從事提供社交電子商務平台業務。它提供雲集App，雲集VIP應用程式和雲集旗艦應用程式的組合。它還提供解決方案和服務，使供應商能夠從公司的營運規模和行銷能力中受益。該公司由尚略肖於2015年5月創立，總部位於中國杭州。

info.description: Socket Mobile, Inc. is a mobile data capture company, which engages in the provision of data capture and delivery solutions for enhanced productivity in workforce mobilization. Its products are incorporated into mobile applications used in point of sale (POS), commercial services (field workers), asset tracking, manufacturing process and quality control, transportation and logistics (goods tracking and movement), event management (ticketing, entry, access control, and identification), medical and education. The company's primary products are cordless data capture devices incorporating barcode scanning or RFID/Near Field Communications (NFC) technologies that connect over Bluetooth. All products work with applications running on smartphones, mobile computers and tablets using operating systems from Apple (iOS), Google (Android), and Microsoft (Windows). It also offers an easy-to-use software developer kit (Capture SDK) to application developers, which enables them to provide their users with advanced barcode scanning and RFID/NFC features. The firm's products are integrated in their application solutions and are marketed by the application developers or the resellers of their applications and number of registered developers for data capture applications continues to grow. The company was founded by Michael L. Gifford and Charlie Bass in March 1992 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Socket Mobile, Inc. 是一家行動數據採集公司，致力於提供數據採集和交付解決方案，以提高勞動力動員的生產力。其產品被納入銷售點 (POS)、商業服務（現場工作人員）、資產追蹤、製造過程和品質控制、運輸和物流（貨物追蹤和移動）、活動管理（票務、進入、存取控制和識別）、醫療和教育等領域使用的行動應用程式。該公司的主要產品是採用條碼掃描或透過藍牙連接的 RFID/近場通訊 (NFC) 技術的無線資料擷取設備。所有產品均可與使用 Apple (iOS)、Google (Android) 和 Microsoft (Windows) 作業系統的智慧型手機、行動電腦和平板電腦上執行的應用程式搭配使用。它還為應用程式開發人員提供易於使用的軟體開發工具包（Capture SDK），使他們能夠為用戶提供先進的條碼掃描和 RFID/NFC 功能。該公司的產品整合在他們的應用程式解決方案中，並由應用程式開發人員或其應用程式經銷商進行行銷，並且資料擷取應用程式的註冊開發人員數量持續增長。該公司由 Michael L. Gifford 和 Charlie Bass 於 1992 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: ClearOne, Inc. engages in the design, development, and marketing of professional audio conferencing, microphone, and video collaboration solutions. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, UT.
info.description_zh: ClearOne, Inc. 從事專業音訊會議、麥克風和視訊協作解決方案的設計、開發和行銷。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於猶他州鹽湖城。

info.description: YXT.COM Group Holding Ltd. engages in the provision of digital learning platforms. It integrates software and content through its SaaS model to assist customers in corporate learning. The company was founded by Xiao Yan Lu, Teng Zu and Jie Ding in November 2011 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
info.description_zh: YXT.COM Group Holding Ltd.從事提供數位學習平台業務。它透過SaaS模式整合軟體和內容，協助客戶進行企業學習。該公司由陸曉燕、騰祖和丁傑於2011年11月創立，總部位於中國蘇州。

info.description: Zai Lab Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the developing and commercializing therapies that address medical conditions with unmet needs in oncology, autoimmune disorders, infectious diseases, and neuroscience. Its products include Zejula, Optune, Qinlock, and Nuzyra. The company was founded by Samantha Ying Du and Marietta Wu in April 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
info.description_zh: 再鼎醫藥 (Zai Lab Ltd.) 是一家生物製藥公司，致力於開發和商業化療法，解決腫瘤學、自體免疫疾病、傳染病和神經科學領域未滿足需求的醫療狀況。其產品包括 Zejula、Optune、Qinlock 和 Nuzyra。該公司由杜英和吳瑪麗於2014年4月創立，總部位於中國上海。

info.description: Power Solutions International, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and trade of power systems and electrical power generation equipment. The firm provides integrated turnkey solutions to global original equipment manufacturers and end-user customers within the energy, industrial, and transportation end markets. The company was founded by Gary S. Winemaster, Kenneth J. Winemaster, and William Winemaster in February 1985 and is headquartered in Wood Dale, IL.
info.description_zh: Power Solutions International, Inc. 從事電力系統和發電設備的設計、製造和貿易。該公司為能源、工業和運輸終端市場的全球原始設備製造商和最終用戶客戶提供整合的交鑰匙解決方案。該公司由 Gary S. Winemaster、Kenneth J. Winemaster 和 William Winemaster 於 1985 年 2 月創立，總部位於伊利諾伊州伍德戴爾。

info.description: Aeva Technologies, Inc. develops sensing paradigm for autonomous vehicles and robotics. The firm offers drones, robotics, vehicle technology, and virtual and augmented reality products. The company was founded by Soroush Salehian Dardashti and Mina Rezk in 2017 and is headquartered in Mountain View, CA.
info.description_zh: Aeva Technologies, Inc. 為自動駕駛車輛和機器人開發感測範例。該公司提供無人機、機器人、車輛技術以及虛擬和擴增實境產品。該公司由 Soroush Salehian Dardashti 和 Mina Rezk 於 2017 年創立，總部位於加州山景城。

info.description: Magnite, Inc. provides a technology solution to automate the purchase and sale of digital advertising inventory for buyers and sellers. It features applications and services for digital advertising sellers including websites, mobile applications, and other digital media properties. The company was founded by Frank Addante, Duc Chau, Craig Roah, Julie Mattern and Brian D. Baumgart on April 20, 2007 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Magnite, Inc. 提供了一種技術解決方案，可為買家和賣家自動購買和銷售數位廣告庫存。它為數位廣告銷售商提供應用程式和服務，包括網站、行動應用程式和其他數位媒體資產。該公司由 Frank Addante、Duc Chau、Craig Roah、Julie Mattern 和 Brian D. Baumgart 於 2007 年 4 月 20 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Ceribell, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical technology company, which engages in the provision of transforming the diagnosis and management of patients with serious neurological conditions. Its products include Point-of-Care EEG, which enables early detection and management of suspected seizure patients, promoting precise patient care and hospital-wide efficiencies, Clarity, an AI algorithm that interprets EEG in real-time, providing bedside alerts and continuous monitoring for status epilepticus, and EEG Portal, which makes it easy to remotely review EEG in real-time with pre-annotated EEG insights. The company was founded by Xing Juan Chao, Josef Parvizi, and Chris Chafe on August 29, 2014 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: Ceribell, Inc. 是一家商業階段的醫療技術公司，致力於改變嚴重神經系統疾病患者的診斷和管理。其產品包括床邊腦電圖（Point-of-Care EEG），它能夠早期發現和管理疑似癲癇患者，促進精確的患者護理和全院效率；Clarity，一種實時解釋腦電圖的人工智能演算法，提供床邊警報和持續監測癲癇持續狀態；以及腦電圖門戶（EEG Portal），它可以通過預先註釋的腦電圖。該公司由 Xing Juan Chao、Josef Parvizi 和 Chris Chafe 於 2014 年 8 月 29 日創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: Newmont Corp. engages in the exploration and acquisition of gold properties, containing copper, silver, lead, zinc or other metals. It operates through the following geographical segments: Canada, Mexico, Suriname, Argentina, Peru, Australia, Papua New Guinea, Ghana, and U.S. The company was founded by William Boyce Thompson on May 2, 1921 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: 紐蒙特公司從事黃金礦產的勘探和收購，其中含有銅、銀、鉛、鋅或其他金屬。該公司在以下地理區域開展業務：加拿大、墨西哥、蘇利南、阿根廷、秘魯、澳洲、巴布亞紐幾內亞、迦納和美國。該公司由 William Boyce Thompson 於 1921 年 5 月 2 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛。

info.description: BUUU Group Ltd. is a holding company, which operates through its subsidiaries, BU Creation and BU Workshop. Its subsidiaries engage in design, planning and production of face-to-face events, immersive environments and brand-based experiences for clients and venues, including event organizers, consumer brand marketers and retail shopping centers. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: BUUU Group Ltd. 是一家控股公司，透過其子公司 BU Creation 和 BU Workshop 營運。其子公司為客戶和場所（包括活動組織者、消費品牌行銷商和零售購物中心）設計、規劃和製作面對面活動、沉浸式環境和基於品牌的體驗。該公司成立於2017年，總部位於香港。

info.description: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF is a non-diversified exchange-traded fund that provides targeted, "pure-play" exposure to the global rare earths industry while specifically excluding companies domiciled in or primarily operating within China. The fund tracks an index of companies involved in the mining, separation, refining, and production of rare earth elements (REEs), catering to investors seeking to capitalize on the geopolitical realignment of critical material supply chains.
info.description_zh: Sprott Rare Earths Ex-China ETF 是一款非多元化交易所交易基金，提供針對全球稀土行業的有針對性的「純粹」投資，同時明確排除在中國註冊或主要在中國運營的公司。該基金追蹤參與稀土元素 (REE) 開採、分離、精煉和生產的公司指數，迎合尋求利用關鍵材料供應鏈地緣政治重組的投資者。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PANW Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of PANW. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PANW 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PANW 普通股價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具組合起來可提供 PANW 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與該基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of PANW. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of PANW and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to PANW, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily PANW Bull 2X Shares 尋求 PANW 每日業績的 200% 的每日投資表現（扣除費用和開支）。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 PANW 證券以及掉期協議和期權等金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來為 PANW 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly inhibit tumors to treat specific types of cancer and other diseases. Its pipeline includes Varlilumab, CDX-1140, and CDX-301, and CDX-3379. The company was founded by Anthony S. Marucci and Tibor Keler in 1983 and is headquartered in Hampton, NJ.
info.description_zh: Celldex Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the business of development, manufacturing and commercialization of novel therapeutics for human health care. Its drug candidates have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in speccess have the ability to engage the human immune system and directly in species soo diseases.其管道包括 Varlilumab、CDX-1140、CDX-301 和 CDX-3379。该公司由 Anthony S. Marucci 和 Tibor Keler 于 1983 年创立，总部位于新泽西州汉普顿。

info.description: Actively managed ETF seeking capital appreciation through exposure to SpaceX and companies participating in the broader space economy.
info.description_zh: 積極管理的 ETF 透過投資 SpaceX 和參與更廣泛的太空經濟的公司尋求資本增值。

info.description: Aehr Test Systems engages in the design, manufacture, market, and sale of test and burn-in equipment used in the semiconductor industry. Its products include FOX-XP, FOX-NP, and FOX-CP wafer contact parallel test and burn-in systems, the WaferPak full wafer contactor, the DiePak Carrier, the WaferPak Aligner, the DiePak Autoloader, and test fixtures. The company was founded by Rhea J. Posedel on May 25, 1977 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Aehr Test Systems 從事半導體行業使用的測試和老化設備的設計、製造、行銷和銷售。其產品包括FOX-XP、FOX-NP和FOX-CP晶圓接觸並行測試和老化系統、WaferPak全晶圓接觸器、DiePak Carrier、WaferPak Aligner、DiePak Autoloader和測試夾具。該公司由 Rhea J. Posedel 於 1977 年 5 月 25 日創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Kestra Medical Technologies Ltd. is a commercial-stage, wearable medical device and digital healthcare company. It focused on transforming patient outcomes in cardiovascular disease using monitoring and therapeutic intervention technologies that are intuitive, intelligent, and connected. The company was founded by Brian Webster and Traci S. Umberger in 2014 and is headquartered in Kirkland, WA.
info.description_zh: Kestra Medical Technologies Ltd. 是一家商業階段的可穿戴醫療設備和數位醫療保健公司。它專注於利用直觀、智慧和互聯的監測和治療幹預技術來改變心血管疾病患者的治療結果。該公司由 Brian Webster 和 Traci S. Umberger 於 2014 年創立，總部位於華盛頓州柯克蘭。

info.description: Global X Disruptive Materials ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Disruptive Materials Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies that produce metals and other raw or composite materials that have been identified as being essential to disruptive technologies such as lithium batteries, solar panels, wind turbines, fuel cells, robotics, and 3D printers. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 顛覆性材料 ETF 尋求與 Solactive 顛覆性材料指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於該指數的證券以及基於該指數的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該指數旨在為那些生產金屬和其他原材料或複合材料的公司提供投資機會，這些材料被認為對鋰電池、太陽能電池板、風力渦輪機、燃料電池、機器人和 3D 列印機等顛覆性技術至關重要。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Vox Royalty Corp. operates as a return-focused mining royalty and streaming company. It holds a portfolio of royalties and streaming assets. The company was founded by Kyle Floyd on January 22, 2014 and is headquartered in Westminster, CO.
info.industry_zh: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.
info.description_zh: Vox Royal Corp. 是一家注重回報的礦業特許權使用費和串流媒體公司。它持有特許權使用費和串流媒體資產的投資組合。該公司由凱爾·弗洛伊德 (Kyle Floyd) 於 2014 年 1 月 22 日創立，總部位於科羅拉多州威斯敏斯特。

info.description: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. engages in the provision of network security solutions to enterprises, service providers, and government entities. It operates through the following geographical segments: the United States, Israel, and Other Countries. The company was founded by Nir Zuk in March 2005 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA.
info.description_zh: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. 致力於為企業、服務供應商和政府實體提供網路安全解決方案。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、以色列和其他國家。該公司由 Nir ​​Zuk 於 2005 年 3 月創立，總部位於加州聖克拉拉。

info.description: Ishares Copper And Metals Mining ETF seeks to track the investment results of the STOXX Global Copper and Metals Mining Index composed of U.S. and non-U.S. equities of companies primarily engaged in copper and metal ore mining. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index and may invest up to 20% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Ishares 銅和金屬礦業 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球銅和金屬礦業指數的投資結果，該指數由主要從事銅和金屬礦石開採的公司的美國和非美國股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的組成證券以及具有與其標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資，並可能將最多 20% 的資產投資於某些期貨、期權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Addentax Group Corp. is a holding company, along with its subsidiaries, engages in the textile and garments industry. It operates through the following segments: Garment Manufacturing, Logistics Services, and Property Management and Subleasing. The Garments Manufacturing segment focuses on manufacturing and distribution of garments. The Logistics Services segment includes delivery and courier services covering some provinces in China. The Property Management and Subleasing segment offers services for wholesalers and retailers. The company was founded on October 28, 2014 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
info.description_zh: Addentax Group Corp. 是一家控股公司，及其子公司從事紡織和服裝行業。它透過以下部門運作：服裝製造部門、物流服務部門以及物業管理和分租賃部門。服裝製造部門專注於服裝的製造和分銷。物流服務部門包括涵蓋中國部分省份的送貨和快遞服務。物業管理和分租部門為批發商和零售商提供服務。公司成立於2014年10月28日，總部位於中國深圳。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to provide daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the common stock of Freeport-McMoRan Inc. The fund employs a leveraged strategy to amplify the daily performance of its underlying security through the use of financial derivative instruments and direct investment.
info.description_zh: Leverage Shares 2x Long FCX Daily ETF 是一款交易所交易基金，旨在提供 Freeport-McMoRan Inc. 普通股每日百分比變化兩倍 (200%) 的每日投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金採用槓桿策略，透過使用金融衍生工具和直接投資來放大其基礎證券的每日表現。

info.description: Sprott Copper Miners ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq Sprott Copper Miners Index. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its total assets in securities of the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenue and/or assets from mining, exploration, development, and production of copper. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Sprott Copper Miners ETF 尋求提供扣除費用和開支先前的投資結果，該結果通常與納斯達克 Sprott Copper Miners Index 的總回報表現相對應。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤至少 50% 的收入和/或資產來自銅礦開採、勘探、開發和生產的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Entegris, Inc. engages in the development, manufacture, and supply of specialty materials for the microelectronics industry. It operates through the Materials Solutions (MS) and Advanced Purity Solutions (APS) segments. The Materials Solutions segment provides materials-based solutions, such as chemical vapor and atomic layer deposition materials, chemical mechanical planarization ("CMP") slurries and pads, ion implantation specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, and other specialty materials that enable customers to achieve better device performance and faster time to yield, while providing for lower total cost of ownership. The Advanced Purity Solutions segment offers filtration, purification and contamination-control solutions that improve customers' yield, device reliability and cost by ensuring the purity of critical liquid chemistries and gases and the cleanliness of wafers and other substrates used throughout semiconductor manufacturing processes, the semiconductor ecosystem and other high-technology industries. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Billerica, MA.
info.description_zh: Entegris, Inc. 從事微電子行業特殊材料的開發、製造和供應。它透過材料解決方案（MS）和高級純度解決方案（APS）部門運作。材料解決方案部門提供基於材料的解決方案，例如化學氣相和原子層沉積材料、化學機械平坦化（“CMP”）漿料和墊、離子注入特種氣體、配方蝕刻和清潔材料以及其他特種材料，使客戶能夠實現更好的裝置性能和更快的產量，同時降低總擁有成本。高階純度解決方案部門提供過濾、純化和污染控制解決方案，透過確保關鍵液體化學品和氣體的純度以及半導體製造流程、半導體生態系統和其他高科技產業中使用的晶圓和其他基材的清潔度，提高客戶的產量、設備可靠性和成本。該公司成立於 1966 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州比爾里卡。

info.description: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Co. is a global edge-to-cloud company, which engages in the provision of information technology, technology and enterprise products, solutions, and services. It operates through the following segments: Server, Hybrid Cloud, Intelligent Edge, Financial Services, and Corporate Investments and Other. The Server segment consists of general-purpose servers for multi-workload computing and workload-optimized servers to deliver the performance and value for demanding applications, and integrated systems comprised of software and hardware designed to address high-performance computing and supercomputing, artificial intelligence, data analytics, and transaction processing workloads for government and commercial customers globally. The Hybrid Cloud segment is involved in a variety of cloud-native and hybrid solutions across storage, private cloud, and the infrastructure software-as-a-service space. The Intelligent Edge segment offers wired and wireless local area networks, campus, branch, and data center switching, software-defined wide-area-networks, private and public cellular network software, network security, and associated services that enable secure connectivity for businesses of any size. The Financial Services segment provides investment solutions, such as leasing, financing, IT consumption, utility programs, and asset management services for customers that facilitate technology deployment models and the acquisition of complete IT solutions, including hardware, software, and services from Hewlett Packard Enterprise and others. The Corporate Investments and Other segment includes the Advisory and Professional Services business, which primarily offers consultative-led services, HPE and partner technology expertise and advice, implementation services, as well as complex solution engagement capabilities, the Communications and Media Solutions business, which primarily offers software and related services to the telecommunications industry, and Hewlett Packard Labs, which is responsible for research and development. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard on July 2, 1939 and is headquartered in Spring, TX.
info.description_zh: 惠普企業有限公司是一家全球邊緣到雲端公司，從事提供資訊科技、技術和企業產品、解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：伺服器部門、混合雲部門、智慧邊緣部門、金融服務部門以及企業投資及其他部門。伺服器部門包括用於多工作負載運算的通用伺服器和工作負載優化伺服器，為要求苛刻的應用程式提供效能和價值，以及由軟體和硬體組成的整合系統，旨在為全球政府和商業客戶解決高效能運算和超級運算、人工智慧、數據分析和事務處理工作負載。混合雲部門涉及跨儲存、私有雲和基礎設施軟體即服務領域的各種雲端原生和混合解決方案。智慧邊緣部門提供有線和無線區域網路、園區、分公司和資料中心交換、軟體定義的廣域網路、專用和公共蜂窩網路軟體、網路安全以及相關服務，為任何規模的企業提供安全連線。金融服務部門為客戶提供投資解決方案，例如租賃、融資、IT消費、公用事業計劃和資產管理服務，以促進技術部署模型和從慧與等公司購買完整的IT解決方案，包括硬體、軟體和服務。企業投資和其他部門包括諮詢和專業服務業務（主要提供諮詢主導的服務、慧與和合作夥伴技術專業知識和建議、實施服務以及複雜的解決方案參與能力）、通訊和媒體解決方案業務（主要向電信行業提供軟體和相關服務）以及惠普實驗室（負責研發）。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1939 年 7 月 2 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州斯普林。

info.description: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the basic materials sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Basic Materials Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Basic Materials Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。標的指數由至少 30 家基礎材料產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: City Different Investments Global Equity ETF seeks to achieve capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities. The managers define "equity securities" to mean common stock, depositary receipts (e.g., American Depositary Receipts ("ADRs") and Global Depositary Receipts ("GDRs")), equity interests in real estate investment trusts ("REITs") and master limited partnerships ("MLPs"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: City Different Investments 全球股票 ETF 尋求實現資本增值。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常情況下將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於股本證券來實現其投資目標。管理者將「股本證券」定義為普通股、存託憑證（例如美國存託憑證（「ADR」）和全球存託憑證（「GDR」））、房地產投資信託（「REIT」）股權和主有限合夥（「MLP」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery. Its product offers automation and customization options for astigmatism treatment planning and other steps of the refractive cataract surgery procedure. The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: LENSAR, Inc. engages in the development of femtosecond laser technology for refractive cataract surgery.其產品為散光治療計劃和屈光性白內障手術的其他步驟提供自動化和定制選項。 The company was founded by Scott Addyman, Randy W. Frey, and Ronald R. Krueger in 2004 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.

info.description: GCM Grosvenor, Inc. provides global alternative asset management solutions. The firm invests on behalf of clients who seek allocations to alternative investments, such as private equity, infrastructure, real estate, credit, and absolute return strategies. It specializes in developing customized portfolios for clients who want an active role in the development of their alternatives programs and also offers multi-client portfolios for investors who desire a turn-key solution for accessing alternative investments. The company's offerings include multi-manager portfolios as well as portfolios of direct investments and co-investments. GCM Grosvenor has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, Tokyo, Hong Kong, and Seoul. GCM Grosvenor was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: GCM Grosvenor, Inc. 提供全球另類資產管理解決方案。該公司代表尋求另類投資配置的客戶進行投資，例如私募股權、基礎設施、房地產、信貸和絕對回報策略。它專門為希望在另類投資項目開發中發揮積極作用的客戶開發客製化投資組合，並為希望獲得另類投資交鑰匙解決方案的投資者提供多客戶投資組合。該公司的產品包括多管理人投資組合以及直接投資和共同投資組合。 GCM Grosvenor 在紐約、洛杉磯、倫敦、東京、香港和首爾設有辦事處。 GCM Grosvenor 成立於 1971 年，總部位於伊利諾州芝加哥。

info.description: AXS 2X Innovation ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of the ARK Innovation ETF. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major global financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the ARK Innovation ETF. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: AXS 2X Innovation ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 ARK Innovation ETF 每日業績的 200%。該基金將與全球主要金融機構簽訂一份或多份互換協議，期限從一天到一年以上不等，根據該協議，基金和全球金融機構將同意交換在ARK Innovation ETF上賺取或實現的回報（或回報率差異）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600  Capped Materials Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. These companies are principally engaged in the business of producing raw materials, including producing and manufacturing chemical products; manufacturing construction materials, containers, and packaging; mining metals and the production of related products; and manufacturing paper and forest products. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Materials ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Materials Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該等公司主要從事原料生產業務，包括生產及製造化學產品；製造建築材料、容器及包裝；開採金屬及相關產品的生產；以及造紙及林產品製造。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is comprised of equity securities of large capitalization companies based in countries classified as emerging markets.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Emerging Markets Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Emerging Markets Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由新興市場國家的大型資本公司的股本證券組成。

info.description: Stratasys Ltd. engages in the development of industrial grade additive solutions. It offers three-dimensional printers and parts, materials, and software. The company was founded on March 3, 1998 and is headquartered in Minnetonka, MN.
info.description_zh: Stratasys Ltd. 從事工業級添加劑解決方案的開發。它提供 3D 列印機以及零件、材料和軟體。該公司成立於1998年3月3日，總部位於明尼蘇達州明尼通卡。

info.description: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. engages in the mining of copper, gold, and molybdenum. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Copper Mines, South America Operations, Indonesia Operations, Molybdenum Mines, U.S. Rod and Refining, Atlantic Copper, and Corporate and Other. The U.S. Copper Mines segment operates open-pit copper mines in Morenci, Bagdad, Safford, Sierrita, Miami in Arizona and Chino, and Tyrone in New Mexico. The South America Operations segment includes Cerro Verde in Peru and El Abra in Chile. The Indonesia Operations segment handles the operations of the Grasberg minerals district that produce copper concentrate containing significant quantities of gold and silver. The Molybdenum Mines segment includes the Henderson underground mine and Climax open pit mine, both in Colorado. The U.S. Rod and Refining segment consists of copper conversion facilities located in North America and includes refinery and rod mills. The Atlantic Copper segment smelts and refines copper concentrate and markets refined copper and precious metals in slimes. The Corporate and Other segment offers other mining and eliminations, oil and gas operations, and other corporate and elimination items. The company was founded by James R. Moffett on November 10, 1987, and is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ.
info.description_zh: Freeport-McMoRan, Inc. 從事銅、金和鉬的開採。該公司透過以下部門運作：美國銅礦部門、南美業務部門、印尼業務部門、鉬礦部門、美國棒材和精煉部門、大西洋銅業部門以及企業及其他部門。美國銅礦部門在亞利桑那州的莫倫西、巴格達、薩福德、謝里塔、邁阿密和新墨西哥州的奇諾和蒂龍經營露天銅礦。南美洲業務部門包括秘魯的Cerro Verde 和智利的El Abra。印尼業務部門負責格拉斯伯格礦區的業務，該礦區生產含有大量金和銀的銅精礦。鉬礦部門包括位於科羅拉多州的亨德森地下礦和 Climax 露天礦場。美國棒材和精煉部門由位於北美的銅轉化設施組成，包括精煉廠和棒材軋鋼機。大西洋銅業部門冶煉和精煉銅精礦，並銷售精煉銅和礦泥中的貴金屬。公司及其他部門提供其他採礦和消除、石油和天然氣業務以及其他公司和消除項目。該公司由 James R. Moffett 於 1987 年 11 月 10 日創立，總部位於亞利桑那州菲尼克斯。

info.description: Baillie Gifford International Concentrated Growth ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified portfolio that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing in a select number of high-growth international businesses outside the United States. Utilizing a high-conviction, bottom-up fundamental research process with a typical holding horizon of around five years, the strategy targets exceptional companies with massive market opportunities, durable competitive advantages, and visionary management, completely unconstrained by benchmark matching
info.description_zh: Baillie Gifford International Concentration Growth ETF 是一種主動管理的非多元化投資組合，透過投資於美國以外的精選數量的高成長國際企業來尋求長期資本增值。該策略採用高說服力、自下而上的基礎研究流程，典型的持有期限為五年左右，目標是擁有巨大市場機會、持久競爭優勢和富有遠見的管理的傑出公司，完全不受基準匹配的限制

info.description: Themes Robotics & Automation ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive Industrial Robotics & Automation Index. The index is designed to provide exposure to companies whose products and services are focused on robotics and automation solutions in an industrial context. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in securities that comprise the index and in ADRs and GDRs based on the securities in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Themes Robotics & Automation ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive 工業機器人與自動化指數（未計費用和開支）的表現。該指數旨在為那些產品和服務專注於工業環境中的機器人和自動化解決方案的公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券以及基於該指數中的證券的 ADR 和 GDR。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Robotics and 3D Printing Index (the "Index"). The index is a rules-based index that consists of globally-listed stocks and depositary receipts of companies that derive at least 50% of their revenues from Robotics and 3D Printing Companies, as determined by the index provider. The fund adviser will generally use a "replication" strategy to achieve its investment objective, meaning it will invest in all of the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer BlueStar Engineering the Future ETF 旨在追蹤 BlueStar 機器人和 3D 列印指數（「指數」）扣除費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該指數是一個基於規則的指數，由指數提供者確定的至少 50% 收入來自機器人和 3D 列印公司的全球上市股票和存託憑證組成。基金顧問通常會使用「複製」策略來實現其投資目標，這意味著它將投資於指數的所有組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable TSLA ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that aims to generate current monthly income and provide limited downside protection by investing in a laddered portfolio of autocallable derivative instruments linked to the common stock of Tesla, Inc. (TSLA). The fund utilizes structured "autocallable" options that pay contingent coupons and include an automatic early redemption feature if the underlying asset's price meets or exceeds predefined barrier levels on specific observation dates.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable TSLA ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，旨在透過投資於與 Tesla, Inc. (TSLA) 普通股掛鉤的可自動贖回衍生性工具階梯投資組合，產生當前每月收入並提供有限的下行保護。該基金利用結構化的「可自動贖回」選擇權，支付或有息票，並包括如果標的資產的價格在特定觀察日期達到或超過預定障礙水平時自動提前贖回的功能。

info.description: REX AI Equity Premium Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund, under normal market conditions, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities comprising the BITA AI Leaders Select Index. It seeks to employ its investment strategy regardless of whether there are periods of adverse market, economic, or other conditions and will not seek to take temporary defensive positions during such periods. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: REX AI 股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於包含 BITA AI Leaders Select Index 的證券。無論是否存在不利的市場、經濟或其他條件，它都力求採用其投資策略，並且不會尋求在此期間採取臨時防禦立場。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Amana Developing World ETF is an actively managed fund targeting long-term capital growth by investing in equity securities of companies with significant operational or revenue exposure to emerging markets. The investment process adheres strictly to Islamic principles, which necessitates the exclusion of businesses involved in prohibited activities such as alcohol, gambling, or interest-based finance, while prioritizing companies with strong balance sheets and low debt.
info.description_zh: Amana 發展中國家 ETF 是一檔積極管理的基金，透過投資於新興市場具有重大營運或收入敞口的公司的股本證券，實現長期資本增長。投資過程嚴格遵守伊斯蘭原則，需要排除涉及酒精、賭博或基於利息的金融等違禁活動的企業，同時優先考慮資產負債表強勁和債務較低的公司。

info.description: eGain Corp. engages in the development, licensing, implementation, and support of customer service infrastructure software solutions. Its solutions include financial services, insurance, retail, travel and hospitality, ecommerce, helpdesks, and marketing. The company was founded by Ashutosh Roy and Gunjan K. Sinha on September 10, 1997 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
info.description_zh: eGain Corp. 從事客戶服務基礎設施軟體解決方案的開發、授權、實施和支援。其解決方案包括金融服務、保險、零售、旅遊和酒店、電子商務、服務台和行銷。該公司由 Ashutosh Roy 和 Gunjan K. Sinha 於 1997 年 9 月 10 日創立，總部位於加州桑尼維爾。

info.description: VictoryShares Free Cash Flow Growth ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the Victory Free Cash Flow Growth Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its assets in securities in the index. VettaFi LLC constructs the index in accordance with a rules-based methodology that screens for positive free cash flow and selects 100 growth companies with the highest score within the VettaFi US Equity Large/Mid-Cap 1000 Index (the "Parent Index").
info.description_zh: VictoryShares 自由現金流成長 ETF 力求提供在費用和支出之前與 Victory 自由現金流成長指數的表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金尋求透過將至少80%的資產投資於指數證券來實現其投資目標。 VettaFi LLC 根據基於規則的方法建立該指數，該方法篩選正的自由現金流，並選擇 VettaFi 美國股票大/中型股 1000 指數（「母指數」）中得分最高的 100 家成長型公司。

info.description: Transcat, Inc. engages in the provision of calibration and laboratory instrument services. It operates through the following business segments: Service and Distribution. The Service segment offers calibration, repair, inspection, analytical qualifications, preventive maintenance, consulting, and other related services. The Distribution segment distributes professional grade tests, measurement, and control instrumentation. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Rochester, NY.
info.description_zh: Transcat, Inc. 從事提供校準和實驗室儀器服務。它透過以下業務部門運作：服務和分銷。服務部門提供校準、維修、檢查、分析鑑定、預防性維護、諮詢和其他相關服務。分銷部門分銷專業級測試、測量和控制儀器。該公司成立於 1964 年，總部位於紐約州羅徹斯特。

info.description: The Walt Disney Co. engages in the business of international family entertainment and media enterprise. It owns and operates television and radio production, distribution and broadcasting stations, direct-to-consumer services, amusement parks, and hotels. It operates through the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Parks, Experiences, and Products. The company was founded by Walter Elias Disney on October 16, 1923 and is headquartered in Burbank, CA.
info.description_zh: 華特迪士尼公司從事國際家庭娛樂和媒體業務。它擁有並經營電視和廣播製作、發行和廣播電台、直接面向消費者的服務、遊樂園和酒店。它透過以下業務部門運作：迪士尼娛樂、ESPN 以及迪士尼樂園、體驗和產品。該公司由沃爾特·埃利亞斯·迪士尼 (Walter Elias Disney) 於 1923 年 10 月 16 日創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州伯班克。

info.description: Fidelity Disruptors ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund normally invests its assets in a combination of five Fidelity funds, each of which normally invests in equity securities of companies that represent a disruptive theme. Fidelity's disruptive strategies seek to identify innovative developments that could signal new directions for delivering products and services to customers. Generally, these companies have or are developing new or unconventional ways of doing business that could disrupt and displace incumbents over time.
info.description_zh: Fidelity Disruptors ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金通常將其資產投資於五個富達基金的組合，每個基金通常投資於代表顛覆性主題的公司的股本證券。富達的顛覆性策略旨在識別創新發展，這些發展可能標誌著向客戶提供產品和服務的新方向。一般來說，這些公司已經或正在開發新的或非常規的經營方式，隨著時間的推移，這些方式可能會顛覆和取代現有企業。

info.description: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities Etf is an exchange traded fund launched by Opal Capital LLC. It is managed by Vident Asset Management. It invests in public equity markets of United States. It invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization. The fund employs quantitative analysis to create its portfolio. Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities Etf is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities ETF 是 Opal Capital LLC 推出的一檔交易所交易基金。它由 Vident 資產管理公司管理。它投資於美國公共股票市場。它投資於多元化行業的公司股票。它投資於多元化市值公司的成長型股票和價值型股票。該基金採用定量分析來創建其投資組合。 Rbb Fund Trust - Pathfinder Focused Opportunities ETF 註冊地在美國。

info.description: Founder-Led ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Founder-Led Index. The index tracks the performance of the top 50 founder-led publicly traded U.S. companies, defined as companies where at least one original founder currently serves in a C-suite or equivalent key executive role. Under normal market conditions, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in founder-led company equities included in the index and/or in financial instruments that collectively provide exposure to founder-led companies represented in the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 創辦人主導的 ETF 旨在追蹤創辦人主導的指數在扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數追蹤美國 50 強創辦人領導的上市公司的業績，這些公司的定義是至少一名原始創辦人目前擔任最高管理層或同等關鍵管理職位的公司。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於指數中包含的創始人領導的公司股票和/或共同為指數中代表的創始人領導的公司提供風險敞口的金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Electra Battery Materials Corp. engages in the refining, acquisition, and exploration of resource properties. Its project portfolio includes Iron Creek, Becancour, Ontario Refinery and North American Nickel. The company was founded on July 13, 2011 and is headquartered Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: Electra Battery Materials Corp. 從事資源資產的精煉、收購和勘探。其項目組合包括 Iron Creek、Becancour、Ontario Refinery 和 North American Nickel。該公司成立於2011年7月13日，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: FTAI Infrastructure, Inc. provides infrastructure and equipment for transportation. It operates through the following segments: Railroad, Jefferson Terminal, Repauno, Power and Gas, Sustainability and Energy Transition, and Corporate and Other. It is in the business of acquiring, developing and operating assets and businesses that represent critical infrastructure for customers in the transportation and energy industries. The company was founded on December 13, 2021 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: FTAI Infrastructure, Inc. 提供交通基礎設施和設備。該公司透過以下部門運營：鐵路部門、傑斐遜車站部門、雷帕諾部門、電力和天然氣部門、永續發展和能源轉型部門以及企業和其他部門。它的業務是收購、開發和營運代表運輸和能源行業客戶關鍵基礎設施的資產和業務。該公司成立於2021年12月13日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: iShares Texas Equity ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Russell Texas Equity Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of equity securities of U.S. companies headquartered in the State of Texas, as defined by FTSE Russell (the "Index Provider" or "Russell"). The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares Texas Equity ETF 旨在追蹤 Russell Texas 股票指數的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量富時羅素（「指數提供者」或「羅素」）定義的總部位於德克薩斯州的美國公司的股票表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於其標的指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares Autocallable SMCI ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks current income by investing at least 80% of its net assets in derivative contracts utilizing autocallable instruments that reference the common stock of Super Micro Computer, Inc. The strategy aims to deliver monthly distributions while managing cash balances through U.S. government securities, money market funds, short-term bond ETFs, investment-grade corporate debt, repurchase agreements, or national exchange-listed U.S. large-cap equities.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares Autocallable SMCI ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於利用參考 Super Micro Computer, Inc. 普通股的可自動贖回工具的衍生性商品合約來尋求當前收入。該策略旨在透過美國政府證券、貨幣市場基金、短期債券 ETF、投資等級公司債務、回購協議或在國家交易所上市的美國大盤股管理現金餘額，同時提供每月分配股票。

info.description: Invesco DWA Energy Momentum ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Dorsey Wright Energy Technical Leaders Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of at least 30 securities of companies in the energy sector that have powerful relative strength or "momentum" characteristics.
info.description_zh: Invesco DWA Energy Momentum ETF 旨在追蹤 Dorsey Wright Energy Technical Leaders Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支之前）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數由至少 30 家能源產業公司的證券組成，這些公司具有強大的相對實力或「動量」特徵。

info.description: Mango Growth ETF is an actively managed ETF. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in the common stock of companies that the fund manager believes have high growth characteristics. The fund manager considers a company to have high growth characteristics if it demonstrates consistently strong year-over-year growth across multiple fundamental and market-based metrics. These may include, but are not limited to, sustained increases in sales, earnings, and cash flows, as well as positive share price trends over a specified evaluation period. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 芒果成長ETF是主動式管理型ETF。該基金透過主要投資於基金經理人認為具有高成長特徵的公司的普通股來尋求長期資本增值。如果一家公司在多個基本面和基於市場的指標上表現出持續強勁的同比增長，基金經理就會認為該公司具有高成長特徵。這些可能包括但不限於銷售額、收益和現金流量的持續成長，以及在特定評估期間內積極的股價趨勢。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Omada Health, Inc. engages in the provision of digital health services. It offers online diabetes and obesity prevention programs, health coaching, and integration of web, mobile, and smart devices. The company was founded by Andrew DiMichele, Adrian James, and Sean Duffy in 2011 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: Omada Health, Inc. 從事提供數位醫療服務。它提供線上糖尿病和肥胖預防計劃、健康指導以及網路、行動和智慧型裝置的整合。該公司由 Andrew DiMichele、Adrian James 和 Sean Duffy 於 2011 年創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index. The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to large-capitalization companies. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities that are the component securities of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator ETF 旨在追蹤 Cash COWZ 100-Nasdaq 100 Rotator Index 的總回報表現（扣除費用和開支）。該指數採用客觀、基於規則的方法來提供對大市值公司的投資。在正常情況下，至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）將投資於作為指數組成證券的股本證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF  is an actively managed ETF designed to generate high levels of monthly and weekly income. The fund primarily employs an options-based strategy, selling put options on a leveraged ETF that tracks CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV). By selling these options, the fund seeks to capture premium income, with secondary objectives of gaining exposure to the underlying security while managing potential downside through a specific volatility-linked framework.
info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST CRWV ETF 是一款主動管理的 ETF，旨在產生高水準的月度和周收入。該基金主要採用基於選擇權的策略，出售追蹤 CoreWeave, Inc. (CRWV) 的槓桿 ETF 的看跌選擇權。透過出售這些選擇權，該基金尋求獲取溢價收入，次要目標是獲得基礎證券的敞口，同時透過特定的波動性相關框架管理潛在的下行風險。

info.description: ClearBridge Large Cap Growth ESG ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation through investing in large-capitalization companies with the potential for high future earnings growth. Under normal circumstances, the fund seeks to meet its investment objective by investing at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, if any, in equity securities or other instruments with similar economic characteristics of U.S. companies with large market capitalizations that meet its financial and environmental, social and governance ("ESG") criteria.
info.description_zh: ClearBridge 大盤成長 ESG ETF 透過投資未來獲利高成長潛力的大市值公司來尋求長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金尋求透過將至少80%的淨資產以及用於投資目的的借款（如有）投資於股本證券或具有與美國大市值公司類似經​​濟特徵且符合其財務和環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）標準的其他工具來實現其投資目標。

info.description: iShares Energy Storage & Materials ETF seeks to track the investment results of STOXX Global Energy Storage and Materials Index. The index measures the performance of equity securities of companies involved in energy storage solutions aiming to support the transition to a low carbon economy, including hydrogen, fuel cells, and batteries as determined by STOXX Ltd. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of its index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of its underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares 儲能和材料 ETF 旨在追蹤 STOXX 全球儲能和材料指數的投資結果。該指數衡量參與旨在支持向低碳經濟轉型的能源儲存解決方案的公司的股本證券的表現，包括由 STOXX Ltd 確定的氫、燃料電池和電池。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於其指數的組成證券以及具有與其基礎指數組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Carlyle Secured Lending, Inc. is a global investment firm with deep industry expertise that deploys private capital. The company was founded in February 2012, and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: 凱雷擔保貸款公司 (Carlyle Secured Lending, Inc.) 是一家全球投資公司，擁有深厚的行業專業知識，可部署私人資本。該公司成立於2012年2月，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: ishares Breakthrough Environmental Solutions ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar Global Emerging Green Technologies Select Index. The underlying index measures the performance of equity securities issued by U.S. and non-U.S. companies involved in breakthrough innovations and new technologies that seek to address or combat climate change, as determined by Morningstar or its affiliates. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: isshares Breakthrough Environmental Solutions ETF 旨在追蹤晨星全球新興綠色技術精選指數的投資結果。該指數衡量由晨星或其附屬公司確定的涉及尋求解決或應對氣候變遷的突破性創新和新技術的美國和非美國公司發行的股本證券的表現。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Exponential Technologies ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Morningstar Exponential Technologies IndexSM composed of stocks of developed and emerging market companies that create or use exponential technologies. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and in investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially identical to the component securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is a subset of the Morningstar Global Markets Index (the "Parent index").
info.description_zh: iShares Exponential Technologies ETF 旨在追蹤 Morningstar Exponential Technologies IndexSM 的投資結果，該指數由創建或使用指數技術的已開發和新興市場公司的股票組成。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券以及具有與標的指數的組成證券基本相同的經濟特徵的投資。基礎指數是晨星全球市場指數（「母指數」）的子集。

info.description: Keen Vision Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which engages in effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, and reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on June 18, 2021 and is headquartered in Summit, NJ.
info.description_zh: Keen Vision Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，從事合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2021年6月18日，總部位於新澤西州薩米特。

info.description: Pegasystems, Inc. engages in the development, market, license, and support of software, which allows organizations to build, deploy, and change enterprise applications. Its product, Pega Infinity, helps connect enterprises to their customers in real-time across channels, streamline business operations, and adapt to meet changing requirements. The company was founded by Alan Trefler in 1983 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: Pegasystems, Inc. 從事軟體的開發、行銷、授權和支持，使組織能夠建置、部署和更改企業應用程式。其產品 Pega Infinity 可協助企業跨通路即時連接客戶、簡化業務營運並適應不斷變化的需求。該公司由 Alan Trefler 於 1983 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Construction Partners, Inc. is a civil infrastructure company, which engages in the construction and maintenance of roadways and highways. The firm is also involved in the provision of products and services to both public and private infrastructure projects, with an emphasis on highways, roads, bridges, airports, and commercial and residential developments. The company was founded by Ned N. Fleming, III, R. Alan Palmer, and Charles E. Owens in 1999 and is headquartered in Dothan, AL.
info.description_zh: Construction Partners, Inc. 是一家民用基礎設施公司，從事道路和高速公路的建設和維護。該公司還為公共和私人基礎設施項目提供產品和服務，重點是高速公路、道路、橋樑、機場以及商業和住宅開發項目。該公司由 Ned N. Fleming, III、R. Alan Palmer 和 Charles E. Owens 於 1999 年創立，總部位於阿拉巴馬州多森。

info.description: Invesco NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ Next Generation 100 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq, Inc. compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is comprised of securities of the next generation of Nasdaq-listed non-financial companies; that is, the largest 100 Nasdaq-listed companies outside of the NASDAQ-100 Index (the "NASDAQ-100") based on market capitalization. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco NASDAQ Next Gen 100 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克下一代 100 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克公司嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數由納斯達克上市的下一代非金融公司的證券組成；即 NASDAQ-100 指數（“NASDAQ-100”）之外按市值計算的最大 100 家納斯達克上市公司。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Baron Technology ETF invests in equity securities (including depositary receipts) of U.S. and non-U.S. technology companies of any market capitalization, selected for their durable growth potential from the development, advancement and use of technology, however, investments in non-U.S. securities are limited to 35% of the Fund's total assets at the time of purchase. Technology companies may be located anywhere in the world, including developing countries. A developing country is a country included in the MSCI Emerging Markets (EM) Index and other countries determined by the Adviser to be developing countries based on classifications made by the International Monetary Fund or on country characteristics similar to those of the countries in the EM Index. BAMCO seeks to invest in businesses it believes have significant opportunities for growth, sustainable competitive advantages, exceptional management, and an attractive valuation.
info.description_zh: Baron Technology ETF 投資於任何市值的美國和非美國科技公司的股本證券（包括存託憑證），因其在技術開發、進步和使用方面的持久增長潛力而被選擇，但對非美國證券的投資僅限於購買時基金總資產的 35%。科技公司可能位於世界任何地方，包括發展中國家。發展中國家是指納入 MSCI 新興市場 (EM) 指數的國家以及顧問根據國際貨幣基金組織的分類或根據與新興市場指數國家類似的國家特徵確定為發展中國家的其他國家。 BAMCO 尋求投資於它認為具有重大成長機會、可持續競爭優勢、卓越管理和有吸引力估值的企業。

info.description: Invesco S&P SmallCap Energy ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Energy Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC (the "index provider") compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which is designed to measure the performance of securities of small-capitalization U.S. companies in the energy sector, as defined by the Global Industry Classification Standard ("GICS  "). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco S&P SmallCap Energy ETF 旨在追蹤 S&P SmallCap 600 Capped Energy Index（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。 S&P Dow Jones Indices, LLC（「指數提供者」）嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算基礎指數，該指數旨在衡量全球行業分類標準（「GICS」）所定義的美國小型公司在能源領域的證券表現。它是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Nasdaq Oil & Gas ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq US Smart Oil & Gas IndexTM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depository receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to U.S. companies comprising the oil and gas sector that have been selected based upon their liquidity and weighted based upon their cumulative score on three investing factors: volatility, value and growth. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克石油和天然氣 ETF 尋求與納斯達克美國智慧石油和天然氣指數TM 的價格和收益率（未計基金費用和開支）相對應的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在提供對包括石油和天然氣行業在內的美國公司的投資，這些公司是根據其流動性進行選擇的，並根據其在三個投資因素（波動性、價值和增長）的累積得分進行加權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Procure Space ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before the fund's fees and expenses, of an equity index called the "S-Network Space Index". The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in companies of the underlying index that receive at least 50% of their revenues or profits from space-related businesses. The underlying index is designed to serve as an equity benchmark for a globally traded portfolio of companies that are engaged in space-related business, such as those utilizing satellite technology. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Procure Space ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為「S-Network Space Index」的股票指數（扣除基金費用和支出之前）的表現相對應。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於相關指數中至少 50% 的收入或利潤來自太空相關業務的公司。該指數旨在作為從事太空相關業務（例如利用衛星技術的公司）的全球交易公司投資組合的股票基準。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Alpha Architect Value Momentum Trend ETF seeks long term capital appreciation while attempting to minimize market drawdowns. The fund is a "fund of funds," meaning that it primarily invests its assets in the shares of other ETFs, rather than in securities of individual companies. Its portfolio will be composed primarily of the other ETFs advised by the Adviser. Currently, there are four Alpha Architect ETFs, which invest in either domestic or international equity securities, and employ either a "momentum" or a "value" investment strategy.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect 價值動量趨勢 ETF 尋求長期資本增值，同時試圖盡量減少市場回檔。該基金是“基金中的基金”，這意味著它主要將其資產投資於其他 ETF 的股票，而不是個別公司的證券。其投資組合將主要由顧問建議的其他 ETF 組成。目前，Alpha Architect 有四種 ETF，投資於國內或國際股票證券，並採用「動量」或「價值」投資策略。

info.description: AEye, Inc. engages in the provision of high-performance, active lidar systems for vehicle autonomy, advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), and robotic vision applications. It specializes in computer vision, autonomous driving, robotic vision, autonomous vehicles, lidar, sensor fusion, and three-dimensional mapping. The company was founded by Luis C. Dussan, Ransom P. Wuller, Barry Behnken, and Jordan Greene in 2013 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, CA.
info.description_zh: AEye, Inc. 致力於為車輛自動駕駛、高級駕駛員輔助系統 (ADAS) 和機器人視覺應用提供高性能主動雷射雷達系統。它專注於電腦視覺、自動駕駛、機器人視覺、自動駕駛汽車、光達、感測器融合和三維測繪。該公司由 Luis C. Dussan、Ransom P. Wuller、Barry Behnken 和 Jordan Greene 於 2013 年創立，總部位於加州普萊森頓。

info.description: Sigma Lithium Corp. engages in the producing of a lithium property. It focuses its project in Minas Gerais. The firm also plans to build a world-class commercial-scale lithium concentration plant. The company was founded on June 8, 2011 and is headquartered in Sao Paulo, Brazil.
info.description_zh: Sigma Lithium Corp. 從事鋰資產的生產。它的項目集中在米納斯吉拉斯州。該公司還計劃建造一座世界級的商業規模鋰濃縮廠。該公司成立於2011年6月8日，總部位於巴西聖保羅。

info.description: abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its objective by investing primarily in equity securities of small non-U.S. companies. Equity securities include, but are not limited to, common stock, preferred stock and depositary receipts. As a non-fundamental policy, under normal market conditions, it will invest at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities of non-U.S. small companies.
info.description_zh: abrdn International Small Cap Active ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金尋求透過主要投資於小型非美國公司的股本證券來實現其目標。股本證券包括但不限於普通股、優先股及存託憑證。作為一項非基本面政策，在正常市場條件下，它將把至少80%的淨資產價值，加上任何用於投資目的的借款，投資於非美國小公司的股本證券。

info.description: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. engages in the provision of drilling and pressure pumping services, directional drilling, rental equipment, and technology. It operates through the following segments: Drilling Services, Completion Services, and Drilling Products. The Drilling Services segment represents contract drilling, directional drilling, oilfield technology, and electrical controls and automation businesses. The Completion Services segment offers hydraulic fracturing, wireline and pumping, completion support, cementing, and pressure pumping business. The Drilling Products segment focuses on manufacturing and distribution of drill bits business. The company was founded by Cloyce A. Talbott and A. Glenn Patterson in 1978 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.description_zh: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. 從事提供鑽井和壓力泵服務、定向鑽井、租賃設備和技術。該公司透過以下部門運作：鑽井服務部門、完井服務部門和鑽井產品部門。鑽井服務部門涉及合約鑽井、定向鑽井、油田技術以及電氣控制和自動化業務。完井服務部門提供水力壓裂、電纜和泵送、完井支援、固井和壓力泵送業務。鑽井產品部門專注於鑽頭業務的製造和分銷。該公司由 Cloyce A. Talbott 和 A. Glenn Patterson 於 1978 年創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund is a closed-ended equity indexed mutual fund launched by Nuveen Investments, Inc. The fund is co-managed by Nuveen Asset Management, LLC and Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC. It invests in the public equity markets of the United States. The fund seeks to invest in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It primarily invests in the stocks of large-cap companies. The fund also invests through index call options. It seeks to replicate the performance of its portfolio against the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund was previously known as NASDAQ Premium Income & Growth Fund Inc. Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund was formed on January 30, 2007 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund 是由 Nuveen Investments, Inc. 推出的封閉式股票指數共同基金。該基金由 Nuveen Asset Management, LLC 和 Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC 共同管理。它投資於美國的公共股票市場。該基金尋求投資於多元化產業的公司股票。它主要投資於大型公司的股票。該基金也透過指數買權進行投資。它試圖複製其投資組合相對於納斯達克 100 指數的表現。該基金以前稱為 NASDAQ Premium Income & Growth Fund Inc. Nuveen Nasdaq 100 Dynamic Overwrite Fund 成立於 2007 年 1 月 30 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF seeks capital appreciation and current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for exposure to the share price (i.e., the price returns) of the securities of the companies comprising the Solactive FANG Innovation Index. The fund advisor seeks to employ the fund's investment strategy regardless of whether there are periods of adverse market, economic, or other conditions and will not seek to take temporary defensive positions during such periods.
info.description_zh: REX FANG & Innovation Equity Premium Income ETF 尋求資本增值和當前收入。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求當前收入，同時保持接觸 Solactive FANG 創新指數公司證券的股價（即價格回報）的機會。無論是否存在不利的市場、經濟或其他條件，基金顧問都會尋求採用基金的投資策略，並且不會尋求在此期間採取臨時防禦立場。

info.description: Lowe's Companies, Inc. engages in the retail sale of home improvement products. The firm offers products for maintenance, repair, remodeling, home decorating, and property maintenance. It also provides home improvement products in the following categories: appliances, seasonal & outdoor living, lumber, lawn & garden, kitchens & bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and decor. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Mooresville, NC.
info.description_zh: Lowe's Companies, Inc. 從事家居裝修產品的零售業務。該公司提供用於維護、修理、改造、家居裝飾和物業維護的產品。它還提供以下類別的家居裝修產品：電器、季節性和戶外生活、木材、草坪和花園、廚房和浴室、五金、建築材料、木製品、油漆、粗糙管道、工具、電氣、地板和裝飾。該公司成立於 1946 年，總部位於北卡羅來納州穆爾斯維爾。

info.description: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or other similar business combination, involving one or more businesses or assets. The company was founded on June 27, 2025 and is headquartered in Oakland, CA.
info.description_zh: Launchpad Cadenza Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是實現涉及一項或多項業務或資產的合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或其他類似業務合併。該公司成立於2025年6月27日，總部位於加州奧克蘭。

info.description: PeakShares RMR Prime Equity ETF seeks to provide capital appreciation and income generation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that may engage in active and frequent trading. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in equity securities that include common stocks of companies and equity ETFs providing exposure to such companies, and have economic characteristics similar to such securities.
info.description_zh: PeakShares RMR Prime 股票 ETF 旨在提供資本增值和創收。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），可以進行活躍且頻繁的交易。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券，其中包括公司的普通股和向此類公司提供敞口的股本ETF，並且具有與此類證券類似的經濟特徵。

info.description: Invesco NASDAQ Future Gen 200 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq Innovators Completion Cap IndexTM. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the index. The index excludes securities of issuers included in the Nasdaq-100 Index (an index that measures the performance of 100 of the largest Nasdaq-listed non-financial companies by market capitalization) and the Nasdaq Next Generation 100 Index (an index that measures the performance of the 100 largest Nasdaq-listed companies outside of the NASDAQ-100 Index based on market capitalization). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco NASDAQ Future Gen 200 ETF 旨在追蹤納斯達克創新者完成上限指數 (Nasdaq Innovators Completion Cap IndexTM) 的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。該基金通常會將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數不包括納斯達克 100 指數（按市值衡量納斯達克上市的 100 家最大非金融公司業績的指數）和納斯達克下一代 100 指數（根據市值衡量納斯達克 100 指數以外的 100 家最大的納斯達克上市公司的業績的指數）所包含的發行人的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: The Home Depot, Inc. engages in the sale of building materials and home improvement products. Its products include building materials, home improvement products, lawn and garden products and decor products. The firm operates through the following geographical segments: U.S., Canada and Mexico. It offers home improvement installation services, and tool and rental equipment. The company was founded by Bernard Marcus, Arthur M. Blank, Kenneth Gerald Langone and Pat Farrah on June 29, 1978 and is headquartered at Atlanta, GA.
info.description_zh: The Home Depot, Inc. 從事建築材料和家居裝修產品的銷售。其產品包括建築材料、家居裝修產品、草坪和花園產品以及裝飾產品。該公司透過以下地理區域開展業務：美國、加拿大和墨西哥。它提供家居裝修安裝服務以及工具和租賃設備。該公司由 Bernard Marcus、Arthur M. Blank、Kenneth Gerald Langone 和 Pat Farrah 於 1978 年 6 月 29 日創立，總部位於喬治亞州亞特蘭大。

info.description: Alpha Architect International Quantitative Momentum ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Adviser employs a multi-step, quantitative, rules-based methodology to identify a portfolio of approximately 50 to 100 non-U.S. equity securities with the highest relative momentum. A "momentum" style of investing emphasizes investing in securities that have had higher recent total return performance compared to other securities. The Adviser then employs proprietary screens to eliminate companies with issues that may negatively impact their momentum. The fund may also invest up to 20% of its assets in cash and cash equivalents, other investment companies, as well as securities and other instruments.
info.description_zh: Alpha Architect International Quantitative Momentum ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該顧問採用多步驟、定量、基於規則的方法來確定由大約 50 至 100 種相對動量最高的非美國股票證券組成的投資組合。 「動量」投資風格強調投資於近期總回報表現高於其他證券的證券。然後，顧問採用專有篩選來消除存在可能對其發展勢頭產生負面影響的問題的公司。該基金還可以將最多 20% 的資產投資於現金和現金等價物、其他投資公司以及證券和其他工具。

info.description: Invesco FTSE RAFI US 1500 Small-Mid ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the FTSE RAFI US Mid Small 1500 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is composed of approximately 1,500 common stocks and is designed to track the performance of small- and medium-sized U.S. companies based on the following four fundamental measures of firm size: book value, cash flow, sales and dividends.
info.description_zh: Invesco FTSE RAFI US 1500 Small-Mid ETF 旨在追蹤 FTSE RAFI US Mid Small 1500 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數由大約 1,500 只普通股組成，旨在根據以下四項衡量公司規模的基本指標來追蹤美國中小型公司的業績：帳面價值、現金流、銷售額和股息。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ Clean Edge Smart Grid Infrastructure Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq Clean Edge Smart Grid Infrastructure Index TM. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index includes companies that are primarily engaged and involved in electric grid, electric meters and devices, networks, energy storage and management, and enabling software used by the smart grid infrastructure sector. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: First Trust 納斯達克 Clean Edge 智慧電網基礎設施指數基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 Clean Edge 智慧電網基礎設施指數 TM 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數包括主要從事和參與電網、電錶和設備、網路、能源儲存和管理以及智慧電網基礎設施領域使用的支援軟體的公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares Flexible Equity Active ETF is a dynamically managed fund that takes both long and short positions primarily in global equity securities across any market capitalization, utilizing derivatives to gain exposure, hedge risk, or implement opportunistic asset and currency strategies. The portfolio incorporates a flexible combination of common stock, preferred stock, REITs, convertible securities, and up to 25% exposure to commodity markets via a wholly owned Cayman Subsidiary and commodity-linked exchange-traded products.

info.description: Alexis Practical Tactical ETF seeks total return primarily through long-term capital appreciation, with income and capital preservation as secondary objectives. In seeking to achieve its investment objective, the fund has the flexibility to allocate its assets among different markets around the world and various asset classes (e.g., equity, fixed income, commodities (including precious metals), and real estate (including real estate investment trusts ("REITs"))) and strategies, including alternative strategies (e.g., merger arbitrage, convertible bond and options-based strategies).
info.description_zh: Alexis Practical Tactical ETF 主要透過長期資本增值來尋求總回報，收入和資本保值是次要目標。為了實現其投資目標，該基金可以靈活地在全球不同市場和各種資產類別（例如股票、固定收益、大宗商品（包括貴金屬）和房地產（包括房地產投資信託基金（「REITs」）））和策略（包括另類策略（例如合併套利、可轉換債券和基於選擇權的策略））之間配置其資產。

info.description: First Trust IndXX NextG ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Indxx 5G & NextG Thematic Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks and depositary receipts that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of companies that have devoted, or have committed to devote, material resources to the research, development and application of fifth generation ("5G") and next generation digital cellular technologies as they emerge.
info.description_zh: First Trust IndXX NextG ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 Indxx 5G 和 NextG 主題指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股和存託憑證。該指數旨在追蹤那些已投入或已承諾投入物質資源用於第五代（「5G」）和下一代數位蜂窩技術的研究、開發和應用的公司的表現。

info.description: VictoryShares WestEnd Global Equity ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund, under normal circumstances, has a policy to invest at least 80% of its assets in the shares of exchange-traded funds ("ETFs") that invest in equity securities. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 40% of its net assets in ETFs that invest primarily in securities of issuers outside of the United States.
info.description_zh: VictoryShares WestEnd 全球股票 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金的政策是將至少80%的資產投資於投資於股本證券的交易所交易基金（「ETF」）的份額。在正常情況下，該基金將至少40%的淨資產投資於主要投資於美國境外發行人的證券的ETF。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2031 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, the Adviser invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2031, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year.
