The fund may also invest in municipal bonds with maturity dates within six months prior to or after the fund's target maturity year. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2031 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，顧問將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅的投資。該基金主要投資於 2031 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入當年發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金還可以投資於到期日在基金目標到期年份之前或之後六個月內的市政債券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Risk Managed Income ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk managed income strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 風險管理收益 ETF 力求提供與 Nasdaq-100 月淨信用領 95-100 指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於 Nasdaq-100 Monthly Net Credit Collar 95-100 Index（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量風險管理收益策略的表現，該策略持有納斯達克 100 指數的標的股票，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Asia Defense Fund seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the WisdomTree Asia Defense Index (the "Index"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in constituents of the index and/or investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such constituents. The index has between 20 and 100 constituents with a maximum weight of 7.5% for "Exposure Score 3" constituents and 4% for "Exposure Score 2" and "Exposure Score 1" constituents. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree 亞洲防務基金致力於追蹤 WisdomTree 亞洲防務指數（「指數」）未計費用和開支的價格和收益率表現。在正常情況下，基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於指數成分股和/或具有與此類成分股經濟特徵基本相似的經濟特徵的投資。該指數有 20 至 100 隻成分股，其中「暴露評分 3」成分股的最大權重為 7.5%，「暴露評分 2」和「暴露評分 1」成分股的最大權重為 4%。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Europe AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Europe Index (the "index"). The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Europe Index (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Europe AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 歐洲指數（「指數」）的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。该基金通常将至少 90% 的净资产（包括投资借款）投资于构成该指数的证券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克歐洲指數（「基礎指數」）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: iShares Dynamic Equity Active ETF seeks to provide total return. The fund will, under normal circumstances, invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities. It seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in both equity and fixed-income securities, including money market securities and other short-term securities or instruments, of issuers located around the world. Equity securities include common stock, preferred stock, ADRs, or securities or other instruments whose price is linked to the value of common stock.
info.description_zh: iShares Dynamic Equity Active ETF 力求提供總回報。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。它尋求透過投資世界各地發行人的股票和固定收益證券（包括貨幣市場證券和其他短期證券或工具）來實現其投資目標。股本證券包括普通股、優先股、美國存託憑證或價格與普通股價值掛鉤的證券或其他工具。

info.description: Vaneck Robotics ETF seeks to track as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of the BlueStar Robotics Index (the "index"). The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in Robotics Companies. The index is comprised of equity securities, which may include depositary receipts of global exchange-listed companies in the robotics industry. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vaneck Robotics ETF 力求在費用和支出之前盡可能密切地追蹤 BlueStar Robotics Index（「指數」）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於機器人公司。該指數由股本證券組成，其中可能包括機器人產業全球交易所上市公司的存託憑證。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PGIM Laddered Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF seeks to provide investors with capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by providing investors with exposure to the stocks included in the Nasdaq-100 Index while attempting to limit downside risk by investing in a "laddered portfolio" of four PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETFs (the "Underlying ETFs").
info.description_zh: PGIM Laddered Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF 旨在為投資者提供資本增值。該基金力求透過向投資者提供納斯達克 100 指數中包含的股票敞口來實現其投資目標，同時嘗試透過投資由四隻 PGIM Nasdaq-100 Buffer 12 ETF（「基礎 ETF」）組成的「階梯投資組合」來限制下行風險。

info.description: Global X CleanTech ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Global CleanTech Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets, plus borrowings for investments purposes, in the securities of the index and in ADRs, GDRs based on the securities in the index. The index is designed to provide exposure to exchange-listed companies that are positioned to benefit from the increased adoption of technologies focused on improving the efficiency of renewable energy production and/or mitigating the adverse environmental effects of resource consumption. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X CleanTech ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx Global CleanTech 指數的價格和收益率表現（未計費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該基金將至少 80% 的總資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於指數證券以及基於指數證券的 ADR、GDR。該指數旨在為交易所上市公司提供投資機會，這些公司能夠從更多地採用專注於提高再生能源生產效率和/或減輕資源消耗對環境的不利影響的技術中受益。它是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Target Range Fund seeks to provide capital appreciation, with a secondary objective of hedging risk. In pursuing its investment objectives, the fund adviser seeks to follow the methodology of the TOPS Global Equity Target RangeTM Index. However, the fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal conditions, approximately 80-85% of the fund's assets are expected to be invested in the cash collateral component upon the annual roll date in January. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree Target Range 基金旨在提供資本增值，次要目標是對沖風險。在追求投資目標時，基金顧問力求遵循 TOPS 全球股票目標範圍™ 指數的方法。然而，該基金是主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」）。在正常情況下，大約 80-85% 的基金資產預計將在一月份的年度展期日投資於現金抵押品部分。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: JPMorgan Nasdaq Equity Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve this objective by (1) creating an actively managed portfolio of equity securities comprised significantly of those included in the fund's primary benchmark, the Nasdaq-100 Index (the Benchmark), and (2) through equity-linked notes (ELNs), selling call options with exposure to the Benchmark. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通納斯達克股票溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。該基金力求透過以下方式實現這一目標：(1) 創建一個積極管理的股本證券投資組合，其中主要包括基金主要基準納斯達克 100 指數（基準）中包含的證券，以及 (2) 透過股票掛鉤票據 (ELN) 出售與基準敞口相關的看漲期權。它是非多元化的。

info.description: KraneShares Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the MerQube Global Humanoid and Embodied Intelligence Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in instruments in its underlying index or in instruments that have economic characteristics similar to those in the index. The index is an equal weighted index designed to measure the performance of companies involved in the advancement of humanoid and embodied intelligence technology or acting as a supply chain solution for a humanoid and embodied intelligence company. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: KraneShares 全球類人生物和具體智慧指數 ETF 力求提供在未計費用和支出之前與 MerQube 全球類人生物和具體智慧指數大致對應的投資結果。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於其標的指數中的工具或與指數中具有相似經濟特徵的工具。該指數是一個等權重指數，旨在衡量參與人形和實體智慧技術進步或為人形和實體智慧公司提供供應鏈解決方案的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Northern Trust Short-Term Tax-Exempt Bond ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the ICE Short Term Focused Municipal Bond Index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of the investment-grade segment of the U.S. municipal bond market with maturities of less than five years as determined by ICE Data Indices, LLC, the index provider. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in debt instruments that pay interest that is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Northern Trust 短期免稅債券 ETF 尋求與 ICE 短期重點市政債券指數的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在衡量由指數提供者 ICE Data Indices, LLC 確定的期限少於五年的美國市政債券市場投資等級部分的表現。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於支付利息且免繳常規聯邦所得稅的債務工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2030 Municipal Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income that is exempt from regular federal income taxes while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the "Adviser" or "SSGA FM") invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2030, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2030 市政債券 ETF 旨在最大限度地提高免繳常規聯邦所得稅的當前收入，同時尋求資本保全。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.（「顧問」或「SSGA FM」）將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資，其收入免徵常規聯邦所得稅。該基金主要投資於 2030 年到期的市政債券，其中可能包括嵌入發行人看漲期權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Global X Artificial Intelligence & Technology ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Indxx Artificial Intelligence & Big Data Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to track the performance of companies involved in the development and utilization of artificial intelligence ("AI") and big data. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X 人工智慧與科技 ETF 尋求提供與 Indxx 人工智慧與大數據指數（「基礎指數」）未計費用和開支前的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於相關指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤參與人工智慧（「AI」）和大數據開發和利用的公司的表現。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Idea Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 18, 2025 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.
info.description_zh: Idea Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月18日，總部位於加州洛杉磯。

info.description: T. Rowe Price Health Care ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund normally invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of health care companies. The manager defines health care companies as companies engaged in health care innovations, such as developing new and effective therapies; pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; life sciences tools and services; managed health care; and/or health care equipment, supplies, providers, services, distributors, and facilities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: T. Rowe Price 醫療保健 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於醫療保健公司的證券。這位經理將醫療保健公司定義為從事醫療保健創新的公司，例如開發新的有效療法；藥品；生物技術；生命科學工具和服務；管理醫療保健；和/或醫療保健設備、用品、提供者、服務、分銷商和設施。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Nasdaq Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM Index. Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index has been designed based upon the principle that the asset class exhibiting the highest levels of "relative strength," based on current prices, will be the asset class with the best performance over the near term.
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright DALI 1 ETF 尋求的投資結果通常與納斯達克 Dorsey Wright DALI 1 TM 指數的價格和收益率（基金費用和開支之前）相對應。在正常情況下，基金將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數的設計原則是，根據當前價格，表現出最高水準「相對強度」的資產類別將是近期表現最好的資產類別。

info.description: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF seeks long-term growth through capital appreciation. Under normal conditions, the fund typically invests in equity securities of U.S. and foreign companies, including common stocks, preferred stocks, and securities convertible into common or preferred stocks. It can invest in companies from a wide range of industries and of various sizes. The fund will invest primarily in mid and small-size companies.
info.description_zh: F/m Emerald Special Situations ETF 透過資本增值尋求長期成長。在正常情況下，該基金通常投資於美國和外國公司的股本證券，包括普通股、優先股以及可轉換為普通股或優先股的證券。它可以投資各個行業和各種規模的公司。該基金將主要投資於中小型企業。

info.description: Goldman Sachs MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker ETF seeks to provide investment results that closely correspond, before fees and expenses, to the performance of the MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker Index (Net, USD, Unhedged). The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in securities included in its underlying index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The index seeks to approximate the returns of private equity investments by replicating region, sector and style exposures through publicly listed equities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤 ETF 力求提供在費用和開支之前與 MSCI 世界私募股權回報追蹤指數（淨值、美元、未對沖）表現密切對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的總資產投資於其標的指數中包含的證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該指數旨在透過公開上市股票複製地區、行業和風格的風險敞口來估算私募股權投資的回報率。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 High Yield Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD High Yield Corporate Bond 2034 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as "junk bonds") with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2034 (collectively, "2034 Bonds"). The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2034 高收益企業債券 ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares 美元高收益企業債券 2034 指數的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。該指數旨在衡量以美元計價的高收益公司債（通常稱為「垃圾債券」）投資組合的表現，這些債券在 2034 年到期，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」（統稱為「2034 年債券」）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Defiance Quantum ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the BlueStar Quantum Computing and Machine Learning Index (the "index"). The fund uses a "passive management" (or indexing) approach to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The index consists of a modified equal-weighted portfolio of the stock of companies that derive at least 50% of their annual revenue or operating activity from the development of quantum computing and machine learning technology.
info.description_zh: Defiance Quantum ETF 旨在追蹤藍星量子計算和機器學習指數（「指數」）扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該基金採用「被動管理」（或指數化）方法來追蹤該指數扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該指數由經過修改的等權重公司股票投資組合組成，這些公司的年收入或營運活動至少有 50% 來自量子計算和機器學習技術的發展。

info.description: Keysight Technologies, Inc. engages in the provision of electronic design and test solutions that are used in the design, development, manufacture, installation, deployment, validation, optimization, and secure operation of electronics systems to communications, networking, and electronics industries. It operates through the Communications Solutions Group (CSG) and Electronic Industrial Solutions Group (EISG) segments. The CSG segment serves customers spanning the global commercial communications and aerospace, defense, and government end markets. The EISG segment offers test and measurement solutions across electronic industrial end markets, focusing on applications in the automotive, and energy industry and measurement solutions for semiconductor design and manufacturing, consumer electronics, education, and general electronics manufacturing. The company was founded by William R. Hewlett and David Packard in 1937 and is headquartered in Santa Rosa, CA.
info.description_zh: 是德科技公司致力於提供電子設計和測試解決方案，這些解決方案用於通訊、網路和電子行業電子系統的設計、開發、製造、安裝、部署、驗證、最佳化和安全操作。它透過通訊解決方案集團（CSG）和電子工業解決方案集團（EISG）部門運作。 CSG 部門為全球商業通訊、航空航太、國防和政府終端市場的客戶提供服務。 EISG 部門提供跨電子工業終端市場的測試和測量解決方案，重點關注汽車和能源產業的應用以及半導體設計和製造、消費性電子、教育和通用電子製造的測量解決方案。該公司由 William R. Hewlett 和 David Packard 於 1937 年創立，總部位於加州聖羅莎。

info.description: Marathon Petroleum Corp. engages in the refining, marketing, and transportation of petroleum products. It operates through the Refining and Marketing, and Midstream segments. The Refining and Marketing segment includes refining crude oil and other feedstocks, purchasing ethanol, and refined products for resale and distribution of refined products. The Midstream segment refers to transportation, storing, distribution, and marketing of crude oil and refined products. The company was founded in 1887 and is headquartered in Findlay, OH.
info.industry_zh: 石油與天然氣精煉與行銷
info.description_zh: 馬拉松石油公司從事石油產品的精煉、行銷和運輸。它透過煉油和行銷以及中游部門運作。煉油和行銷部門包括煉油原油和其他原料、採購乙醇以及用於轉售和分銷煉油產品的煉油產品。中游部門是指原油和成品油的運輸、儲存、分銷和行銷。該公司成立於 1887 年，總部位於俄亥俄州芬德利。

info.description: Centurion Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 18, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Centurion Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年1月18日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: VanEck Fallen Angel High Yield Bond ETF seeks to replicate as closely as possible, before fees and expenses, the price and yield performance of ICE US Fallen Angel High Yield 10% Constrained Index (the "Fallen Angel Index"). The fund normally invests at least 80% of its total assets in securities that comprise the fund's benchmark index. The index is comprised of below investment grade corporate bonds denominated in U.S. dollars that were rated investment grade at the time of issuance.
info.description_zh: VanEck Fallen Angel 高收益債券 ETF 力求在扣除費用和開支之前盡可能接近複製 ICE 美國 Fallen Angel 高收益 10% 約束指數（「Fallen Angel 指數」）的價格和收益率表現。該基金通常將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於構成該基金基準指數的證券。該指數由以美元計價的低於投資等級的公司債券組成，這些債券在發行時被評為投資等級。

info.description: Beta Bionics, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical device company. It engages in the design, development, and commercialization of solutions for insulin-requiring people with diabetes. The company was founded by Edward R. Damiano on October 21, 2015 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Beta Bionics, Inc. 是一家商業階段的醫療器材公司。它致力於為需要胰島素的糖尿病患者設計、開發和商業化解決方案。該公司由 Edward R. Damiano 於 2015 年 10 月 21 日創立，總部位於加州歐文。

info.description: Blackrock Short-Term California Muni Bond ETF seeks to maximize tax-free current income by investing in short-term municipal bonds issued in the State of California. Under normal circumstances, the fund will primarily invest in U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade short-term fixed- and floating-rate municipal securities issued by California with remaining maturities of five years or less, such as municipal bonds, municipal notes and variable rate demand obligations, as well as money market instruments and registered investment companies. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德短期加州市政債券 ETF 尋求透過投資加州發行的短期市政債券來最大化免稅當期收入。一般情況下，該基金將主要投資於加州發行的、剩餘期限為五年或以下的以美元計價的投資等級短期固定和浮動利率市政證券，例如市政債券、市政票據和浮動利率即期債券，以及貨幣市場工具和註冊投資公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Calamos Investments LLC. It is managed by Calamos Advisors LLC. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in a portfolio of convertible securities, investment grade and below investment grade bonds, loans, equity-linked notes, and floating rate securities. The fund also invests through derivatives such as options. It employs fundamental analysis with a top-down global macroeconomic approach to create its portfolio. Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund was formed on March 11, 2014 and is domiciled in the United States.
info.description_zh: Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 是 Calamos Investments LLC 推出的封閉式固定收益共同基金。它由 Calamos Advisors LLC 管理。該基金投資於美國的固定收益市場。它主要投資於可轉換證券、投資等級及低於投資等級債券、貸款、股票掛鉤票據和浮動利率證券的投資組合。該基金也透過選擇權等衍生性商品進行投資。它採用基本面分析和自上而下的全球宏觀經濟方法來創建其投資組合。 Calamos Dynamic Convertible and Income Fund 成立於 2014 年 3 月 11 日，註冊地為美國。

info.description: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF seeks stment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of DraftKings Inc. (Nasdaq: DKNG). The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that attempts to achieve two times (200%) the daily percentage change in the share price of the underlying security by employing derivatives, namely swap agreements and/or listed options contracts. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Daily Target 2X Long DKNG ETF 尋求在費用和開支之前，DraftKings Inc.（納斯達克股票代碼：DKNG）股價每日百分比變化兩倍（200%）的評估結果。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），試圖透過使用衍生性商品（即掉期協議和/或上市選擇權合約）來實現標的證券股價每日百分比變化的兩倍（200%）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Roman DBDR Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was incorporated for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 25, 2024 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Roman DBDR Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 7 月 25 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: Lakefront Biotherapeutics is a biotechnology company, which engages in the identification and development of small molecule and antibody therapies. Its clinical pipeline includes filgotinib, GLP3667, Toledo program, and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. The company was founded by Onno van de Stolpe, Rudi Pauwels, and Helmuth van Es on June 30, 1999 and is headquartered in Mechelen, Belgium.
info.description_zh: Lakefront Biotherapeutics 是一家生物技術公司，從事小分子和抗體療法的鑑定和開發。其臨床管線包括filgotinib、GLP3667、Toledo計畫、特發性肺纖維化等。該公司由 Onno van de Stolpe、Rudi Pauwels 和 Helmuth van Es 於 1999 年 6 月 30 日創立，總部位於比利時梅赫倫。

info.description: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination. The company was founded on April 16, 2021 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: Newbridge Acquisition Ltd. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是實現合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、資本重組、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2021年4月16日，總部位於香港。

info.description: QuantumScape Corp. engages in developing next-generation solid-state lithium-metal batteries. The company's next-generation batteries are designed to enable greater energy density, faster charging, and enhanced safety to support the transition away from legacy energy sources toward a lower-carbon future. The company was founded by Jagdeep Singh, Tim Holme, and Fritz B. Prinz in May 2010 and is headquartered in San Jose, CA.
info.description_zh: QuantumScape Corp. 致力於開發新一代固態鋰金屬電池。該公司的下一代電池旨在實現更高的能量密度、更快的充電速度和更高的安全性，以支持從傳統能源向低碳未來的過渡。該公司由 Jagdeep Singh、Tim Holme 和 Fritz B. Prinz 於 2010 年 5 月創立，總部位於加州聖荷西。

info.description: Velo3D, Inc. operates as a technology company, which engages in developing and manufacturing metal laser sintering printing machines for 3D printing. Its products include assure system, flow software, sapphire printer & sapphire XC. The company was founded by Benyamin Buller in June 2014 and is headquartered in Fremont, CA.
info.description_zh: Velo3D, Inc.是一家科技公司，致力於開發和製造用於3D列印的金屬雷射燒結印表機。其產品包括保固系統、流程軟體、藍寶石印表機和藍寶石XC。該公司由 Benyamin Buller 於 2014 年 6 月創立，總部位於加州弗里蒙特。

info.description: Wisdomtree Core Laddered Municipal Fund seeks to generate current income that is exempt from federal income taxes. The manager seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily through investments in municipal debt securities whose interest payments generally are exempt from U.S. federal income taxes. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in municipal debt securities. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree Core Laddered 市政基金尋求產生免徵聯邦所得稅的當前收入。該管理人主要透過投資市政債務證券來實現其投資目標，這些證券的利息支付通常免徵美國聯邦所得稅。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於市政債務證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2029. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2029.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2029 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2029 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2029 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 1000 Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 1000  Index that measures the investment return of large-capitalization stocks in the United States. The fund advisor employs an indexing investment approach designed to track the performance of the Russell 1000 Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of large-capitalization stocks in the United States. The Advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 1000 Index Fund ETF Shares旨在追蹤衡量美國大盤股投資回報的Russell 1000指數的表現。基金顧問採用指數投資方法，旨在追蹤 Russell 1000 指數的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國大盤股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。

info.description: iShares 0-5 Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Markit iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade 0-5 Index composed of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds with remaining maturities of less than five years. The fund will invest at least 80% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index, and the fund will invest at least 90% of its assets in fixed income securities of the types included in the underlying index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of U.S. dollar-denominated investment-grade corporate debt.
info.description_zh: iShares 0-5 年投資等級公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤 Markit iBoxx 美元流動投資等級 0-5 指數的投資結果，該指數由以美元計價、剩餘期限少於五年的投資等級公司債組成。該基金將至少80%的資產投資於標的指數的成分證券，並且該基金將至少90%的資產投資於標的指數所包含類型的固定收益證券。該指數旨在反映以美元計價的投資等級公司債務的表現。

info.description: Ascentage Pharma Group International Co., Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. It engages in the development of novel therapies for cancers, hepatitis B virus, or HBV, and age-related diseases. The company was founded by Da Jun Yang, Wang Shao Meng and Ming Guo in May 2009 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 亞盛醫藥集團國際有限公司是一家臨床階段的生技公司。它致力於開發癌症、乙型肝炎病毒或 HBV 以及與年齡相關的疾病的新療法。該公司由楊大軍、王少萌和郭明於2009年5月創立，總部位於中國蘇州。

info.description: US Treasury 3 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index (GA03). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 3-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 3-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 3 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 3 年期美國國債指數 (GA03) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美銀美林目前 3 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 3 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: F/m Opportunistic Income ETF seeks is to maximize total return, including both income and appreciation, by identifying undervalued and opportunistic sectors and securities in the U.S. fixed income markets. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") managed by F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC (the "adviser") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in fixed-income securities.
info.description_zh: F/m 機會主義收入 ETF 尋求透過識別美國固定收益市場中被低估和機會主義的行業和證券來最大化總回報，包括收入和升值。該基金為一檔主動式管理型交易所交易基金（「ETF」），由 F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC（「顧問」）管理，旨在透過投資固定收益證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: IDX Dynamic Fixed Income ETF seeks high current income. The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund ("ETF") that is a "fund of funds," meaning that it normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, including any borrowings for investment purposes, in other ETFs that invest in various sectors of the debt markets, including corporate bonds, U.S. government and agency securities, private debt, foreign bonds (including emerging markets), foreign sovereign bonds, convertible securities, Treasury Inflation Protected Securities (TIPS), bank loans, asset-backed securities, mortgage-backed securities, and cash equivalent instruments. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: IDX 動態固定收益 ETF 追求高當期報酬。該基金是主動管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”），屬於“基金中的基金”，這意味著它通常將至少 80% 的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於投資於債務市場各個領域的其他 ETF，包括公司債券、美國政府和機構證券、私人債務、外國債券（包括新興市場）、外國主權債券、可轉換證券(TIPS)、銀行貸款、資產支持證券證券、抵押貸款支持證券和現金等價工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2029 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2029, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2029 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2029年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG 1-5 Year USD Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results of the Bloomberg MSCI US Corporate 1-5 Year ESG Focus Index. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index and may invest up to 10% of its assets in certain futures, options and swap contracts, cash and cash equivalents. The index has been developed by Bloomberg Finance L.P. and its affiliates with environmental, social and governance ("ESG") rating inputs from MSCI ESG Research LLC pursuant to an agreement between MSCI ESG Research and Bloomberg Index Services Limited, a subsidiary of Bloomberg.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG 1-5 年期美元公司債 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博 MSCI 美國企業 1-5 年期 ESG 焦點指數的投資結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於標的指數的組成證券，並可能將最多 10% 的資產投資於某些期貨、選擇權和掉期合約、現金和現金等價物。該指數由 Bloomberg Finance L.P. 及其附屬公司根據 MSCI ESG Research 與 Bloomberg 子公司 Bloomberg Index Services Limited 的協議，可利用 MSCI ESG Research LLC 提供的環境、社會和治理（「ESG」）評級資訊開發。

info.description: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses, which refer to throughout this prospectus as initial business combination. The company was founded on June 9, 2025 and is headquartered in Boca Raton, FL.
info.description_zh: Bitcoin Infrastructure Acquisition Corp. Ltd. 作為一家空白支票公司運作。其成立的目的是与一个或多个企业进行合并、合并、股份交换、资产收购、股份购买、重组或类似的业务合并，在本招股说明书中将其称为初始业务合并。該公司成立於 2025 年 6 月 9 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州博卡拉頓。

info.description: BlackRock High Yield ETF seeks to maximize total return, consistent with income generation and prudent investment management. The fund invests primarily in non-investment grade bonds with maturities of ten years or less. It normally invests at least 80% of its net assets, plus any borrowings for investment purposes, in high yield investments and other financial instruments with economic characteristics similar to such investments. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 貝萊德高收益 ETF 尋求最大化總回報，與創收和審慎的投資管理保持一致。該基金主要投資於期限為十年或更短的非投資等級債券。它通常將至少80%的淨資產以及任何用於投資目的的借款投資於高收益投資和具有與此類投資類似的經濟特徵的其他金融工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Tailwind 2.0 Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. The company was founded on May 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Greenwich, CT.
info.description_zh: Tailwind 2.0 Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。該公司成立於2025年5月29日，總部位於康乃狄克州格林威治。

info.description: Cabana Target Leading Sector Moderate ETF seeks to provide long-term growth. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily by allocating its assets among ETFs that invest in securities of companies in the various sectors of the U.S. market: communication services, consumer discretionary, consumer staples, energy, financials, health care, industrials, information technology, materials, real estate, and utilities. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Cabana Target 領先產業溫和 ETF 尋求提供長期成長。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要透過將其資產分配給投資於美國市場各行業公司證券的 ETF 來實現其投資目標：通訊服務、非必需消費品、必需消費品、能源、金融、醫療保健、工業、資訊科技、材料、房地產和公用事業。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2030 Treasury Bond ETF is a passively managed, non-diversified fixed-income strategy designed to track the performance of the ICE BulletShares US Treasury Bond 2030 Index by investing in U.S. dollar-denominated Treasury bonds maturing in the year 2030. The fund combines the structure of a defined-maturity investment with the liquidity of an exchange-traded vehicle, maintaining a systematic monthly rebalancing cycle and executing a mandatory cash liquidation and distribution on or about December 15, 2030
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2030 公債 ETF 是一種被動管理、非多元化的固定收益策略，旨在透過投資於 2030 年到期的美元計價國債來追蹤 ICE BulletShares 美國國債 2030 指數的表現。該基金將固定期限投資的結構與交易所交易工具的流動性相結合，維持系統性的每月再平衡週期並執行強制現金清算並於 2030 年 12 月 15 日左右分發

info.description: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation with capital preservation as a secondary objective. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that is primarily a "fund of funds." The Advisor seeks to achieve it's investment objective by investing in ETFs that invest primarily in domestic and foreign equity securities of any capitalization, including in emerging markets. The fund invests in fixed income ETFs with a short or ultra-short duration, money market funds, cash and cash equivalents ("Defensive Investments"). It may invest in affiliated and unaffiliated ETFs.
info.description_zh: AdvisorShares Dorsey Wright FSM All Cap World ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值，並將資本保值作為次要目標。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），主要是「基金中的基金」。該顧問尋求透過投資 ETF 來實現其投資目標，這些 ETF 主要投資於任何資本的國內外股票證券，包括新興市場。本基金投資於短期或超短期固定收益ETF、貨幣市場基金、現金及現金等價物（「防禦性投資」）。它可以投資關聯和非關聯的 ETF。

info.description: Nuveen Preferred And Income ETF seeks to provide a high level of current income and total return. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to pursue its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of the sum of its net assets and the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes in preferred securities and other income producing securities.
info.description_zh: Nuveen Preferred And Income ETF 力求提供高水準的當前收入和總回報。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過在正常市場條件下將其淨資產總和以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額的至少 80% 投資於優先證券和其他創收證券來實現其投資目標。

info.description: KraneShares Artificial Intelligence and Technology ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, track the performance of the Solactive Etna Artificial General Intelligence Index. The underlying index is a modified, free float adjusted market capitalization weighted index designed to measure the equity performance of companies in developed markets with exposure to AI businesses. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests principally in instruments in the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: KraneShares 人工智慧和技術 ETF 尋求提供在費用和支出之前追蹤 Solactive Etna 人工智慧指數表現的投資結果。基礎指數是經過修改的、自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在衡量已開發市場中從事人工智慧業務的公司的股票表現。在正常情況下，該基金主要投資於相關指數的工具。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: PMorgan Equity Premium Yield ETF is an actively managed, non-diversified fund that seeks to provide a high level of current income and total return by combining a defensive U.S. large-cap equity portfolio with an proprietary options overlay. The strategy utilizes a data science-driven investment process to select a diversified basket of equities with attractive risk-return characteristics while systematically selling call option spreads on the S&P 500 Index to harvest premiums and mitigate volatility.
info.description_zh: PMorgan Equity Premium Yield ETF 是一檔主動管理的非多元化基金，旨在透過將防禦性美國大盤股投資組合與專有選擇權疊加相結合，提供高水準的當前收入和總回報。該策略利用數據科學驅動的投資流程來選擇具有有吸引力的風險回報特徵的多元化一籃子股票，同時系統地出售標準普爾 500 指數的看漲期權價差，以獲取溢價並減輕波動性。

info.description: OptimizeRx Corp. is digital health company, engaged in the provision of digital health messaging via electronic health records, which serve as a direct channel for pharmaceutical companies to communicate with healthcare providers. It offers electronic health record (EHR) workflow solutions which include financial messaging, patient education, and brand messaging and brand support. The company was founded by David A. Harrell in 2006 and is headquartered in Waltham, MA.
info.description_zh: OptimizeRx Corp. 是一家數位健康公司，致力於透過電子健康記錄提供數位健康訊息，這是製藥公司與醫療保健提供者溝通的直接管道。它提供電子健康記錄 (EHR) 工作流程解決方案，其中包括財務訊息傳遞、患者教育以及品牌訊息傳遞和品牌支援。該公司由 David A. Harrell 於 2006 年創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州沃爾瑟姆。

info.description: Invesco BulletShares 2031 Treasury Bond ETF is a passively managed, non-diversified fixed-income strategy designed to track the performance of the ICE BulletShares US Treasury Bond 2031 Index by investing in U.S. dollar-denominated Treasury bonds maturing in the year 2031. The fund combines the structure of a defined-maturity investment with the liquidity of an exchange-traded vehicle, maintaining a systematic monthly rebalancing cycle and executing a mandatory cash liquidation and distribution on or about December 15, 2031
info.description_zh: Invesco BulletShares 2031 公債 ETF 是一種被動管理、非多元化的固定收益策略，旨在透過投資於 2031 年到期的美元計價國債來追蹤 ICE BulletShares 美國國債 2031 指數的表現。該基金將固定期限投資的結構與交易所交易工具的流動性相結合，維持系統性的每月再平衡週期並執行強制現金清算並於 2031 年 12 月 15 日左右分發

info.description: Ocean Park High Income ETF seeks to provide total return and to limit exposure to downside risk. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by tactically allocating the fund's assets between unaffiliated higher yielding ETFs ("High Income ETFs"), long-term Treasury ETFs ("Treasury ETFs") and cash equivalents. Under normal market conditions, the advisor expects to invest substantially all of its assets in high income ETFs.
info.description_zh: 海洋公園高收入 ETF 旨在提供總回報並限制下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過戰術性地在獨立的高收益 ETF（「高收入 ETF」）、長期國債 ETF（「國債 ETF」）和現金等價物之間分配基金資產來實現其投資目標。在正常市場條件下，顧問預計將其大部分資產投資於高收益 ETF。

info.description: Innovator Nasdaq-100 10 Buffer ETF - Quarterly seeks capital appreciation with a measure of downside protection by providing investors with returns that match the price return of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in FLexible EXchange Options that reference the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 創新者 Nasdaq-100 10 Buffer ETF - 每季度透過為投資者提供與 Invesco QQQ TrustSM，系列 1 的價格回報相匹配的回報，尋求資本增值和一定程度的下行保護。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於參考 Invesco QQQ TrustSM，系列 1 的彈性交易選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2030. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2030.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2030 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2030 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2030 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Franklin Multisector Income ETF seeks to provide a high level of current income; capital appreciation over the long term is a secondary goal. Under normal market conditions, the fund invests in a diversified portfolio of U.S. and foreign debt securities across multiple fixed income sectors. Debt securities include all varieties of fixed, variable and floating rate income securities, including bonds, U.S. and foreign government and agency securities, corporate loans (and loan participations) and mortgage-backed securities and other asset-backed securities.
info.description_zh: 富蘭克林多部門收入 ETF 力求提供高水準的當期收入；長期資本增值是次要目標。在正常市場條件下，該基金投資於多個固定收益領域的美國和外債證券的多元化投資組合。債務證券包括各種固定、可變和浮動利率收入證券，包括債券、美國和外國政府和機構證券、公司貸款（和貸款參與）以及抵押貸款支持證券和其他資產支持證券。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2031 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2031. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2031.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2031 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2031 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2031 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: NEOS NASDAQ-100(R) High Income ETF seeks to generate high monthly income in a tax efficient manner with the potential for equity appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in a portfolio of stocks that make up the Nasdaq-100 Index and a call options strategy, that consists of written (sold) call options on the Nasdaq-100 Index. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in securities, or derivative instruments linked to securities, of companies that are included in the reference index.
info.description_zh: NEOS NASDAQ-100(R) 高收入 ETF 力求以節稅的方式產生高額月收入，並具有股票升值的潛力。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資構成 Nasdaq-100 指數的股票組合和看漲期權策略（包括 Nasdaq-100 指數的書面（出售）看漲期權）來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上投資目的借款，將投資於參考指數所包含公司的證券或與證券掛鉤的衍生性商品。

info.description: Hartford Dynamic Bond ETF seeks to provide long-term total return. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (including any borrowings for investment purposes) in fixed-income securities. The fund normally invests in both investment grade fixed income securities and non-investment grade fixed income securities (also known as "junk bonds").
info.description_zh: Hartford Dynamic Bond ETF 尋求提供長期總回報。在正常情況下，基金將至少80%的淨資產（包括任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於固定收益證券。本基金通常投資於投資等級固定收益證券和非投資等級固定收益證券（也稱為「垃圾債券」）。

info.description: JPMorgan U.S. Tech Leaders ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund will invest primarily in equity securities issued by technology and technology-enabled companies which the adviser believes are leaders and where the magnitude and/or duration of future growth for these companies is underappreciated by the market.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通美國科技領袖 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金將主要投資於顧問認為處於領先地位的技術和技術支援公司發行的股本證券，並且這些公司未來成長的規模和/或持續時間被市場低估。

info.description: Vaneck Technology Trusector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing, under normal market circumstances, at least 80% of its total assets in equity securities of information technology-related companies or instruments that provide exposure to information technology-related companies as determined by the adviser. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Vaneck Technology Trusector ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過在正常市場情況下將其總資產的至少80%投資於資訊科技相關公司的股本證券或顧問確定的為資訊科技相關公司提供投資的工具來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2031 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2031, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2031 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2031年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人買權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Melar Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on March 11, 2024 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Melar Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司成立於2024年3月11日，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: Defiance Nasdaq 100 Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index subject to a limit on potential investment gains is the secondary consideration. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the value of the index, subject to a limit on potential gains from increases in the value of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Nasdaq 100 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；納斯達克 100 指數的表現受到潛在投資收益限制是次要考慮因素。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），尋求當前收入，同時維持間接接觸指數價值的機會，但受到指數價值上漲潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WisdomTree Emerging Markets Quality Dividend Growth Fund seeks income and capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing primarily in emerging market dividend-paying common stocks with growth characteristics. The adviser, using a disciplined model-based process focused on a long-term approach to investing, seeks to identify dividend-paying companies with strong corporate profitability and sustainable growth characteristics. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WisdomTree新興市場優質股息成長基金尋求收入和資本增值。該基金尋求透過主要投資於具有成長特徵的新興市場派息普通股來實現其投資目標。該顧問採用基於模型的嚴格流程，專注於長期投資方法，力求識別具有強勁企業盈利能力和可持續增長特徵的派息公司。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2032 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2032, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2032 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2032年到期的公司債，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: US Treasury 7 Year Note ETF seeks investment results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the ICE BofA Current 7-Year US Treasury Index (GA07). Under normal market conditions, The adviser seeks to achieve the fund's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the component securities of the underlying index. The ICE BofA Current 7-Year US Treasury Index is a one-security index comprised of the most recently issued 7-year U.S. treasury note.
info.description_zh: 美國國債 7 年期公債 ETF 尋求與 ICE 美國銀行當前 7 年期美國國債指數 (GA07) 的價格和收益率表現大致相對應的投資結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，顧問尋求透過將至少 80% 的基金淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的指數的成分證券來實現基金的投資目標。 ICE 美銀美林目前 7 年期美國國債指數是一種單一證券指數，由最近發行的 7 年期美國國債組成。

info.description: Sophus Capital Emerging Market Small Cap ETF is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation by investing at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities-including common and preferred stock, depositary receipts (ADRs, GDRs, EDRs), and ETFs-issued by small-capitalization companies located in or tied economically to emerging and frontier markets. The strategy combines quantitative screening via a proprietary alpha model ranking approximately 4,500 small-cap stocks with bottom-up fundamental analysis to build a diversified portfolio targeting companies positioned for sustainable earnings growth and positive earnings revisions at attractive valuations.
info.description_zh: Sophus Capital Emerging Market Small Cap ETF 是一檔主動管理基金，透過將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於由位於新興和前沿市場或與新興和前沿市場經濟相關的小型資本公司發行的股本證券（包括普通股和優先股、存託憑證（ADR、GDR、EDR）和 ETF）來尋求長期資本增值。該策略將透過專有的阿爾法模型對約 4,500 隻小型股進行排名的定量篩選與自下而上的基本面分析結合起來，建立一個多元化的投資組合，目標是那些定位於可持續盈利增長和以有吸引力的估值進行積極盈利修正的公司。

info.description: Xtrackers Artificial Intelligence and Big Data ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq Global Artificial Intelligence and Big DataTM Index. The index is designed to track the performance of a selection of companies from global developed and emerging markets engaged in the following themes (Artificial Intelligence) and its sub-themes (Deep learning, Image recognition, Natural language processing, Speech recognition & chatbots). The fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets (but typically far more) in component securities of the underlying index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Xtrackers 人工智慧和大數據 ETF 尋求與納斯達克全球人工智慧和大數據TM指數未計費用和開支之前的表現大致相符的投資結果。該指數旨在追蹤來自全球已開發和新興市場的精選公司的業績，這些公司從事以下主題（人工智慧）及其子主題（深度學習、圖像識別、自然語言處理、語音識別和聊天機器人）。該基金將至少將其總資產的 80%（但通常更多）投資於基礎指數的組成證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Harte-Hanks, Inc. is a global customer experience company operating in three business segments: Marketing Services, Customer Care, and Fulfillment & Logistics Services. The company's mission is to partner with clients to provide them with a robust customer-experience, or CX, strategy, data-driven analytics and actionable insights combined with seamless program execution to better understand, attract, and engage their customers. Its services include strategic planning, data strategy, performance analytics, creative development, and execution, technology enablement, marketing automation, B2B and B2C e-commerce, cross-channel customer care, and product, print, and mail fulfillment. The company was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Chelmsford, MA.
info.description_zh: Harte-Hanks, Inc. 是一家全球客戶體驗公司，經營三個業務部門：行銷服務、客戶服務以及履行和物流服務。該公司的使命是與客戶合作，為他們提供強大的客戶體驗（CX）、策略、數據驅動的分析和可行的見解，並結合無縫的專案執行，以更好地了解、吸引和吸引客戶。其服務包括策略規劃、數據策略、績效分析、創意開發和執行、技術支援、行銷自動化、B2B 和 B2C 電子商務、跨通路客戶服務以及產品、印刷和郵件履行。該公司成立於 1923 年，總部位於馬薩諸塞州切姆斯福德。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Income Advantage ETF seeks total return through current income and long-term growth of capital. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by: (1) investing in a portfolio of U.S. equity securities designed to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the NASDAQ-100 Index or U.S.-listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that seek to track the performance of the index, or both, and (2) utilizing an options-based income strategy implemented through equity-linked notes (ELNs) with exposure to either the index or ETFs tracking the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ Income Advantage ETF 透過當前收入和資本的長期成長尋求總回報。該基金力求透過以下方式實現其投資目標：(1) 投資於旨在追蹤 NASDAQ-100 指數或旨在追蹤該指數表現的美國上市交易所交易基金 (ETF) 或兩者的表現（未計費用和開支）的美國股票證券投資組合，以及 (2) 利用透過股票掛鉤的票據 (ELN) 實施的基於期權的基於期權的貨幣策略，並投資於該指數或該指數 (ELN) 實施的基於期權的期權或該指數 ETF。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Wisdomtree 7-10 Year Laddered Treasury Fund ETF seeks to track the price and yield performance, before fees and expenses, of the Bloomberg US Treasury 7-10 Year Laddered Treasury Index. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. Treasuries that have a remaining maturity of seven to ten years and investments that have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to the economic characteristics of such Treasuries. The index is composed of fixed-rate coupon U.S. Treasury securities maturing in 7 to 10 years or with remaining maturities between 7 to 10 years.
info.description_zh: Wisdomtree 7-10 年階梯式國債基金 ETF 旨在追蹤彭博美國財政部 7-10 年階梯式國債指數（未計費用和支出）的價格和收益率表現。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的淨資產投資於剩餘期限為7至10年的美國國債以及與此類國債經濟特徵基本相似的投資。該指數由 7 至 10 年到期或剩餘期限為 7 至 10 年的固定利率美國公債組成。

info.description: Jpmorgan Healthcare Leaders ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund will invest primarily in equity securities issued by pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare services, healthcare technology, medical technology and life sciences companies which the adviser believes are leaders and where the magnitude and/or duration of future growth for these companies is underappreciated by the market. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in the equity securities of healthcare companies.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通醫療保健領袖 ETF 尋求提供長期資本增值。該基金將主要投資於製藥、生物技術、醫療保健服務、醫療保健技術、醫療技術和生命科學公司發行的股票證券，顧問認為這些公司處於領先地位，並且這些公司未來成長的規模和/或持續時間被市場低估。一般情況下，該基金至少80%的資產投資於醫療保健公司的股權證券。

info.description: STF Tactical Growth & Income ETF seeks long-term growth of capital and current income. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its investments among a combination of (i) U.S. equity securities or ETFs that, in the aggregate, seek to replicate the Nasdaq-100 Index, (ii) directly in, or in ETFs that hold, long-duration U.S. Treasury securities (the "Fixed Income Allocation"), and (iii) short-term U.S. Treasury bills, money market funds, and cash and/or cash equivalents (the "Cash Equivalents"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STF 戰術成長和收入 ETF 尋求資本和當前收入的長期成長。該基金是一款主動管理型 ETF，旨在透過將其投資分配到以下組合中來實現其投資目標：(i) 總體而言旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數的美國股本證券或 ETF，(ii) 直接投資於或持有長期美國國債的 ETF（「固定收益分配」），以及 (iii) 短期美國國庫、貨幣市場基金和現金和現金和現金等價物（現金等價物或現金等價物（現金等價物或現金等價物）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 and Bitcoin 75/25 Strategy ETF seeks to replicate, before fees and expenses, the total return of the S&P 500 and S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index 75/25 Blend Index. The index measures the weighted return performance of a multi-asset strategy that consists of a 75% weight in the S&P 500 Index and a 25% weight in the S&P CME Bitcoin Futures Index. The fund will invest approximately 75% of its assets in the stock of large U.S. companies that comprise the S&P 500 Index and will invest in Bitcoin futures contracts so that the total value of the Bitcoin to which the fund has economic exposure is approximately 25% of the assets of the fund.
info.description_zh: CYBER HORNET S&P 500 和比特幣 75/25 策略 ETF 旨在複製 S&P 500 和 S&P CME 比特幣期貨指數 75/25 混合指數的總回報（扣除費用和開支）。該指數衡量多元資產策略的加權回報表現，其中標普 500 指數佔 75% 的權重，標普 CME 比特幣期貨指數佔 25% 的權重。該基金將把約75%的資產投資於構成標準普爾500指數的美國大型公司的股票，並將投資於比特幣期貨合約，以便該基金所擁有的經濟風險的比特幣總價值約佔該基金資產的25%。

info.description: Calamos Nasdaq Autocallable Income ETF seeks to generate high monthly income while providing reduced downside risk through exposure to the MerQube Nasdaq-100 Vol Advantage Autocallable Index. The fund is a non-diversified, actively managed ETF that, under normal market conditions, seeks to invest at least 80% of its total assets in U.S. Treasuries, cash, cash equivalents, "box spreads" and unfunded total return swaps that provide exposure to the index. The fund will not attempt to replicate or track the index but will instead use financial instruments such as total return swaps to gain exposure to the level of the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Calamos Nasdaq Autocallable Income ETF 尋求產生高月收入，同時透過投資 MerQube Nasdaq-100 Vol Advantage Autocallable Index 來降低下行風險。該基金是一種非多元化、主動管理的 ETF，在正常市場條件下，尋求將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於美國國債、現金、現金等價物、「箱式利差」和提供指數敞口的無融資總回報掉期。該基金不會嘗試複製或追蹤該指數，而是會使用總回報掉期等金融工具來獲得指數水準的曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Hilton Small-Midcap Opportunity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Sub-Adviser uses its proprietary Small & Mid Cap Opportunities investment process ("SMCO Process") to seek risk-adjusted returns by investing in U.S. equity securities within the small- and mid-cap asset classes. The fund's portfolio will typically consist of between 50-75 stocks. The fund's portfolio will consistently consist of stocks that the Sub-Adviser deems fundamentally attractive and reasonably valued. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, will be invested in equity securities of small- and mid-capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: 希爾頓中小型股機會 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。副顧問使用其專有的中小型股機會投資流程（「SMCO 流程」），透過投資中小型資產類別內的美國股票證券來尋求風險調整後的回報。該基金的投資組合通常由 50-75 隻股票組成。該基金的投資組合將始終由副顧問認為具有基本吸引力且估值合理的股票組成。一般情況下，基金淨資產的至少80%，加上投資用途的借款，將投資於中小型公司的股本證券。

info.description: Nicola Mining, Inc. engages in the business of identification, acquisition, and exploration of mineral property in Canda. Its projects include New Craigmont Copper, Dominion Creek and Treasure Mountain Silver. The company was founded in March 1980 and is headquartered in Lower Nicola, Canada.
info.description_zh: Nicola Mining, Inc. 在加拿大從事礦產鑑定、收購和勘探業務。其項目包括New Craigmont Copper、Dominion Creek 和Treasure Mountain Silver。該公司成立於1980年3月，總部位於加拿大下尼古拉。

info.description: STF Tactical Growth ETF seeks long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by allocating its investments among a combination of (i) U.S. equity securities or ETFs that, in the aggregate, seek to replicate the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "Index Allocation"), (ii) directly in, or in ETFs that hold, long-duration U.S. Treasury securities (the "Fixed Income Allocation"), and (iii) short-term U.S. Treasury bills, money market funds, and cash and/or cash equivalents (the "Cash Equivalents"). It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: STF Tactical Growth ETF 尋求資本的長期成長。該基金是一款主動管理型 ETF，旨在透過將其投資分配到以下組合中來實現其投資目標：(i) 總體而言旨在複製納斯達克 100 指數的美國股本證券或 ETF（「指數配置」），(ii) 直接投資或持有長期美國國債的 ETF（「固定收益配置」），以及 (iii) 短期貨幣基金等價物、現金、現金、現金、現金、現金等價物或現金（現金或現金基金等現金、現金或現金基金等現金（它是非多元化的。

info.description: Alphadroid Defensive Sector Rotation ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the AlphaDroid EZ-RO Defensive Sector Rotation Index ("Defensive Sector Index" or the "Index"). The fund manager employs a "passive management" (or indexing) investment approach designed to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the index. The fund invests in various types of U.S. publicly traded ETFs that comprise the index ("Underlying ETFs") and therefore operates as a "fund-of-funds." The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Alphadroid 防禦性產業輪動 ETF 旨在追蹤 AlphaDroid EZ-RO 防禦性產業輪動指數（「防禦性產業指數」或「指數」）在扣除費用和支出之前的總回報表現。基金經理人採用「被動管理」（或指數化）投資方法，旨在追蹤指數未計費用和開支之前的總回報表現。該基金投資於構成該指數的各種類型的美國公開交易 ETF（「基礎 ETF」），因此以「基金中的基金」的形式運作。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2034 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2034, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2034 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，SSGA Funds Management, Inc.將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2034年到期的公司債券，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Goldman Sachs Nasdaq-100 Core Premium Income ETF seeks current income while maintaining prospects for capital appreciation. The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in equity investments of companies that are included in the fund's benchmark. The fund will generally seek to maintain style, capitalization and industry characteristics similar to its benchmark. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 高盛 Nasdaq-100 核心溢價收入 ETF 尋求當前收入，同時維持資本增值前景。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於納入該基金基準的公司的股權投資。該基金通常會尋求保持與其基準相似的風格、資本規模和行業特徵。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2034 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2034. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2034.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2034 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2034 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2034 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares seeks to track the performance of the Russell 1000 Growth Index. The index is designed to measure the performance of large-capitalization growth stocks in the United States. The Advisor attempts to replicate the target index by investing all, or substantially all, of its assets in the stocks that make up the index, holding each stock in approximately the same proportion as its weighting in the index. The fund may become non-diversified, as defined under the Investment Company Act of 1940, solely as a result of a change in relative market capitalization or index weighting of one or more constituents of the index.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Russell 1000 Growth Index Fund ETF Shares 旨在追蹤 Russell 1000 Growth Index 的表現。該指數旨在衡量美國大盤成長股的表現。顧問試圖透過將其全部或幾乎全部資產投資於構成指數的股票來複製目標指數，並以與其在指數中的權重大致相同的比例持有每隻股票。根據 1940 年《投資公司法》的定義，基金可能會變得非多元化，這僅僅是由於指數的一個或多個成分股的相對市值或指數權重變化的結果。

info.description: ProShares Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks investment results, before fees and expenses, that track the performance of the Nasdaq-100 Daily Covered Call Index. The index is designed to replicate the performance of an investment strategy that combines a long position in the Nasdaq-100 Index with a short position in Nasdaq-100 Index call options. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its total assets in component securities of the index or in instruments with similar economic characteristics. The fund is non-diversified. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: ProShares Nasdaq-100 高收入 ETF 尋求在費用和支出之前追蹤 Nasdaq-100 每日備兌買權指數表現的投資結果。該指數旨在複製將納斯達克 100 指數多頭頭寸與納斯達克 100 指數看漲期權空頭頭寸相結合的投資策略的績效。一般情況下，基金將至少80%的總資產投資於指數的組成證券或具有類似經濟特徵的工具。該基金是非多元化的。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF seeks to boost performance by generating high monthly income in a tax-efficient manner with the potential for enhanced equity appreciation in rising markets. The fund utilizes a multi-part strategy including a core 100% exposure to a portfolio of stocks that make up the Nasdaq-100 Index and an additional synthetic options strategy designed to create approximately 150% notional portfolio exposure to the index, while generating income through a data-driven call option overlay.
info.description_zh: NEOS Boosted Nasdaq-100 High Income ETF 尋求透過以節稅的方式產生高額月收入來提高業績，並有可能在新興市場中提高股票升值。該基金採用多部分策略，包括對構成納斯達克 100 指數的股票投資組合進行 100% 核心敞口，以及旨在創建對該指數約 150% 名義投資組合敞口的附加綜合期權策略，同時透過數據驅動的看漲期權疊加產生收入。

info.description: Fidelity NASDAQ Composite Index Track seeks to provide investment returns that closely correspond to the price and yield performance of the Nasdaq Composite Index. The fund normally invests at least 80% of assets in common stocks included in the index. The advisor uses statistical sampling techniques that take into account such factors as capitalization, industry exposures, dividend yield, price/earnings (P/E) ratio, price/book (P/B) ratio, and earnings growth to create a portfolio of securities listed in the Nasdaq Composite Index that have a similar investment profile to the entire index.
info.description_zh: 富達納斯達克綜合指數追蹤旨在提供與納斯達克綜合指數的價格和收益率表現密切相關的投資回報。該基金通常將至少 80% 的資產投資於該指數所包含的普通股。顧問使用統計抽樣技術，考慮資本化、行業風險、股息收益率、本益比 (P/E)、市淨率 (P/B) 比率和盈利增長等因素，創建納斯達克綜合指數中列出的與整個指數具有相似投資狀況的證券投資組合。

info.description: First Trust Developed Markets Ex-US AlphaDEX Fund seeks results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ AlphaDEX Developed Markets Ex-US Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to select stocks from the NASDAQ Developed Markets Ex-US Index that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust 已開發市場（美國除外）AlphaDEX 基金尋求與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX 已開發市場（美國除外）指數的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的結果。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法從納斯達克發達市場（美國除外）中選擇相對於傳統指數可產生正 alpha 或風險調整回報的股票。

info.description: SPDR SSGA My2035 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to maximize current income while seeking preservation of capital. Under normal circumstances, the adviser invests at least 80% of the fund's net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in corporate bonds. The fund primarily invests in corporate bonds maturing in the year 2035, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund may also invest in corporate bonds with maturity dates within six months prior to or after the fund's target maturity year. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: SPDR SSGA My2035 公司債 ETF 力求在尋求資本保全的同時實現當前收入最大化。在正常情況下，顧問將至少80%的基金淨資產（加上投資目的借款）投資於公司債。該基金主要投資於2035年到期的公司債券，其中可能包括嵌入發行人認購選擇權的債券。該基金還可以投資於到期日在基金目標到期年份之前或之後六個月內的公司債。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Infrastructure Capital Nasdaq Option Income ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that combines a long equity portfolio with dynamic options overlays to generate high monthly distribution returns while preserving capital appreciation potential. The fund utilizes a top-down macroeconomic framework to selectively buy and write short-duration put and call options alongside an actively managed, value-tilted stock portfolio that mirrors the economic risk profile of the Nasdaq Composite Index.
info.description_zh: 基礎設施資本納斯達克選擇權收益 ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，將長期股票投資組合與動態選擇權疊加相結合，產生高月度分配回報，同時保留資本增值潛力。該基金利用自上而下的宏觀經濟框架，選擇性地購買和賣出短期看跌期權和看漲期權，以及反映納斯達克綜合指數經濟風險狀況的積極管理、價值傾斜的股票投資組合。

info.description: First Trust Mid Cap Growth AlphaDEX Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the Nasdaq AlphaDEX Mid Cap Growth Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the common stocks that comprise the index. The index is designed to select growth stocks from the NASDAQ US 600 Mid Cap Index TM (the "base index") that may generate positive alpha, or risk-adjusted returns, relative to traditional indices through the use of the AlphaDEX selection methodology.
info.description_zh: First Trust Mid Cap Growth AlphaDEX 基金尋求的投資結果通常與稱為納斯達克 AlphaDEX Mid Cap Growth Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的普通股。該指數旨在從納斯達克美國 600 中型股指數 TM（「基礎指數」）中選擇成長型股票，透過使用 AlphaDEX 選擇方法，相對於傳統指數，這些股票可能會產生正的 alpha 或風險調整回報。

info.description: Lazard US Systematic Small Cap Equity ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The Portfolio invests primarily in equity securities, principally common stocks, of small capitalization U.S. companies. Under normal circumstances, the Portfolio invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of small cap U.S. companies. The Portfolio may invest up to 20% of its assets in other securities which need not be equity securities of small cap U.S. companies, including investments in larger U.S. companies and in non-U.S. companies, including securities of emerging markets companies traded on a U.S. exchange.
info.description_zh: Lazard 美國系統性小型股 ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該投資組合主要投資於美國小型公司的股本證券，主要是普通股。在正常情況下，該投資組合將至少80%的資產投資於美國小型企業的股本證券。投資組合最多可將其資產的 20% 投資於其他證券，這些證券不必是美國小型公司的股本證券，包括對大型美國公司和非美國公司的投資，包括在美國交易所交易的新興市場公司的證券。

info.description: Vanguard Target Maturity 2036 Corporate Bond ETF tracks a market-weighted index of U.S. dollar-denominated, investment-grade corporate bonds scheduled to mature within the calendar year 2036. This term fund employs a passive sampling strategy designed to provide predictable monthly income and a return of principal upon its scheduled liquidation on or about December 15, 2036.
info.description_zh: Vanguard Target Maturity 2036 Corporate Bond ETF 追蹤計畫於 2036 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債的市場加權指數。該定期基金採用被動抽樣策略，旨在在 2036 年 12 月 15 日左右的預定清算時提供可預測的月收入和本金回報。

info.description: State Street SPDR Portfolio Nasdaq 100 ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the total return performance of the Nasdaq 100 Index by employing a sampling strategy to invest in large-cap domestic and international non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq-affiliated exchanges. The Fund targets 100 of the largest non-financial equity securities across various market sectors-with key concentrations in technology and consumer discretionary-and employs a modified market-capitalization weighting methodology.
info.description_zh: State Street SPDR Portfolio Nasdaq 100 ETF採用抽樣策略投資於納斯達克附屬交易所上市的大型國內外非金融公司，力求提供與納斯達克100指數總回報表現大致相符的投資結果。該基金的目標是各市場領域中 100 隻最大的非金融股票證券（主要集中在技術和非必需消費品領域），並採用改進的市值加權方法。

info.description: Invesco Bulletshares 2036 Corporate Bond ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2036 Index. The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated investment grade corporate bonds with maturities or, in some cases, "effective maturities" in the year 2036. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco Bulletshares 2036 Corporate Bond ETF 旨在追蹤 Invesco BulletShares USD Corporate Bond 2036 指數的投資結果（未計費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 80% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。相關指數旨在衡量 2036 年到期的以美元計價的投資等級公司債投資組合的表現，或在某些情況下為「有效到期日」。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF seeks to track the investment results of the MSCI USA Choice ESG Screened Index (the "underlying index"). The underlying index is a free float-adjusted market capitalization-weighted index designed to reflect the equity performance of large- and mid-capitalization U.S. companies with favorable environmental, social and governance ("ESG") ratings while applying extensive screens, including removing fossil fuel exposure. The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its assets in the component securities of the underlying index. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: iShares ESG Advanced MSCI USA ETF 旨在追蹤 MSCI USA Choice ESG 篩選指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果。基礎指數是自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在反映具有良好環境、社會和治理（“ESG”）評級的大中型美國公司的股票表現，同時應用廣泛的篩選，包括消除化石燃料風險。該基金通常將至少 90% 的資產投資於相關指數的成分證券。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the NASDAQ-100 Index (the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. Strictly in accordance with its guidelines and mandated procedures, Nasdaq, Inc. ("Nasdaq" or the "index provider") compiles, maintains and calculates the underlying index, which includes securities of 100 of the largest domestic and international nonfinancial companies listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC based on market capitalization. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF 旨在追蹤 NASDAQ-100 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和支出）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。納斯達克公司（「納斯達克」或「指數提供者」）嚴格按照其指導方針和規定程序編制、維護和計算基礎指數，其中包括在納斯達克股票市場有限責任公司上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司的證券（按市值計算）。它是非多元化的。

info.description: F/M 10-Year Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF seeks results that correspond (before fees and expenses) generally to the price and yield performance of the [ICE BofA 10-Year Target Maturity Index]. Under normal market conditions, F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC seeks to achieve the F/m 10-Year Bond ETF's investment objective by investing at least 80% of the F/m 10-Year Bond ETF's net assets in the component securities of the underlying index. The [ICE BofA 10-Year Target Maurity Index] is an index comprised of U.S. investment-grade corporate bonds.
info.description_zh: F/M 10 年期投資等級公司債 ETF 尋求整體上與 [ICE BofA 10 年期目標到期指數] 的價格和收益率表現相對應的結果（未計費用和開支）。在正常市場條件下，F/m Investments, LLC d/b/a North Slope Capital, LLC 尋求透過將 F/m 10 年期債券 ETF 淨資產的至少 80% 投資於基礎指數的組成證券來實現 F/m 10 年期債券 ETF 的投資目標。 [ICE BofA 10 年目標毛利率指數] 是由美國投資等級公司債組成的指數。

info.description: Pacer Trendpilot 100 ETF seeks to track the total return performance, before fees and expenses, of the Pacer NASDAQ-100 Trendpilot Index. The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) in the component securities of the index. The index implements a systematic trend-following strategy that directs exposure (i) 100% to the NASDAQ-100 Index, (ii) 50% to the NASDAQ-100 and 50% to 3-Month U.S. Treasury bills, or (iii) 100% to 3-Month U.S. Treasury bills, depending on the relative performance of the NASDAQ-100 and its 200-business day historical simple moving average. It is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Pacer Trendpilot 100 ETF 旨在追蹤 Pacer NASDAQ-100 Trendpilot 指數在費用和支出之前的總回報表現。該基金將其總資產的至少 80%（不包括證券借貸所持有的抵押品）投資於該指數的成分證券。該指數實施系統性趨勢追蹤策略，將風險敞口 (i) 100% 投資於 NASDAQ-100 指數，(ii) 50% 投資於 NASDAQ-100 指數，50% 投資於 3 個月期美國國債，或 (iii) 100% 投資於 3 個月市場經濟指數 3 個月期美國國債，或 (iii) 100% 投資於 3 個月市場合理期。它是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco QQQ Trust seeks investment results that generally correspond to the price and yield performance of the NASDAQ-100 Index. To maintain the correspondence between the composition and weights of the securities in the trust (the "securities") and the stocks in the NASDAQ-100 Index, the adviser adjusts the securities from time to time to conform to periodic changes in the identity and/or relative weights of index securities. The composition and weighting of the securities portion of a portfolio deposit are also adjusted to conform to changes in the index.
info.description_zh: Invesco QQQ Trust 尋求通常與 NASDAQ-100 指數的價格和收益率表現相對應的投資結果。為了維持信託中的證券（「證券」）與 NASDAQ-100 指數中的股票的組成和權重之間的對應關係，顧問會不時調整證券，以符合指數證券的身份和/或相對權重的定期變化。投資組合存款的證券部分的組成和權重也會被調整，以適應指數的變化。

info.description: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF seeks to provide current income with consideration for capital appreciation. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by employing a targeted outcome strategy that is intended to optimize, in the opinion of Fund management, premium income generation and the potential for capital appreciation. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market. Investments in derivatives are counted toward the fund's 80% policy to the extent that they provide investment exposure to the securities included within that policy or to one or more market risk factors associated with such securities.
info.description_zh: iShares Nasdaq Premium Income Active ETF 旨在提供當前收入，同時考慮資本增值。該基金尋求透過採用有針對性的結果策略來實現其投資目標，該策略旨在根據基金管理層的意見優化保費收入的產生和資本增值的潛力。該基金將至少80%的淨資產投資於納斯達克股票市場上市的股票證券。衍生性商品投資計入基金的 80% 保單，只要它們提供對該保單中包含的證券或與此類證券相關的一個或多個市場風險因素的投資曝險。

info.description: Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF seeks to provide investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield performance,before fees and expenses, of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 Index ("underlying index"). The underlying index measures the performance of a risk management strategy that holds the underlying stocks of the NASDAQ 100 Index and applies an options collar strategy (i.e., a mix of short (sold) call options and long (purchased) put options) on the NASDAQ 100 Index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Global X NASDAQ 100 Collar 95-110 ETF 尋求提供與 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的價格和收益率表現（扣除費用和開支）大致相對應的投資結果。該基金將其總資產的至少 80% 投資於 Nasdaq-100 Quarterly Collar 95-110 指數（「基礎指數」）的證券。標的指數衡量持有納斯達克 100 指數標的股票的風險管理策略的績效，並對納斯達克 100 指數應用期權領策略（即空頭（賣出）看漲期權和多頭（買入）看跌期權的組合）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Horizon Kinetics Medical ETF seeks to provide long-term growth of capital. The fund is an actively-managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that pursues its investment objective by investing, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in common stocks, convertible securities, warrants and other equity securities having the characteristics of common stocks of U.S. and foreign companies engaged in medical research, pharmaceutical and medical technology industries and related technology industries. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Horizo​​n Kinetics Medical ETF 致力於提供長期的資本成長。該基金是一種主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），在正常情況下，透過將至少80%的淨資產加上任何用於投資目的的借款投資於從事醫學研究、製藥和醫療技術行業及相關技術行業的美國和外國公司的普通股、可轉換證券、認股權證和其他具有普通股特徵的股本證券來實現其投資目標。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Invesco ESG NASDAQ 100 ETF seeks to track the investment results (before fees and expenses) of the Nasdaq-100 ESG Index(the "underlying index"). The fund generally will invest at least 90% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the performance of companies included in the Nasdaq-100 Index (the "parent index") that also meet the index provider's ESG criteria. The parent index includes securities of 100 of the largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC based on market capitalization. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Invesco ESG NASDAQ 100 ETF 旨在追蹤 Nasdaq-100 ESG 指數（「基礎指數」）的投資結果（扣除費用和開支）。該基金通常將至少 90% 的總資產投資於構成標的指數的證券。基礎指數旨在衡量納斯達克 100 指數（「母指數」）中包含的公司的業績，這些公司也符合指數提供者的 ESG 標準。母指數包括在納斯達克股票市場有限責任公司上市的 100 家最大的國內和國際非金融公司的證券（按市值計算）。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Blaize Holdings, Inc. provides artificial intelligence solutions. It develops hardware computing platforms for augmented reality, drones, and automobiles. The company was founded by Dinakar C. Munagala, Satyaki Koneru, and Ke Yin in January 2010 and is headquartered in El Dorado Hills, CA.
